name.zh: 归档文件名编码差异

description.zh: 归档库、操作系统和业务层对反斜杠、标志位或文件名编码解释不同。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Archive Filename-Encoding Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: archive libraries, operating systems, and application layers interpret backslashes, flags, or filename encodings differently. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 归档文件名编码差异针对归档库、操作系统和业务层对反斜杠、标志位或文件名编码解释不同的场景：同一成员名在不同层含义不同。验证反斜杠分隔成员名的字节保留与解析差异。
overview.en: The archive filename-encoding differential targets archive libraries, operating systems, and business layers interpreting backslashes, flag bits, or filename encodings differently, giving one member name different meanings per layer. It validates byte preservation and parsing of backslash-separated member names.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是归档库、操作系统和业务层对反斜杠、标志位或文件名编码解释不同；只有当解释差异使成员写入或读取跨越目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is archive libraries, operating systems, and business layers interpreting backslashes, flag bits, or filename encodings differently; risk holds only when interpretation gaps push member writes or reads across a directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的脚本构造以反斜杠分隔的成员名并输出 repr、flag_bits 与归档原始字节，确认归档库实际保留的文件名字节；再把归档交给目标解压流程，命中判据为某一层把反斜杠当分隔符折叠成目录结构并写出 PAYLOADER_MARKER。记录各层解析出的成员名对照；处理含中文或特殊编码文件名时同样保留原始字节证据。
exploitation.en: Construct backslash-separated member names with the step-1 script, outputting repr, flag_bits, and the archive's raw bytes to confirm what the archive library actually preserves; then hand the archive to the target extraction flow. A hit is any layer folding backslashes into directory structure and writing PAYLOADER_MARKER. Record each layer's parsed member names as a contrast; keep raw-byte evidence for non-ASCII or specially encoded names too.

mitigation.zh:
统一各层对成员名的解释：含反斜杠、绝对路径、盘符、父目录段或控制字节的文件名按字面拒绝，再执行目标目录边界校验。
    if '\\' in zi.filename or zi.filename.startswith(('/', 'C:')) \
            or '..' in zi.filename.split('/') or '\x00' in zi.filename:
        raise ValueError(f'bad member name: {zi.filename}')
mitigation.en: Normalize and verify each member target, reject parent-directory, absolute, and link members, unify filename-encoding interpretation across layers, and use safe extraction APIs in an isolated temp directory. After the fix, replay the step-1 archive and confirm backslash members are rejected literally while normal extraction works.

description.en: Archive Member-Path Normalization narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the extractor does not verify that a normalized member path remains inside the destination before writing. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 归档成员路径规范化针对解压器在写入前未验证成员路径的场景：zip-slip 成员可在解压时越过目标目录。验证构造含 ../outside 成员的 ZIP 后，解压端归一化行为是否越界。
overview.en: Archive member-path normalization targets extractors that do not validate member paths before writing: zip-slip members can escape the target directory during extraction. It builds a ZIP containing a ../outside member and checks whether the extractor's normalization stays in bounds.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解压器在写入前未验证成员路径规范化后仍位于目标目录；只有当成员写入跨越目标目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is extractors not verifying that member paths remain inside the target directory after normalization before writing; risk holds only when member writes cross the target-directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的脚本构造含 ../outside 成员的测试 ZIP 并列出全部原始成员名，确认成员路径按预期构造；然后把归档交给目标解压流程执行，命中判据为成员被写到解压根目录之外（outside 目录出现 PAYLOADER_MARKER）。记录解压器返回的规范化成员名与实际落盘位置形成对照；测试完成后清理越界文件并恢复环境。
exploitation.en: Build a test ZIP containing a ../outside member with the step-1 script and list all raw member names to confirm construction; then hand the archive to the target extraction flow. A hit is the member written outside the extraction root (PAYLOADER_MARKER appearing in the outside directory). Record the extractor's normalized member names versus actual on-disk locations as a contrast; clean up escaped files and restore the environment afterwards.

mitigation.en: Normalize and verify each member target, reject parent-directory, absolute, and link members, and use safe extraction APIs in an isolated temp directory. After the fix, replay the step-1 zip-slip archive and confirm writes are rejected while normal archive extraction is unaffected.

description.zh: 空字节、路径填充或分隔符变体在旧式组件之间被截断或二次规范化。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Download Legacy-Terminator Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: null bytes, path padding, or separator variants are truncated or renormalized across legacy components. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 文件下载旧式终止符边界针对空字节、路径填充或分隔符变体在旧式组件之间被截断或二次规范化的场景。验证 %00、%00.txt、点填充、....//、..; 与反斜杠变体的截断差异。
overview.en: The file-download legacy-terminator boundary targets null bytes, path padding, or separator variants being truncated or re-normalized between legacy components. It contrasts truncation behavior across %00, %00.txt, dot padding, ....//, ..;, and backslash variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是空字节、路径填充或分隔符变体在旧式组件之间被截断或二次规范化；只有当截断使最终文件名越过类型或目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is null bytes, path padding, or separator variants being truncated or re-normalized between legacy components; risk holds only when truncation pushes the final filename past a type or directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以 %00、%00.txt、点填充、....//、..; 与反斜杠变体对同一路径逐条请求；命中判据为某一变体在截断或折叠后返回根目录外的 PAYLOADER_MARKER 内容。每条请求记录发送值与最终解析文件名，形成校验层与文件系统层的对照；%00 类变体阴性时注明运行时版本，作为现代组件已拒绝空字节的证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, request the same path with the %00, %00.txt, dot-padding, ....//, ..;, and backslash variants one by one; a hit is any variant returning out-of-root PAYLOADER_MARKER content after truncation or folding. Record the sent value and final resolved filename per request as a validation-layer versus filesystem-layer contrast; when %00 variants are negative, note the runtime version as evidence that modern components reject null bytes.

mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result. After the fix, replay the step-1 terminator variants alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate downloads keep working.

description.zh: 请求正常下载判断组件年代与解码行为，推断其对终止符的敏感程度。命中判据：入口对编码变体存在明显反应。

overview.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异针对下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间不一致的场景。验证 ../、....//、单次与双重编码、反斜杠五类遍历变体加两个对照路径的解码与最终路径差异，以 marker 回读为准。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间出现不一致；只有当差异使最终路径越过预期目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 download 参数依次施加 ../、....//、单次与双重编码、反斜杠五类遍历变体并记录每次响应；命中判据为某一变体返回根目录外 PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt 的内容。再用第 2 步以纯查询串形式重放双重编码与反斜杠变体，对照 curl 场景验证不同入口的解码顺序差异；两条路径的命中都应记录最终解析路径作为证据。

Then replay the double-encoding and backslash variants as pure query strings per step 2, contrasting decoding-order differences between entry points; record the final resolved path for every hit as evidence.

mitigation.en: Use server-side object identifiers, unify decoding and normalization, and enforce root-directory and scheme allowlists before opening files. overview.zh: 文件下载流包装器边界针对下载参数被文件系统之外的 URI 或运行时 stream wrapper 解析的场景。验证六个常见参数名的遍历探测与 file://、php://filter 两类 wrapper 的接受情况。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是下载参数被文件系统之外的 URI 或运行时 stream wrapper 解析；只有当 wrapper 解释结果跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。

mitigation.en: Use server-side object identifiers, unify decoding and normalization, enforce root-directory and scheme allowlists before opening files, and reject all wrapper URIs. title.zh: 文件下载流包装器边界验证块 1
title.en: File Download Stream-Wrapper Boundary Validation Block 1

description.zh: 用六个常见参数名探测 ../ 遍历，再以 file:// 与 php://filter wrapper 读取 marker，验证下载参数接受非文件系统 URI 与运行时 wrapper。

name.zh: PHP 文件包含运行时边界

description.zh: 动态 include 参数可选择本地文件、会话或 PHP stream wrapper 而不是固定模板。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: PHP File-Inclusion Runtime Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a dynamic include parameter selects local files, sessions, or PHP stream wrappers instead of fixed templates. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: PHP 文件包含运行时边界针对动态 include 参数可选择本地文件、会话或 PHP stream wrapper 的场景：包含目标不再是固定模板。验证本地 marker 的 log/env/会话文件包含与 php://filter base64 读取两类行为。
overview.en: The PHP file-inclusion runtime boundary targets dynamic include parameters able to select local files, sessions, or PHP stream wrappers instead of fixed templates. It validates including local marker log/env/session files and php://filter Base64 reads.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是动态 include 参数可选择本地文件、会话或 PHP stream wrapper 而不是固定模板；只有当选择结果跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a dynamic include parameter able to select local files, sessions, or PHP stream wrappers instead of fixed templates; risk holds only when the selection crosses an expected directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留 BASE 变量后先包含本地 marker 的 log/env/会话文件，确认动态 include 对常规文件的选择行为；再用 php://filter 加 convert.base64-encode 读取同一 marker 文件，命中判据为返回的 Base64 解码后等于 marker 内容。两类命中分别记录最终解析路径与 wrapper 日志；若包含的是会话文件，同时核对会话内容是否被解释执行。
exploitation.en: Keeping the BASE variable as in step 1, first include the local marker's log/env/session files to confirm dynamic include's selection of regular files; then read the same marker via php://filter with convert.base64-encode—a hit is returned Base64 decoding to the marker content. Record final resolved paths and wrapper logs for both hit classes; when a session file is included, also check whether its content is interpreted and executed.

mitigation.zh:
用户输入一律不进入 include/require：页面选择走逻辑键到固定模板的白名单映射，运行时关闭远程包含与流包装器。
    $tpl = ['home' => __DIR__ . '/tpl/home.php',
            'about' => __DIR__ . '/tpl/about.php'];
    require $tpl[$_GET['page'] ? ''] ? $tpl['home'];
    ; php.ini
    allow_url_include = Off
    allow_url_fopen = Off
mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result; keep user input out of include/require. After the fix, replay every step-1 inclusion target and confirm uniform rejection while fixed template loading keeps working.

description.zh: 找到传入 include 的参数并用正常路径摸清包含行为与响应差异。命中判据：包含内容随参数取值变化。
description.en: Find the parameter feeding include and probe it with normal paths. Success: content changes with the parameter.

attackChain.payload:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080/include?path="
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../fixtures/PAYLOADER_MARKER.log"

curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../fixtures/sess_PAYLOADER_MARKER"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
printf "%s\n" "require exact marker output and final include path audit"

description.en: Include log/env/session files and read them via the base64 filter. Success: the marker content is returned.

name.zh: 文件元数据二次解析注入

description.zh: 入口只校验文件容器，而缩略图、索引或元数据提取器继续解析可控字段。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Metadata Downstream-Parser Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: ingress validates only the container while thumbnailing, indexing, or metadata extraction parses controlled fields. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文档活动内容与公式注入

overview.zh: 文件元数据下游解析边界针对入口只校验文件容器而缩略图、索引或元数据提取器继续解析可控字段的场景。验证用 exiftool 向 JPEG 三个元数据字段写入 marker 后的写入与回读。
overview.en: The file-metadata downstream-parser boundary targets entries validating only the file container while thumbnailers, indexers, or metadata extractors keep parsing attacker-controlled fields. It validates writing markers into three JPEG metadata fields with exiftool and reading them back.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是入口只校验文件容器，而缩略图、索引或元数据提取器继续解析可控字段；只有当字段内容进入有副作用的下游解析器时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the entry validating only the container while thumbnailers, indexers, or metadata extractors keep parsing controlled fields; risk holds only when field content reaches downstream parsers with side effects.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步复制夹具 JPG 到临时工作目录，用 exiftool 向 Comment、XMP Description 与 ICC ProfileDescription 写入 PAYLOADER_MARKER 并以 -json 回读；命中判据为三个字段均按预期写入且可被读取，证明元数据可控字段可到达下游解析器。随后在授权范围内让目标业务处理该文件，观察缩略图或索引层是否读取这些字段，并记录处理日志。
exploitation.en: Copy the fixture JPG into a temp working directory as in step 1, write PAYLOADER_MARKER into Comment, XMP Description, and ICC ProfileDescription with exiftool, and read back with -json; a hit is all three fields written and readable as expected, proving controllable metadata fields reach downstream parsers. Then have the target business process the file within scope, observing whether thumbnailing or indexing reads these fields, and record processing logs.

mitigation.zh:
上传入库前剥离非必要元数据字段，下游解析器以最小权限在隔离环境运行并启用严格字段允许列表。
    exiftool -all= -overwrite_original "$tmp/$stored"   # 剥离全部元数据
    # 下游解析隔离：无网络、独立文件系统视图
    firejail --noprofile --net=none --private=/srv/sandbox -- exiftool -ver
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, strip or rewrite non-essential metadata fields at upload, and enforce strict field allowlists on downstream parsers; run processing containers isolated. After the fix, replay the step-1 write flow and confirm controlled fields are removed while normal image features work.

description.zh: 用 exiftool 向 JPEG 的 Comment、XMP 与 ICC 字段写入内容并以 JSON 回读。命中判据：三个字段均写入成功。
description.en: Write marker content into Comment, XMP and ICC fields via exiftool. Success: all three fields accept it.

attackChain.payload:
WORK=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
cp "./payloader-fixture/fixture.jpg" "$WORK/marker.jpg"
exiftool -overwrite_original -Comment="PAYLOADER_MARKER" "$WORK/marker.jpg"
exiftool -overwrite_original -XMP-dc:Description="PAYLOADER_MARKER" "$WORK/marker.jpg"
exiftool -overwrite_original -ICC_Profile:ProfileDescription="PAYLOADER_MARKER" "$WORK/marker.jpg" || true
exiftool -json -Comment -XMP-dc:Description -ICC_Profile:ProfileDescription "$WORK/marker.jpg"
grep --binary-files=text --fixed-strings "PAYLOADER_MARKER" "$WORK/marker.jpg" >/dev/null

description.zh: 提交写入元数据的文件，触发下游组件解析其中的字段内容。命中判据：解析流程实际读取了注入字段，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Submit the file so downstream parses its metadata. Success: the injected fields are consumed.

title.zh: 借解析缺陷执行注入内容

description.zh: 让注入内容进入执行或请求路径，实现 SSRF 或代码执行效果。命中判据：注入产生可观测的副作用，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Steer injected content into execution or request paths. Success: an observable side effect fires.

name.zh: 文件路径长度截断差异

description.zh: 超长路径在校验、数据库和文件系统边界采用不同长度限制或截断策略。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Path-Length Truncation Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: overlong paths encounter different limits or truncation policies in validation, persistence, and filesystem layers. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件名与文件系统边界

overview.zh: 文件路径长度截断差异针对超长路径在校验、数据库和文件系统边界采用不同长度限制的场景：截断点不同导致最终文件名不同。验证 /./ 填充、长字母尾缀与多点尾缀三类超长变体。
overview.en: File path-length truncation differentials target overlong paths hitting different length limits across validation, database, and filesystem boundaries—different truncation points yield different final filenames. It validates three overlong variant classes: /./ padding, long letter suffixes, and multi-dot suffixes.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是超长路径在校验、数据库和文件系统边界采用不同长度限制或截断策略；只有当截断使最终文件名越过目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overlong paths hitting different length limits or truncation policies across validation, database, and filesystem boundaries; risk holds only when truncation pushes the final filename past a directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的验证块逐条提交 /./ 填充、长字母尾缀与多点尾缀三类超长路径变体，每条记录发送长度与最终解析文件名；命中判据为某一变体在截断后指向根目录外的 PAYLOADER_MARKER。对照校验层接受的长度与文件系统实际处理的长度；阴性时记录各层长度上限，作为现代系统已统一截断的证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit the three overlong variant classes—/./ padding, long letter suffixes, and multi-dot suffixes—one by one, recording sent length and final resolved filename per request; a hit is any variant pointing at the out-of-root PAYLOADER_MARKER after truncation. Contrast the length accepted at validation versus what the filesystem actually processed; when negative, record each layer's length cap as evidence modern systems truncate uniformly.

mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, unify length caps across layers, and validate the final path before opening. After the fix, replay all step-1 overlong variants and confirm the truncation divergence is gone while legitimate reads keep working.

description.zh: 找到对超长路径敏感的读取或包含入口并摸清行为。命中判据：超长路径没有被入口直接拒绝，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Find a read/include entry that tolerates very long paths. Success: long paths are not rejected outright.

description.en: Submit /./ padding, letter and multi-dot suffix variants. Success: a length triggers truncation.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 超长路径触发截断差异。判据：截断后仍指向目标文件。
description.en: Overlong path triggers truncation. Success: still resolves to the target after truncation.

description.zh: 超长文件名在旧系统截断。判据：截断后保留 .txt 之前可利用形态。
description.en: Long name truncates on legacy systems. Success: exploitable form survives.

description.zh: 超过 260 触发不同解析。判据：长路径被规范化绕过。
description.en: Beyond 260 chars changes parsing. Success: normalization bypassed.

title.zh: 文件路径长度截断差异验证块 1
title.en: File Path-Length Truncation Differential Validation Block 1

description.zh: 列出 /./ 填充、长字母尾缀与多点尾缀三种超长路径变体，验证校验层与文件系统层在不同截断点上的差异。
description.en: Lists three overlong-path variants (/./ padding, a long letter tail, a multi-dot tail), exposing where the validation layer and the filesystem truncate differently.

name.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断

description.zh: 终止字节、短名和路径填充在旧式解析链上改变最终文件名。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Path-Traversal Legacy Termination and Truncation narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: terminator bytes, short names, and path padding alter the final filename in a legacy parsing chain. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断针对终止字节、短名和路径填充在旧式解析链上改变最终文件名的场景。验证 %00、%2500、8.3 短名、/./ 填充与尾缀点空格五类变体的最终文件名差异。
overview.en: Path-traversal legacy termination and truncation targets terminator bytes, short names, and path padding changing the final filename across legacy parsing chains. It contrasts final filenames across five variant classes: %00, %2500, 8.3 short names, /./ padding, and trailing dot/space.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是终止字节、短名和路径填充在旧式解析链上改变最终文件名；只有当变化使最终目标越过目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is terminator bytes, short names, and path padding changing the final filename across legacy parsing chains; risk holds only when the change pushes the final target past a directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的验证块逐条提交 %00、%2500、8.3 短名、/./ 填充与尾缀点空格五类变体，每条记录发送值与最终解析文件名；命中判据为某一变体的最终文件名与校验层判定不同并指向根目录外的 marker。%00 类变体阴性时记录运行时版本，说明现代组件已拒绝空字节，避免误报。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit the five variant classes—%00, %2500, 8.3 short names, /./ padding, and trailing dot/space—one by one, recording sent value and final resolved filename per request; a hit is a final filename differing from the validation verdict and pointing at the out-of-root marker. When %00 variants are negative, record the runtime version showing modern components reject null bytes to avoid false positives.

mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result. After the fix, replay the step-1 terminator variants alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate reads keep working.

description.zh: 摸清接受路径参数的读取或包含接口的响应形态与限制。命中判据：路径变化会直接改变返回内容，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Map how the path-taking endpoint responds to input. Success: path changes alter the response.

description.zh: 以 %00、%2500、8.3 短名、/./ 填充与点空格尾缀变体请求目标路径。命中判据：某类变体命中文件。
description.en: Try %00, %2500, 8.3 names, /./ padding and dot-space suffixes. Success: a class hits the file.

title.zh: 命中截断打开目标文件

description.zh: 用命中的变体构造路径，读取受限目录中的目标文件。命中判据：目标文件内容成功返回到响应中，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Craft paths with the working variant to read restricted files. Success: file content returns.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 已备好终止字节与路径填充的解析链对照与最终文件名日志。
prerequisites.en: Terminator-byte and path-padding contrasts across the parse chain are ready, with final-filename logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是字节级请求、运行时解析日志和唯一 marker 输出三者一致，普通输入与缺失 marker 对照均失败。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 双重解码还原截断。判据：返回 passwd。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double decode restores truncation. Success: passwd returned. Fails when: only holds on architectures that perform a second URL decode.

description.zh: Windows 分隔符加截断。判据：读出文件。失效条件：仅 PHP<5.3.4 或自研 C 层截断成立，现代解析器已修复。
description.en: Windows separators plus truncation. Success: file read. Fails when: holds only on PHP below 5.3.4 or custom C-level truncation; modern parsers reject null bytes in paths.

description.zh: 分号段被代理剥离。判据：200。
description.en: Semicolon segments stripped by proxies. Success: 200.

title.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断验证块 1
title.en: Path-Traversal Legacy Termination and Truncation Validation Block 1

description.zh: 列出 %00、%2500、8.3 短名、/./ 填充与尾缀点空格五类终止符变体，验证终止字节、短名与填充在旧式解析链上的最终文件名变化。
description.en: Lists five terminator variants (%00, %2500, 8.3 short name, /./ padding, trailing dot-space), showing how termination bytes, short names, and padding change the final filename on legacy parse chains.

name.zh: POSIX 路径遍历规范化

description.zh: 相对段在应用过滤后由 POSIX 路径解析继续折叠并越过允许根目录。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: POSIX Path-Traversal Normalization narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: relative segments are folded by POSIX path resolution after filtering and escape the allowed root. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: POSIX 路径遍历规范化针对相对段在应用过滤后仍由 POSIX 路径解析继续折叠的场景。验证按深度 1-4 递增的 ../ 遍历，确定折叠与根目录回退的真实行为，以 marker 命中深度为证据。
overview.en: POSIX path-traversal normalization targets relative segments that keep collapsing through POSIX path resolution after application filtering. It validates ../ traversal at depths 1-4 to determine real folding and root-fallback behavior, using the hit depth as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是相对段在应用过滤后由 POSIX 路径解析继续折叠并越过允许根目录；只有当折叠使最终路径越过目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is relative segments continuing to collapse through POSIX path resolution after application filtering and escaping the allowed root; risk holds only when folding pushes the final path past a directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的循环以深度 1、2、3、4 依次发送 ../ 遍历并请求 PAYLOADER_MARKER；命中判据为某一深度返回 marker 内容，脚本会打印命中 depth。记录首个命中深度与最终解析路径，说明应用过滤与 POSIX 折叠之间的差异数量；随后可在同一入口测试双重编码变体扩大对照面。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, send ../ traversal at depths 1, 2, 3, and 4 in a loop requesting PAYLOADER_MARKER; a hit is marker content at some depth, and the script prints the hit depth. Record the first hit depth and final resolved path to quantify the gap between application filtering and POSIX folding; then broaden the contrast with double-encoding variants on the same endpoint.

mitigation.zh:
拒绝绝对路径、设备文件与父目录段，用户输入限定为纯文件名，最终以 realpath 结果做根目录前缀校验后再打开。
    root = os.path.realpath(BASE_DIR)
    if '/' in name or '..' in name or '\x00' in name:
        abort(400)
    target = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(root, name))
    if os.path.commonpath([root, target]) != root:
        abort(403)
mitigation.en: Reject absolute, device, and parent-directory forms, access files through a confined directory handle, and run boundary checks on the final path. After the fix, replay the step-1 depth samples alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate reads keep working.

description.zh: 找到接收路径的读取或下载参数并请求正常文件记录行为。命中判据：路径参数直接决定返回的内容，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Find the path-taking parameter and fetch a normal file. Success: the parameter drives returned content.

attackChain.payload:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080/file?path="
for depth in 1 2 3 4; do
  traversal=$(printf "../%.0s" $(seq 1 "$depth"))
  value=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}${traversal}outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt" || true)
  [ "$value" = "PAYLOADER_MARKER" ] && printf "marker_read depth=%s\n" "$depth"
done

description.zh: 按深度 1 到 4 循环提交 ../ 前缀路径，观察哪一深度命中根外文件。命中判据：某深度返回标记内容。
description.en: Loop ../ at depths 1-4 to see which escapes the root. Success: a depth returns the marker content.

attackChain.payload:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080/file?path="
for depth in 1 2 3 4; do
  traversal=$(printf "../%.0s" $(seq 1 "$depth"))
  value=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}${traversal}outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt" || true)
  [ "$value" = "PAYLOADER_MARKER" ] && printf "marker_read depth=%s\n" "$depth"
done

description.zh: 用命中的深度构造路径读取 passwd 与应用配置，并把结果外带。命中判据：接收端收到完整文件内容。
description.en: With the winning depth, read passwd and configs and exfiltrate. Success: the collector receives content.

analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the unique marker outside the approved root is read and canonical-path or network-resolution logs correlate exactly with the request ID. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

description.zh: 多斜杠规范化等价绝对路径。判据：200 返回内容。

title.zh: POSIX 路径遍历规范化验证块 1

name.zh: UNC 路径遍历

description.zh: 应用把用户路径传给支持 UNC 的 Windows API 并触发网络解析。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: UNC Path Resolution Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the application passes a user path to a Windows API that accepts UNC and triggers network resolution. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: UNC 路径解析边界针对应用把用户路径传给支持 UNC 的 Windows API 并触发网络解析的场景：\\host\share 形式可发起出站连接。验证指向受控域名的 UNC 路径能否触发解析行为。
overview.en: The UNC path resolution boundary targets user paths passed to UNC-capable Windows APIs, triggering network resolution: \\host\share forms can create outbound connections. It validates whether a UNC path pointing at a controlled domain triggers resolution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把用户路径传给支持 UNC 的 Windows API 并触发网络解析；只有当解析行为产生出站连接或越界读取时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user paths passed to UNC-capable Windows APIs, triggering network resolution; risk holds only when resolution produces outbound connections or out-of-bounds reads.

exploitation.zh: 在受控 DNS 或监控主机上准备捕获，再按第 1 步复用受控入口的 BASE 变量提交指向 example.invalid 的 UNC 路径；命中判据为响应返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本或 UNC 解析日志记录对应查询。记录出站查询的目标与协议作为证据；生产环境测试时必须使用自有域名，避免指向真实内部主机。
exploitation.en: Prepare a capture on controlled DNS or a monitoring host, then submit a UNC path pointing at example.invalid reusing the controlled entry's BASE variable as in step 1; a hit is the response returning PAYLOADER_MARKER text or the UNC resolution log recording the query. Record the outbound query target and protocol as evidence; on production tests always use your own domain, never real internal hosts.

mitigation.en: Reject absolute, device, and parent-directory forms as well as UNC paths, access files through a confined directory handle, and run boundary checks on the final path; restrict service-account outbound SMB. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm no UNC queries occur while legitimate reads keep working.

description.zh: 找到接受路径的接口参数并摸清正常响应形态与限制。命中判据：参数可控并能直接影响文件访问结果，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Find the path-taking parameter and its normal behavior. Success: the parameter steers file access.

description.en: Submit %5c%5c UNC paths and watch for server-side resolution. Success: content returns or resolution logs appear.

title.zh: 指向攻击者共享捕获凭据

description.zh: 把 UNC 主机指向攻击者侧 SMB 监听，触发目标认证回连。命中判据：捕获到 NTLM 请求或哈希。
description.en: Aim the UNC host at an attacker SMB listener. Success: an NTLM request or hash is captured.

title.zh: UNC 路径解析边界验证块 1
title.en: UNC Path Resolution Boundary Validation Block 1

description.zh: 该请求复用受控入口的 BASE 变量并只指向 example.invalid。命中判据：响应返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本或 UNC 解析日志记录对应查询。
description.en: This request reuses the controlled endpoint BASE variable and points only to example.invalid. Success check: the response returns the PAYLOADER_MARKER text, or the UNC resolution log records the query.

name.zh: Windows 路径遍历规范化

description.zh: 反斜杠、驱动器路径和 8.3 短名在 Windows 层绕过上层字符串过滤。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Windows Path-Traversal Normalization narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: backslashes, drive paths, and 8.3 short names bypass string filters before Windows resolution. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: Windows 路径遍历规范化针对反斜杠、驱动器路径和 8.3 短名在 Windows 层绕过上层字符串过滤的场景。验证驱动器、反斜杠与短文件名三类变体在过滤与文件系统两层之间的解释差异。
overview.en: Windows path-traversal normalization targets backslashes, drive paths, and 8.3 short names bypassing upper-layer string filtering at the Windows layer. It contrasts interpretation across filtering and filesystem layers for drive, backslash, and short-name variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是反斜杠、驱动器路径和 8.3 短名在 Windows 层绕过上层字符串过滤；只有当两层的解释差异使最终路径越过目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is backslashes, drive paths, and 8.3 short names bypassing upper-layer string filtering at the Windows layer; risk holds only when the two layers' interpretation gap pushes the final path past a directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留 BASE 变量后逐条提交驱动器（C:%5c…）、反斜杠与 8.3 短文件名变体；命中判据为短文件名或反斜杠变体返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本。每条记录发送值与最终解析路径，标注 Windows 版本与服务器组件，因为短名生成与反斜杠折叠行为随版本不同。
exploitation.en: Keeping the BASE variable as in step 1, submit drive (C:%5c…), backslash, and 8.3 short-name variants one by one; a hit is short-name or backslash variants returning the PAYLOADER_MARKER text. Record sent value and final resolved path per request, noting the Windows version and server component, since short-name generation and backslash folding vary by version.

mitigation.en: Reject absolute, device, and parent-directory forms, access files through a confined directory handle, and run boundary checks on the final path; disable 8.3 short names (NtfsDisable8dot3NameCreation). After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and confirm uniform rejection while legitimate reads keep working.

title.zh: 判断 Windows 目标形态

description.zh: 从响应与路径行为判断目标是否为 Windows 文件系统处理。命中判据：反斜杠与盘符形式被服务端接受。
description.en: Judge from responses whether paths hit a Windows filesystem. Success: backslash and drive forms are accepted.

title.en: Read via drive and short-name forms

description.zh: 提交盘符、反斜杠与 8.3 短文件名变体请求目标文件。命中判据：短名或反斜杠变体返回文件内容，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Submit drive-letter, backslash and 8.3 short-name variants. Success: a variant returns the content.

title.en: Use short names to slip filters

description.zh: 用 8.3 短名形式访问被过滤规则拦截的长文件名目标。命中判据：目标文件内容成功返回响应，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Access filtered long names via their 8.3 short forms. Success: the target content is returned.

prerequisites.zh: 已在 Windows 夹具准备 8.3 短名与反斜杠解析的分层日志。
prerequisites.en: The Windows fixture has per-layer logs ready for 8.3 short-name and backslash resolution.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是批准根目录外的唯一 marker 被读取，且规范路径或网络解析日志与请求 ID 精确关联。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the unique marker outside the approved root is read and canonical-path or network-resolution logs correlate exactly with the request ID. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 盘符与分隔符全编码。判据：200。

name.zh: Content-Type 欺骗上传

description.zh: 客户端声明的 Content-Type 被当作可信文件类型而未与内容和扩展名交叉校验。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Declared-Type Mismatch narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the client-declared Content-Type is trusted without checking content and extension. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传声明类型不一致针对客户端声明 Content-Type 被当作可信文件类型的场景：声明与内容、扩展名可能不一致。验证以 image/jpeg 声明上传文本 marker 后服务端的分类与存储行为。
overview.en: Upload declared-type mismatch targets client-declared Content-Type treated as trusted file type, which can diverge from content and extension. It uploads a text marker declared as image/jpeg and contrasts the server's classification and storage behavior.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是客户端声明的 Content-Type 被当作可信文件类型而未与内容和扩展名交叉校验；只有当分类结果跨越类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is client-declared Content-Type treated as trusted file type without cross-checking content and extension; risk holds only when the classification crosses a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留 BASE 与 MARKER 变量，以 type=image/jpeg 声明上传文本 marker，再对照正常声明上传一份；命中判据为 HEAD 回读确认存储成功且声明类型被记录为分类依据，与另一份形成对照。记录声明类型、检测类型与存储名三个字段；若服务端把声明为图片的文件送入图片处理链，需单独评估解析器暴露面。
exploitation.en: Keeping the BASE and MARKER variables as in step 1, upload the text marker declared as type=image/jpeg, then upload a control with the honest declaration; a hit is HEAD read-back confirming storage with the declared type recorded as the classification basis, contrasting with the control. Record declared type, detected type, and stored name; if image-declared files enter the image-processing chain, separately assess parser exposure.

mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names and validate name, content, and type uniformly under target filesystem semantics, treating declarations as hints only; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay both step-1 declarations and confirm classification follows real content, not declarations, while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 上传普通文件记录响应与存储信息，摸清入口参数与处理流程。命中判据：正常上传链路完整可用可重复，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Upload a benign file and capture response and storage info. Success: the normal flow works.

description.zh: 以 image/jpeg 声明上传文本内容文件并回读，测试声明是否被直接采信。命中判据：上传成功且类型按声明记录。
description.en: Upload a text body declared as image/jpeg and read it back. Success: it is stored under the declared type.

description.zh: 回读上传对象确认存储路径与元数据的实际形态。命中判据：对象按伪造的声明类型保存落盘，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Read the object back to confirm storage and metadata. Success: it persists under the fake type.

title.zh: 触发下游按假类型处理

description.en: Let downstream parse it under the wrong type. Success: an exploitable parsing deviation appears.

name.zh: 上传双重写入扩展名

description.zh: 过滤器以单次字符串替换删除黑名单扩展片段，而重复构造的文件名在清洗后重新拼出受保护后缀。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Double-Write Extension Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a filter strips extension fragments with replacement and allows a protected suffix to re-form after one pass. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传双重写入扩展名针对过滤器通过重复字符串替换删除扩展片段的场景：单次清洗后受保护后缀会重新拼合。验证 ttxtxt、tTxTxt 等变体在清洗与落盘两个阶段的差异。
overview.en: Upload double-write extensions target filters that delete extension fragments via repeated string replacement, letting protected suffixes reassemble after a single cleaning pass. It contrasts the cleaning and storage phases across ttxtxt, tTxTxt, and related variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器以单次字符串替换删除黑名单扩展片段，重复构造的文件名在单次清洗后重新拼出受保护后缀；只有当重组后的扩展名越过处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a filter deleting extension fragments through repeated string replacement, reassembling the protected suffix after a single cleaning pass; risk holds only when the reassembled extension crosses a handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的验证块以 PAYLOADER_MARKER.ttxtxt、tTxTxt、txttxtt、aasasa 等双重写入变体逐条上传，每条上传后按原文件名 HEAD 回读；命中判据为清洗后的存储名重新拼出受保护扩展名（如 .txt 或 .php），记录清洗输入、清洗输出与落盘名三者对照作为证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, upload the double-write variants PAYLOADER_MARKER.ttxtxt, tTxTxt, txttxtt, and aasasa one by one, HEAD-reading back under the original filename after each; a hit is the cleaned storage name reassembling the protected extension (e.g., .txt or .php)—record the cleaning input, cleaned output, and stored name as three-way contrast evidence.

mitigation.zh:
停止单次字符串替换式清洗（黑名单必被双重写入重组绕过），改为对最终规范化名称执行允许列表校验；服务端生成对象名；上传目录不可执行。
    # Python：只认白名单，不做任何"删后缀再拼"的清洗
    ext = os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower()
    if ext not in {'.jpg', '.png', '.pdf'}:
        raise UploadRejected(name)   # ttxtxt 之类直接拒绝
    stored = f'{uuid4().hex}{ext}'
mitigation.en: Stop string-replacement cleaning; validate the final normalized name against an allowlist and generate server-side object names; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 double-write variants and confirm stored names no longer reassemble protected suffixes while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 提交含敏感片段的文件名，观察服务端字符串替换清洗的行为细节。命中判据：确认存在单次替换式清洗逻辑，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Submit names with sensitive fragments to observe replace-based sanitizing. Success: a single-pass replace is confirmed.

name.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异

description.zh: 大小写、多扩展名、编码和服务器映射规则对允许扩展产生不同结论。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Extension Normalization Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: case, multiple extensions, encoding, and server mapping rules produce different allowlist decisions. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异针对大小写、多扩展名、编码与服务器映射规则对同一文件名产生不同结论的场景。验证入口值、规范化结果与最终存储扩展名之间的一致性，以唯一 marker 建立可重复对照。
overview.en: Upload extension normalization differential targets scenarios where case, multi-extension, encoding, and server mapping rules reach different conclusions for the same filename. It compares the entry value, normalized result, and final stored extension, using a unique marker for repeatable contrasts.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是大小写、多扩展名、编码和服务器映射规则对允许扩展产生不同结论；只有当差异跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that case, multi-extension, encoding, and server-mapping rules reach different conclusions about allowed extensions; risk holds only when the difference crosses an expected directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步与第 2 步的验证块逐条上传：先测 PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt.jpg、%00 截断、.phtml/.php5 替代扩展与大小写变体，再对照写入顺序、ADS（::$DATA）、分号截断与尾随点/空格；每条上传后回读存储名并记录接受状态与原因。命中判据为某一变体的最终存储扩展名越过允许扩展边界，形成跨处理器的存储结果对照。
exploitation.en: Upload item by item through the verification blocks of steps 1 and 2: first test PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt.jpg, %00 truncation, .phtml/.php5 alternatives, and case variants; then contrast write order, ADS (::$DATA), semicolon truncation, and trailing dot/space. Read back the stored name after each upload and record acceptance status and reason. A hit is any variant whose final stored extension crosses the allowed-extension boundary, forming a cross-handler storage contrast.

mitigation.zh:
放弃用户文件名，由服务端生成对象名（随机 ID+白名单扩展）；在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容与类型；上传目录设为不可执行。
    # Python：白名单校验最终扩展 + 生成对象名
    ext = os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower()
    if ext not in {'.jpg', '.png', '.pdf'}:
        raise UploadRejected(ext)
    stored = f'{uuid4().hex}{ext}'
    # Nginx：上传目录禁执行
    location /uploads/ { location ~* \.(php|jsp|py|cgi)$ { deny all; } }
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, validate name, content, and type uniformly under target filesystem semantics, and make upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-2 anomalous samples alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate file flows keep working.

description.zh: 先上传正常文件记录响应、存储名与提示信息，推断黑名单或白名单的校验口径。命中判据：校验规则可以从响应中推断出来。

overview.zh: 上传文件名解析差异针对入口、存储层和静态文件服务器对多扩展名与文件名边界解释不同的场景：同一文件名在不同层产生不同结论。验证多个 filename 变体的存储名与判定结果对照。
overview.en: The upload filename-parser differential targets entry, storage, and static file servers interpreting multi-extension names and filename boundaries differently—the same name yields different conclusions per layer. It contrasts stored names and verdicts across filename variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是入口、存储层和静态文件服务器对多扩展名与文件名边界的解释不同；只有当差异使最终文件跨越类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is entry, storage, and static file servers interpreting multi-extension names and filename boundaries differently; risk holds only when the difference pushes the final file past a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步复用受控夹具中的 BASE 与 MARKER 变量，以 txt.jpg、jpg.txt、txt.bin 三种文件名变体逐一上传同一内容；命中判据为不同 filename 变体产生不同的存储名与判定结果，说明至少两层对边界解释不一致。每条上传后 HEAD 回读记录存储名、Content-Type 与处理器路由，形成解析差异矩阵。
exploitation.en: Reusing the fixture's BASE and MARKER variables as in step 1, upload the same content under txt.jpg, double-extension, case, and semicolon filename variants; a hit is different filename variants producing different stored names and verdicts, showing at least two layers disagree on the boundary. After each upload, HEAD-read back and record stored name, Content-Type, and handler routing to form a parsing-difference matrix.

mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, validate name, content, and type uniformly under target filesystem semantics, and have entry and storage consume the same normalized result; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and confirm stored names and verdicts agree while normal uploads work.

name.zh: Multipart 内容类型解析差异

description.zh: 代理、Web 服务器和应用框架对 multipart 边界与部件类型的解析不一致。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Multipart Content-Type Parser Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the proxy, web server, and application framework parse multipart boundaries and part types differently. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: Multipart 内容类型解析差异针对代理、Web 服务器和应用框架对 multipart 边界与部件类型解析不一致的场景：手工构造的报文可被不同层拆解为不同部件。验证定长 multipart 报文在解析端的处理。
overview.en: The multipart content-type parser differential targets proxies, web servers, and application frameworks disagreeing on multipart boundaries and part types: a hand-crafted message can decompose differently per layer. It validates how the parser handles a fixed-length multipart message.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是代理、Web 服务器和应用框架对 multipart 边界与部件类型的解析不一致；只有当解析差异使部件被不同层归入不同类型或处理器时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is proxies, web servers, and application frameworks disagreeing on multipart boundaries and part types; risk holds only when parsing differences route a part into different types or handlers per layer.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以原始 socket 向 127.0.0.1:8080 发送定长 multipart 报文（boundary 为 PAYLOADER_BOUNDARY）并回读完整响应；命中判据为应用端解析出的部件名、类型或存储结果与报文字面不一致，说明边界处理存在层间差异。对照 curl 标准上传的解析结果一并记录；同时核对 Content-Length 与实际字节数是否被各层一致采纳。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, send a fixed-length multipart message (boundary PAYLOADER_BOUNDARY) over a raw socket to 127.0.0.1:8080 and read back the full response; a hit is the application's parsed part name, type, or storage result diverging from the message literal, showing cross-layer boundary-handling differences. Record alongside a curl standard-upload control; also verify Content-Length versus actual byte count is adopted consistently across layers.

mitigation.zh:
各层解析策略对齐：入口对 multipart 边界与部件类型做严格格式校验，应用以单一解析器消费报文，歧义报文直接 400。
    # ModSecurity：multipart 边界格式非法即拒绝
    SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Content-Type "!@rx ^multipart/form-data;[ \t]*boundary=[A-Za-z0-9'()+_,./:=? -]{1,70}$" \
        "id:1001,phase:1,deny,status:400,msg:'malformed multipart boundary'"
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, parse and validate uploads uniformly, follow the specification for boundary handling, and have all layers consume one result; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 hand-crafted message against a standard-upload control and confirm parsing agrees while normal uploads work.

title.zh: 手工构造 multipart 报文

description.zh: 以原始 socket 发送定长 multipart 报文并回读完整响应。命中判据：服务器接受手工构造的报文。
description.en: Send a hand-built, fixed-length multipart message over raw socket. Success: the server accepts it.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import socket

host, port = "127.0.0.1", 8080
boundary = "PAYLOADER_BOUNDARY"
body = (
    f"--{boundary}\r\n"
    'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"\r\n'
    "Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\n"
    f"PAYLOADER_MARKER\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n"
).encode("ascii")
request = (
    "POST /upload HTTP/1.1\r\n"
    f"Host: {host}:{port}\r\n"
    f"Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}\r\n"
    f"Content-Length: {len(body)}\r\n"
    "Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
).encode("ascii") + body
with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=3) as sock:
    sock.sendall(request)
    print(sock.recv(4096).decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))
PY

name.zh: NTFS ADS 上传绕过

description.zh: 应用允许冒号文件名，而 NTFS 把后续部分解释为 Alternate Data Stream。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload NTFS ADS Filename narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the application permits colons while NTFS interprets the suffix as an Alternate Data Stream. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件名与文件系统边界

overview.zh: 上传 NTFS ADS 文件名针对应用允许冒号文件名而 NTFS 把冒号后内容解释为 Alternate Data Stream 的场景：冒号名在校验与存储两层含义不同。验证 ::$DATA、命名流等变体的存储与回读差异。
overview.en: Upload NTFS ADS filenames target cases where the application allows colon-containing names while NTFS interprets the suffix as an Alternate Data Stream, giving colon names different meanings at validation and storage layers. It contrasts storage and read-back across ::DATA and named-stream variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用允许冒号文件名，而 NTFS 把冒号后内容解释为 Alternate Data Stream；只有当该差异使内容越过类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application allowing colon-containing filenames while NTFS interprets content after the colon as an Alternate Data Stream; risk holds only when this difference lets content cross a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步依次上传 filename 为 PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt::$DATA、::$INDEX_ALLOCATION 与命名流三种冒号变体，每条上传后按命令中的 HEAD 请求回读；命中判据为某一变体的存储结果与校验阶段判定不一致（如内容写入默认流或流类型改变），记录冒号在两层的不同解释作为证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, upload the three colon variants PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt::DATA, ::INDEX_ALLOCATION, and a named stream as filenames, HEAD-reading back after each as shown in the command; a hit is any variant whose stored result diverges from the validation verdict (e.g., content written to the default stream or stream type changed)—record the colon's differing interpretations at the two layers as evidence.

mitigation.en: Reject colons and reserved stream syntax in filename validation, generate server-side object names, and validate uniformly under target filesystem semantics; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 colon variants and confirm uniform rejection while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 把脚本内容写入命名流中，躲避常规的文件枚举与内容检查。命中判据：指定流路径可读出隐藏的内容，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Write backdoor content into a named stream to dodge enumeration. Success: the stream path yields the content.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 已在 NTFS 卷准备隔离上传目录，并备好 ADS 命名的 dir /r 对照输出。
prerequisites.en: An isolated upload directory is ready on an NTFS volume, with dir /r output prepared as the ADS-naming contrast.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 编码冒号绕过 :: 检测。判据：ADS 写入成功。

title.zh: NTFS ADS 名称解析对照块

description.zh: NTFS ADS 名称边界验证块 1 — 对照 ::$DATA、命名流、::$INDEX_ALLOCATION、%00 截断与 PAYLOA~1 短名变体，验证应用层与 NTFS 层对同一名称的不同解释。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。条目为命名解析对照夹具，五类名称变体已与描述逐项对齐。
description.en: Contrasts ::$DATA, named streams, ::INDEX_ALLOCATION, %00 truncation, and the PAYLOA~1 short name, showing the application layer and NTFS interpret the same name differently. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique. The entry is a name-resolution comparison fixture; the five name variants now match the description item by item.

description.zh: NTFS 下 ::$INDEX_ALLOCATION 使带后缀路径按目录流解析，可绕过扩展名黑名单与「路径必须是文件」的类型校验，依赖 IIS 或自研存储层对 NTFS 命名流的解析差分；非 NTFS 卷（exFAT/FAT）无效。命中判据：服务端按目录语义处理该名称，类型校验被穿透。
description.en: On NTFS the ::$INDEX_ALLOCATION suffix makes the extension-bearing path resolve as a directory stream, bypassing extension blacklists and path-must-be-a-file type checks through the parsing differential between IIS or custom storage layers and the filesystem; invalid on non-NTFS volumes such as exFAT or FAT. Success: the server treats the name as a directory and the type gate is bypassed.

explanation.zh: 带后缀名称按目录流解析
explanation.en: Extension-bearing name resolves as a directory stream

title.zh: 上传 NTFS ADS 文件名验证块 1
title.en: Upload NTFS ADS Filename Validation Block 1

description.zh: 上传 ::$DATA、::$INDEX_ALLOCATION 与命名流三种冒号文件名并逐一 HEAD 回读，验证 NTFS 把冒号名解释为默认流或命名 ADS 的差异。
description.en: Uploads ::DATA, ::INDEX_ALLOCATION, and a named-stream colon filename and re-reads each via HEAD, showing NTFS resolves colon names to the default stream or a named ADS.

name.zh: 上传文件名空字节边界

description.zh: 文件名在 HTTP、字符串 API 和底层文件接口之间因 NUL 字节产生截断差异。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。版本边界：NUL 截断利用面依赖旧式 C 字符串文件接口，PHP < 5.3.4 的路径函数会把文件名在 NUL 处截断；PHP 5.3.4 起路径函数显式拒绝 NUL，现代语言栈该链路默认闭合，结论必须按组件版本区分。
description.en: Upload Filename Null-Byte Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a filename is truncated differently across HTTP, string APIs, and native file interfaces because of a NUL byte. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures. Version boundary: the truncation surface depends on legacy C-string file interfaces — PHP before 5.3.4 truncates filenames at a NUL byte, while PHP 5.3.4 and later reject NUL in path functions outright, so conclusions must be drawn per component version.

overview.zh: 上传文件名空字节边界针对文件名在 HTTP、字符串 API 和底层文件接口之间因 NUL 字节产生截断差异的场景：校验名与存储名可能不同。验证含 NUL 的 multipart 报文在两层的截断结果。
overview.en: The upload filename null-byte boundary targets filenames diverging across HTTP, string APIs, and low-level file interfaces due to NUL-byte truncation, so validated and stored names can differ. It contrasts truncation results at the two layers with NUL-bearing multipart messages.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是文件名在 HTTP、字符串 API 和底层文件接口之间因 NUL 字节产生截断差异；只有当截断使存储名越过类型或目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is filenames diverging across HTTP, string APIs, and low-level file interfaces due to NUL truncation; risk holds only when truncation pushes the stored name past a type or directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以原始 socket 发送文件名含 NUL 字节的 multipart 报文并回读完整响应，记录应用层返回的存储名与文件系统层实际落盘名；命中判据为两层截断点不同导致存储名与校验名不一致（如 NUL 后的扩展名被截去或保留）。对照正常无 NUL 上传形成基线；阴性时记录运行时版本说明 NUL 已被统一拒绝。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, send a multipart message with a NUL byte in the filename over a raw socket and read back the full response, recording the application-layer stored name versus the actual on-disk name; a hit is different truncation points at the two layers making the stored name diverge from the validated name (e.g., the post-NUL extension truncated or kept). Contrast with a normal no-NUL upload baseline; when negative, record the runtime version showing NUL is uniformly rejected.

mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, have all layers consume one normalized filename, and switch to server-side object names; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 NUL message against a normal control and confirm the truncation divergence is gone while normal uploads work.

title.zh: 发送含空字节文件名报文

description.zh: 以原始 socket 提交文件名含 NUL 字节的 multipart 报文并回读。命中判据：服务器未拒绝该报文。
description.en: Post a multipart message whose filename contains NUL via raw socket. Success: the server accepts it.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import socket

host, port = "127.0.0.1", 8080
boundary = b"PAYLOADER_BOUNDARY"
filename = b"PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt\x00.jpg"
body = b"--" + boundary + b"\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"" + filename + b"\"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nPAYLOADER_MARKER\r\n--" + boundary + b"--\r\n"
request = b"POST /upload HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:8080\r\nContent-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary + b"\r\nContent-Length: " + str(len(body)).encode("ascii") + b"\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n" + body
with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=3) as sock:
    sock.sendall(request)
    print(sock.recv(4096).decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))
PY

description.zh: 记录应用层与文件系统层对 NUL 的截断位置，找出解释差异。命中判据：两层截断口径存在不同，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Record where app and filesystem truncate at NUL. Success: the two layers disagree.

description.zh: 空字节置于主名内绕过位置检测。判据：落盘后缀为 php。失效条件：仅 PHP<5.3.4 或自研 C 层截断成立，现代解析器已修复。

description.en: Splits and rejoins the extension. Success: suffix restored to php. Fails when: holds only on PHP below 5.3.4 or custom C-level truncation; modern parsers reject null bytes in paths.

description.zh: 超长编码在旧解析器还原为截断。判据：php 生效。
description.en: Overlong form decodes to truncation on old parsers. Success: .php wins.

name.zh: 上传签名与内容不一致

description.zh: 校验器只检查少量 magic bytes，而下游组件继续消费完整文件。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Signature-Content Mismatch narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the validator checks only a short magic-byte prefix while downstream components consume the full file. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传签名与内容不一致针对校验器只检查少量 magic bytes 而下游继续消费完整文件的场景：文件头与实际内容可以完全不同。验证 JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP 四种魔术头夹具在检测与解析两层的差异。
overview.en: Upload signature-content mismatch targets validators checking only a few magic bytes while downstream keeps consuming the full file—header and actual content can differ entirely. It contrasts detection versus parsing layers across JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP magic-header fixtures.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是校验器只检查少量 magic bytes，而下游组件继续消费完整文件；只有当两层差异使文件进入非预期处理器时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validators checking only a few magic bytes while downstream components keep consuming the complete file; risk holds only when the two-layer difference routes the file into an unintended handler.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步生成 JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP 四种魔术头加 marker 尾部的夹具并输出文件大小与前 12 字节，确认头部按预期构造；再把四个夹具分别上传，命中判据为签名检测放行而下游解析行为与声明类型不符（解码失败或进入其他处理器）。记录每条的检测结论与下游处理结果对照。
exploitation.en: Generate the four fixtures—JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP magic headers with marker tails—per step 1, outputting file size and first 12 bytes to confirm construction; upload each fixture in turn. A hit is signature checks passing while downstream parsing diverges from the declared type (decode failure or entry into another handler). Record detection verdicts versus downstream handling per fixture as a contrast.

mitigation.zh:
对上传内容执行完整解码校验而非只查 magic bytes：图片用解码器全量验证，校验与业务处理消费同一文件，上传目录不可执行。
    from PIL import Image
    with Image.open(tmp) as im:
        im.verify()          # 完整结构校验
    with Image.open(tmp) as im:
        im.load()            # 强制全量解码，失败即拒绝
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, perform full decoding validation on upload content rather than header-only checks, and keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 fixtures and confirm uploads whose content mismatches the signature are rejected while normal image processing works.

description.zh: 生成 JPEG、PNG、GIF、BMP 四种魔术头加可控尾部的文件。命中判据：夹具头部合法而尾部内容可控。
description.en: Emit JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP headers with attacker-controlled tails. Success: headers pass while tails are yours.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

fixtures = {
    "marker.jpg": bytes.fromhex("FFD8FFE000104A464946") + b"PAYLOADER_MARKER",
    "marker.png": bytes.fromhex("89504E470D0A1A0A") + b"PAYLOADER_MARKER",
    "marker.gif": b"GIF89aPAYLOADER_MARKER",
    "marker.bmp": b"BM" + (54).to_bytes(4, "little") + b"\x00" * 48 + b"PAYLOADER_MARKER",
}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="payloader-signature-") as directory:
    root = Path(directory)
    for name, data in fixtures.items():
        path = root / name
        path.write_bytes(data)
        assert path.read_bytes().endswith(b"PAYLOADER_MARKER")
        print(name, len(data), data[:12].hex())
PY

description.zh: 提交夹具文件通过仅检查文件签名的上传检测流程。命中判据：文件被接受并成功落盘存储，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Submit the fixtures against signature-only checks. Success: they are accepted and stored.

description.zh: 让下游按真实内容解析文件，触发注入代码或异常执行路径。命中判据：注入的尾部内容被解析执行，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Get downstream to parse the real content. Success: the injected tail is parsed or executed.

name.zh: Windows 尾随字符上传绕过

description.zh: 尾随空格、点、分号或控制编码在上传校验后被 Windows 或 Web 服务器折叠。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Windows Trailing Filename narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: trailing spaces, dots, semicolons, or encoded controls are folded after upload validation. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件名与文件系统边界

overview.zh: 上传 Windows 尾随文件名针对尾随空格、点、分号或控制编码在校验后被 Windows 或 Web 服务器折叠的场景：校验名与落盘名可能不同。验证两个阶段对文件名的解释差异，以回读存储名为证据。
overview.en: Upload Windows trailing filenames target cases where trailing spaces, dots, semicolons, or control encodings are folded by Windows or the web server after validation, diverging the validated name from the stored name. It contrasts the two phases' interpretations using read-back storage names as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是尾随空格、点、分号或控制编码在上传校验后被 Windows 或 Web 服务器折叠；只有当折叠使最终名称跨越类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is trailing spaces, dots, semicolons, or control encodings being folded by Windows or the web server after upload validation; risk holds only when folding pushes the final name across a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步与第 2 步的验证块逐条上传：先测尾随空格（原样与 %20）、%00 截断与制表符 %09 变体，再测尾随点、多点、点空格混排与分号截断；每条上传后 HEAD 回读确认落盘名。命中判据为校验阶段接受的名称在落盘后被折叠为其他扩展名或类型，记录两个阶段的名称差异作为证据。
exploitation.en: Upload item by item through the verification blocks of steps 1 and 2: first trailing spaces (raw, %20, %09) and %00 truncation variants, then trailing dots, multiple dots, dot-space mixes, and semicolon truncation; HEAD-read back the stored name after each upload. A hit is a name accepted at validation being folded into a different extension or type on disk—record the two-phase name divergence as evidence.

mitigation.zh:
校验前对文件名显式规范化，拒绝尾随空格、点、分号与控制字符（Windows 会在校验后折叠）；生成服务端对象名与用户名解耦；上传目录不可执行。
    # Python：尾随异常字符一律拒绝，再生成服务端对象名
    import re
    if re.search(r'[. ;\r\n\x00-\x1f]$', name):
        raise UploadRejected(name)
    stored = f'{uuid4().hex}{ext}'
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names and normalize filenames explicitly before validation, rejecting control characters, trailing dots/spaces, and semicolons; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-2 variants alongside normal samples and confirm the folding divergence is gone while legitimate uploads work.

description.zh: 上传普通文件观察校验层与落盘层对文件名的处理差异，记录两层各自的解释结果。命中判据：两层行为可以清楚区分。

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import requests

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
names = [
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt.",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt ",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt::$DATA",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.TXT",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt" + "/./" * 64,
]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="payloader-name-") as directory:
    marker = Path(directory) / "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
    marker.write_text("PAYLOADER_MARKER", encoding="utf-8")
    for name in names:
        with marker.open("rb") as handle:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE}/upload", files={"file": (name, handle, "text/plain")}, timeout=3)
        print(repr(name), response.status_code)
PY

description.en: Post-Upload Wrapper Reference Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a post-upload file reference is handed to zip, phar, or another runtime wrapper for further interpretation. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传后包装器引用边界针对上传后的文件引用被交给 zip、phar 等运行时 wrapper 继续解释的场景：引用路径可指向归档内部成员。验证两类归档 wrapper 引用能否按路径读到成员内容。
overview.en: The post-upload wrapper reference boundary targets uploaded file references being handed to runtime wrappers like zip and phar for further interpretation, where a reference path can point inside archives. It validates whether the two archive wrapper references read member content by path.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传后的文件引用被交给 zip、phar 或其他运行时 wrapper 继续解释；只有当解释结果跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is uploaded file references being handed to zip, phar, or other runtime wrappers for continued interpretation; risk holds only when the interpretation crosses an expected directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步分别提交 zip:///tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.zip#marker.txt 与 phar:///tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.phar/marker.txt 两条引用；命中判据为按引用读到归档成员内容。记录 wrapper 选择与成员解析日志；命中后核对入口是读取还是 include 语义，后者按代码执行单独取证。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the two references zip:///tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.zip#marker.txt and phar:///tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.phar/marker.txt separately; a hit is member content read by reference path. Log wrapper selection and member resolution; on a hit, determine whether the entry reads or includes—the latter needs separate code-execution evidence.

mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay both step-1 references and confirm wrapper references are rejected while object-ID reads work.

name.zh: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断

description.zh: 使用 URL 编码空字节和后缀组合验证旧版 PHP 或底层 C 文件 API 是否在安全校验与最终打开之间截断路径；现代 PHP 通常拒绝 NUL，必须以实际版本和文件访问证据判定。精确边界：空字节路径截断仅对 PHP < 5.3.4（路径函数开始拒绝 NUL 之前）及直接调用 C 字符串 API 的旧组件成立；PHP >= 5.3.4 现代栈该链路预期失败，命中证据须附带组件版本。
description.en: Uses URL-encoded null bytes and suffix combinations to test whether legacy PHP or an underlying C file API truncates a path between validation and final open; modern PHP generally rejects NUL, so findings require version and file-access evidence. Precise boundary: NUL path truncation holds only for PHP before 5.3.4 (before path functions reject NUL) and legacy components calling C-string APIs directly; on PHP 5.3.4+ the chain is expected to fail, and any hit must cite the component version.

overview.zh: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断针对 URL 解码后的 NUL 跨过后缀拼接并在底层文件 API 中提前终止路径的场景。验证 %00 与后缀组合在目标运行时的截断效果，以实际版本和文件访问证据判定。
overview.en: Legacy PHP file-path null-byte truncation targets URL-decoded NUL crossing suffix concatenation and terminating the path early in low-level file APIs. It validates %00-with-suffix combinations against the target runtime, judged by actual version and file-access evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 URL 解码后的 NUL 跨过应用后缀拼接并在底层文件 API 中提前终止路径；现代 PHP 通常拒绝 NUL，阳性必须证明 NUL 后缀在最终文件调用前被截断并实际读取隔离标记。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is URL-decoded NUL crossing application suffix concatenation and terminating the path early in low-level file APIs; modern PHP usually rejects NUL, and a positive must prove the NUL suffix was truncated before the final file call and an isolated marker was actually read.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 /etc/passwd%00.php、%00 截断与遍历加后缀变体，并把系统目标替换为授权范围内的测试标记；命中判据为老版本 PHP 下 %00 截断读取到目标文件，新版本返回拼接路径错误。每条记录运行时版本、PHP 文件函数与响应差异；阴性时注明版本号，作为现代运行时已拒绝 NUL 的证据，不要把旧版本语义套到当前目标。
exploitation.en: Submit /etc/passwd%00.php, %00 truncation, and traversal-with-suffix variants one by one per step 1, replacing system targets with in-scope test markers; a hit is %00 truncation reading the target on legacy PHP, while newer versions return a concatenated-path error. Record runtime version, PHP file function, and response differences per request; when negative, note the version as evidence modern runtimes reject NUL—never assume legacy semantics for the current target.

mitigation.en: Upgrade to supported PHP, reject control characters and NUL, parse canonical absolute paths after full decoding, and enforce a fixed root before file APIs. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and legitimate samples, confirm NUL inputs are rejected and normal upload/read flows persist, and clear fixed markers from test objects and logs.

title.zh: 界定“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”入口
